title: AuraLuxMuse: Adaptive Fusion Modeling for Aesthetic Stage Lighting Design with Music and Expert Guidance
comment: Accepted to appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: We present AuraLuxMuse, a novel system for automated aesthetic stage lighting design that integrates expert knowledge, representation learning, and preference-adaptive modeling. Lighting design in live performance settings requires the seamless translation of musical features into dynamic lighting behaviors. However, traditional workflows remain time-consuming, labor-intensive, and difficult to transfer. AuraLuxMuse encodes music and professional cue sequences into a shared retrieval space, estimates cue-event density, and retargets selected fixture commands to the destination stage. It assists pre-production authoring by returning editable cues rather than replacing the designer with an unconstrained generator. At the heart of AuraLuxMuse are two key modules: Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP), which performs contrastive learning between audio and lighting cues for alignment, and Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE), which conditions preference-aware cue retrieval and adaptation on designers' intent through a gated ensemble of style-specific expert networks. To support training and evaluation, we introduce Musilux, the first dataset of paired musical audio and professional lighting cue sequences under diverse performance scenarios. We evaluate AuraLuxMuse across both virtual simulation environments and professional-grade laboratories. Experimental results, including objective and subjective evaluation, demonstrate that AuraLuxMuse retrieves and adapts stage-lighting cues that are visually cohesive, semantically meaningful, and artistically expressive, showing its potential for AI-assisted aesthetic stage design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AuraLuxMuse 系统，通过音乐-灯光对齐预训练（LAMP）与偏好自适应专家混合（PAMoE）实现可编辑的自动化舞台灯光设计，并发布配对数据集 Musilux，在虚拟环境与专业实验室中验证了其在视觉连贯性、语义合理性与艺术表现力上的优势。
AI.motivation: 现场演出的灯光设计需要将音乐特征无缝转化为动态灯光行为，但传统工作流耗时长、人力密集且难以迁移复用，因此需要一种既能融入专家知识、又能适配设计师偏好、并可跨场地复用的自动化辅助系统。
AI.method: 方法上，将音乐与专业灯光指令序列编码到共享检索空间，估计灯光事件密度，并将选定的灯具指令重定向到目标舞台；核心包含两个模块：LAMP 通过音频与灯光指令的对比学习实现跨模态对齐；PAMoE 通过门控的、风格特异的专家网络集成，基于设计师意图进行偏好感知的指令检索与适配；系统输出可编辑的 cue 而非由无约束生成器取代设计师。
AI.result: 构建并发布 Musilux 数据集，为首个覆盖多样演出场景的音乐音频与专业灯光指令序列配对数据集；在虚拟仿真环境与专业级实验室中开展客观与主观评估，结果表明 AuraLuxMuse 检索并适配出的舞台灯光 cue 具有视觉连贯性、语义意义和艺术表现力。
AI.conclusion: AuraLuxMuse 展示了 AI 辅助美学舞台设计的潜力，其以专家知识、表示学习与偏好自适应建模相结合的方式，在保留设计师主导权的前提下提升了灯光设计的效率与可迁移性。

title: From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"感知到认知评价"的多模态情感理解新范式，并构建数据集 CogEmo-40K、模型 CogEmo-MoE 与基准 CogEmo-Bench（含 AEQS 指标），实验表明该范式在评价推理上领先且具强跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型的情感理解主要依赖可观察的情感线索进行推理，容易退化为表层的"线索—标签"关联，产生 Clever Hans 效应；当情感线索隐含、跨模态冲突、语言误导或被冗余细节遮蔽时，这种捷径便不可靠。而人类情感取决于个体对事件的主观解释与评价，因此需要超越表层线索的推理范式。
AI.method: 受情感评价理论启发，将多模态情感理解形式化为"从感知到认知评价"的递进过程，并构建三部分支撑：1）CogEmo-40K，通过感知—评价流水线构建的大规模指令微调数据集，覆盖情感背后的六个认知评价维度，用于激发基于证据的推理；2）CogEmo-MoE，紧凑的稀疏 MLLM，引入交错 MoE 模块实现评价维度的专门化适配，在远小于典型情感 MLLM 的规模下完成有效评价推理；3）CogEmo-Bench，提出 Appraisal Evidence Quality Score（AEQS），从六个互补评价维度评估认知—情感理解，弥补传统情感指标只评"预测何种情感"而不评"为何产生"的缺陷。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，该范式不仅在 CogEmo-Bench 上取得领先表现，还展现出较强的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，感知—评价式推理可使多模态情感理解摆脱表层线索—标签关联，走向更可靠的理解，并促进 MLLM 与人类之间更接近的认知对齐。

title: A Camera-Native Stereo VR180 Dataset
summary: Immersive VR180 video is increasingly produced with professional stereo fisheye cameras, yet public VR180 research resources are mostly collected from online platforms such as YouTube: already stitched, projected and compressed by unknown pipelines, and without lens calibration. We present a firsthand-captured stereo VR180 dataset recorded with two Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive cameras. It contains 1,211 samples -- 636 stereo video clips (2,220.8 s, mostly 90 fps) and 575 stereo stills -- each released as camera-native Blackmagic RAW, separate-eye native fisheye HEVC (8160x7200 per eye) and half-equirectangular HEVC (7200x7200 per eye), together with the factory lens calibration, portable fisheye/half-equirectangular conversion tools and AI-generated scene and visual-challenge annotations. Re-encoding the released fisheye and half-equirectangular renders with x265 over 24 clips, both eyes, four rate points and nine viewing directions, native-fisheye coding needed more bitrate than half-equirectangular coding at equal viewport quality for all 24 clips (median +38%), in every part of the field of view. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lulinxuan/VR180 ; code: https://github.com/lulinxuan/vr180-dataset-tools

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个第一手采集的立体VR180数据集（1211个样本），以相机原生RAW、原生鱼眼HEVC和半等距柱状HEVC三种形式发布，并附带镜头标定与转换工具；实验表明在同等视口质量下，原生鱼眼编码比半等距柱状编码需要更高码率（中位数+38%）。
AI.motivation: 现有公开VR180研究资源多来自YouTube等在线平台，已被未知流程拼接、投影和压缩，且缺少镜头标定，难以支撑可复现、可溯源的研究。作者希望提供第一手采集、未经未知处理的VR180数据与标定信息。
AI.method: 使用两台Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive相机拍摄立体VR180内容，构建含1211个样本的数据集（636个立体视频片段共2220.8秒、多为90fps，以及575张立体静态图）。每个样本以三种形式发布：相机原生Blackmagic RAW、分眼原生鱼眼HEVC（每眼8160x7200）和半等距柱状HEVC（每眼7200x7200），并提供工厂镜头标定、可移植的鱼眼/半等距柱状转换工具及AI生成的场景与视觉挑战标注。随后对24个片段的鱼眼与半等距柱状渲染结果用x265重编码，覆盖双眼、四个码率点和九个观看方向，比较视口质量与码率关系。
AI.result: 在全部24个片段中，于同等视口质量下，原生鱼眼编码比半等距柱状编码需要更高码率，中位数高出38%，且这一现象在视场的各个区域均成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可溯源、带标定的第一手立体VR180数据集及配套工具，并揭示原生鱼眼编码在等视口质量下编码效率劣于半等距柱状表示，为VR180采集、表示与编码研究提供了基础资源与实证依据。数据与代码已公开。

title: Controlled Acquisition and Abstention in Three-Channel Score Conflicts
summary: When audio, video, and text disagree, accuracy alone does not show whether to acquire another source or abstain. We study these choices in a controlled three-score benchmark: a policy observes two signed scores, may request the third at a cost, and can abstain. The primary reward is mechanism-specific: abstention is correct only for one designated ambiguity mechanism and is penalized under mixed corruption. Matched controls show that a threshold policy matches always-request decisions with fewer requests; its advantage over always-answer fusion depends on the reward assigned to that ambiguity. On a partially held-out synthetic split, the threshold policy reaches 0.789 +/- 0.006 targeted decision accuracy and 0.481 +/- 0.014 utility across 83 seeds. A three-score majority reference reaches 0.626 +/- 0.008 and 0.252 +/- 0.016, but uses more information. In a matched-budget test, a train-only value selector improves utility over no-query and matched-random policies at 10% and 25% budgets, while pair uncertainty has higher utility at every budget. At 50% and 63.7% budgets, the selector lowers utility despite slightly higher non-ambiguous accuracy. If all abstentions are scored incorrect, majority outranks the threshold policy in utility. At a central temporal setting, full-trace controls match the neural models while position perturbations separate them. On held-out-actor emotion clips, eight-frame fusion has opposite-signed accuracy differences for two encoder pairs, with both actor intervals containing zero; matched-request routing gains are small and uncertain. These results separate full-modality accuracy from pre-request selection value and show that selection value depends on budget and the observed-pair ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文在多模态（音频、视频、文本）三评分设定下，研究"请求额外信息或弃权"的决策问题，区分全模态精度与请求前选择价值，发现选择价值依赖预算与已观测对的排序。
AI.motivation: 在多模态信息不一致时，仅靠精度指标无法判断何时应追加信息源或弃权。作者希望将"全模态精度"与"请求前的选择价值"分离，并考察奖励机制（弃权仅在特定歧义机制下正确）如何影响决策策略的优劣。
AI.method: 构建受控三评分基准：策略观测两个带符号分数，可有偿请求第三个分数，并可弃权。设定机制特定奖励（仅一种指定歧义机制下弃权正确，混合污染下弃权受罚），并配以匹配对照、匹配预算测试、阈值策略、三分数多数参考、仅训练集价值选择器，以及在情绪片段上的八帧融合与匹配请求路由实验。
AI.result: 在部分留出合成划分、83个随机种子下，阈值策略达到目标决策精度0.789±0.006、效用0.481±0.014；三分数多数参考为0.626±0.008与0.252±0.016但用更多信息。匹配预算下，仅训练集选择器在10%、25%预算上优于不查询与匹配随机策略，配对不确定性在各预算下效用更高；但在50%、63.7%预算下选择器效用更低，尽管非歧义精度略高。若所有弃权均判为错误，多数法效用反超阈值策略。时间中心设置下全轨迹对照与神经模型相当，位置扰动可区分二者；情绪片段上两个编码器对的八帧融合精度差异符号相反且区间含零，匹配请求路由收益小而不确定。
AI.conclusion: 结果将全模态精度与请求前选择价值区分开来，表明选择价值取决于预算以及已观测对的排序；阈值策略可在更少请求下匹配总是请求的决策，其相对融合的优势取决于歧义奖励设定。

title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

AI.tldr: ActiveMedAgent：面向多模态医学AI的成本感知序贯诊断框架，基于冻结VLM，用MLP控制器离线学习何时追加证据、何时给出诊断，三基准上优于无引导采集与全模态基线，并发现信息过载效应。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断本质上是序贯的：医生只在对消除诊断不确定性有预期收益时才从廉价检查升级到昂贵检查。现有多模态医学AI通常一次性使用全部模态，忽略了检查的成本与获取顺序。
AI.method: 在冻结的、仅通过API访问的视觉语言模型之上构建ActiveMedAgent：维护候选诊断的概率分布，对每次证据获取按"每步诊断效用减去成本"打分；在此基础上离线训练一个轻量MLP控制器，从打分轨迹中学习何时请求额外证据、何时终止并给出结论。
AI.result: 在三个常用基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习持续优于无引导采集和全模态基线。识别出信息过载效应：在175个案例中，智能体用更少的模态通道即可给出正确诊断，而全模态基线失败。
AI.conclusion: 学习"舍弃哪些信息"与学习"获取哪些信息"同等重要；成本感知的序贯采集策略可为多模态医学AI带来更优的诊断效率与准确率。

title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
summary: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

AI.tldr: 提出 LadderEdit，在每次获得编辑后即时压缩其 LoRA 适配器，用"阶梯式"低秩草图与按需升秩策略降低终身编辑的存储开销。
AI.motivation: 终身编辑大语言模型需要存储数千条编辑。主流的"每条编辑一个 LoRA 适配器"方案虽能保持模型行为，但存储量随编辑数线性增长，难以扩展。
AI.method: 每条编辑先以低秩形式存为廉价草图（sketch），随后在探针提示（probe prompts）上检验该草图是否仍满足改写、泛化与局部性契约：通过者保留草图，失败者沿"阶梯"逐级升秩，直至满足契约。由于每条编辑都保留一定表征，覆盖性得以维持，只有困难编辑才消耗更多秩。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B 上，于 ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit 三个基准测试中，LadderEdit 以约 5.2 倍更少的内存达到与精确 LoRA 存储相当的性能，并在 50,000 条顺序编辑下仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过按编辑难度自适应分配秩的压缩策略，LadderEdit 在保持编辑契约（改写、泛化、局部性）的同时显著降低存储，使超大规模终身编辑更具可行性。

title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
summary: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"证据充分性"（evidential sufficiency）作为短视频事实核查的证据选择标准，构建 MiniVer-V 基准（195个短视频、5,510个多模态证据单元、三分类判决），并提出两层验证框架配合充分性驱动的贪心搜索，以约16%的证据量达到与全证据基线统计上不可区分的 Macro-F1，并显著提升"证据不足"案例的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 短视频事实核查的核心挑战在于判断哪些证据足以支撑验证结论。现有方法要么将全部证据交给验证器而引入噪声，要么按主题相关性选择证据，混淆了"相关"与"充分"。作者据此将"证据充分性"（证据子集是否足以在无冗余情况下支撑一个置信判决）明确为证据选择准则。
AI.method: 构建 MiniVer-V 基准，包含195个短视频、三分类判决标注（supported、refuted、insufficient）以及5,510个多模态证据单元（视觉关键帧、语音转录、网络检索外部来源）。提出两层验证框架：第一层基于内部证据评估"主张—视频一致性"，第二层在此之外引入外部佐证以进行事实判决。框架之上采用充分性驱动的贪心搜索，持续聚合证据直至满足充分性阈值；当候选池耗尽时输出 insufficient 而非强行给出判决。
AI.result: 使用 Claude Sonnet 4，方法平均仅用4.5个证据单元（占全部证据集的16%）即达到 Macro-F1 0.510，与全证据基线（0.518，使用27.7个单元）在统计上不可区分；相比不带弃权机制的同类搜索，显著提升了 insufficient 案例的识别。效率结论在 GPT-5.5 上得到复现，在开源权重验证器 Qwen2.5-72B 上仅部分成立。消融实验表明外部证据对事实判决不可或缺，而内部视频证据将判决锚定于"主张—视频一致性"。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明证据高效的验证是可行的，同时在证据确实不充分时，显式弃权（abstention）是必要的。该工作为短视频事实核查提供了新的证据选择准则、基准与验证框架。

title: SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
summary: Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.

AI.tldr: SignRAG：结合分层预训练、目标域检索增强与检索感知强化微调的统一无gloss手语翻译框架，基于decoder-only LLM，在多个SLT基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有无gloss手语翻译（SLT）预训练范式多围绕传统encoder-decoder预训练语言模型设计，难以直接适配decoder-only LLM，因此需要专门针对decoder-only架构的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 分层预训练：先学习具有语言学基础的符号表征，再将手语编码器与LLM联合对齐，缓解跨模态优化不平衡；2) 目标域检索增强：在参数微调之外引入检索库提供实例级翻译线索；3) 检索效用引导的强化微调（RUG-RFT）：结合翻译质量奖励与检索效用奖励，鼓励有益的检索使用并抑制有害依赖。
AI.result: 在多个SLT基准上达到新的SOTA；在CSL-Daily上，据作者所知是首个在所有报告指标上超越gloss监督方法的无gloss方法。
AI.conclusion: SignRAG有效解决decoder-only LLM在无gloss SLT中的适配问题，并首次在CSL-Daily全指标上超过gloss监督方法；代码与多规模模型已开源以支持后续研究。

title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
comment: Accepted to British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出用复数神经网络融合视觉-文本与音频-文本相似度，实现开放词汇音视频事件定位，在OV-AVEBench与AVE上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇音视频事件定位方法将视觉-文本与音频-文本两个余弦相似度用固定规则（几何平均、加权平均）压成单一标量后再取argmax，融合方式僵化，无法自适应学习跨模态相似度的组合关系。
AI.method: 计算复值相似度并用复值神经网络（CVNN）学习融合。各模态标准表示作为实部，配对伴随流提供虚部：视觉模态使用iHSV的虚部，音频模态使用CycleGAN转换的相位谱图。由此得到两个复值相似度再进行融合。视觉与音频编码器（如ImageBind）冻结，仅训练时间注意力块与融合CVNN，形成四流复值架构；另提出双流替代方案。
AI.result: 在OV-AVEBench开放（未见类）划分上达到66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1（较此前微调基线提升+1.6/+4.1/+6.6），已见类同样一致提升；在改造后的AVE数据集上达到60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，均刷新SOTA。双流方案也较基线显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 用复值表示与CVNN学习跨模态相似度融合，替代固定规则融合，能有效提升开放词汇音视频事件定位性能，在多个基准上取得SOTA。

title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS'26. Project page: https://vincie-next.github.io/
summary: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: VINCIE-NExT 通过"视频→图像→图像→视频"的可组合子任务链与上下文视觉示范，将图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑，无需大规模配对视频数据，并在 OpenVE-Bench 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑比视频生成更难，核心瓶颈在于（源视频、指令、编辑后视频）三元组标注成本极高、难以规模化合成；而图像编辑领域已有数百万现成配对数据，能力成熟。因此作者希望在缺乏大规模配对视频编辑数据的前提下，把图像编辑能力迁移到视频。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 VINCIE-NExT：将视频编辑分解为结构化可组合子任务链（Video → Image → Image → Video），把编辑意图路由到图像域，从而在统一扩散目标下对异构图像与视频语料进行可扩展的联合训练。将模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑对作为上下文视觉示范前置，充当每一输出帧的空间外观蓝图；并引入新型位置编码，把图像示范与视频帧链接到共享空间坐标系，实现外观变化的像素级忠实传播。Chain-of-Editing 将子任务链作为渐进式扩散阶段执行，支持无需重训练即可通过增加算力提升编辑质量（测试时扩展）。
AI.result: 在 OpenVE-Bench 上的综合实验表明，该方法在多种编辑类别上均达到最先进（state-of-the-art）性能；消融实验验证了各组成部分的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文视觉示范迁移图像编辑能力、并借助 Chain-of-Editing 实现测试时算力扩展，VINCIE-NExT 为缓解视频编辑配对数据稀缺问题提供了可行路径，并展现出领先的编辑性能。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
summary: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

AI.tldr: 提出逐场景框架，用相对位姿引导的 RGB-D 图像复用替代邻近视角的重复 3DGS 渲染，几何 warp 结合轻量多尺度网络预测 RGB 残差。
AI.motivation: 交互式场景探索中视角频繁更新，但小幅度相机运动下可见内容高度重叠；传统 3D Gaussian Splatting 对每个目标视角都完整渲染，未利用这种图像重叠，导致重复计算。
AI.method: 逐场景（per-scene）框架：利用深度与相对位姿进行几何 warping 传输源视角内容；轻量多尺度网络预测 RGB 残差，修正伪影并推断新暴露区域的缺失外观；同时缓存源特征以减少重复计算。
AI.result: 在 GS-render 数据上，残差细化相比纯 warping 提升 PSNR 约 0.72 dB；在实拍与渲染场景上的评估显示查询延迟低，验证了图像复用对邻近视角更新的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将场景渲染与局部视角更新解耦，可支撑响应式场景探索，在增强现实与虚拟现实中具有应用潜力。

title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration.
  SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time.
  Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构化潜在视觉推理框架SLVR，将多模态推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择与整合的带类型潜在阶段，在避免推理时生成文本思维链的同时提升细粒度视觉推理性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型常依赖语言先验而非任务相关的视觉证据来回答视觉推理问题。文本思维链虽能部分缓解，但自回归生成中间步骤会增加推理成本；现有潜在推理方法对中间状态编码内容缺乏控制，难以分别对规划、定位、证据选择施加监督。
AI.method: SLVR首先通过掩蔽揭示答案的文本并将正确答案与视觉上合理的干扰项进行对比，训练模型依赖图像；随后将推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择与整合四个潜在阶段，并分别用计划、边界框、视觉证据和最终推理理由作为对应阶段的监督信号，从而在不在推理时生成文本链的前提下赋予潜在推理明确的功能结构。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建，SLVR在多模态推理基准上取得一致提升：MMVP绝对提升+9.4，BLINK Relation提升+14.2，并在V*、MathVista和ChartQA上也有改进。
AI.conclusion: 结构化潜在监督能够在不引入文本思维链解码开销的情况下改善细粒度视觉推理。

title: Seeing Through the Glare: A Multi-Source Benchmark and Ocular-Adaptive Pixel MeanFlow for Eyeglass Reflection Removal
summary: Eyeglass reflection removal is important across smartphone imaging, video conferencing, and other face-centric visual applications. The task is challenging because reflections range from mild photometric contamination to severe ocular occlusion, requiring selective correction and plausible reconstruction without altering identity or natural appearance. Existing datasets cover limited reflection conditions, constraining generalization to complex real-world scenes and systematic evaluation. We introduce \textbf{OcuBench}, a multi-source benchmark comprising 10,280 controllable synthetic pairs, 732 real-input pseudo-pairs, and 458 independent real-world test images, supporting both paired evaluation and assessment beyond generated supervision. We further propose \textbf{OcuFlow}, an ocular-adaptive pixel MeanFlow (pMF) framework for efficient, detail-preserving restoration. It combines geometry-adaptive representation with one-step pMF to focus reconstruction on reflection-obscured ocular regions, together with native-resolution frequency-preserving synthesis to retain reliable observed details. Experiments across diverse reflection conditions demonstrate that OcuFlow achieves consistent advantages in reflection removal quality, ocular fidelity, and efficiency. In a blind user study, it receives $67.32\%$ of selections, $6.2\times$ the next-best share. Both the code and dataset will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对眼镜反光去除任务，提出多源基准数据集OcuBench与基于眼周自适应像素MeanFlow的高效修复框架OcuFlow，在反光去除质量、眼部保真度与效率上取得一致优势。
AI.motivation: 眼镜反光去除在智能手机成像、视频会议等以人脸为中心的视觉应用中十分重要，但该任务存在挑战：反光从轻微的光度污染到严重的眼部遮挡不等，需要选择性校正与合理重建，同时不改变身份特征或自然外观。现有数据集覆盖的反光条件有限，制约了方法在复杂真实场景中的泛化能力与系统性评估。
AI.method: 作者提出OcuBench多源基准，包含10,280对可控合成图像对、732对真实输入伪图像对及458张独立真实测试图像，同时支持配对评估与生成监督之外的评测。方法上提出OcuFlow，即眼周自适应像素MeanFlow（pMF）框架，结合几何自适应表示与一步pMF，将重建聚焦于被反光遮挡的眼部区域，并采用原生分辨率保频合成以保留可靠的观测细节。
AI.result: 在多种反光条件下的实验表明，OcuFlow在反光去除质量、眼部保真度和效率方面均取得一致优势。在盲测用户研究中，其获得67.32%的选择率，为次优方法的6.2倍。代码与数据集将公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过构建覆盖多样反光条件的多源基准OcuBench与高效的眼周自适应一步生成框架OcuFlow，为眼镜反光去除提供了更系统的评估平台与更优的修复方案。

title: LinSlot: Exploiting Linear Representation hypothesis for unsupervised attribute discovery from slot based object representation
summary: This paper studies the problem of learning disentangled representations of objects and their attributes from raw, unstructured image data. Slot-based methods have shown considerable success in unsupervised learning of object representations from images. Block-slot attention-based methods extend this framework to attribute representations by assuming a uniform factorization of object representations into attributes, which may be suboptimal and consequently limit the quality of the learned representations. We therefore investigate a framework for jointly discovering object and attribute representations. Our key contribution is leveraging the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which postulates that composable concepts can be represented as linearly additive subspaces in slot representations. Based on this insight, we propose a probabilistic model connecting images, slots (objects), and blocks (attributes). We present an architecture that leverages block attention to connect attribute representations to slots and incorporates LRH in both object and attribute representation spaces. This architecture effectively optimizes the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) of the proposed graphical model. Our experiments demonstrate (i) effective discovery of disentangled object and attribute representations, (ii) empirical evidence for LRH in slot space, and (iii) the ability to perform image editing owing to the disentangled and interpretable nature of the learned representations. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in DCI scores over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合发现图像中物体与属性解耦表示的概率框架，核心是引入线性表示假说（LRH）并将其融入基于block attention的slot架构中，实现物体与属性表示的联合学习。
AI.motivation: 现有基于slot的无监督物体表示方法在扩展到属性表示时，通常假设物体表示可均匀分解为属性，这种假设可能并非最优，从而限制了所学表示的质量。因此需要一种能够联合发现物体与属性表示的框架。
AI.method: 基于线性表示假说（LRH）——可组合概念可表示为slot表示中线性可加的子空间——构建了一个连接图像、slot（物体）与block（属性）的概率模型；提出一种架构，利用block attention将属性表示连接到slot，并在物体与属性表示空间中同时引入LRH；该架构有效优化所提图模型的ELBO。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i) 能有效发现解耦的物体与属性表示；(ii) 为slot空间中的LRH提供了经验证据；(iii) 由于表示具有解耦性和可解释性，具备图像编辑能力。在多个数据集上，DCI分数相比当前最先进方法有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入线性表示假说并联合建模物体与属性表示，本文方法在解耦性、可解释性和图像编辑方面均取得优势，并在DCI指标上超越现有最先进方法。

title: MESSENGER: Memory-Enhanced Sequential Scene Flow Estimation via Autoregressive Next-Frame Forecasting
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger
summary: Scene flow can capture low-level 3D motion displacements in dynamic scenarios. Early pairwise estimators relying on instantaneous two-frame motion lack long-term temporal correlation and also struggle with poor extrapolation ability in future prediction. Although some recent methods attempt to explore multi-frame scene flow estimation in a sequence-to-sequence manner, they typically suffer from heavy computational overhead with increasing input frames and long-horizon prediction degradation due to ineffective motion propagation. To address these problems, we propose a novel memory-enhanced sequential scene flow pipeline, called MESSENGER. To sufficiently mine long-term temporal dependencies naturally within consecutive sequences, a memory buffer is designed by explicitly storing multiple history flow estimates and latent states. For each input frame, the temporally stored flows and states are correlated and retrieved to predict the current initialized flow in a next-frame forecasting manner. Furthermore, we develop an uncertainty-aware reweighting module to filter unreliable retrievals and mitigate accumulated errors. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of our MESSENGER, reducing EPE3D by 71.6% on nuScenes and 67.7% on Argoverse 2 in long-horizon future extrapolation. This superiority can be attributed to our designed autoregressive forecasting paradigm, which naturally forces the network to progressively learn the next-frame distribution based on history observations. Code will be released at https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger.

AI.tldr: 提出记忆增强的顺序场景流估计框架MESSENGER，通过记忆缓冲存储历史流和潜状态，结合不确定性感知重加权模块，实现长时程预测并显著降低EPE3D误差。
AI.motivation: 早期成对场景流估计依赖瞬时双帧运动，缺乏长期时序关联，未来外推能力差；近期多帧序列到序列方法随输入帧增加计算开销大，且因运动传播低效导致长时程预测性能退化。
AI.method: 设计记忆缓冲，显式存储多个历史流估计与潜状态；对每帧输入，关联并检索时序存储的流和状态，以预测下一帧的方式初始化当前流；提出不确定性感知重加权模块过滤不可靠检索、缓解累积误差；构建自回归预测范式。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上达到最先进性能，长时程未来外推中EPE3D分别降低71.6%和67.7%。
AI.conclusion: 自回归预测范式自然促使网络基于历史观测逐步学习下一帧分布，验证了记忆增强与不确定性重加权在长时程场景流估计中的有效性。

title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
summary: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.

AI.tldr: 该论文将logo提示优化从"文本改写"重构为"结构化设计空间采样"，提出DOGS方法：从真实logo语料挖掘带类型、图结构的设计语法，用GFlowNet按终端奖励（可识别性、美学、相对语料原创性）采样设计图，从构造上实现侵权规避。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I提示优化几乎全部视为文本改写，即把简短用户需求扩展为更长的模型偏好token序列。作者认为这种语言空间范式不适合logo设计等结构化视觉设计任务：一行brief无法指定大多数设计决策，这些决策依赖线性序列无法编码的关系型先验；同时语言空间留下不受控通道，可能复现受保护标识。
AI.method: 将logo提示重构为结构化设计空间中的采样，实例化为DOGS（Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler）。从大规模真实logo语料挖掘类型化、图结构的设计语法，边记录经验共现关系；用GFlowNet采样器生成设计图，生成概率与终端奖励成正比，该奖励综合可识别性、美学和相对语料原创性。每个槽位仅从封闭的设计级词汇表中抽取，解析阶段移除任何诱发侵权或有害的token。原创性奖励进一步惩罚与已有logo的接近程度，从而在方法构造层面纳入侵权规避。
AI.result: 在两个开源渲染器上、与九个基线方法对比，DOGS生成的logo更具可识别性和美学性，多样性显著更高，且远不易引发商标侵权。
AI.conclusion: 将logo提示优化从语言空间改写转为结构化设计空间采样是有效路径；通过设计语法约束封闭词汇和原创性奖励，DOGS在质量、多样性与侵权规避上同时优于现有基线，表明构造性约束可替代事后过滤式的安全/合规控制。

title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs),
  but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many
  become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the
  visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor
  and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as
  scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty
  is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with
  actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and
  visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest
  self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized
  RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution,
  VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: VICO：一种视觉语言模型后训练的共同进化框架，通过让"环境改写器"动态编辑图像结构生成难度适配的可验证样本，解决静态训练环境中学习信号塌缩的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在视觉语言模型后训练中通常假设训练环境是静态的。随着actor能力提升，固定任务会脱离其学习前沿：一部分变得过于简单，另一部分始终无法解决，导致学习信号塌缩。作者认为VLM后训练应让视觉环境与actor共同进化，而不仅是优化actor本身。
AI.method: 提出VICO共同进化框架，联合训练actor和Environment-as-Rewriter（EnvRewriter）。EnvRewriter对可验证的图像侧结构（场景图、图表表格、受保护区域掩码等）进行编辑并重新渲染，生成标签有效的训练样本；并通过基于通过率的奖励将样本难度校准到actor当前能力。该循环无需额外人工标注即可持续对齐任务难度与actor能力。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学推理与视觉 grounded 理解的九个多模态基准上，VICO-8B在域外任务上较基座模型提升最高+5.0%，分别超过最强的自进化基线和文本编辑共同进化基线+4.3%和+8.4%，并在使用少16-160倍标注样本的情况下与图表专用RLVR方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过从人工标注监督转向图像编辑共同进化，VICO为视觉推理提供了一条超越静态语料RLVR的可扩展路径。

title: Velocity Scaling in Flow Matching
summary: Scaling a learned flow-matching velocity field $v_θ$ by a gain $γ(t)$ was recently shown to greatly improve generation quality. Prior work argued that velocity fields trained with mean-squared error (MSE) systematically underestimate velocity magnitude and that scaling corrects this error. We show that MSE training does not create a velocity-magnitude deficit. We find instead that velocity scaling reduces population time lag: sampled states at model time $t$ resemble training states from an earlier time. Velocity scaling and moving model time back are two ways to address this population time lag. Across architectures and model sizes, measuring population time lag and using it to select a gain greatly improves generation quality, reducing FID from 28.0 to 12.2 (estimated by linear interpolation between FID measurements at neighboring gains) on ImageNet-256 at NFE 25 without guidance.

AI.tldr: 该论文否定了"MSE训练导致速度幅值系统性低估"的既有解释，提出速度缩放（velocity scaling）真正的作用是缓解群体时间滞后（population time lag），并据此给出可迁移的增益选择准则，在ImageNet-256上大幅降低FID。
AI.motivation: 近期研究发现将学习到的流匹配速度场按增益γ(t)缩放可显著提升生成质量。先前工作将其归因于MSE训练会系统性低估速度幅值，缩放可纠正该偏差。论文质疑这一解释，试图澄清缩放有效的真实机制，从而为增益选择提供理论依据而非经验试错。
AI.method: 作者首先通过实验检验MSE训练是否存在速度幅值缺陷；随后提出"群体时间滞后"这一度量：模型时间t处的采样状态实际上更接近训练数据中更早时间点的状态。基于此，将速度缩放与"把模型时间向后移动"视为解决同一问题的两种等价手段，并在不同架构与模型规模上测量群体时间滞后，用它来自动选择增益γ(t)。
AI.result: 实验表明MSE训练并不产生速度幅值不足。跨架构与模型规模的实验显示，测量群体时间滞后并据此选取增益能显著改善生成质量：在ImageNet-256、NFE 25、无引导条件下，FID从28.0降至12.2（该数值由相邻增益处FID测量值的线性插值估计）。
AI.conclusion: 速度缩放的有效性并非源于修正幅值低估，而是源于补偿群体时间滞后；缩放与时间轴平移在本质上等价。群体时间滞后既是可诊断的指标，也是选择增益的实用准则，可在无需引导且低NFE预算下带来显著的质量提升。

title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出数据驱动的遗忘方法依赖多步去噪动力学，在少步蒸馏（FSD）扩散模型中失效，且“基模型遗忘后再蒸馏”代价高昂；为此提出面向少步生成的偏好驱动遗忘框架，改进DPO以直接移除FSD模型中的概念，实现有效遗忘并保持少步效率与非目标能力。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型正被蒸馏为少步变体以加速推理，但其可能生成有害或不良内容，存在安全风险。现有数据驱动遗忘方法通过微调权重抑制目标生成，然而其目标函数隐含依赖多步去噪动力学，该假设在少步蒸馏（FSD）模型中不再成立，导致遗忘失效。若先在非蒸馏基模型上遗忘再重新蒸馏得到已遗忘的FSD模型，则计算与时间开销巨大，难以实用。
AI.method: 提出偏好驱动的遗忘框架，重新审视面向扩散模型的直接偏好优化（DPO）。分析表明，围绕噪声预测误差构建的标准DPO及其遗忘衍生方法因FSD模型生成动力学改变而迁移效果差。为此引入与少步生成特性显式对齐的改进偏好优化公式，从而在FSD模型中直接进行概念移除。
AI.result: 主要在身份（identity）与NSFW（裸露）移除任务上评估，并扩展至对象级遗忘。大量实验显示出一致且有效的遗忘效果，同时具备强保留性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持少步效率的同时实现有效遗忘并良好保留非目标能力，为FSD模型中的遗忘提供了实用且有理论依据的解决方案。

title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
summary: Vision-Language (VL) reasoning requires a model to both extract relevant and accurate information from an image (visual reasoning, VR), and to infer the answer from it (language reasoning, LR). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically trains both through a single chain-of-thought with a final-answer reward. This gives every CoT token the same sequence-level advantage, failing to distinguish capability specific errors. We propose SPLIT-RL, a staged post-training approach that trains VR and LR in disjoint phases. Because a group's rollouts differ along one capability at a time, the group-relative advantage isolates it, and each phase is optimized using phase-specific reward. We further introduce Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO), which decomposes VR-phase rollouts into atomic visual claims and provides a fine-grained advantage at claim level based on visual-type group formation. Although trained in two phases, trained policy is evaluated like GRPO model, with a single CoT call at inference time. Under this protocol, SPLIT-RL improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.4-6.1 points across Qwen3-VL models from 2B to 30B-A3B and InternVL3.5-8B. Evaluating each capability using an oracle based diagnostic shows that answer-only GRPO leaves perception unchanged, whereas SPLIT-RL improves both VR and LR.

AI.tldr: SPLIT-RL 将视觉推理（VR）与语言推理（LR）分阶段解耦训练，并引入 Claim-Level Advantage（CLA-GRPO）在视觉子句级别提供细粒度优势；推理时仍为单次 CoT 调用，在 Qwen3-VL（2B–30B-A3B）与 InternVL3.5-8B 上平均准确率较 GRPO 提升 1.4–6.1 点。
AI.motivation: VL 推理同时依赖视觉信息抽取（VR）与基于抽取结果的推断（LR）。现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习用单一 CoT 配合最终答案奖励，导致所有 CoT token 共享同一序列级优势，无法区分"看错"与"推错"这类能力特异性错误。
AI.method: 提出分阶段后训练方法 SPLIT-RL：在互不重叠的阶段分别训练 VR 与 LR。由于同一 group 内的 rollout 仅在一个能力维度上有差异，组相对优势可隔离该能力，且每阶段使用阶段专属奖励。进一步提出 Claim-Level Advantage（CLA-GRPO），将 VR 阶段 rollout 分解为原子视觉主张（atomic visual claims），基于视觉类型分组建模，在 claim 级别提供细粒度优势。训练虽分两阶段，推理时与 GRPO 模型一致，仅需单次 CoT 调用。
AI.result: 在该评估协议下，SPLIT-RL 相较 GRPO 在 Qwen3-VL 2B 至 30B-A3B 各规模模型及 InternVL3.5-8B 上平均准确率提升 1.4–6.1 点。基于 oracle 的能力诊断显示：仅答案奖励的 GRPO 未改变感知能力，而 SPLIT-RL 同时提升了 VR 与 LR。
AI.conclusion: 解耦 VR 与 LR 的分阶段强化学习能有效隔离并分别优化两类能力，claim 级优势进一步细化了视觉阶段的信用分配；在不增加推理开销的前提下，SPLIT-RL 优于单阶段 GRPO，并带来感知与推理能力的双重提升。

title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
summary: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVER, a dense-to-sparse post-training framework that uses dense video views as training-time references for sparse-frame inference. During reinforcement post-training, paired dense and sparse views are optimized with grounding rewards and a reliability-gated reference reward, encouraging sparse view predictions to preserve task-relevant temporal evidence. Notably, SAVER is trained only on 1,250 randomly sampled temporal grounding examples, without using any video question answering annotations. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks and six video question-answering benchmarks, SAVER consistently improves performance across frame budgets. In particular, SAVER can match or surpass dense-frame Qwen3.5 baselines while using substantially fewer frames. These results show that temporal grounding can serve as an effective evidence-localization proxy for learning sparse video reasoning that transfers to broader video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAVER 框架，将密集视频视图作为训练参考、稀疏帧用于推理，通过强化后训练提升有限时序证据下的推理可靠性，在时序定位与视频问答基准上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型常假设时序观测越多推理越可靠，本文质疑该假设，认为核心挑战不是高效处理更多帧，而是在有限时序证据下实现可靠推理。
AI.method: SAVER 是一种从稠密到稀疏的后训练框架。训练时使用成对的稠密与稀疏视频视图，采用定位奖励与可靠性门控的参考奖励进行强化后训练，促使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关的时序证据。仅使用 1,250 个随机采样的时序定位样本，不使用任何视频问答标注。
AI.result: 在三个时序定位基准和六个视频问答基准上，SAVER 在各帧预算下都稳定提升性能；在显著减少帧数的情况下可匹配甚至超越密集帧的 Qwen3.5 基线。
AI.conclusion: 时序定位可作为有效的证据定位代理，用于学习可迁移到更广泛视频理解任务的稀疏视频推理能力。

title: GHARP: Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages (14 main + references + 15 pages supplementary), 14 figures, 17 tables
summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject's geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. This separation offers a favorable trade-off with respect to fidelity, quality and runtime: the identity stage can be expensive while the animation stage runs a lightweight network, optimized for mobile devices. Our method performs animation in a semantically structured latent space of a pretrained reconstruction model, where expression changes remain spatially contained, making residual prediction efficient. This reconstruction prior provides a consistent spatial layout, allowing fusion of multiple input views into a compact, fixed-size canonical Gaussian representation. While this two-stage design improves the runtime-quality trade-off, it still inherits a problem common to all expression-driven avatar methods: expression codes describe only the face and thus omit body pose and clothing position, making these regions underspecified in the input. The animation network faces an ill-posed mapping and resorts to averaging over conflicting body appearances, producing blur and temporal flicker. We address this with a body alignment network that learns to align the person's body in the target image with the input reference images, removing the ambiguity from the training signal. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quality on the Ava-256 benchmark while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.

AI.tldr: GHARP 将头部动画解耦为离线身份重建与实时表情残差预测两阶段，并在预训练重建模型的语义潜空间中进行动画，同时引入身体对齐网络消除身体姿态缺失导致的模糊与时序闪烁，在 Ava-256 上取得最优质量且推理显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有表情驱动的头像方法面临质量与运行时难以兼得的权衡；且表情编码仅描述面部，缺少身体姿态与衣物位置信息，导致这些区域在输入中欠定义，动画网络被迫在冲突的身体外观上取平均，产生模糊与时间闪烁。
AI.method: 1) 双阶段解耦：身份阶段离线构建主体的几何与外观表示，动画阶段在运行时预测与表情相关的残差；2) 在预训练重建模型的语义结构化潜空间中做动画，使表情变化在空间上保持局部化、利于高效残差预测；3) 借助重建先验的一致空间布局，将多视角输入融合为紧凑的固定尺寸规范高斯表示；4) 引入身体对齐网络，将目标图像中的人体与输入参考图像对齐，从训练信号中消除身体区域的歧义。
AI.result: 在 Ava-256 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 质量；在 A100 GPU 上运行速度最高提升 13 倍，且高斯数量减少 8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过身份/动画两阶段解耦与重建先验潜空间建模，GHARP 实现了高质量的实时 3D 人头动画；身体对齐网络有效缓解了身体与衣物区域欠定义带来的模糊与闪烁问题，在质量与效率上同时优于现有方法。

title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Includes supplementary material (8 pages) after the main paper. Code: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data
summary: In recent years, persistent homology has seen rapid adoption in deep learning, yet its computation remains a major bottleneck in network training. This paper introduces TopoGPU, a GPU streaming pipeline that computes persistence diagrams of cubical complexes induced by 2D and 3D images. TopoGPU streams the input image chunk by chunk, processing each chunk with massively parallel GPU kernels on a grid of GPU blocks; the resulting boundary relations are accumulated in host memory, where the CPU performs the boundary matrix reduction. TopoGPU introduces a stratification-aware discrete Morse matching that provably preserves persistent homology under streaming, together with a parallel topological sorting algorithm and a parallel V-path parity algorithm for deriving Morse boundaries on the GPU. TopoGPU outperforms Cubical Ripser, a state-of-the-art method for persistent homology computation, on every benchmark evaluated, achieving an average end-to-end speedup of 53.24x and a maximum of 198.01x. We further integrate TopoGPU into a topology-preserving deep network, demonstrating that it substantially reduces the cost of persistent homology computation during network training. TopoGPU is open source, with pre-built binaries, Google Colab notebooks, and Docker images available at the project's GitHub page: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data.

AI.tldr: TopoGPU 是一个 GPU 流式流水线，用于计算 2D/3D 图像所诱导的立方复形的持续图，相比 Cubical Ripser 平均加速 53.24 倍（最高 198.01 倍），并可集成到保持拓扑的深度网络中以降低训练开销。
AI.motivation: 持续同调虽被深度学习快速采用，但其计算仍是网络训练的主要瓶颈，亟需高效的 GPU 加速方案。
AI.method: 提出 GPU 流式流水线：按块流式读入图像，用大规模并行 GPU 核在块网格上处理，边界关系累积于主机内存并由 CPU 执行边界矩阵约简；引入保持持续同调的层次感知离散 Morse 匹配、并行拓扑排序算法以及并行 V-path 奇偶性算法，以在 GPU 上导出 Morse 边界。
AI.result: 在所有评测基准上均优于 Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速 53.24 倍，最高 198.01 倍；集成到保持拓扑的深度网络中显著降低训练时的持续同调计算成本。
AI.conclusion: TopoGPU 有效缓解了持续同调计算瓶颈，具备开源实现（预编译二进制、Colab notebook、Docker 镜像）。

title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
summary: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

AI.tldr: 提出LVSPM模型，联合估计相机位姿并从无标定图像集合成新视角，仅需RGB与位姿监督，可扩展至数百视图。
AI.motivation: 从无标定图像集合中同时进行相机位姿估计与新视角合成，需避免稠密3D真值并支持大规模视图，是现有方法面临的挑战。
AI.method: 提出LVSPM通用模型，联合估计相机位姿并合成新视角；仅用RGB图像和位姿监督训练，规避稠密3D真值；采用测试时训练（TTT）层，无缝扩展至数百个输入视图。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2、DL3DV上，16-256视图的位姿估计优于VGGT，严格阈值下优势更大；在视图越多场景越大的实用协议下，无位姿新视角合成达SOTA，PSNR超越依赖位姿的模型，场景规模增大时仍保持高质量，基线方法则崩溃。
AI.conclusion: LVSPM在无位姿新视角合成与位姿估计上均取得领先，兼具可扩展性与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: Fluid-Gen-Zero: Grounding Pretrained Video Generators in Physics without Training
summary: We present Fluid-Gen-Zero, a training-free framework for physics-aware fluid-object interaction video generation that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis. Our key insight is to delegate motion dynamics to a physics simulator while preserving the appearance modeling capacity of pretrained video generators. We bridge these two domains through a two-level agentic workflow: generation-time planning, where a vision-language model (VLM) agent interprets intent and the simulation rollout to organize generation clips, and latent-space guidance, which injects simulation signals into denoising through region-aware latent wrapping. This plug-and-play design is compatible with current video foundation models. We further introduce a benchmark for fluid-object interaction video generation. Across Tora (CogVideoX-based), VACE and WanMove (Wan-based), Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment, reducing object trajectory error by 26.7%-81.5% and fluid fEPE (fluid flow endpoint error) by 67.9%-84.0%, while largely preserving perceptual quality. In a human preference study, raters favor Fluid-Gen-Zero in 55.1%-74.4% of same-backbone comparisons across three backbones, and in 90.4%-94.2% of comparisons against simulation-based methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Fluid-Gen-Zero 是一个免训练框架，将物理推理与外观合成解耦：由物理模拟器负责运动动力学，预训练视频生成器负责外观建模，通过两层智能体工作流实现流体-物体交互视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以同时保证物理一致的运动动力学与高质量外观建模；作者希望在不重新训练的前提下，将模拟器的物理精确性与预训练视频生成器的外观能力结合。
AI.method: 采用免训练、即插即用设计。核心是将运动动力学委托给物理模拟器，保留预训练视频生成器的外观建模能力。通过两层智能体工作流桥接两个领域：(1) 生成时规划——由 VLM 智能体解读用户意图与模拟推演结果，组织生成片段；(2) 潜空间引导——通过区域感知的 latent wrapping 将模拟信号注入去噪过程。兼容 Tora(CogVideoX)、VACE 与 WanMove(Wan) 等现有视频基础模型。同时提出流体-物体交互视频生成基准。
AI.result: 在 Tora、VACE、WanMove 上一致提升模拟对齐度：物体轨迹误差降低 26.7%-81.5%，流体 fEPE 降低 67.9%-84.0%，且基本保持感知质量。人类偏好研究中，同骨干对比下 55.1%-74.4% 偏好 Fluid-Gen-Zero，对比基于模拟的方法时达 90.4%-94.2%。
AI.conclusion: Fluid-Gen-Zero 证明了免训练、模拟器与生成器解耦的智能体框架可在多种视频基础模型上有效提升流体-物体交互视频的物理对齐度，同时保持外观质量，且人类偏好显著优于模拟基线。代码与数据将在接收后发布。

title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: Omni-Diffusion-Distill提出统一两阶段蒸馏框架，将多模态dLLM的图像生成与多模态理解统一压缩至离散token空间，在保持生成与理解能力的同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态扩散大语言模型（dLLM）迭代解码需数十至数百次前向传播，推理成本高；现有少步蒸馏方法多聚焦单一模态（图像或文本），难以将完全离散的多模态dLLM压缩为同时保留生成与理解能力的单一高效学生模型。
AI.method: 1）两阶段蒸馏：第一阶段让学生通过回放缓存的教师轨迹跳过解码步；第二阶段在学生自身rollout的中间状态上微调。2）在离散token空间中对齐图像与文本的生成和理解蒸馏。3）引入两项改进：成对碰撞惩罚（pairwise collision penalty）减少并行文本解码中的重复；熵匹配引导（entropy-matched guidance）防止拟合尖锐化教师分布导致的图像生成熵崩塌。
AI.result: 在解码效率与生成/理解性能间取得SOTA权衡：图像生成从128步降至8步，多模态理解从512步降至64步，分别实现18.2倍和21.2倍墙钟加速。该预算下GenEval得分0.828，DPG-Bench 83.0；多模态理解MM-Vet GPT评判得分20.0，COCO captioning 57.2（同一步数下为教师28.4的两倍）。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Diffusion-Distill证明可通过统一的两阶段离散空间蒸馏，将多模态dLLM大幅压缩为单一高效学生模型，同时保持图像生成与多模态理解能力，并以碰撞惩罚和熵匹配引导缓解统一蒸馏中的性能退化。

title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
summary: Image retrieval methods often rely on a single global semantic descriptor extracted from an image, e.g., the [CLS] token in vision transformers. However, trying to squeeze all the semantic information of an image into a single descriptor can hurt downstream retrieval performance, especially for fine-grained retrieval tasks. In this work, we augment the semantic tokens in the newer visual transformers, the global [CLS] token and the four register tokens, with a carefully selected collection of spatial tokens, aiming to capture the spatial region representation that characterizes the contents captured in each of the semantic tokens. We leverage the DINOv2-reg model, which includes register tokens that emergently learn object and part-based representations. For each "cue" token ([CLS] and each register token), we find a "buddy" image patch token and extract an N x N patch region to produce a set of localized ROI tokens. Our approach automatically captures important regions of interest without any external bounding boxes or saliency modules, purely by matching semantic tokens with their spatial representation regions. Furthermore, we incorporate these tokens into a multi-vector retrieval framework inspired by ColBERT, enabling fine-grained matching via a per-token alignment mechanism while avoiding the large storage cost of keeping all patch embeddings. Through extensive experiments, we find that (1) register tokens encode useful fine-grained details that can complement the [CLS] token; (2) automatically pooled ROI tokens further improve fine-grained discrimination; and (3) multi-vector retrieval with a small set of tokens improves over a DINOv2-reg single-vector baseline while remaining tractable for large-scale search. The code is available at https://github.com/IdhcbIan/Augmenting_CLS_with_ROI_tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"伙伴"图像块区域增强视觉Transformer的语义token（[CLS]及register token），生成ROI token，并纳入ColBERT式多向量检索框架，从而在可控存储成本下提升细粒度图像检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像检索方法多依赖单一全局语义描述子（如ViT的[CLS] token）。将图像所有语义压缩进单一描述子会损害下游检索表现，尤其在细粒度检索任务中更为明显，因此需要补充空间区域信息。
AI.method: 基于DINOv2-reg模型（其register token可涌现地学习物体与部件级表示），为每个"线索"token（[CLS]及每个register token）匹配一个"伙伴"图像块token，并提取N×N的图像块区域，形成一组局部化的ROI token。该方法无需外部边界框或显著性模块即可自动捕获感兴趣区域。随后将这些token引入受ColBERT启发的多向量检索框架，通过逐token对齐实现细粒度匹配，同时避免保存全部图像块嵌入带来的巨大存储开销。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) register token编码了可补充[CLS]的有用细粒度细节；(2) 自动池化的ROI token进一步提升了细粒度区分能力；(3) 使用少量token的多向量检索优于DINOv2-reg单向量基线，且在大规模检索中仍然可行。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义token与其空间区域配对生成ROI token，并采用多向量检索框架，可在不依赖外部标注与显著性模块的前提下提升细粒度图像检索性能，同时保持存储与检索的可行性。

title: PCAsplat: Gaussian Splatting with Local PCA Regularization
summary: Gaussian splatting has emerged as a flexible representation for 3D reconstruction from posed images. However, existing methods are optimized primarily using rasterization-based losses, which supervise a splat only when it contributes to sampled camera rays. Gaussians that are occluded or contribute little to the sampled view therefore receive weak or no geometric gradients and may drift away from the underlying surface, producing undesired floaters. We introduce PCAsplat, a geometry-aware regularization framework for Gaussian splatting based on differentiable local principal component analysis (PCA). Our PCA regularizer acts directly on neighborhoods of Gaussian centers and can therefore update Gaussians that do not contribute to the current training view. We regularize the PCA eigenvalues to encourage Gaussians to move to the underlying surface with isotropic tangent-plane coverage. We also align each Gaussian normal with the PCA-estimated neighborhood normal to enforce consistent orientation. Experiments on DTU, Tanks and Temples, and NeRF Synthetic show that the splats produced by PCAsplat better approximate samples of the reference surface while substantially reducing undesired floaters. These surface-aligned splats enable downstream geometry-processing tasks, including point cloud segmentation, and direct Poisson reconstruction. Additionally, PCAsplat remains competitive under conventional novel view synthesis and mesh extraction tasks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出PCAsplat，一种基于可微局部主成分分析的几何感知正则化框架，直接作用于高斯中心邻域，可将被遮挡或贡献很小的高斯拉回真实表面，减少floater，并支持下游几何处理任务。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅方法主要用基于光栅化的损失优化，只监督对采样相机光线有贡献的高斯；被遮挡或对采样视角贡献小的高斯获得弱或无几何梯度，容易偏离底层表面，产生不期望的floater。因此需要一种不完全依赖当前训练视角贡献的几何正则化手段。
AI.method: PCAsplat采用可微局部主成分分析（PCA）正则器，直接作用于高斯中心的邻域，因此可以更新对当前训练视角无贡献的高斯。方法包括：正则化PCA特征值，促使高斯移动到真实表面并具有各向同性的切平面覆盖；同时将每个高斯的法向与PCA估计的邻域法向对齐，以强制方向一致性。
AI.result: 在DTU、Tanks and Temples和NeRF Synthetic上的实验表明，PCAsplat生成的泼溅能更好地逼近参考表面的采样，并显著减少不期望的floater；这些表面对齐的泼溅支持下游几何处理任务，包括点云分割和直接Poisson重建；同时在传统新视角合成和网格提取任务上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PCAsplat通过可微局部PCA正则化解决了高斯泼溅中弱监督高斯漂移与floater问题，提升了几何质量并拓展了高斯泼溅在几何处理任务中的应用，且不牺牲新视角合成与网格提取性能。

title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
summary: Multimodal large language models learn mostly from paired image-text data or annotated video, and raw web video is rarely used to further train an existing language model. We study whether raw video, with no captions and no text loss, can serve as mid-training data for a pretrained language model. Frames are encoded into continuous visual tokens, and the language model learns to predict the next visual token. We mid-train Qwen3-1.7B on raw clips from YT-Temporal-1B and then apply the same image-text instruction tuning to it and to the model without mid-training, so that the two differ only in mid-training. The mid-trained model scores 2.9 points higher on average across four video benchmarks and 5.1 points higher across ten image benchmarks, spanning perception, document, and chart tasks. Text performance is preserved even though mid-training includes no text, with an average of 48.9 across 14 text benchmarks compared with 48.0 for the model without mid-training. Analyses across training show that the image and video gains emerge within 30% of training and plateau thereafter, varying by less than 0.5 points. Predicting captions fails to outperform next-visual-token prediction, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain purely self-supervised without the computational overhead or labeling noise of automated captioning.

AI.tldr: 原始无字幕视频可作为预训练语言模型的中间训练数据：以“预测下一个视觉token”为自监督目标对Qwen3-1.7B进行视频中间训练，可同时提升多模态与图像基准表现且不损失文本能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型多依赖成对图文数据或标注视频训练，而原始网络视频几乎未被用于继续训练已有语言模型。作者试图验证：不含字幕、不含文本损失的原始视频能否作为有效的中间训练数据。
AI.method: 将视频帧编码为连续视觉token，让语言模型学习预测下一个视觉token。使用YT-Temporal-1B的原始视频片段对Qwen3-1.7B进行中间训练，随后对中间训练模型与未中间训练模型施加相同的图文指令微调，使两者仅在中间训练环节存在差异；并对比“预测字幕”与“预测下一视觉token”两种目标。
AI.result: 中间训练模型在四个视频基准上平均高2.9分，在十个图像基准（涵盖感知、文档、图表任务）上平均高5.1分。文本能力得以保持：14个文本基准平均48.9，而未中间训练模型为48.0。训练过程分析显示图像与视频增益在30%训练进度内即出现并随后趋于平台，波动小于0.5分。预测字幕的表现未能超过预测下一视觉token。
AI.conclusion: 原始视频中间训练可完全自监督进行，无需自动字幕带来的计算开销与标注噪声，并能同时增强视觉与保留文本能力，说明无字幕原始视频是有效的中间训练资源。

title: Expression-Diverse References for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation aims to maintain a subject's identity while synthesizing realistic videos. Yet a single reference portrait captures the subject's appearance under only one facial configuration. As expressions change, facial appearance can vary in highly identity-specific ways, leaving the subject's appearance under unseen expressions underdetermined by the reference alone. This expression-dependent variation also complicates evaluation: similarity to a neutral reference may decrease under strong expressions even for real images of the same person. We investigate this limitation from both generation and evaluation perspectives. First, we quantify how face-recognition similarity varies with expression intensity using controlled photographs and MEAD videos. We then construct a compact yet expressive reference gallery that captures diverse expression-dependent facial configurations. Matching against this gallery provides a more robust measure of identity similarity under expressive motion. To further expose performance degradation with expression intensity, we report identity similarity separately for mild, intense, and extreme expressions. For generation, we extend Stand-In to condition on our expression-diverse reference sets and develop a data-curation pipeline that extracts consistent yet diverse face crops from training videos. In practical settings where only a single portrait is available, we construct the reference set by synthesizing additional expressions with a pretrained facial reenactment model. On our controlled benchmark, both real and synthesized reference sets outperform the evaluated baselines in identity similarity across all three expression-intensity regimes, with the largest improvements for extreme expressions.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出单张参考肖像无法确定人物在未见表情下的外观，且基于中性参考的相似度评价在强表情下会失真。作者量化了身份相似度随表情强度的变化，构建了表情多样化的参考集，并将其用于生成与评价，在极端表情下取得最大提升。
AI.motivation: 身份保持视频生成面临一个根本性限制：单张参考肖像仅捕获某一表情配置下的外观，而面部外观随表情变化的方式具有高度身份特异性，使未见表情下的外观欠定。这一问题同时影响生成与评价——即使对同一真实人物的图像，与中性参考的相似度也会在强表情下下降，导致评价指标不可靠。
AI.method: 作者从生成与评价两方面展开研究。评价上，利用受控照片与MEAD视频量化人脸识别相似度随表情强度的变化；构建紧凑而富有表现力的参考图库以捕捉多样的表情相关面部配置，并以该图库匹配作为更稳健的身份相似度度量；同时按轻度、强烈、极端三档表情强度分别报告身份相似度。生成上，扩展Stand-In以条件化于表情多样化的参考集，并设计数据筛选流程从训练视频中提取一致且多样的人脸裁剪；在仅有单张肖像的实际场景中，用预训练面部重演模型合成额外表情以构建参考集。
AI.result: 在自建的受控基准上，无论是真实参考集还是合成参考集，在轻度、强烈、极端三档表情强度下的身份相似度均优于所评估的基线，且提升幅度在极端表情下最大。
AI.conclusion: 单参考肖像的表达欠定性同时是生成与评价的瓶颈。引入表情多样化的参考集可同时改善身份保持生成与身份相似度评价的鲁棒性，且对强表情场景收益最显著。

title: Transforming Image Editors into Video Editors
summary: Recent image editing systems have achieved impressive semantic understanding, visual fidelity, and instruction-following ability, while video editing remains substantially more difficult and costly. In this paper, we present a simple alternative to end-to-end video editing: instead of training a monolithic video editor, we transform a strong image editor into a video editor through anchor-based generation. Our key insight is that video editing can be decomposed into two subproblems: editing a sparse set of keyframes and propagating those edits across time. Based on this observation, we propose Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE), a two-stage framework in which a powerful image editor first performs composed editing on selected keyframes, and a motion-guided image-to-video diffusion model then generates the final video by treating the edited keyframes as fixed anchors. This design directly inherits the strengths of modern image editors while avoiding expensive end-to-end video editing training. Experiments on IVEBench and VIE-Bench show that AVE achieves strong performance in instruction following, temporal consistency, and content fidelity. Further ablations reveal that final video editing quality is strongly correlated with the quality of the image editor, suggesting that future progress in video editing may come from stronger image editing foundations and lightweight transfer to video. Code is available at https://github.com/wangf3014/AVE.

AI.tldr: 提出 AVE 框架，用锚点式生成把强图像编辑器转化为视频编辑器，避免昂贵的端到端视频编辑训练。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑比图像编辑更难且成本更高：端到端训练单体视频编辑器需大量数据与算力。作者希望复用现代图像编辑器在语义理解、视觉保真与指令跟随上的优势。
AI.method: 核心洞察：视频编辑可分解为两个子问题——编辑稀疏关键帧 + 跨时间传播编辑。AVE 为两阶段框架：第一阶段用强图像编辑器在选定关键帧上做组合编辑；第二阶段用运动引导的图像到视频扩散模型，将已编辑关键帧作为固定锚点生成最终视频。
AI.result: 在 IVEBench 与 VIE-Bench 上，AVE 在指令跟随、时间一致性与内容保真方面均取得强劲性能。消融实验表明，最终视频编辑质量与图像编辑器质量强相关。
AI.conclusion: 视频编辑的进一步进展可能来自更强的图像编辑基础，以及向视频的轻量迁移；代码已开源。

title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
summary: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL)视角选择策略，用"可回答性"量化未来视角的价值，通过两阶段蒸馏从特权前瞻训练中学习预测动作价值，部署时无需渲染未来视角即可选择相机运动，在E3VS-Bench上较直接动作基线提升43%。
AI.motivation: 视角依赖的问答要求机器人主动控制相机，暴露回答所需但当前视角不可见的视觉证据（如抬升相机俯视箱内）。然而现有VLM虽能解读已观测图像，却难以预判未见视角是否有用，导致相机运动选择困难。
AI.method: 将视角价值量化为"可回答性"（VLM判断某视角是否足以回答问题的估计）。训练阶段：特权教师模型在3D Gaussian Splatting场景中渲染候选未来视角，用冻结VLM计算一步和两步可回答性目标；通过两阶段蒸馏，让学生模型从问题、近期视觉观测和候选相机运动中预测这些动作价值。部署阶段：直接用预测值排序候选相机运动，无需渲染未来视角。
AI.result: 在377个未见环境的E3VS-Bench测试回合上，使用同一VLM的条件下，RFL的平均评判得分较直接动作基线提升43%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从特权视觉前瞻中学习相机控制策略，可有效解决视角依赖的问答任务，验证了该范式在主动机器人视觉中的可行性与优越性。

title: SatFix: Absolute Visual Localization of UAVs in Satellite Maps from a Single Oblique Image
summary: We study absolute metric UAV localization within a provided geo-referenced satellite region, recovering continuous map position and viewing heading from a single oblique image or a short multi-view clip. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods retrieve the most similar satellite tile from a gallery and report Recall@K, but retrieval depends on gallery sampling, provides no heading estimate, and returns a tile index rather than a continuous coordinate. We propose SatFix, a feed-forward UAV--satellite localization framework built on VGGT-$Ω$. Satellite-grid features act as queries that aggregate UAV visual evidence, and two lightweight heads regress a 3-DoF pose in the satellite-map frame: continuous 2D position and heading. SatFix requires no explicit 3D map, rendered bird's-eye image, auxiliary sensor, or test-time pose alignment. A single model supports both single- and multi-view inputs, with trajectory constraints used during multi-view training. For metric evaluation, we introduce University-Metric, where satellite imagery is re-collected over a region up to 10.7$\times$ longer on a side (about 114$\times$ the ground area) than the original University-1652 tiles, with continuous position and heading labels for the original UAV tours. With one UAV view, SatFix localizes 52.08% of test frames within 50 m and 17.34% within 10 m, with median position and heading errors of 45.66 m and $20.81^\circ$, respectively. Inference takes under 0.1 s per single-view query on an NVIDIA RTX 4090. With nine UAV views, the median position error falls to 21.96 m and the median heading error to $8.73^\circ$. Compared with a fine-tuned VGGT-$Ω$ baseline, SatFix reduces median position error by 34.0% and nine-view median heading error from $25.43^\circ$ to $8.73^\circ$.

AI.tldr: 提出SatFix前馈式无人机—卫星绝对定位框架，从单张斜视或短多视图直接回归卫星地图坐标系下的连续2D位置与航向，并构建University-Metric度量基准进行评测。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视图地理定位方法基于图库检索最相似卫星瓦片并报告Recall@K，依赖图库采样、不提供航向估计、且只返回瓦片索引而非连续坐标，无法满足无人机绝对度量定位需求。
AI.method: 基于VGGT-Ω构建：以卫星网格特征作为查询，聚合无人机视觉证据；两个轻量预测头回归3自由度位姿（连续2D位置与航向）。无需显式3D地图、渲染鸟瞰图、辅助传感器或测试时位姿对齐；单模型同时支持单视图与多视图输入，多视图训练中引入轨迹约束。评测方面提出University-Metric，其卫星影像单边覆盖范围最长扩展10.7倍（约114倍地面面积），并为原始无人机航迹提供连续位置与航向标签。
AI.result: 单视图下52.08%测试帧定位误差在50 m内、17.34%在10 m内，位置与航向中位误差分别为45.66 m和20.81°；NVIDIA RTX 4090上单视图查询推理耗时低于0.1 s。九视图时位置中位误差降至21.96 m，航向中位误差降至8.73°。相比微调VGGT-Ω基线，位置中位误差降低34.0%，九视图航向中位误差由25.43°降至8.73°。
AI.conclusion: SatFix可在无3D地图与无测试时对齐条件下实现连续、度量化的无人机绝对定位，同时输出位置与航向，并具备实时推理能力；多视图输入通过轨迹约束显著提升定位与定向精度。

title: Learning What to Trust in Multimodal Learning under Noisy Supervision
summary: Multimodal classification processes and relates information from multiple modalities to achieve more accurate predictions. However, existing methods typically rely on high-quality ground-truth labels, which are difficult to obtain in real-world scenarios. While sample-selection methods for learning with noisy labels aim to identify correctly labeled examples from noisy data, traditional methods primarily focus on unimodal settings and fail to exploit multimodal information fully. This motivates us to build a more reliable noise detector in multimodal learning. To this end, we theoretically analyze the relationship between representation structure and noise detection capability. Based on this analysis, we propose REFINE, which is a multimodal label-noise detection framework that jointly uses fused and unimodal representations for label-noise detection. Specifically, REFINE constructs discriminative eigenvectors through discriminative analysis of the target and background classes and selects trusted representation spaces with better noise detection capability for each class. Within each trusted space, REFINE measures the alignment between each instance representation and the discriminative eigenvectors. It then combines the subsets selected from these spaces. The combined set provides cleaner supervision for updating the multimodal classifier, thereby reducing the influence of mislabeled examples during training and improving model generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate REFINE's superiority compared to baseline methods. The source code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态学习中的标签噪声问题，提出 REFINE 框架，通过判别性特征向量筛选可信表示空间并融合多模态表示进行噪声检测。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态分类方法依赖高质量真值标签，而现实场景中标签往往含噪。传统噪声标签样本选择方法主要针对单模态，无法充分利用多模态信息，因此需要一个更可靠的多模态噪声检测器。
AI.method: 首先从理论上分析表示结构与噪声检测能力之间的关系；基于此提出 REFINE，联合使用融合表示与单模态表示进行标签噪声检测。REFINE 通过对目标类与背景类进行判别分析构造判别性特征向量，为每个类别选择噪声检测能力更优的可信表示空间；在每个可信空间中度量实例表示与判别性特征向量的对齐程度，再合并各空间选出的子集，为多模态分类器提供更干净监督。
AI.result: 在多种任务上的大量实验表明，REFINE 相比基线方法具有更优性能。
AI.conclusion: REFINE 通过可信表示空间选择与多模态表示对齐度量，有效降低误标样本影响，提升模型泛化能力；源码将公开。

title: Refine Connections, Close the Gap: A Reliable Enhancement Framework for Driving Scene Topology
summary: In autonomous driving, understanding scene topology - the connectivity between lanes and traffic elements - is critical for safe path planning and motion control. While current methods excel at detecting individual map elements, their connectivity reasoning often falls short of its theoretical potential, leaving a significant performance gap relative to the theoretical upper-bound achievable given the underlying detections. Furthermore, the decision-ready topology graphs passed to downstream tasks often remain unreliable. Current approaches typically derive connectivity by thresholding continuous topology scores; however, these scores often fail to reflect the true logical likelihood of connectivity, resulting in false positives or missing connections. Existing benchmarks further overlook this issue by primarily evaluating continuous metrics, rather than assessing the discrete connectivity required for decision-making. To bridge these gaps, we propose TopoEnhance, a novel topology enhancement framework designed to unlock the latent potential of existing methods and improve the reliability of decision-ready topology. We formulate topology enhancement as a denoising-based reconstruction process, where the model learns to recover structural consistency from stochastically corrupted ground-truth graphs. This formulation enables the model to resolve logical inconsistencies and rectify unreliable connections, producing robust discrete topology graphs that closely approach theoretical maximum performance. Extensive experiments across different baselines show that TopoEnhance consistently improves both continuous topology metrics (TOP score), and discrete connectivity measured by our adapted Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS) metric. As a flexible, source-agnostic framework, TopoEnhance delivers substantial gains across diverse state-of-the-art baselines without requiring retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 TopoEnhance 拓扑增强框架，将拓扑增强建模为去噪重建过程，从随机损坏的真实图恢复结构一致性，提升自动驾驶场景拓扑的连续指标与离散连通性可靠性，且无需重训练即可适配多种基线。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需理解车道与交通元素的连通性以支持安全路径规划与控制。现有方法虽能较好检测单个地图要素，但连通性推理远未达到给定检测结果下的理论上界，性能存在明显差距；同时传递到下游任务的"可决策拓扑图"常不可靠。当前方法多通过对连续拓扑分数阈值化导出连通性，而这些分数难以反映真实逻辑连通概率，导致误连或漏连；现有基准也主要评估连续指标，忽视了决策所需的离散连通性。
AI.method: 提出 TopoEnhance 拓扑增强框架，将拓扑增强形式化为基于去噪的重建过程：模型从随机损坏的真实拓扑图中学习恢复结构一致性，从而解决逻辑不一致并纠正不可靠连接，生成鲁棒的离散拓扑图。同时引入适配的 Topology Jaccard Similarity（TJS）指标以评估离散连通性。
AI.result: 在多类基线上开展的大量实验表明，TopoEnhance 能持续提升连续拓扑指标（TOP score）以及由适配的 TJS 指标衡量的离散连通性；作为灵活且与来源无关的框架，无需重训练即可在多种先进基线上取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: TopoEnhance 通过去噪重建式拓扑增强，挖掘现有方法的潜在能力并提升可决策拓扑的可靠性，使离散拓扑图接近理论最大性能；其框架通用、与来源无关、无需重训练，可广泛适用于不同先进基线。

title: AffordDrive3D: Affordance-Aware World-Action Modeling with Spatial Understanding
summary: World-action models have recently improved autonomous driving by jointly learning future scene prediction and trajectory generation. Most existing approaches model the future primarily through RGB appearance, and recent works have begun to incorporate geometric prediction to improve spatial understanding. However, dense geometry describes the spatial layout of the entire scene without indicating which parts are most relevant to the ego vehicle's action. For driving, the model must also identify and anticipate where it can safely move and which regions may pose collision risks. Jointly modeling action-relevant regions and future geometry can provide the policy with both driving-relevant cues and their corresponding spatial structure. We therefore propose AffordDrive3D, an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model that jointly learns future action-relevant regions and spatial structure.
