In order to capture the scene semantics and driving context needed for driving affordance prediction, we build AffordDrive3D on a VLM backbone to forecast drivable areas and collision-critical regions that directly affect ego motion, while predicting future geometry from RGB world-model latents. On NAVSIM, AffordDrive3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS and 89.9 EPDMS, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling future affordances and geometry for trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 提出AffordDrive3D，一种可通行性（affordance）与几何感知的世界-动作模型，联合学习未来动作相关区域与空间结构，在NAVSIM上达到91.3 PDMS与89.9 EPDMS的最新性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶世界-动作模型多以RGB外观建模未来，近期工作虽引入几何预测以增强空间理解，但稠密几何仅刻画全场景空间布局，无法指出与自车动作最相关的区域。驾驶任务还需识别并预判何处可安全行驶、何处存在碰撞风险，因此需联合建模动作相关区域与未来几何，为策略同时提供驾驶相关线索及其空间结构。
AI.method: 提出AffordDrive3D，一种可通行性与几何感知的世界-动作模型，联合学习未来动作相关区域与空间结构。为捕捉驾驶可通行性预测所需的场景语义与驾驶上下文，模型以VLM为骨干，预测可行驶区域与对自车运动有直接影响的碰撞关键区域；同时从RGB世界模型的隐变量（latent）中预测未来几何。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM基准上，AffordDrive3D取得91.3 PDMS与89.9 EPDMS，达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，联合建模未来可通行性与几何对轨迹规划具有显著有效性，验证了动作相关区域与空间结构协同预测的价值。

title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://deepaksridhar.github.io/dmp.github.io/. Code: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
summary: Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp

AI.tldr: 提出扩散元提示（DMP）框架，将已学提示的分布用扩散模型建模，在无需原始任务样本与损失的情况下，以自然语言任务描述为条件合成新提示，并结合测试时锚点引导策略提升采样稳定性，显著提升跨任务泛化并大幅降低存储与推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有提示学习（prompt learning）得到的提示通常高度任务特定，难以泛化到新类别、新领域或任务组合；而提示检索类方法又带来较高的存储与推理成本。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Diffusion Meta-Prompt（DMP）模型，对历史已学提示集合的分布进行建模，训练与采样均不依赖原始任务样本或任务损失；2) 以自然语言任务描述为条件，采样生成新提示；3) 提出测试时引导（test-time steering）策略，在扩散采样过程中以检索库中经训练筛选的最优提示作为隐空间锚点，无需重训练 DMP、也无需访问测试类别。
AI.result: 在分类、检索与文生图任务上提升泛化能力，支持概念组合与负向提示且无需显式训练；相较提示检索方法，存储与推理成本降低 90% 以上；组合分类在 55 组数据集对上平均提升最高 2.0%，个别组合（如 Eurosat 与 Flowers）提升达 8.5%；层次分类等跨任务泛化提升约 2–9%；并给出所采样提示的期望任务损失的界。
AI.conclusion: DMP 通过在提示空间上建模生成式分布，把提示学习从“任务特定”推进到“任务可迁移、可组合、可条件生成”，在性能、泛化与效率上均优于提示检索与先前元学习方法，并具备理论保证。

title: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping
summary: Audio-driven facial animation underpins real-time avatars, telepresence, and embodied virtual agents. And it must run online: each frame emitted from audio observed up to the current time, at interactive rates. Recent progress is dominated by diffusion models, which need many network evaluations per sample and are therefore a poor fit for streaming. We argue the cost is unnecessary in this domain. Audio-conditioned facial motion occupies a comparatively low-dimensional manifold, a regime where a single-pass GAN suffices. The obstacle is not capacity but stochastic structure. We show that a causal, time-invariant generator driven by i.i.d. noise cannot suppress its output spectrum over a band without collapsing its per-step innovation. We proposed FaceGAN, which dissolved the limitation by shaping the noise pathway acausally. Because the driving noise is synthetic, its future can be sampled now, so the audio-to-expression path stays causal, and the model supports fully causal operation. FaceGAN emits expression and head pose in a single forward pass per frame and matches or outperforms state-of-art approaches in generation quality. Being feed-forward with bounded attention windows, it generates indefinitely without drift.

AI.tldr: 提出FaceGAN：通过非因果噪声通路将音频驱动表情与头姿生成转化为单次前向的GAN框架，兼顾流式实时性与生成质量且无漂移。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动面部动画需在线流式运行（每帧仅依赖当前及历史音频，且需交互帧率）。扩散模型因需多次网络评估而不适配流式，但作者认为该代价不必要：音频条件的面部运动处于低维流形，单次前向GAN已足够。真正障碍在于随机结构而非模型容量。
AI.method: 作者证明：由i.i.d.噪声驱动的因果、时不变生成器，若要在某个频带内抑制输出谱，就必然导致每步创新（per-step innovation）坍缩，形成固有矛盾。FaceGAN的解法是"非因果地塑造噪声通路"：由于驱动噪声是合成的，其未来值可以在当前时刻采样得到，从而实现非因果噪声调制；而音频到表情的映射路径仍保持因果，因此整体支持完全因果操作。模型每帧单次前向同时输出表情与头部姿态。
AI.result: 生成质量匹配或优于当前最先进方法（state-of-the-art）；单次前向、有界注意力窗口，可无限时长生成且不产生漂移。
AI.conclusion: 音频驱动面部动画无需依赖多步扩散，单次前向GAN配合非因果噪声塑造即可满足流式实时的在线需求，在质量、效率与长时稳定性上取得优势。

title: Contrast Enhancement or Noise Reduction? On Improving Cervical Cancer Classification
summary:
Purpose: Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Deep learning has shown promising performance in medical image classification. The influence of image preprocessing algorithms on classification performance remains insufficiently investigated in the literature. This research aims to evaluate the impact of image preprocessing algorithms on the performance of CNNs for Pap smear image classification.
  Methods: Three CNN architectures (ResNet-34, MobileNet-V2, and DenseNet-121) were trained and evaluated using the SIPaKMeD dataset. Two preprocessing algorithms were applied: the PMD filter for noise reduction and CLAHE for contrast enhancement. The model performance was assessed using a confusion matrix.
  Results: Preprocessing improved the classification performance of all models. CLAHE significantly increased the accuracy of ResNet-34 from 76.73% to 84.16% and DenseNet-121 from 76.73% to 84.16%. The PMD filter yielded limited improvement and slightly reduced the MobileNet-V2 performance.
  Novelty: This research provides a systematic comparison of contrast enhancement and noise reduction techniques across CNN architectures. This research demonstrates that contrast enhancement is more effective than noise reduction in improving CNN performance. The research provides new pipelines for improving cervical cancer classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了图像预处理算法对CNN宫颈癌巴氏涂片图像分类性能的影响，发现CLAHE对比度增强比PMD去噪更有效。
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌是全球主要致死原因之一，深度学习在医学图像分类中表现良好，但图像预处理算法对分类性能的影响在文献中研究不足，因此需要评估预处理对CNN巴氏涂片分类性能的作用。
AI.method: 使用SIPaKMeD数据集，训练并评估三种CNN架构（ResNet-34、MobileNet-V2、DenseNet-121）；应用两种预处理算法：用于降噪的PMD滤波器和用于对比度增强的CLAHE；通过混淆矩阵评估模型性能。
AI.result: 预处理提升了所有模型的分类性能。CLAHE显著将ResNet-34的准确率从76.73%提升至84.16%，DenseNet-121同样从76.73%提升至84.16%。PMD滤波器改进有限，并略微降低了MobileNet-V2的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统比较了不同CNN架构下的对比度增强与降噪技术，证明对比度增强在提升CNN性能方面比降噪更有效，并为改进宫颈癌分类提供了新的流程方案。

title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
summary: Visual tracking across the air-water interface is challenged by splashes, bubbles, refraction, reflections, and abrupt appearance changes that can temporarily invalidate observations. This setting poses two coupled difficulties: first, for evaluation, image-only annotation cannot reliably describe the target's physical location during visual blindness; second, for online tracking, corrupted observations can contaminate motion estimates and appearance templates. We address the first difficulty with a construction pipeline that synchronizes camera frames with motion-capture poses, projects known target geometry, corrects underwater projection with a medium-gated residual, and subjects the annotations to manual review. This yields an evaluation-only cross-medium test set of 22,346 frames. We further introduce a Cross-Medium Recovery Policy (CMRP) centered on confidence-triggered template selection. It supplies MixFormerV2 with the fixed initial template, a window-best pre-trigger template, and a trigger-frame Kalman-guided image crop, together with their associated weights, without retraining the visual backbone. In the accuracy evaluation, CMRP achieves 49.90 Macro Success AUC, 2.95 points above MixFormerV2 Official. On selected cross-medium transition and occlusion-recovery intervals, CMRP increases MixFormerV2 tracking coverage from 47.91\% to 50.43\% relative to Official updating, while mean loss-to-recovery latency over successfully recovered videos decreases from 55.3 to 49.3 frames.

AI.tldr: 提出跨介质（气-水界面）视觉跟踪评估数据集与CMRP策略，无需重训练主干即可提升MixFormerV2在遮挡/瞬态失效下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 气-水界面下的视觉跟踪受水花、气泡、折射、反射及外观突变影响，观测会暂时失效。由此带来两个耦合难题：评估上，仅靠图像标注无法可靠描述视觉盲区时目标的真实物理位置；在线跟踪上，被污染的观测会污染运动估计与外观模板。
AI.method: 针对评估难题，构建同步相机帧与动捕位姿的标注流水线：投影已知目标几何、用介质门控残差校正水下投影，并辅以人工复核，得到仅用于评估的跨介质测试集（22,346帧）。针对跟踪难题，提出跨介质恢复策略CMRP，核心为置信度触发的模板选择：为MixFormerV2提供固定初始模板、窗口内最优的预触发模板、触发帧的卡尔曼引导图像裁剪及相应权重，且不重训练视觉主干。
AI.result: 精度评估中，CMRP达到49.90 Macro Success AUC，较MixFormerV2 Official高2.95个点。在选定的跨介质转换与遮挡恢复区间，CMRP将MixFormerV2的跟踪覆盖率相对Official更新从47.91%提升至50.43%，且成功恢复视频的平均丢失-恢复延迟由55.3帧降至49.3帧。
AI.conclusion: 物理位置可靠的跨介质评测基准与置信度触发的模板选择机制，可有效缓解界面遮挡/折射导致的观测失效，在不重训练主干的前提下提升跟踪精度、覆盖率并缩短恢复延迟。

title: Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation for Thin Curvilinear Structures
summary: Accurate segmentation of thin curvilinear structures is vital for various real-world applications, from vessel analysis to road extraction. Yet their intricate geometry makes even minor pixel-wise errors enough to break the global topology, and this structural fragility turns severe domain shifts into catastrophic failures. The difficulty is most acute under cross-modality gaps, where the imaging process itself differs fundamentally between source and target. While test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical source-free remedy, existing methods adapt feature statistics and confidence, neither of which constrains connectivity, and thus degrade under such extreme gaps. To address this, we propose Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation (SGP-TTA). Progressive Batch Normalization (ProgBN) shifts normalization from frozen source statistics toward current target estimates under a sample-count schedule, so that the source-target balance follows the stage of adaptation rather than a fixed coefficient. Consensus Skeleton Recall (CSR) then derives a structural target from geometrically aligned multi-view predictions and updates only the BN affine parameters to preserve connected structures. Extensive experiments show that SGP-TTA consistently outperforms existing TTA methods in topological connectivity, with the largest margins under cross-modality shift. The project page is available at https://boa-jang.github.io/SGP-TTA.

AI.tldr: 针对细长曲线结构在跨模态域偏移下拓扑易断的问题，提出骨架引导渐进式测试时适应方法SGP-TTA，通过渐进批归一化和共识骨架召回率约束连通性，取得最优拓扑连接性能。
AI.motivation: 细长曲线结构（如血管、道路）分割对众多实际应用至关重要，但其几何结构精细，微小像素级误差即可破坏全局拓扑，结构脆弱性使严重域偏移演变为灾难性失败。跨模态场景下成像过程根本不同，问题尤为严峻。现有测试时适应方法仅调整特征统计量和置信度，未约束连通性，在极端模态间隙下性能退化。
AI.method: 提出Skeleton-Guided Progressive Test-Time Adaptation（SGP-TTA）。包含两个核心组件：渐进批归一化（ProgBN），按样本数调度将归一化从冻结的源域统计量逐步转向当前目标域估计，使源-目标平衡随适应阶段变化而非固定系数；共识骨架召回率（CSR），从几何对齐的多视角预测中推导结构目标，仅更新BN仿射参数以保持连通结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SGP-TTA在拓扑连通性上持续优于现有TTA方法，且在跨模态偏移下取得最大领先幅度。项目页面：https://boa-jang.github.io/SGP-TTA。
AI.conclusion: SGP-TTA通过渐进归一化与骨架召回率约束实现了无源跨模态测试时适应，有效保护细长曲线结构的拓扑连通性，在跨模态偏移场景优势尤为显著。

title: TKCAM: Text and Keyframe to Camera Trajectory Generation
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures. Paper accepted to NeurIPS2026 (submission number 15461)
summary: Generating high-quality and controllable camera motion is essential for AI-assisted cinematography, video synthesis, and 3D scene understanding. We introduce TKCAM, a Text- and Keyframe-conditioned CAMera-motion synthesis framework based on generative masked modeling. We represent camera dynamics using a 12-dimensional kinematic feature comprising position, velocity, and a continuous rotation representation and discretize them into hierarchical motion tokens via a Residual Vector Quantizer (RVQ). A two-stage masked transformer architecture then learns to reconstruct and refine these tokens, utilizing explicit self- and cross-attention modules for multimodal conditioning. A central feature of our framework is sparse visual keyframe conditioning: users can provide free-form text prompts together with RGB observations at selected timestamps, which provide temporally localized visual guidance for generating coherent in-between trajectories. Furthermore, to advance evaluation standards, we curate RealEstate10K-Cap, a large-scale text-camera dataset, and establish a cross-domain benchmark with a Universal CLaTr Evaluator. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TKCAM surpasses recent state-of-the-art baselines on Fréchet distance (FID), text-motion matching scores, and retrieval metrics (R@K), while additional analyses evaluate temporal smoothness and cross-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/linearalgebrayhz/TKCAM.

AI.tldr: 提出TKCAM，一种文本与关键帧条件驱动的摄像机运动合成框架，基于生成式掩码建模，并构建RealEstate10K-Cap数据集与通用评测基准。
AI.motivation: 高质量且可控的摄像机运动生成对AI辅助电影摄影、视频合成与3D场景理解至关重要。现有方法在文本与稀疏视觉关键帧联合条件下生成连贯的中间轨迹方面存在不足，且缺乏统一的大规模文本-摄像机数据集与评测标准。
AI.method: 将摄像机动态表示为包含位置、速度和连续旋转表示的12维运动学特征，通过残差向量量化器（RVQ）离散化为层次化运动token。采用两阶段掩码Transformer架构，先重建再精炼这些token，并借助显式自注意力与交叉注意力模块实现多模态条件融合。框架核心为稀疏视觉关键帧条件：用户可在选定时间戳提供自由文本提示与RGB观测，生成时序局部化的视觉引导以产生连贯的中间轨迹。
AI.result: 整理出大规模文本-摄像机数据集RealEstate10K-Cap，并基于通用CLaTr评测器建立跨域基准。大量实验表明，TKCAM在Fréchet距离（FID）、文本-运动匹配分数与检索指标（R@K）上超越近期最先进基线，同时评估了时间平滑性与跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TKCAM通过掩码生成建模与稀疏关键帧条件，实现了高质量、可控的摄像机运动合成，并配套数据集与评测基准推动了该领域评价标准的进步。

title: DiscoVL: Unveiling Disentangled C ross-Modal Representation Learning via Orthogonal Adversarial Regularization for V ision-Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026
summary: Pre-trained vision-language models excel across varied perception tasks, but adapting them to novel downstream settings without sacrificing generalization remains non-trivial. Existing parameter-efficient prompt learning method often yields inconsistent representations and fails to account for semantic distribution shifts. In this work, we present DiscoVL, a disentangled cross-modal representation learning framework that couples orthogonal adversarial regularization with structured cross-modal alignment for vision-language models. To address the insufficient cross-modal interaction, our DiscoVL designs a multi-branch low-rank residual aligner that decomposes representations into subspaces and enables bidirectional cross-modal feedback between visual and textual streams at each layer. Furthermore, while conventional triplet constraints overfit features to class centroids, we design an orthogonal regularization for adversarial triplet loss, which prevents centroid collapse and substantially boosts generalization. Evaluations on 15 benchmarks demonstrate that DiscoVL delivers consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods for base-to-novel generalization, cross-dataset evaluation, and few-shot learning

AI.tldr: DiscoVL：解耦跨模态表示学习框架，结合正交对抗正则与结构化跨模态对齐，在15个基准上提升基类到新类泛化、跨数据集评估与少样本学习。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型虽在多任务上表现优异，但适配新下游场景时难以兼顾泛化性。现有参数高效提示学习方法常产生不一致表示，且未考虑语义分布偏移（semantic distribution shift）。
AI.method: 提出 DiscoVL 解耦跨模态表示学习框架：1）多分支低秩残差对齐器，将表示分解到子空间，并在每层实现视觉与文本流的双向跨模态反馈，以增强跨模态交互；2）针对传统三元组约束易使特征过拟合类中心的问题，设计面向对抗三元组损失的正交正则化，防止质心坍缩。
AI.result: 在15个基准上的评估表明，DiscoVL 在基类到新类泛化、跨数据集评估和少样本学习三项任务上均持续优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过正交对抗正则与结构化跨模态对齐的耦合，DiscoVL 在参数高效适配下有效缓解表示不一致与语义分布偏移，兼顾泛化性能。

title: MCL: Meta Convolution Layer
summary: Dynamic convolution enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by adapting kernels to input content, but it expresses the effective kernel as a linear mixture of a small number of basis kernels, which limits expressivity and complicates optimization as the mixture size grows. In this work, we revisit dynamic convolution from a functional perspective and propose the Meta Convolution Layer (MCL), which directly models the convolutional kernel as an input-conditioned function W(x) realized via a high-order polynomial expansion. Leveraging nested residual blocks inspired by deep polynomial networks, MCL implements a structured polynomial meta-network that generates a single input-adaptive kernel, thereby decoupling representational power from the explicit number of mixture kernels and alleviating training instability. MCL is a plug-in addition with standard convolutions and can be seamlessly integrated into both CNN and transformer backbones. Experimental evaluation shows that adding MCL improves the Top-1 accuracy of Resnet- 18, Resnet-50 and ResNet-101 by 6.61%, 3.42% and 3.05% on the ImageNet dataset. Moreover, the proposed method significantly boosts the accuracy of Resnet and Wide-Resnet variants on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets. Additionally, the proposed method outperforms previous methods on fine-grained visual classification tasks using Swin and ViT backbones. These results demonstrate that high-order polynomial kernel generation is a powerful and scalable alternative to linear mixture based dynamic convolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Meta Convolution Layer（MCL），从函数视角将卷积核建模为输入条件函数 W(x)，通过高阶多项式展开与嵌套残差块实现核生成，解耦表达能力与混合核数量，可即插即用于 CNN 与 Transformer，在 ImageNet、CIFAR 及细粒度分类任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 动态卷积通过使卷积核适应输入内容来增强 CNN，但现有方法将有效核表示为少量基核的线性混合，这限制了表达能力，且随着混合规模增大优化变得复杂、训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 Meta Convolution Layer（MCL），从函数视角重新审视动态卷积，直接将卷积核建模为输入条件函数 W(x)，并经由高阶多项式展开实现。受深度多项式网络启发，采用嵌套残差块构建结构化多项式元网络，生成单一输入自适应核，从而将表达能力与显式混合核数量解耦，缓解训练不稳定。MCL 作为插件与标准卷积结合，可无缝集成到 CNN 和 Transformer 骨干中。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上，加入 MCL 使 ResNet-18、ResNet-50、ResNet-101 的 Top-1 准确率分别提升 6.61%、3.42%、3.05%；在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上显著提升 ResNet 与 Wide-ResNet 变体的准确率；在使用 Swin 和 ViT 骨干的细粒度视觉分类任务上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，高阶多项式核生成是线性混合式动态卷积的一种强大且可扩展的替代方案。

title: IntrinSync: Joint Intrinsic Decomposition and Reciprocal Rendering
summary: Inverse rendering decomposes an image into intrinsic properties such as appearance, illumination, geometry, and material, yet these properties are inherently interdependent. A reliable decomposition should produce intrinsic maps that are not only individually plausible, but also mutually compatible in explaining the image. However, existing methods either model intrinsic channels in isolation or treat inverse and forward rendering as separate processes, leaving the interdependence underexploited. In this paper, we introduce IntrinSync, a unified framework that captures this interdependence through joint-channel modeling and reciprocal inverse-forward rendering. At the channel level, we jointly decompose an input RGB into albedo, shading, surface normal, roughness, and metallic maps through a 1-to-N mapping, enabling information exchange across channels throughout generation. At the process level, we establish inverse-forward reciprocity through a dual cycle-consistent objective that aligns corresponding predictions across a closed loop. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive intrinsic estimation and forward rendering performance, improving coherence and physical consistency. Beyond decomposition, IntrinSync provides a physically grounded interface for image editing, allowing intrinsic properties to be explicitly manipulated and rendered back into RGB images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntrinSync，一个通过联合通道建模与逆向-正向渲染互惠机制来捕捉本征属性相互依赖关系的统一逆向渲染框架。
AI.motivation: 逆向渲染需将图像分解为外观、光照、几何、材质等本征属性，但这些属性本质上相互依赖。现有方法要么孤立地建模各本征通道，要么将逆向与正向渲染视为独立过程，未能充分利用这种相互依赖性。可靠分解应产生既各自合理又相互兼容的本征图。
AI.method: 在通道层面，采用1对N映射将输入RGB联合分解为反照率、着色、表面法线、粗糙度和金属度图，实现生成过程中跨通道的信息交换；在过程层面，通过双循环一致性目标建立逆向-正向互惠关系，在闭环中对齐相应预测。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在本征估计与正向渲染上均达到有竞争力的性能，并提升了连贯性与物理一致性。此外，IntrinSync提供了物理基础扎实的图像编辑接口，可显式操控本征属性并渲染回RGB图像。
AI.conclusion: IntrinSync通过联合通道建模与逆向-正向互惠，有效捕捉本征属性的相互依赖，实现连贯且物理一致的本征分解与渲染，并支持可解释的图像编辑应用。

title: Improving Image-Based Nutrition Estimation Through Multimodal Food-Item Verification and Recovery
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Single-image nutrition estimation can fail silently when visible foods are missed. Even when a food is correctly identified, its proposed region may not support portion estimation. We propose a framework that uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to inventory visible foods and separately verify food identity and whether each proposed 2D region supports portion estimation. One whole-image review uses these verification results to identify unresolved gaps and omitted foods, triggering at most one targeted recovery pass. Recovered regions are re-verified without access to the recovery prompt, then reconciled into a final item set for nutrition estimation. The framework requires no task-specific fine-tuning. Matched evaluation on common valid-output samples shows that item-level grounding improves mass accuracy across all tested settings and energy accuracy relative to an adapted retrieval baseline, with item-identity precision and recall also improving, while post-recovery visual coverage is assessed separately at inference time without ground-truth annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的单图营养估计框架，通过"清单化—双验证—一次定向恢复—再验证"流程，解决可见食物遗漏与区域不支持份量估计的静默失败问题，无需任务特定微调。
AI.motivation: 单图像营养估计存在两类静默失败：一是可见食物被漏检；二是即便食物被正确识别，其候选区域也可能不足以支撑份量（portion）估计。这类错误往往不报错，导致营养估算结果不可靠。
AI.method: 用MLLM先对可见食物做清单化（inventory），并分别验证食物身份（identity）与每个候选2D区域是否支持份量估计；再以一次全图复核（whole-image review）汇总验证结果，找出未解决的缺口与被遗漏食物，触发至多一次定向恢复（targeted recovery pass）；恢复得到的区域在不接触恢复提示（recovery prompt）的条件下重新验证，最后调和（reconcile）为最终条目集合用于营养估计。全流程无需任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在共同有效输出样本上的匹配评估显示：条目级定位（item-level grounding）在所有测试设置下均提升质量估计精度，相对适配后的检索基线（adapted retrieval baseline）提升能量估计精度；条目身份识别的精确率与召回率也均有提升。恢复后的视觉覆盖率在推理时单独评估，不使用真值标注。
AI.conclusion: 通过MLLM驱动的显式验证与至多一次定向恢复，可在免微调条件下缓解单图营养估计中的静默失败，改善条目定位、身份识别与质量/能量估计；恢复覆盖率可作为推理期的无标注评估指标。

title: SP-DocReader: Difference-Aware Self-Play for Precise Document OCR
summary: Accurate page transcription remains difficult for vision language models under limited input and training budgets. We present SP-DocReader, a self-play framework for optical character recognition (OCR) that targets residual errors after supervised fine-tuning. Reading Discrepancy Masking aligns reference and generated model tokens through a longest common subsequence, then scores unmatched positions with their full conditioning prefixes. Focused Fidelity Loss adds direct negative log-likelihood supervision at unmatched ground-truth positions. Only the OCR module is trained, while the backbone remains frozen. We derive the combined gradient to distinguish relative score optimization from direct supervision. Compared with SFT-2, SP-DR-3 reduces Vary-600K character error rate on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it reduces character error rate by approximately 54 percent and improves DocVQA Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) by 3.7 points. These results show the value of focusing self-play training on the discrepancies that remain after supervised fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出SP-DocReader自博弈OCR框架，针对监督微调后的残余错误进行训练。
AI.motivation: 在有限输入与训练预算下，视觉语言模型的页面转录仍不准确；监督微调后仍存在残余错误未被针对性优化。
AI.method: 采用Reading Discrepancy Masking，通过最长公共子序列对齐参考与生成token，并用完整条件前缀对未匹配位置打分；引入Focused Fidelity Loss，对未匹配的ground-truth位置施加直接负对数似然监督；仅训练OCR模块，主干冻结；推导组合梯度以区分相对分数优化与直接监督。
AI.result: 与SFT-2相比，SP-DR-3在两种主干上均降低Vary-600K字符错误率；在Qwen3-VL-4B上字符错误率下降约54%，DocVQA的ANLS提升3.7个点。
AI.conclusion: 将自博弈训练聚焦于监督微调后残留的差异，能够有效提升OCR转录与文档理解性能。

title: A Unified Score Matching Paradigm for Video Anomaly Detection and Anticipation
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a fundamental and safety-critical task in computer vision. Recent generative approaches detect anomalies from a distributional perspective, but remain limited by local anomaly modes. Meanwhile, video anomaly anticipation (VAA), as a proactive extension beyond post-hoc detection, introduces additional challenges. In particular, the contrastive inference paradigm in VAD, which relies on ground-truth frames, is not applicable to VAA, hindering its development. To address these challenges, we propose a unified score-driven framework, termed Uni-DSM, based on denoising score matching (DSM), which models anomaly patterns through likelihood estimation and score functions over the learned data distribution. Within this unified framework, we adopt a shared noise-conditioned score transformer backbone with scene-dependent embeddings and motion-aware weighting for distribution-level modeling. Instead of introducing separate architectures, Uni-DSM unifies VAD and VAA through different inference and supervision paradigms built upon the same score-based formulation. For VAD, we instantiate an autoregressive denoising score matching (ADSM) mechanism, which progressively accumulates anomalous evidence via autoregressive denoising, enabling enhanced perception of local modes beyond visual cues. For VAA, we extend the same architecture by incorporating a lightweight auxiliary decoder and a novel self-distilled denoising score matching (SDSM) mechanism. By constructing supervision from output discrepancies instead of relying on unavailable future ground truth, our method achieves efficient training suitable or early anomaly anticipation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both VAD and VAA while maintaining high efficiency, establishing a unified and scalable pipeline from anomaly detection to anticipation.

AI.tldr: 提出统一分数驱动框架 Uni-DSM，基于去噪分数匹配同时建模视频异常检测（VAD）与视频异常预判（VAA），在多个基准上取得SOTA且高效。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式VAD方法从分布角度检测异常，但受限于局部异常模式；VAA作为后验检测的主动扩展带来额外挑战，尤其VAD中的对比推理范式依赖真值帧，无法用于VAA，阻碍其发展。因此需要统一框架解决两类任务。
AI.method: 基于去噪分数匹配（DSM）建模异常模式（似然估计与分数函数）。采用共享的噪声条件分数Transformer主干，结合场景相关嵌入与运动感知加权进行分布级建模。VAD实例化自回归去噪分数匹配（ADSM），通过自回归去噪累积异常证据；VAA复用同架构并加入轻量辅助解码器与自蒸馏去噪分数匹配（SDSM），以输出差异构造监督替代不可得的未来真值。统一框架下通过不同推理与监督范式实现两任务。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，VAD与VAA均达到SOTA性能，同时保持高效率。
AI.conclusion: Uni-DSM建立了从异常检测到异常预判的统一、可扩展流水线。

title: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
summary: Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. The teacher fuses multi-level representations and transfers logit-standardized class-discriminative knowledge to the student. To further refine the explanation pathway, we design diversity and sparsity terms to regularize student attention heads, reducing redundancy and encouraging compact trait localization. Experiments on CUB, Oxford-IIIT Pet, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars show that CARE achieves strong classification performance under an interpretable frozen-backbone setting, reaching 78.5% Top-1 accuracy on CUB. Faithfulness analysis with insertion and deletion metrics further indicates that the top-ranked attention regions retain class-relevant evidence for explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE框架，通过教师-学生蒸馏实现可解释的细粒度视觉分类：学生模型保持类特定注意力结构并负责最终预测与解释，训练期辅助教师读取DINOv2中间层特征并向学生传递类别判别知识，同时用多样性与稀疏正则约束注意力头。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉分类需要识别细微局部特征并给出预测依据。类特定注意力路径天然具备可解释性，但其受限的预测结构削弱了判别能力，且未能充分利用强预训练骨干网络的中间层表征，导致性能与解释性难以兼顾。
AI.method: CARE采用约束式注意力精炼框架：1）学生端为类特定注意力模块，最终预测与解释均由学生给出，保持解释路径的结构约束；2）引入仅训练时使用的辅助查询教师，以可学习查询读取DINOv2若干选定中间层，融合多层级表征；3）教师通过logit标准化将类别判别知识蒸馏至学生；4）为学生注意力头设计多样性项与稀疏项正则，降低冗余、促进紧凑的特征定位。骨干网络冻结。
AI.result: 在CUB、Oxford-IIIT Pet、Stanford Dogs、Stanford Cars数据集上，CARE在可解释的冻结骨干设定下取得较强分类性能，CUB上Top-1准确率达78.5%。插入（insertion）与删除（deletion）忠实性指标分析表明，排名靠前的注意力区域保留了与类别相关的证据，可用作解释。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期辅助教师蒸馏中间层判别知识并对学生注意力施加结构与正则约束，CARE在保持类特定注意力可解释性的同时提升了细粒度分类性能，且注意力区域具备较好的解释忠实性。

title: VGGTWorld-VLA: Intent-Conditioned 3D World Evolution for Autonomous Driving
summary: VGGT provides a strong foundation for geometry-centric world models by recovering unified 3D scene geometry from visual observations. Although recent extensions enable temporal 3D prediction, their future evolution remains weakly conditioned on driving intentions and actions, limiting their ability to model alternative action-dependent futures. We propose VGGTWorld-VLA, an intention-conditioned extension of VGGT-World for controllable 3D world evolution in autonomous driving. First, we introduce an action--semantic conditioning mechanism that injects complementary driving semantics and ego-motion representations into the future-token stream, enabling different future geometry predictions for the same observed scene under alternative ego actions. Second, we develop a geometry--language--action bridge that adapts historical geometry, VLA semantic features, and maneuver and trajectory representations for joint conditioning of future geometry prediction. We evaluate future geometry prediction on NAVSIM, while conditioning ablations further examine the contributions of semantic and action information. Compared with the baseline, our method demonstrates competitive geometry prediction performance. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of semantic and action conditioning. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic and action conditioning for controllable VGGT-based world prediction in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出 VGGTWorld-VLA，通过意图/动作条件化扩展 VGGT-World，实现自动驾驶中可控的3D世界演化预测。
AI.motivation: 现有 VGGT 扩展虽能做时序3D预测，但未来演化对驾驶意图与动作的条件约束较弱，难以建模依赖动作的多样化未来场景。
AI.method: 引入动作—语义条件化机制，将驾驶语义与自车运动表示注入未来token流；构建几何—语言—动作桥，联合历史几何、VLA语义特征与机动/轨迹表示来条件化未来几何预测。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 上评估未来几何预测，性能与基线相比具有竞争力；条件化消融实验验证了语义与动作信息的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 语义与动作条件化可有效支撑基于 VGGT 的可控世界预测，在自动驾驶中具有潜力。

title: AutoAdapt: Reliable Few-Shot Adaptation under Clinical Distribution Shifts
summary: Large pretrained clinical models provide a practical way to reuse learned prior knowledge across hospitals by adapting models to them. In practice, a target hospital may only have a small labeled patient cohort, a setting commonly referred to as few-shot adaptation. This requires making multiple decisions, such as which pretrained model to adapt, how much of the model to update, and which patients to use. Nevertheless, this process faces two primary challenges. First, the best adaptation strategy varies across clinical tasks. Second, evaluating and comparing candidate strategies becomes unreliable due to the small patient cohort. In this work, we introduce AutoAdapt with two core designs to deal with these challenges. The Adapter defines an extensible space of adaptation recipes, and the Automator forms a weighted recipe combination from evidence within the adaptation patients. We propose a reliability rule to ensure that only the most effective strategy on most available patients will be selected. These selected strategies then form a combination for effective few-shot adaptation. We conduct extensive experiments across critical care, emergency care, and diagnostic datasets, and the results show that AutoAdapt consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance using only a few patients for adaptation.

AI.tldr: AutoAdapt：通过Adapter定义可扩展的适配配方空间，Automator在适配患者内基于证据形成加权配方组合，并用可靠性规则保证选择最有效策略，实现小样本临床模型适配的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练临床模型可通过适配实现跨医院先验知识复用，但目标医院常仅有少量标注患者队列（few-shot adaptation）。该过程需决策适配哪个模型、更新多少参数、使用哪些患者。两大挑战：最优适配策略因临床任务而异；小患者队列使候选策略的评估与比较不可靠。
AI.method: 提出AutoAdapt，含两个核心设计：Adapter定义可扩展的适配配方（recipe）空间；Automator依据适配患者内部的证据形成加权配方组合。此外提出可靠性规则，确保仅选择在大多数可用患者上最有效的策略，所选策略再组合成用于有效小样本适配的最终方案。
AI.result: 在重症监护、急诊护理和诊断数据集上进行大量实验，结果显示AutoAdapt仅用少量患者进行适配即可持续达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: AutoAdapt通过可扩展适配配方空间与证据驱动的加权组合，并借助可靠性规则缓解策略选择不可靠问题，在多种临床任务的少样本适配中稳定优于现有方法。

title: VAMR: Multi-Question Agentic Reasoning for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Long-form video understanding often involves multiple questions about different aspects of the same recording. Yet existing video agents typically process each question through an isolated tool-use trajectory. This repeatedly restarts video exploration and memory construction, missing opportunities to acquire evidence jointly and progressively build a shared understanding that supports the complete question set. We introduce \textbf{VAMR} (\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{A}gent for \textbf{M}ulti-Question \textbf{R}easoning), which coordinates all questions about a video through one shared tool-use trajectory. At each round, a persistent policy model can invoke tools for one or more unresolved questions and submit answers for questions with sufficient evidence. Question-conditioned visual perception retrieves fine-grained clues for several questions in one call, while layered multi-question memory integrates reusable context into a shared video story and preserves separate evidence for individual questions. After supervised fine-tuning initializes this interaction protocol, we propose question-horizon policy optimization (\qhpo) to optimize shared trajectories in which questions progress and finish at different rounds. Specifically, a question-level critic estimates the value of each active question, while round alignment maps each question advantage to the rounds that directly serve it before the aligned advantages are aggregated to optimize the shared actor. Across LVBench, Video-Holmes, and LongVideoBench, VAMR achieves the highest accuracy overall and the fewest reasoning rounds among iterative methods. On LVBench, it reaches 62.1\% accuracy, exceeding VideoARM by \textbf{4.3} points while reducing reasoning rounds and processed frames by \textbf{85.9\%} and \textbf{61.4\%}.

AI.tldr: 提出VAMR，用一条共享工具使用轨迹协调同一长视频的多个问题，并设计问题级评论家与轮次对齐的QHPO优化，在多个基准上以更少轮次和帧数取得最高精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视频智能体对每个问题独立执行工具调用轨迹，反复重启视频探索与记忆构建，无法联合获取证据并逐步形成支持整组问题的共享理解，造成效率与效果的双重损失。
AI.method: VAMR通过单一共享轨迹协调视频的全部问题：每轮持久策略模型可为多个未解决问题调用工具、对证据充分的问题提交答案；问题条件化视觉感知一次调用检索多个问题的细粒度线索；分层多问题记忆将可复用上下文整合为共享视频故事，同时为单个问题保留独立证据。先用监督微调初始化交互协议，再用问题-视野策略优化（QHPO）优化问题在不同轮次推进与完成的共享轨迹，其中问题级评论家估计每个活跃问题的价值，轮次对齐将每个问题优势映射到直接服务该问题的轮次，再聚合对齐后的优势优化共享actor。
AI.result: 在LVBench、Video-Holmes、LongVideoBench上，VAMR总体精度最高，且在迭代方法中推理轮次最少。在LVBench达到62.1%精度，超过VideoARM 4.3个百分点，同时推理轮次与处理帧数分别减少85.9%和61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 共享轨迹的多问题协调范式可同时提升长视频理解精度与推理效率，QHPO为多问题异步推进的轨迹优化提供了有效方案。

title: IntactWorld: Joint World Modeling with Intact Features
summary: While recent video generation models synthesize highly realistic visuals, they lack a genuine understanding of intrinsic real-world logic. Existing methods attempt to understand the world by internalizing diverse world knowledge, yet constrained by computational overhead or dimensionality alignment, their learning processes inevitably compress features, causing a severe loss of structural information. To address this, we propose \textbf{IntactWorld}, a \textbf{Joint World Modeling Architecture} utilizing uncompressed \textbf{Intact Features}. Since data naturally reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a high-dimensional space, predicting the flow velocity $v$ within this uncompressed high-dimensional space induces a severe manifold gap. To successfully eliminate this optimization bottleneck, our framework instead predicts the clean feature $x_0$ at intermediate layers. Furthermore, to mitigate the computational overhead of incorporating complete world knowledge, we introduce a \textit{Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm}. By replacing raw full features with highly refined CLS tokens, this paradigm enables efficient single-branch guidance, reducing spatial memory consumption by 11.4\% and cutting inference latency by 43.8\%. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of IntactWorld, outperforming established baselines by 2.46 points on the VBench 2.0 benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出 IntactWorld——一种联合世界建模架构，利用未压缩的完整特征进行视频生成的世界建模。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高度逼真的画面，但缺乏对真实世界内在逻辑的理解；已有方法因计算开销或维度对齐限制，在学习过程中不可避免地压缩特征，导致严重的结构信息损失。
AI.method: 在未压缩高维空间中预测中层干净特征 x0 而非流速度 v，以规避流形间隙带来的优化瓶颈；并提出 Full-to-Compact 训练范式，用高度精炼的 CLS token 替代原始完整特征，实现高效单分支引导。
AI.result: 空间内存消耗降低 11.4%，推理延迟减少 43.8%；在 VBench 2.0 基准上较既有基线提升 2.46 分。
AI.conclusion: IntactWorld 通过保留完整特征结构并配合高效训练范式，有效提升了视频生成模型对真实世界逻辑的建模能力。

title: Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration: A Comprehensive Review, Challenges and Prospects
comment: 12 figures, 8 tables, 135 references. Review article accepted for publication in Photogrammetric Engineering and Remote Sensing (ASPS), manuscript number PERS-26-00034
summary: Multimodal remote sensing image registration is a crucial prerequisite for the collaborative processing and downstream application of remote sensing data, such as image fusion, change detection, and target recognition. However, significant variations in radiometry, geometry, scale, viewpoint, and time often exist between multimodal images. These differences, driven by varying sensor geometries, physical radiation mechanisms, imaging platforms, and environmental disturbances, pose severe challenges to achieving high-precision, robust registration. This paper systematically reviews the progress of mainstream multimodal remote sensing image registration methods. Based on their registration pipelines, existing approaches are categorized into three main types: region-based, feature-based, and deep learning-based methods. We detail the core principles, representative algorithms, advantages, and limitations of each category. Additionally, we summarize publicly available multimodal image datasets in the remote sensing domain, analyzing their specific characteristics and applicable scenarios. Finally, we highlight current bottlenecks in high-precision registration research and outline future development trends. This review aims to provide a comprehensive reference and valuable insights for researchers in related fields.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了多模态遥感图像配准方法，按配准流程将其分为区域法、特征法和深度学习法三类，详述其原理、代表算法及优缺点，总结公开数据集，并指出当前瓶颈与未来趋势。
AI.motivation: 多模态遥感图像配准是图像融合、变化检测、目标识别等协同处理和下游应用的关键前提。然而，多模态图像在辐射、几何、尺度、视角和时间上差异显著，这些差异源于传感器几何、物理辐射机制、成像平台和环境干扰的不同，给高精度、鲁棒配准带来严峻挑战，因此有必要系统梳理该领域进展。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述性论文，依据配准流程将主流方法划分为区域法、特征法和深度学习法三大类，逐一阐述各类别的核心原理、代表性算法、优势与局限；同时汇总遥感领域公开的多模态图像数据集，分析其特征与适用场景。
AI.result: 梳理并分类了多模态遥感图像配准的主流方法体系，明确了三大类方法的核心原理与代表算法，总结了公开多模态数据集及其特性与适用场景，提炼出高精度配准研究的当前瓶颈与未来发展方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为多模态遥感图像配准领域提供了全面的参考和有价值的见解，有助于相关领域研究者把握方法脉络、数据集资源及未来研究趋势。

title: MATE4D: Matrix-Guided Editable 4D Generation from a Single Image
summary: Generative models have rapidly pushed content creation be-yond 2D imagery toward dynamic 3D and 4D scene synthesis. Yet pro-ducing realistic and temporally stable 4D content from a single image is still difficult because one view provides limited structural cues and weak motion evidence. We introduce MATE4D, a framework that converts one input image into editable dynamic 4D content. Our method constructs a spatio-temporal multi-view image matrix with text-guided background manipulation, delivering coherent supervision over viewpoint, appear-ance, and motion. These synthesized observations are used to optimize 3D Gaussian primitives, which are then animated through a lightweight deformation module to form a 4D representation. The resulting scenes preserve geometry more faithfully, maintain smoother temporal behavior, and keep background edits more consistent, reducing context ambiguity and motion artifacts. Experiments on Objaverse-XL and Diffusion4D show that MATE4D outperforms strong baselines in visual quality, effi-ciency, and controllability, supporting practical AR/VR content creation.

AI.tldr: MATE4D 从单张图像生成可编辑动态 4D 内容，通过时空多视图图像矩阵提供监督，优化 3D 高斯并配合轻量变形模块，在 Objaverse-XL 与 Diffusion4D 上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 单视图提供结构线索有限、运动证据薄弱，因此从单张图像生成真实且时间稳定的 4D 内容仍然困难。
AI.method: 构建带文本引导背景操作的时空多视图图像矩阵，对视角、外观和运动提供一致监督；据此优化 3D 高斯原语，并通过轻量变形模块动画化，形成 4D 表示。
AI.result: 场景更忠实保留几何、时间行为更平滑、背景编辑更一致，减少上下文歧义与运动伪影；在 Objaverse-XL 和 Diffusion4D 上于视觉质量、效率和可控性方面优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: MATE4D 支持实用的 AR/VR 内容创作，能够将单张输入图像转换为可编辑的动态 4D 内容。

title: WorldFact-Bench: Beyond Image-Internal Plausibility to Image-World Consistency
summary: Advances in image generation have made visual authenticity increasingly difficult to assess. Although image forensics now examines both generation artifacts and higher-level visual inconsistencies, a plausible image can still contradict real-world facts or rules. We introduce WorldFact-Bench to evaluate image-world consistency from a single image, without a predefined claim or verification target. The benchmark contains 1,274 source-aligned real-fake pairs across four verification regimes and ten semantic domains. Each pair introduces a specific, evidence-supported factual conflict while seeking to preserve non-target content and visual plausibility. Images are evaluated independently, and pair accuracy requires both members of a pair to be classified correctly. We further propose PERSIST-Agent, which organizes iterative verification around a persistent state linking candidate facts, visual observations, evidence, and verification statuses. This state guides subsequent inspection and retrieval while retaining unresolved candidates. With backbone weights fixed, harness self-optimization refines the agent's prompts and execution rules through validation feedback. Experiments reveal strong label biases in several detectors and uneven gains from retrieval. On the evaluated 8B backbones, PERSIST-Agent improves pair accuracy over both direct judgment and retrieval-augmented baselines, while ablations support the role of persistent verification state. These findings highlight the value of state-guided verification and the remaining gap between visual plausibility and factual correctness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WorldFact-Bench基准与PERSIST-Agent方法，从单张图像出发评估"图像—世界"事实一致性，发现现有检测器存在强标签偏置，持久状态引导的验证能显著提升成对准确率。
AI.motivation: 图像生成技术的进步使视觉真实性难以判断。现有图像取证多关注生成伪影或高层视觉不一致，但一张视觉上合理的图像仍可能与现实世界的事实或规则相冲突。因此需要在不依赖预设声明或验证目标的前提下，仅凭单张图像评估其与世界事实的一致性。
AI.method: 构建WorldFact-Bench基准，包含1,274个源对齐的真假图像对，覆盖四种验证范式和十个语义领域，每对引入有证据支持的具体事实冲突，同时尽量保持非目标内容与视觉合理性；评估时图像独立判断，成对准确率要求一对中两张均分类正确。提出PERSIST-Agent，围绕持久状态组织迭代验证，该状态关联候选事实、视觉观察、证据与验证状态，指导后续检查与检索并保留未决候选；在骨干权重固定的条件下，通过验证反馈进行harness自优化，改进提示与执行规则。
AI.result: 实验发现多个检测器存在明显的标签偏置，检索带来的增益不均衡。在评估的8B骨干模型上，PERSIST-Agent相比直接判断和检索增强基线均提升了成对准确率，消融实验支持持久验证状态的作用。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明状态引导的验证具有价值，同时也揭示了视觉合理性与事实正确性之间仍存在差距。

title: RGBD-to-3D Object Mesh Refinement via Depth Matching and Symmetry Propagation
summary: Single-view 3D reconstructors often produce plausible meshes that disagree with the input view, especially near depth discontinuities and self-occlusions. We present a lightweight, plug-and-play RGBD-to-3D refinement that improves any RGB-to-3D reconstructor without retraining. Given a depth map, we correct the visible surface by bipartite matching to back-projected depth points, mirror these corrections onto the occluded side across a detected symmetry plane, and propagate them with a smoothness solver. Every stage is closed-form, making the method orders of magnitude faster than optimization-heavy test-time refinement. On GSO and OmniObject3D with five backbones, it yields consistent gains, also with monocular pseudo-depth, benefits more from symmetry on symmetric objects, and compares favorably with prior refinement in accuracy and runtime. It further improves an RGB-D-to-mesh reconstructor and transfers to real captures with noisy sensor depth.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量、即插即用的RGBD-to-3D细化方法，无需重训练即可改进任意RGB-to-3D重建器，通过二部图匹配、对称镜像与平滑求解实现可见表面校正与遮挡侧传播，速度远超优化型测试时细化，在多个数据集和骨干网络上取得一致增益。
AI.motivation: 单视图3D重建器生成的网格虽看似合理，但常与输入视图不一致，尤其在深度不连续和自遮挡区域。现有测试时细化方法依赖优化，计算代价高，且难以直接改进已有重建器。
AI.method: 输入深度图，通过二部图匹配将可见表面校正到反投影的深度点；检测对称平面后将校正镜像到遮挡侧；再用平滑性求解器传播校正。所有阶段均为闭式解。
AI.result: 在GSO与OmniObject3D上配合五个骨干网络均获一致增益；单目伪深度亦有效；对称物体从对称性中获益更多；在精度与运行时间上优于既有细化方法；能改进RGB-D-to-mesh重建器，并迁移到含噪传感器深度的真实拍摄。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为通用、高效、无需重训练的RGBD-to-3D细化方案，精度与速度兼具，具备良好的可迁移性。

title: 3DTexMOR: 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting
comment: 17 pages, including appendix. Kunxin Guang and Yonghao Zhao contributed equally
summary: 3D object removal aims to remove target objects from reconstructed scenes and complete the geometry and appearance of occluded regions. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods typically inpaint 2D images to guide 3D completion. However, complex multi-object layouts limit the surrounding context visible in each view, making 2D inpainting prone to artifacts. Inconsistent completions across views also introduce conflicting supervision and blurry reconstructions. We propose 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting (3DTexMOR). Our key idea is to perform inpainting in a unified texture space shared by all views. By combining complementary observations, this space provides richer context for recovering missing regions and promotes cross-view appearance consistency. We aggregate multi-view observations into texture maps, inpaint the missing regions, and reproject the completed maps into camera views to supervise Gaussian scene completion. To avoid the influence of view-dependent highlights and reflections, we decompose appearance and aggregate view-independent intrinsic attributes instead of RGB colors. We further introduce geometrically regularized Gaussian completion to constrain the geometry of the completed regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate visually plausible completions and state-of-the-art multi-object removal performance, improving PSNR by 5.8 dB and reducing LPIPS by at least 22% compared with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出3DTexMOR，在统一纹理空间进行修复以完成3D高斯场景中的物体移除，实现跨视角一致性与几何补全。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NeRF和3DGS的3D物体移除方法依赖2D图像修复来引导三维补全，但复杂多物体布局导致单视角可见上下文有限，2D修复易产生伪影；且跨视角补全不一致会引入冲突监督，造成重建模糊。
AI.method: 核心思想是在所有视角共享的统一纹理空间中进行修复：聚合多视角观测生成纹理图，对缺失区域进行修复，再将补全后的纹理图重投影回相机视角以监督高斯场景补全。为规避视角相关的高光与反射影响，方法对表观进行分解，聚合视角无关的本征属性而非RGB颜色。此外引入几何正则化的高斯补全以约束补全区域的几何。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法能生成视觉上合理的补全结果，实现当前最优的多物体移除性能：相比现有方法PSNR提升5.8 dB，LPIPS至少降低22%。
AI.conclusion: 在统一纹理空间进行修复并聚合视角无关本征属性，可有效提升跨视角一致性与三维补全质量，显著优于依赖2D修复引导的现有方法。

title: Dissecting Representation Structure in Vision Transformers: A Rigorous Architectural Study
summary: Representation structure is crucial for understanding Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures and their generalization behavior. However, prior studies neither isolate nor analyze module-level features nor investigate how their interactions contribute to performance estimation. In this work, we conduct the first rigorous analysis of feature information across diverse architectural scales, empirically uncover the relationship between ViT representation and generalization behavior, and leverage these insights to guide efficient ViT design. Our contributions are fivefold: Across diverse architectural scales, 1) We identify feature collapse at initialization, which leads to redundancy, and propose a reduction scheme to mitigate this issue. 2) We quantify feature information using entropy and the minimum eigenvalue, demonstrating that these metrics serve as reliable indicators for generalization prediction. 3) We show that feature in the token space provides a more faithful representation than those in embedding space. 4) We discover an unexpected finding: features produced by linear submodules within ViT layers are critical for the prediction of generalization performance. 5) Our proposed proxy improves the correlation ranking by 18-48% over prior baselines and can effectively identify ViT architectures that achieve higher accuracy at lower or comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析ViT模块级特征信息与泛化行为的关系，提出基于熵和最小特征值的泛化预测代理，并据此指导高效ViT设计，代理相关性排序较基线提升18-48%。
AI.motivation: 表征结构对理解ViT架构及其泛化行为至关重要，但已有研究既未隔离分析模块级特征，也未探究模块间交互如何影响性能估计，因此需要更细粒度的实证分析来揭示ViT表征与泛化的联系并指导架构设计。
AI.method: 在多种架构尺度下进行模块级特征信息分析：识别初始化时的特征坍缩并提出缓解冗余的缩减方案；用熵和最小特征值量化特征信息；对比token空间与embedding空间的特征表征；分析ViT层内线性子模块所生成特征的作用，并据此构建泛化性能预测代理。
AI.result: 发现初始化阶段存在特征坍缩导致冗余；熵与最小特征值可作为可靠的泛化预测指标；token空间特征比embedding空间更忠实；层内线性子模块产生的特征对泛化预测尤为关键。所提代理的相关性排序较已有基线提升18-48%，可有效识别在更低或相当计算成本下取得更高精度的ViT架构。
AI.conclusion: 模块级特征信息分析为理解ViT泛化提供了有效视角，所提代理可作为高效ViT架构搜索与设计的实用工具，兼顾精度与计算成本。

title: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
summary: Reconstructing complete, scene-aligned 3D objects from casual images requires integrating sparse, uncertain observations and inferring surfaces hidden by occlusions. We present GATOR, a generative and agentic framework that recovers textured object assets and their scene-relative pose from one or more images. Our local modality mixer couples patch-aligned RGB, target-mask, and pointmap features before cross-view reasoning, preserving scene context while distinguishing the target from its surroundings. Text-guided semantic conditioning complements these spatial cues with category names and object captions through stage-specific adapters for structure, geometry, and appearance generation. The generated asset initializes a multimodal agent, providing instance-specific geometry and pose for targeted structural and texture refinement through an observation-guided edit-render-review loop. Across synthetic objects, cluttered tabletops, and indoor scenes, GATOR achieves strong geometric and appearance fidelity while recovering scene-relative pose from sparse observations. Time-budget comparisons and scene-level simulation further demonstrate the reconstruction efficiency and simulation readiness. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/gator/

AI.tldr: GATOR 是一个生成式与智能体框架，能从稀疏、随意的图像中重建带纹理的物体资产及其相对场景的位姿，兼顾几何保真度与重建效率。
AI.motivation: 从随意拍摄的图像重建完整且与场景对齐的3D物体，需要整合稀疏、不确定的观测，并推断被遮挡而不可见的表面，这一任务具有较大挑战性。
AI.method: 提出局部模态混合器，在跨视角推理前耦合patch对齐的RGB、目标mask与点图特征以保留场景上下文并区分目标；引入文本引导的语义条件，通过面向结构、几何与外观生成的分阶段适配器，结合类别名与物体描述提供补充线索；生成资产用于初始化多模态智能体，通过观察引导的"编辑-渲染-审查"循环实现针对性的结构与纹理精修。
AI.result: 在合成物体、杂乱桌面及室内场景中，GATOR 实现了较强的几何与外观保真度，并能从稀疏观测中恢复场景相对位姿；时间预算对比与场景级仿真进一步验证了其重建效率与仿真可用性。
AI.conclusion: GATOR 通过生成式建模与智能体精修的协同，有效解决了稀疏观测下的场景对齐物体重建问题，具备高效性与面向仿真应用的潜力。

title: Breaking the Group Size Barrier: Parameter-Efficient Group Dance Generation with Chain-of-Dancers
summary: Group dance generation aims to synthesize coordinated multi-dancer choreography from music, with broad applications in animation and interactive content creation. This task requires modeling dense inter-person dependencies to ensure spatial coordination, while naturally preserving individual dancer identities. Existing approaches model all dancers jointly with end-to-end transformers, which tie the architecture to a fixed group size and entangle per-dancer identities across frames. We propose ChainDance, a scalable framework that reformulates group dance generation as a Chain-of-Dancers: a sequential decomposition over per-dancer conditional distributions, allowing a single model to scale across variable group sizes without retraining and naturally preserving per-dancer identity. Built on a frozen single-dancer diffusion backbone, ChainDance introduces two lightweight modules: a Role-Aware Text Encoder (RATE) for per-dancer semantic conditioning, and a Group-Aware Motion Encoder (GAME) that aggregates previously generated dancers via a distance-weighted graph convolutional network, and incorporates a training-free noise optimization procedure at inference time to enforce global spatial coherence. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChainDance achieves state-of-the-art motion quality and group coordination while structurally preserving per-dancer identity, with $3$-$4\times$ fewer parameters and requiring $3$-$6\times$ less training time compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: ChainDance 将群体编舞生成重构成"舞者链"（Chain-of-Dancers），用逐舞者条件分布的序列分解实现可扩展的群体舞蹈生成，在参数量减少3-4倍、训练时间减少3-6倍的情况下达到最优运动质量与群体协调性。
AI.motivation: 群体舞蹈生成需同时建模密集的舞者间依赖以保证空间协调，并保留每个舞者的个体身份特征。现有方法用端到端 Transformer 联合建模所有舞者，导致架构与固定群体规模绑定，且跨帧纠缠各舞者身份，难以扩展到可变群体规模。
AI.method: 提出 ChainDance 框架，将群体舞蹈生成形式化为 Chain-of-Dancers，即对逐舞者条件分布的序列分解，使单一模型无需重训练即可适应不同群体规模并自然保留个体身份。基于冻结的单人扩散骨干网络，引入两个轻量模块：角色感知文本编码器（RATE）用于逐舞者语义条件注入；群体感知运动编码器（GAME）通过距离加权图卷积网络聚合已生成舞者，并在推理阶段加入免训练的噪声优化以增强全局空间一致性。
AI.result: 在 AIOZ-GDance 数据集上，ChainDance 在运动质量与群体协调性上达到 state-of-the-art，同时在结构上保留了每位舞者的身份，参数量较先前方法减少 3-4 倍，训练时间减少 3-6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将群体编舞生成重构为序列化的"舞者链"分解，ChainDance 以更轻量、可扩展的架构实现了高质量、具身份保持性的群体舞蹈生成，兼顾了效率与协调性。

title: Attributing HOW, Not Just WHICH: Counterfactual Response Trajectories for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet tracing their outputs to individual training examples remains challenging. Existing attribution methods often compress factor-specific effects into scalar responses, making distinct internal changes indistinguishable. This is particularly limiting for diffusion models, where semantic factors emerge through evolving representation dynamics during denoising. We therefore reformulate diffusion data attribution as attributing factor-induced internal response trajectories. In this paper, we propose a novel Concept Attribution method through Dynamic Trajectories(CADT). We argue that attribution should therefore ask not only \emph{which} examples matter, but also \emph{how} their influence unfolds during generation. Specifically, we construct matched counterfactual pairs at identical noisy states to isolate factor-specific representation displacements, and model their directional and magnitude evolution across denoising as dynamic attribution signatures. For each training example and generated query, CADT extracts stage-wise feature vectors and integrates them along the denoising process to form a trajectory descriptor. Applying the same construction across the training set yields a bank of factor-specific trajectory descriptors. The covariance statistics of this bank are then used to construct . CADT uses this covariance-aware positive-semidefinite kernel to calibrate the query and training representations, and compares the calibrated query trajectory with each training trajectory to produce the final training-sample attribution scores. Experiments on multiple public datasets show consistent improvements over existing diffusion attribution baselines across hierarchical, compositional, and style attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADT方法，将扩散模型数据归因重新表述为“因子诱导的内部响应轨迹归因”，通过构建匹配反事实对、提取分阶段特征向量并沿去噪过程积分形成轨迹描述子，再利用轨迹描述子库的协方差统计构造半正定核进行校准，从而给出训练样本归因分数。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型归因方法通常将因子特定效应压缩为标量响应，使不同内部变化难以区分；而扩散模型的语义因子是在去噪过程中通过不断演化的表示动态逐步形成的，因此标量归因不足以刻画其影响机制。
AI.method: CADT在相同噪声状态构造匹配反事实对，以隔离因子特定的表示位移；将方向与幅度的演化建模为动态归因签名。对每个训练样本与生成查询，提取分阶段特征向量并沿去噪过程积分形成轨迹描述子；对训练集施加同样构造得到因子特定轨迹描述子库。基于该库的协方差统计构造协方差感知半正定核，用其校准查询与训练表示，再将校准后的查询轨迹与每条训练轨迹比较，得到最终训练样本归因分数。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，CADT在层次、组合与风格归因任务中相较现有扩散归因基线均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 归因不仅应回答“哪些样本重要”，还应回答“其影响如何在生成过程中展开”；以去噪轨迹为载体的因子归因能更细粒度地区分扩散模型内部变化，并在多类归因设定下优于既有基线。

title: TAP3D: Thermal-Assisted 3D Human Point Clouds
summary: Human body point clouds are a versatile representation for AI-enabled human sensing. However, existing methods using LiDAR, radar, and depth cameras suffer from inherent drawbacks in high cost, sparse reconstruction, and privacy concerns, etc. In this paper, we exploit low-cost thermal arrays and present TAP3D, the first system to reconstruct 3D human point clouds from body heat signatures, offering significant advantages in cost, density, human sensitivity, and privacy. To overcome major challenges in depth estimation, thermal interference, and multi-person separation, we propose a novel physics-informed design, which integrates a forward thermal physics model with two distinct modules: multi-primitive estimation for self-supervised joint recovery of depth and other thermal properties, and geometric perspective fusion for suppressing interference and disentangling multiple people. We implement TAP3D using a single commodity thermal array sensor and build a large-scale dataset (160K samples, 8 environments, 11 users) for evaluation. TAP3D achieves remarkable accuracy for dense point cloud generation, enabling downstream tasks like fall detection (91.46%), indoor tracking (21.86 cm MAE), and human mesh recovery (4.87 cm error). By transforming body heat into point clouds for the first time, TAP3D pioneers a new paradigm for privacy-first, fully passive human sensing for many applications. TAP3D is open-sourced at https://github.com/aiot-lab/TAP3D.

AI.tldr: TAP3D首次利用低成本热阵列从人体热特征重建3D人体点云，通过物理信息设计解决深度估计、热干扰与多人分离难题，并在多项下游任务中验证了高精度。
AI.motivation: 现有人体点云获取方法（LiDAR、雷达、深度相机）存在成本高、重建稀疏、隐私担忧等固有缺陷，亟需一种低成本、高密度、隐私友好的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出物理信息设计，将前向热物理模型与两个模块结合：多基元估计（自监督联合恢复深度及其他热属性）和几何视角融合（抑制干扰并解耦多人）；使用单目商用热阵列传感器实现，并构建大规模数据集（160K样本、8种环境、11位用户）。
AI.result: 实现高精度密集点云生成，支撑跌倒检测（91.46%）、室内跟踪（21.86 cm MAE）及人体网格恢复（4.87 cm误差）等下游任务。
AI.conclusion: TAP3D首次将体热转化为点云，开创了隐私优先、完全被动的人体感知新范式，适用于多种应用，并已开源。

title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose \textbf{V-CoLA}, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel \textit{uniqueness-aware importance criterion} for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an \textit{adaptive token merging strategy} that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86$\times$ to 6.15$\times$ prefill speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 V-CoLA，一个面向线性注意力（如 Qwen3.5）的免训练视觉 token 压缩框架，通过唯一性感知重要性准则与自适应 token 合并策略，在保留 50.0% 视觉 token 时达到原性能的 99.5%，仅保留 12.5% 时仍达 88.0% 以上，并获得 1.86×–6.15× 的 prefill 加速。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）性能优异但计算开销大，主因是视觉 token 主导输入序列长度，因此视觉 token 压缩是关键方向。然而随着引入线性注意力的混合架构（如 Qwen3.5）出现，原本为 softmax 注意力设计的压缩方法难以泛化：基于注意力与基于相似度的方法在该机制下均出现明显性能退化，亟需针对该范式的专用压缩方法。
AI.method: 提出 V-CoLA，一种专为线性注意力设计的高效免训练 token 压缩框架。核心包括：(1) 新颖的唯一性感知重要性准则（uniqueness-aware importance criterion），用于识别关键视觉 token；(2) 自适应 token 合并策略（adaptive token merging strategy）完成压缩。所有组件在实现层面进行优化，以兼容线性注意力的分块并行（chunk-wise parallelism），保证实际部署价值。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验显示：仅使用 50.0% 视觉 token 即可达到原始性能的 99.5%；在低至 12.5% 视觉 token 时仍保持 88.0% 以上性能；同时实现 1.86×–6.15× 的 prefill 加速。
AI.conclusion: V-CoLA 验证了针对线性注意力机制定制视觉 token 压缩的必要性与有效性，能够在显著压缩视觉 token 的同时几乎无损地保持模型性能，并带来可观的 prefill 加速，兼具学术价值与工程实用性。

title: LR-V2X: Loss-Resilient Collaborative Perception under Low-Bandwidth Communication
summary: Given the inherent unpredictability of packet loss in vehicular wireless communications, V2X collaborative perception can yield practical benefits only if agents can achieve reliable collaboration under lossy and low-bandwidth communication conditions. Existing dense BEV feature fusion methods depend on redundant BEV feature exchange, which is infeasible in low-bandwidth scenarios, while compact-communication methods aggressively compress messages but can hardly recover the missing feature content after packet loss. In this paper, we present LR-V2X, a loss-resilient, latent-space reconstruction framework that converts corrupted received latents (even under severe 90% packet loss) into a spatial prior and then reconstructs the missing BEV information from this informative prior and using ego context as condition. Notably, the model can be trained under complete communication conditions and can be directly applied to lossy conditions at test time, eliminating the need for training under numerous lossy conditions. Experiments on DAIR-V2X and V2XREAL show that LR-V2X delivers the strongest robustness under severe packet loss and preserves reliable collaboration as communication quality degrades. And it reduces communication overhead by $64\times$ compared to dense BEV feature fusion baselines. Code will be released at https://github.com/sidiangongyuan/LR-V2X.

AI.tldr: 提出LR-V2X，将受损隐变量转为空间先验并重建缺失BEV信息，在90%丢包下保持稳健协同，通信开销较密集BEV融合降低64倍。
AI.motivation: V2X协同感知在丢包和低带宽下才能实用。现有密集BEV特征融合依赖冗余特征交换，低带宽下不可行；紧凑通信方法压缩消息后难以在丢包后恢复缺失特征内容。
AI.method: LR-V2X为丢包鲁棒、隐空间重建框架：将受损接收隐变量转换为空间先验，再以自车上下文为条件从该先验重建缺失BEV信息。模型可在完整通信条件下训练，测试时直接应用于有损条件，无需针对大量丢包条件训练。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X和V2XREAL上，LR-V2X在严重丢包下展现最强鲁棒性，通信质量下降时仍保持可靠协同；相比密集BEV特征融合基线，通信开销降低64倍。
AI.conclusion: LR-V2X以隐空间重建实现丢包鲁棒协同感知，兼顾低带宽与强鲁棒性，且训练仅需完整通信条件，具备实用性与泛化性。

title: When Scene Text Hijacks the Scene: Uncovering, Exploiting, and Mitigating Rendered-Text Semantic Leakage in Image Generation Models
comment: To appear in the 2027 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P 2027)
summary: The reliability and accountability of image generative models (IGMs) are essential for building responsible and trustworthy AI systems. Recent IGMs, such as Nano Banana and GPT-Image, now support complex instruction following, realistic image synthesis, and controllable scene-text rendering. As these capabilities expand, safety analysis must also account for new control channels introduced by complex prompts. In this work, we study rendered-text semantic leakage, a largely overlooked phenomenon in open-domain text rendering. Although rendered text is intended to serve as a local visual constraint that should be reproduced verbatim in the generated image, it also carries linguistic semantics that may be interpreted by the model as part of the input instruction. This makes rendered text a potential semantic control channel whose safety implications remain insufficiently understood. We systematically characterize this phenomenon by decoupling the main visual prompt from the rendered text and measuring their individual and compositional effects on generated images. We quantify semantic leakage and rendering fidelity, and further analyze how leakage emerges from intermediate model evidence. We then show that harmful semantics embedded in scene text can persist through LLM-based prompt enhancement pipelines and steer non-text image regions, even when the main visual prompt remains benign. Finally, we propose a preliminary mitigation approach that reduces unsafe semantic transfer from rendered text to non-text regions while preserving the intended text-rendering behavior on FLUX-2-dev. Our findings reveal rendered text as a dual-use carrier of visible data and latent semantics, exposing a text-centric cross-modal attack surface in modern IGMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图像生成模型中的"渲染文本语义泄漏"现象：本应作为局部视觉约束的文本，其语言语义会被模型当作指令的一部分，构成潜在语义控制通道，可绕过良性主提示注入有害语义并影响非文本区域，作者还提出了初步缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 现代图像生成模型（如 Nano Banana、GPT-Image）已支持复杂指令跟随、逼真图像合成与可控场景文本渲染。能力扩展带来了新的控制通道，安全分析需覆盖复杂提示引入的新入口。现有研究对"渲染文本"这一通道的安全含义认识不足：渲染文本本意是局部视觉约束（逐字复现），但其携带的语言语义可能被模型解读为输入指令的一部分，从而形成被忽视的语义控制通道。
AI.method: 1) 解耦主视觉提示与渲染文本，分别测量二者单独及组合对生成图像的影响；2) 量化语义泄漏程度与文本渲染保真度；3) 分析泄漏如何从模型中间证据（intermediate model evidence）中产生；4) 检验嵌入场景文本的有害语义能否穿过基于 LLM 的提示增强流程，并在主视觉提示良性时仍操控非文本图像区域；5) 在 FLUX-2-dev 上提出初步缓解方案。
AI.result: 实验表征了渲染文本对生成结果的独立与组合效应，给出语义泄漏与渲染保真度的量化结果，并揭示泄漏源于模型中间证据。结果表明：场景文本中的有害语义可经 LLM 提示增强流程保留下来，并且即使主视觉提示保持良性，也能引导非文本图像区域发生语义偏移。所提缓解方法在 FLUX-2-dev 上可降低从渲染文本到非文本区域的不安全语义传递，同时保持预期的文本渲染行为。
AI.conclusion: 渲染文本是"可见数据 + 潜在语义"的双用途载体，在现代图像生成模型中暴露出一条以文本为中心的跨模态攻击面。该发现要求将场景文本渲染纳入图像生成模型的安全与可信评估范畴，并为后续防御研究提供了初步方向。

title: Spatial-Frequency-Aware Implicit Neural Representation of Multidimensional Signals via MLP-KAN Fusion
summary: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a compelling paradigm for modeling multidimensional signals by mapping continuous coordinates to signal values. However, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP)-based INRs inherently suffer from spectral bias, which favors low-frequency components and suppresses the reconstruction of essential high-frequency details. While existing techniques, such as Fourier feature mappings, mitigate this issue, they often rely on sensitive manual tuning and are prone to spectral artifacts. In this paper, we propose a spatial-frequency-aware INR framework that combines an MLP branch with a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) branch for complementary frequency-oriented modeling. The MLP branch provides a low-frequency-oriented representation of smooth structures, whereas the KAN branch complements localized variations and fine details. To coordinate the two branches, we integrate the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT) into the output fusion stage. The outputs of the two branches are decomposed into wavelet coefficients, and the corresponding coefficients are additively fused before inverse wavelet reconstruction. A wavelet-domain band-separation regularization further penalizes high-frequency responses in the MLP branch and low-frequency responses in the KAN branch, thereby encouraging complementary frequency-oriented behavior. Experiments on 1D signals, 2D images, 3D volumes and signed distance functions, videos, and 4D light-fields demonstrate the applicability of the proposed representation across the evaluated signal modalities. Results demonstrate improved reconstruction fidelity across the evaluated signal modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出空间-频率感知的INR框架，用MLP分支与KAN分支分别建模低频与高频，并通过DWT/IDWT在频域融合输出，配合频带分离正则，在多类信号模态上提升重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 基于MLP的隐式神经表示（INR）存在固有频谱偏置，偏向低频、抑制高频细节重建。现有傅里叶特征映射等方法缓解该问题，但依赖敏感的人工调参且易产生频谱伪影，因此需要更稳健的频率建模方案。
AI.method: 构建双分支INR：MLP分支负责低频平滑结构，KAN分支补充局部变化与细节。在输出融合阶段引入DWT与IDWT：将两分支输出分解为小波系数，对相应系数加性融合后再进行小波逆变换重建。同时提出小波域频带分离正则，惩罚MLP分支的高频响应与KAN分支的低频响应，促进频率互补分工。
AI.result: 在1D信号、2D图像、3D体数据与符号距离函数、视频以及4D光场等模态上开展实验，结果显示所提表示在这些信号模态上均获得更高的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 将KAN引入INR并与MLP互补，结合小波域融合与频带分离正则，可有效缓解频谱偏置、减少对手工调参的依赖，并具备跨多维信号模态的通用性。

title: iCATS: Fast Video Generation via Interaction-Aware Sparse Attention and Timestep-Adaptive Sparsity
summary: Training-free sparse attention offers a practical acceleration solution to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) via reducing computations without fine-tuning. It typically involves estimating the importance of query-key regions and deriving sparse masks to compute only the important candidates, which inevitably introduces approximation errors that may degrade generation quality. To better balance the efficiency-quality trade-off, we propose iCATS, integrating improved importance estimation and sparse mask construction with an efficient hardware execution strategy. Specifically, for importance estimation, unlike previous works that perform independent clustering over query and key tokens based on feature similarity to estimate attention scores, iCATS demonstrates that clustering based on query-key dot-product interactions is more accurate and further reformulates this objective as a simple quadratic form for low-cost computation. For sparse mask construction, instead of using a fixed top-p rule, we observe that tolerance to sparse approximation errors varies across denoising timesteps and therefore introduce an SNR-guided sparsity schedule to adjust sparsity dynamically, leading to higher accuracy. Finally, for hardware execution, we devise a tail-merging strategy to reduce padding overhead caused by irregular cluster sizes, improving GPU kernel utilization. Extensive experiments show that iCATS achieves $2.03\times$ acceleration with 31.017 dB PSNR on HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B and $1.55\times$ acceleration with 29.301 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V-14B, delivering a state-of-the-art efficiency-quality trade-off.

AI.tldr: iCATS：面向DiT的无训练稀疏注意力框架，通过基于query-key点积交互的聚类重要性估计、SNR引导的动态稀疏调度及尾合并硬件执行策略，在HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B和Wan2.1-T2V-14B上分别实现2.03×/1.55×加速且保持高PSNR。
AI.motivation: 无训练稀疏注意力可在不微调的情况下加速Diffusion Transformers，但现有方法通过独立聚类query与key token来估计重要性并生成稀疏掩码，必然引入近似误差、损害生成质量，因而需要在效率与质量之间取得更优平衡。
AI.method: 提出iCATS，包含三部分：(1) 重要性估计：指出基于query-key点积交互的聚类比基于特征相似度的独立聚类更准确，并将其重述为简单二次型以实现低成本计算；(2) 稀疏掩码构造：发现不同去噪时间步对稀疏近似误差的容忍度不同，故引入SNR引导的稀疏调度动态调整稀疏度；(3) 硬件执行：设计尾合并（tail-merging）策略，减少不规则簇大小带来的填充开销，提升GPU内核利用率。
AI.result: 在HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B上实现2.03×加速、PSNR 31.017 dB；在Wan2.1-T2V-14B上实现1.55×加速、PSNR 29.301 dB，达到当前最优的效率-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: iCATS通过改进重要性估计、动态稀疏调度与高效硬件执行，在无训练条件下显著加速DiT推理并保持高生成质量，验证了各组件设计的有效性，为视频扩散模型的实用化加速提供了新方案。

title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation can automatically generate clinical descriptions from X-ray images, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of radiologists. This task is challenging because it requires medical knowledge to accurately identify diseases and describe them in a professional manner. However, existing methods often overlook the importance of enhancing medical knowledge in describing pivotal areas, a capability that requires models to effectively extract and aggregate knowledge at multiple levels of granularity. Accordingly, we herein propose a novel and compact Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer (\textbf{EMGKT}) method to address the above issues. First, we encode global knowledge embeddings using a medical vision-language model, which provides contextual medical knowledge. Moreover, we devise a novel Fine-Grained Knowledge Distillation (FGKD) training task which efficiently extract fine-grained knowledge. Specifically, the FGKD training task contains teacher embeddings and student embeddings. Teacher embeddings are encoded using extra priors; while student embeddings are learned from the teacher embeddings through knowledge distillation. During inference, the student embeddings are used to enhance fine-grained knowledge while the teacher embeddings are discarded, resulting in negligible computational costs and no need for extra priors. Finally, we further develop a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers to enhance knowledge extraction. The classifiers are initialized using disease embeddings and are modeled as different experts to address various granularity features. Notably, \textbf{EMGKT} can be efficiently applied to most existing methods. Extensive experiments are conducted on two widely-used public datasets and various baselines, which demonstrates the effectiveness and transferability of \textbf{EMGKT}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效多粒度知识迁移方法EMGKT，通过全局知识编码、细粒度知识蒸馏（FGKD）与疾病诊断专家分类器混合，增强放射报告生成中对关键区域的医学知识描述，可插拔应用于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 放射报告生成需医学知识以准确识别疾病并专业描述，但现有方法忽视了增强关键区域医学知识的重要性，而该能力要求模型有效提取并聚合多粒度知识。
AI.method: 1) 用医学视觉-语言模型编码全局知识嵌入，提供上下文医学知识；2) 设计细粒度知识蒸馏训练任务FGKD，教师嵌入由额外先验编码，学生嵌入通过蒸馏从教师学习，推理时仅用学生嵌入、丢弃教师嵌入，从而几乎无额外计算开销且无需先验；3) 构建疾病诊断专家分类器混合，分类器用疾病嵌入初始化并建模为不同专家以处理不同粒度特征。EMGKT可高效应用于多数现有方法。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的公开数据集及多种基线上进行的大量实验验证了EMGKT的有效性与可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: EMGKT通过多粒度知识迁移有效增强放射报告生成中的医学知识表达，且具通用性与高效性。

title: Collaboratively Guided Adversarial Robust Distillation with Teacher-Favorable Examples
summary: Adversarial distillation transfers robustness from high-capacity teachers to compact students. Existing adversarial distillation methods mainly use teacher predictions on clean or adversarial examples to supervise student learning. However, teacher-favorable supervision within the perturbation neighborhood remains underexplored in adversarial distillation. We therefore propose Collaboratively Guided Adversarial Robust Distillation (CGARD), which jointly optimizes distinct student-adversarial and teacher-collaborative examples within the same perturbation neighborhood. The teacher-collaborative example is constrained to incur no greater cross-entropy loss under the teacher than the clean input. CGARD combines collaborative teacher guidance with adversarial teacher supervision to improve robust knowledge transfer. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, including white-box evaluation and additional black-box transfer evaluation, demonstrate consistent robustness improvements over strong adversarial distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出协同引导对抗鲁棒蒸馏（CGARD），在同一扰动邻域内联合优化学生对抗样本与教师协同样本，提升鲁棒知识迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗蒸馏方法主要依赖教师对干净样本或对抗样本的预测来监督学生，忽视了扰动邻域内"教师友好"的监督信号，导致鲁棒知识迁移不充分。
AI.method: CGARD 在同一扰动邻域内联合优化两类样本：学生对抗样本与教师协同样本；其中教师协同样本被约束为在教师模型下的交叉熵损失不超过干净输入，从而结合协同教师引导与对抗教师监督。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 上进行白盒评估及额外地黑盒迁移评估，结果显示相较强对抗蒸馏基线取得一致的鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用扰动邻域内教师友好的协同样本可有效补充对抗监督，CGARD 为对抗鲁棒蒸馏提供了更充分的知识迁移途径。

title: FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs
summary: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance. We further introduce SAVED-Bench (Spatial Audio-Visual Egocentric Benchmark with Dynamic Agents), constructing essential tasks of spatial capability in real-world scenarios: dynamic relativity, regional, and path reasoning QAs. FloorSAV improves AV-LLMs' spatial reasoning on various tasks from both SAVED-Bench and SAVVY-Bench. Studies with ground-truth floormaps demonstrate the substantial potential of FloorSAV with accurate spatial information.

AI.tldr: 提出 FloorSAV 框架，将 3D 点云、相机轨迹、空间音频与语义地标渲染为动态 2D 平面图，作为与自我中心视频同步的流注入 AV-LLM，实现免微调的空间音频视觉推理，并发布 SAVED-Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 动态自我中心环境下的 3D 空间推理对具身智能至关重要，但现有 AV-LLM 缺乏从原始多模态感知流中直接处理并内化全局几何结构的显式机制；已有方法要么需昂贵的微调，要么未充分利用模型的跨模态推理能力。
AI.method: 提出 FloorSAV：整合 3D 点云、相机轨迹、空间音频线索和语义接地目标地标，渲染出动态 2D floormap，并以同步流的形式与自我中心视频一同注入 AV-LLM；借助 floormap 解释引导，模型在单次推理中联合推理视觉、听觉与几何线索，无需微调。同时构建 SAVED-Bench，包含动态相对性、区域与路径推理三类 QA 任务。
AI.result: FloorSAV 在 SAVED-Bench 与 SAVVY-Bench 的多种任务上均提升了 AV-LLM 的空间推理能力；使用真值 floormap 的研究进一步表明，在具备准确空间信息时 FloorSAV 具有显著潜力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式渲染动态平面图作为同步模态注入，可在免微调条件下有效增强 AV-LLM 的时空音频视觉空间推理能力，且基准与真值实验验证了该范式的可行性与扩展空间。

title: It's Always 10:10: Reference Images Break a Bias That Prompts Only Dent
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Data and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23224681
summary: Text-to-image models appear to reproduce the habits of the photographs they learned from. Analog clocks are an extreme case: in advertising, watches almost always show 10:10, and generated clocks return to 10:10 even when another time is requested. We measure this bias and test three ways of overcoming it on 52 models available on the Magnific platform, with a replication on Higgsfield. Every image shows three identical clocks that must show 2:35, 6:50 and 11:20. The description of the object is fixed and only the request about the time changes: no time (A), the time in digits (B), the hand positions described by construction relative to the dial numerals (C), or the same description plus a drawn reference dial (D). Two AI readers read all 1,799 images blind from coded copies, with a third reader and the author settling disagreements (dial-level agreement 96.0% and 97.3%). With no time requested, 67% of the images have all three clocks at 10:10. On the 20 current models, all three clocks are correct in 34% of the images with digits, 30% with the hands described in words and 75% with the reference dial (D-B: +37 points, 95% CI +28 to +45); we found no evidence that describing the hands in words beats the digits (C-B: -4 points, CI -10 to +1). The replication on the 12 models shared by both platforms gives the same picture (B 54%, C 50%, D 81%). Writing the time reduces the bias but leaves two thirds of the images of the 20 current models with at least one wrong clock; adding a drawn reference raises full accuracy to three quarters and almost eliminates images entirely at 10:10. We release all images, prompts, raw readings and a script that recomputes every result.

AI.tldr: 该论文量化了文生图模型生成模拟时钟时偏向"10:10"的偏差，并在52个模型上测试了三种提示改进方式，发现加入参考表盘图示可将全部正确率提升至75%。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型会复现训练数据（广告摄影）中的习惯性偏差，模拟时钟是极端案例：手表在广告中几乎总显示10:10，导致生成模型即使被要求其他时间也倾向返回10:10。作者希望测量这一偏差并寻找可行的克服方法。
AI.method: 在Magnific平台的52个模型上测量（并在Higgsfield的12个共同模型上复现）。每张图包含三个相同的时钟，需分别显示2:35、6:50、11:20。固定物体描述，仅改变时间请求：A（不请求时间）、B（数字时间）、C（用表盘数字描述指针位置）、D（C加绘制参考表盘）。共1,799张图像由两名AI读者盲读编码副本，第三名读者与作者裁决分歧（表盘级一致性96.0%与97.3%）。
AI.result: 不请求时间时，67%的图像三个时钟全部显示10:10。在20个当前模型上，三钟全对比例：数字提示34%，文字描述指针30%，参考表盘75%（D-B：+37个百分点，95%CI +28至+45）；无证据表明文字描述指针优于数字（C-B：-4，CI -10至+1）。Higgsfield复现结果一致（B 54%，C 50%，D 81%）。
AI.conclusion: 写出时间可减少偏差，但20个当前模型中仍有三分之二的图像至少一个时钟错误；加入绘制参考表盘可将完全正确率提升至约四分之三，并几乎消除全部为10:10的图像。作者公开全部图像、提示词、原始读数及可复现所有结果的脚本。

title: PathLang: A Language-Centered Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Computational Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong visual perception ability, but their robustness in the language domain remains poorly characterized. Existing pathology VLM benchmarks largely rely on canonical closed-set prompts or perturb only generic templates, treating language as a fixed evaluation component rather than a variable axis of model behavior. In clinical practice, however, diagnostic language varies across reports, institutions, and candidate diagnoses. We introduce PathLang, a language-centered and clinically grounded zero-shot benchmark. PathLang holds the underlying slides, ground-truth labels, and image-text evaluation direction fixed while systematically varying only the diagnostic language, so that performance differences reflect how a diagnosis is phrased rather than what is imaged. The language variation follows how pathologists actually rephrase diagnoses (terminology, specificity, and reporting style), and all prompts and candidate pools are validated by six board-certified pathologists. PathLang covers four task families: (1) zero-shot classification with image-text alignment analysis, (2) cross-modal retrieval, (3) paraphrase robustness, including semantic-equivalence paraphrases, length and reporting-style variation, and prompt ensembling, and (4) open-vocabulary diagnosis retrieval over four candidate pools with distinct forms of semantic competition. Across nine VLMs and five public datasets spanning four organs, we find that performance is highly sensitive to clinically equivalent paraphrases, varies substantially across forms of semantic competition, and that image-text alignment quality does not necessarily translate into inter-class separability.
