We release the prompt corpus, candidate pools, pre-computed text embeddings, and evaluation code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PathLang.

AI.tldr: 该文提出PathLang，一个以语言为中心、临床基础的病理视觉-语言模型零样本基准，通过固定图像与标签、仅系统变化诊断语言，评估九种VLM在五种数据集上的语言鲁棒性，发现性能对临床等价改写高度敏感，且图像-文本对齐质量未必带来类间可分性。
AI.motivation: 现有病理VLM基准多依赖规范闭集提示或仅扰动通用模板，将语言视为固定评估组件，而非模型行为变量；而临床中诊断语言随报告、机构和候选诊断而变化，语言域鲁棒性尚缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 构建PathLang零样本基准：固定切片、真值标签与图文评估方向，仅系统改变诊断语言；语言变化遵循病理学家改写诊断的方式（术语、特异性、报告风格），所有提示与候选池经六位执业病理学家验证。涵盖四类任务：零样本分类与图文对齐分析、跨模态检索、改写鲁棒性（语义等价改写、长度与报告风格变化、提示集成）、开放词汇诊断检索（四种候选池，不同语义竞争形式）。
AI.result: 在九种VLM和五个公共数据集（跨四个器官）上评估，发现性能对临床等价改写高度敏感，在不同语义竞争形式间差异显著，且图文对齐质量不一定转化为类间可分性。
AI.conclusion: 语言域鲁棒性是病理VLM被低估的关键维度，需以语言为变量进行临床化评估；作者公开提示语料、候选池、预计算文本嵌入与评估代码。

title: Point-Focused Attention Meets Context-Scan State Space: Robust Biological Visual Perception for Point Cloud Representation
summary: Synergistically capturing intricate local structures and global contextual dependencies has become a critical challenge in point cloud representation learning. To address this, we introduce PointLearner, a point cloud representation learning network that closely aligns with biological vision which employs an active, foveation-inspired processing strategy, thus enabling local geometric modeling and long-range dependency interactions simultaneously. Specifically, we first design a point-focused attention, which simulates foveal vision at the visual focus through a competitive normalized attention mechanism between local neighbors and spatially downsampled features. The spatially downsampled features are extracted by a pooling method based on learnable inducing points, which can flexibly adapt to the non-uniform distribution of point clouds as the number of inducing points is controlled and they interact directly with point clouds. Second, we propose a context-scan state space that mimics eye's saccade inference, which infers the overall semantic structure and spatial content in the scene through a scan path guided by the Hilbert curve for the bidirectional S6. With this focus-then-context biomimetic design, PointLearner demonstrates remarkable robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple point cloud tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PointLearner，一种受生物视觉启发的点云表示学习网络，通过"聚焦再语境"的仿生策略同时建模局部几何结构与长程依赖，在多个点云任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 点云表示学习中，同时捕获复杂的局部结构与全局上下文依赖是一个关键挑战。现有方法难以兼顾局部几何建模与长程依赖交互，本文借鉴生物视觉的主动式中央凹（foveation）处理策略来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 包含两个核心设计：(1) point-focused attention，模拟视觉焦点处的中央凹视觉，通过局部邻域与空间降采样特征之间的竞争归一化注意力机制实现；其中空间降采样特征由基于可学习诱导点（inducing points）的池化方法提取，诱导点数量可控且直接与点云交互，从而灵活适应点云的非均匀分布。(2) context-scan state space，模拟眼动的扫视（saccade）推理，通过由Hilbert曲线引导的扫描路径驱动双向S6，推断场景的整体语义结构与空间内容。二者构成"focus-then-context"的仿生设计。
AI.result: PointLearner展现出显著的鲁棒性，并在多个点云任务上取得state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过模拟生物视觉的中央凹聚焦与扫视扫描机制，PointLearner有效融合了局部几何建模与全局上下文交互，验证了仿生"聚焦再语境"设计在点云表示学习中的有效性与优越性。

title: EgoPhys: Estimating Peak Contact Force and Mechanical Work from Egocentric Manipulation Video
summary: Physically grounded manipulation of articulated objects requires understanding both the maximum forces encountered during contact and the work performed as their parts move. Peak contact force and mechanical work quantify these complementary aspects, but estimating them from egocentric video is challenging because physical interaction cues are local and indirect. Moreover, peak force is associated with brief contact events, whereas mechanical work depends on force-motion coupling throughout the contact duration. To address these challenges, we propose EgoPhys, an RGB-only framework comprising Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CASA) and Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing (TMTR). CASA integrates appearance and geometry features to emphasize interaction-relevant cues, while TMTR models semantic, event, and motion cues with specialized temporal experts and routes them separately for force and work prediction. On the test split from Hoi! dataset, EgoPhys substantially improves predictions of peak force and mechanical work, achieving MAEs of \(5.205 \pm 0.584\) $N$ and $0.894 \pm 0.081$ $J$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoPhys，一种仅用RGB视频估计铰接物体操作中峰值接触力与机械功的框架，在Hoi!数据集上取得5.205 N和0.894 J的MAE。
AI.motivation: 物理落地的铰接物体操作需要同时理解接触时的最大力与部件运动所做的功。峰值接触力与机械功刻画了互补的物理属性，但从自我中心视频估计二者极具挑战：物理交互线索局部且间接；峰值力对应短暂接触事件，而机械功依赖整个接触时长内的力—运动耦合。
AI.method: EgoPhys为纯RGB框架，包含两个模块：接触感知空间聚合（CASA）融合外观与几何特征以突出交互相关线索；目标特定多专家时序路由（TMTR）用专门化的时序专家建模语义、事件与运动线索，并分别为力和功的预测进行路由。
AI.result: 在Hoi!数据集的测试划分上，EgoPhys显著提升了峰值力与机械功的预测，MAE分别为5.205±0.584 N和0.894±0.081 J。
AI.conclusion: EgoPhys验证了仅凭RGB视频即可有效估计铰接物体操作中的峰值接触力与机械功，空间聚合与时序多专家路由的设计对两类互补物理量的预测均有增益。

title: Adaptive Adversarial Augmentation for Controllable Face Synthesis
summary: Synthetic data provides a scalable alternative to real-world datasets for training face recognition models, particularly under challenging conditions such as low resolution, occlusion, and masks. Yet, most approaches lack diversity and fail to generalize effectively. We propose Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS), a guided framework that generates diverse and challenging samples while preserving visual realism. EFCS expands distributional variability, often reflected in higher FID and KID scores compared to single-feedback and random synthesis, while maintaining high precision. Recognition models trained on EFCS data consistently outperform baselines across multiple benchmarks, showing improved generalization to real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce an analytically motivated formulation linking perturbation-induced difficulty, sample utility, and performance degradation, offering principled insights into balancing synthetic data complexity for optimal training. Together, these contributions establish EFCS as an effective and analytically grounded approach for bridging the gap between synthetic and real datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 EFCS 框架，通过集成反馈可控合成生成多样且有难度的合成人脸数据，提升识别模型泛化能力，并给出扰动难度与样本效用的理论分析。
AI.motivation: 合成数据是真实人脸识别数据的可扩展替代方案，尤其在低分辨率、遮挡和口罩等困难条件下。但现有方法多样性不足、泛化能力差，合成与真实数据之间仍存在差距。
AI.method: 提出 Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS)：一种引导式框架，在保持视觉真实性的同时生成多样且具挑战性的样本；并通过集成反馈机制扩展分布多样性。同时给出一个解析性动机的公式，将扰动诱导的难度、样本效用与性能退化联系起来。
AI.result: EFCS 扩大了分布多样性，表现为相比单反馈与随机合成更高的 FID 与 KID 分数，同时保持高精度；在 EFCS 数据上训练的识别模型在多个基准上持续优于基线，对真实场景泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: EFCS 是一种有效且有解析依据的方法，能够弥合合成数据与真实数据集之间的差距，并为平衡合成数据复杂度以达到最优训练提供了原则性见解。

title: FlyMark: Training-Free Invisible Watermarking of 3D Gaussian Splatting via a Fruit Fly Connectome
summary: A trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene ships as a portable parameter array that can be copied, pruned, requantized, or repackaged outside its training pipeline, so ownership evidence is most useful when it lives in the released parameters and remains checkable long after the embedding tooling is gone. Existing 3DGS watermarks typically tie embedding or extraction to scene optimization, a learned decoder, or rendered views, so the evidence survives only as long as a second trained artifact does. FlyMark instead writes a keyed message into the parameters a 3DGS file already stores. Its carrier directions are derived from the photoreceptors of a published connectome, a citable versioned artifact that fixes the geometry exhaustively and leaves nothing to tune per scene. A virtual observer reads cone-wise apparent luminance along a scene-normalized orbit from stored centers, colors, and opacities; a keyed dithered quantization-index-modulation code replicates each message bit across these observations; and one sparse bounded least-squares solve realizes the targets through achromatic shifts of existing degree-zero colors under a hard per-channel linear-RGB bound. All geometry and higher-order appearance parameters are preserved bit-identically, and extraction needs only cone queries, rounding, and majority voting. Under a model-domain threat model on synthetic and real scenes, FlyMark attains high clean bit accuracy and visual fidelity while cleanly separating matched from wrong keys.

AI.tldr: FlyMark将密钥消息直接写入3DGS文件已有参数中，载体方向源自公开连接组的光感受器几何，提取仅需锥体查询、取整与多数投票，无需训练或渲染视图。
AI.motivation: 已训练的3DGS场景以可移植参数数组形式发布，可被复制、剪枝、重量化或重新打包，因此所有权证据最好内嵌于发布参数中，并在嵌入工具消失后仍可核查。现有3DGS水印把嵌入或提取绑定于场景优化、学习解码器或渲染视图，证据只在第二个训练产物存活期间有效。
AI.method: FlyMark把带密钥消息写入3DGS文件已存储的参数。载体方向由公开连接组的光感受器推导，该可引用、带版本的产物固定几何、无需逐场景调参。虚拟观察者沿场景归一化轨道，从存储的中心、颜色与不透明度读取锥体通道表观亮度；带密钥的抖动量化索引调制码将每位消息复制到这些观测上；一次稀疏有界最小二乘求解，在每通道线性RGB硬约束下，通过对现有零阶颜色做非彩色偏移实现目标。所有几何与高阶外观参数按位保持不变，提取只需锥体查询、取整与多数投票。
AI.result: 在合成与真实场景上、模型域威胁模型下，FlyMark取得高干净比特准确率与视觉保真度，并能清晰区分匹配密钥与错误密钥。
AI.conclusion: FlyMark将水印证据直接固化于3DGS发布参数，摆脱对场景优化、学习解码器与渲染视图的依赖，提取轻量且长期可核查，为3DGS所有权保护提供了免训练、免渲染的鲁棒方案。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Loss in CLIP Post-training: A Complementary Framework with Frozen Text Encoder
summary: CLIP serves as a foundational vision-language model and the de facto vision encoder for downstream VLMs such as LLaVA. Post-training offers a lightweight route to refine CLIP, but recent work argues that the standard contrastive loss is unsuitable for post-training due to catastrophic forgetting under small batches, motivating designs that abandon the contrastive objective in favor of distillation. We revisit this premise and find that, for the InfoNCE objective, the reported forgetting is driven primarily not by insufficient negatives but by an inappropriate magnitude of the contrastive temperature $τ$: with $τ$ set sufficiently small, contrastive post-training improves rather than degrades the pretrained CLIP, which we explain through the temperature dependence of the InfoNCE gradient. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ComCLIP}, a lightweight single-epoch post-training recipe that freezes CLIP's text encoder---so the refined vision encoder is a drop-in replacement with unchanged architecture and inference cost---and trains the vision encoder with a properly-tempered contrastive loss, an MSE anchoring loss against the original CLIP, and a relational distillation loss from DINOv2. Over multiple seeds, ComCLIP matches the self-distillation baseline CLIP-Refine on zero-shot classification while significantly improving the transferability of visual features, measured by linear probing ($48.99$ vs.\ $42.28$ on ViT-B/16), and on ViT-L/14 it also improves MMVP over CLIP-Refine ($24.20$ vs.\ $19.01$); CLIP-Refine remains stronger on image-text retrieval. Used as a drop-in vision encoder for LLaVA-1.5-7B without re-aligning the projector or LLM, ComCLIP yields no net change across $8$ VLM benchmarks, i.e., the refinement does not break downstream compatibility. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showstarpro/ComCLIP.git.

AI.tldr: ComCLIP 是一种轻量级单轮 CLIP 后训练方法，通过调节对比温度 $\tau$ 并冻结文本编码器，在保持零样本分类性能的同时显著提升视觉特征可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有观点认为标准对比损失（InfoNCE）因小批量下负样本不足导致灾难性遗忘，不适合 CLIP 后训练，因而转向蒸馏式设计。本文重新审视该前提，发现遗忘的主因并非负样本不足。
AI.method: 提出 ComCLIP：冻结文本编码器使精炼后视觉编码器可直接替换；以适当温度的对比损失、针对原始 CLIP 的 MSE 锚定损失、以及来自 DINOv2 的关系蒸馏损失训练视觉编码器。
AI.result: 多随机种子下，ComCLIP 在零样本分类上匹配 CLIP-Refine，线性探测显著提升（ViT-B/16 上 48.99 vs. 42.28）；ViT-L/14 上 MMVP 提升（24.20 vs. 19.01）；检索任务 CLIP-Refine 更强。作为 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的即插即用视觉编码器，在 8 个 VLM 基准上无净变化。
AI.conclusion: 对比后训练中的遗忘主要由对比温度 $\tau$ 的不当取值驱动，而非负样本不足；温度足够小时对比后训练可提升预训练 CLIP。ComCLIP 在提升特征可迁移性的同时保持下游兼容性。

title: CRISP: Fixing Flying Pixels in Latent LiDAR Generation via Diffusion Decoding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 41 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://andrea25512.github.io/CRISP/
summary: Latent LiDAR pipelines suffer from flying pixels: convolutional VAEs blur sharp radial depth discontinuities, yielding edge depths that back-project to points floating between surfaces. We identify this as a major, directly correctable decoder bottleneck and introduce CRISP: a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a backbone-agnostic latent adapter, DiT-based denoiser, and support mask predictor. CRISP replaces video-VAE and LiDAR-native decoders alike while keeping the encoder and latent generator fixed. Across KITTI-360, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes, replacing only the decoder reduces FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average across frozen backbones; for generic video VAEs, the reductions reach 71%/74%. On the LiDAR-native LiDM backbone, FRID drops by 71%, with the largest gains at depth discontinuities. In a pretrained LiDM world model, the same zero-shot replacement improves FSVD by 15.5%, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

AI.tldr: 论文提出即插即用的像素空间扩散解码器CRISP，替换潜在LiDAR管线中的解码器，显著减少飞点（flying pixels）并提升深度不连续处质量。
AI.motivation: 潜在LiDAR管线存在飞点问题：卷积VAE模糊径向深度不连续，导致边缘深度反投影为漂浮在表面之间的点。作者将其识别为解码器瓶颈，且可直接修正。
AI.method: CRISP由三部分组成：与骨干无关的潜在适配器、基于DiT的去噪器、支持掩码预测器。它保持编码器和潜在生成器固定，仅替换视频VAE与LiDAR原生解码器。
AI.result: 在KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI与nuScenes上，冻结骨干下FSVD/FPVD平均降低50.5%；通用视频VAE上降低达71%/74%；LiDAR原生LiDM骨干上FRID下降71%，深度不连续处增益最大；LiDM世界模型中零样本替换使FSVD改善15.5%，缩小sim-to-real差距。
AI.conclusion: 仅替换解码器即可大幅缓解飞点并提升解码质量，CRISP是骨干无关、可零样本迁移的通用方案。

title: FastJEV: Understanding Redundancy for Compact JEV Inference
summary: JEV models make multimodal decisions by directly scoring candidates. Although the common context is encoded once, candidate evaluation can still repeat matching token histories, duplicate inference states, and execute the full backbone. In this paper, we study these sources of redundancy and present FastJEV for compact candidate evaluation. We jointly organize history reuse and state storage, since sharing computation requires preserving states for later branches. We first introduce shared context anchoring to reuse recurrent initial states and omit unused final recurrent caches. We extend this reuse through candidate prefix sharing, retaining the intermediate states needed by subsequent branches. To further reduce the depth of these paths, we apply decision guided pruning based on relative score changes measured on a small unlabeled set. Our method retains full context encoding and all candidates without additional training. We evaluate FastJEV across three OmniJev model sizes on five public benchmarks and reconstructed LIBERO-10 offline questions. At the selected pruning budgets, the complete method reduces candidate depth by 43.75% to 45.83%, while retaining 93.66% to 97.52% of the original task scores on average across the six evaluation sets. Through controlled experiments, we show how candidate overlap and branching structure affect the execution cost of history reuse. In our implementation, candidate prefix sharing can reduce repeated computation while increasing latency. These findings motivate designing sharing granularity and execution schedules together for efficient JEV inference.

AI.tldr: FastJEV通过联合组织历史复用与状态存储、共享上下文锚定、候选前缀共享，以及基于相对分数变化的决策引导剪枝，在不额外训练的前提下减少JEV候选评估冗余，降低候选深度43.75%~45.83%，并保留93.66%~97.52%的任务得分。
AI.motivation: JEV模型通过直接对候选打分进行多模态决策。虽然共享上下文只编码一次，但候选评估仍会重复匹配token历史、复制推理状态并执行完整主干网络，从而带来冗余计算。
AI.method: 1）联合组织历史复用与状态存储，因为共享计算需要为后续分支保留状态；2）提出共享上下文锚定，复用循环初始状态并省略未使用的最终循环缓存；3）将复用扩展到候选前缀共享，保留后续分支所需的中间状态；4）基于小规模无标签集上测得的相对分数变化，应用决策引导剪枝以降低这些路径的深度。方法保留完整上下文编码与全部候选，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在三种OmniJev模型规模和五个公开基准及重建的LIBERO-10离线问题上评估FastJEV。在选定剪枝预算下，完整方法将候选深度降低43.75%~45.83%，同时在六个评估集上平均保留原始任务得分的93.66%~97.52%。对照实验表明候选重叠与分支结构会影响历史复用的执行成本；在实现中，候选前缀共享可减少重复计算，但会增加延迟。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，为提升JEV推理效率，需要将共享粒度与执行调度协同设计。候选前缀共享虽能减少重复计算，却可能增加延迟，因此共享策略与调度需联合优化。

title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.

AI.tldr: EvoKnow将AI生成图像检测的持续适应问题重新表述为"取证知识演化"，通过无回放的共享基座+孤立残差专家+闭式增量路由实现跨生成器泛化与长时程持续学习。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器通常在固定的生成器域上训练，当新的生成模型不断出现时难以维护。持续适应面临两大困难：回放历史生成图像成本高昂；用有限的当前域数据更新共享参数会覆盖已有的取证知识。
AI.method: 提出EvoKnow，一个无回放框架。该框架：1）保留从基座域学习到的共享取证基座；2）为补充性的生成器相关证据增量式添加相互隔离的残差专家；3）通过解析增量路由器（AIR）检索专家知识，该路由器利用当前阶段生成图像和累积的充分统计量以闭式解更新。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法具备有效的跨生成器泛化、少样本扩展和长时程持续适应能力。在每到达一个新生成器仅用10张生成图像的情况下，EvoKnow在非基座GenImage生成器上达到96.70%的平均准确率，在无需目标基准适应的情况下于Chameleon上达到94.48%的准确率。在严格的无回放持续学习协议下，EvoKnow取得最先进的持续学习性能，平均阶段准确率为96.32%，平均遗忘率为4.32%。
AI.conclusion: EvoKnow通过知识演化的视角解决持续AI生成图像检测，在无回放、少样本条件下兼顾跨生成器泛化与抗遗忘，实现了最先进的持续学习性能。

title: GroundSight at GroundLM 2026 Shared Tasks: GoldenViewVQA
summary: GoldenViewVQA requires models to jointly answer driving-scene questions and identify the camera view containing the supporting visual evidence, making precise evidence localization as important as answer correctness. We present \textbf{CoVeR-VQA}, a training-free multi-stage verification and correction framework for grounded multi-view VQA. Starting from GPT-5.6 zero-shot predictions, CoVeR-VQA progressively applies view-specific verification with Gemini-3.6-Flash, prior-guided joint verification with Claude-Opus-5, and cross-split group-level verification that exploits semantically filtered question groups from shared multi-view scenes and validation-derived prior knowledge. On the official GoldenViewVQA test set, the four-stage CoVeR-VQA pipeline achieves 84.75\% Joint Accuracy, improving the GPT-5.6 zero-shot baseline by 13.56 percentage points, while reaching 94.92\% Answer Accuracy and 86.44\% View Accuracy. The final submitted run achieves 88.14\% Joint Accuracy after two additional evaluator-informed post-hoc corrections. Our analysis shows that supporting-view localization remains the primary source of residual errors, highlighting the importance of explicit evidence verification for reliable multi-view multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: CoVeR-VQA：面向多视图具身/驾驶场景VQA的无训练多阶段验证与纠错框架，通过多模型级联验证提升联合答案与证据视图定位精度。
AI.motivation: GoldenViewVQA 要求模型在回答驾驶场景问题的同时指出包含支撑视觉证据的相机视图，因此证据定位与答案正确性同等重要。现有零样本大模型在支持视图定位上仍有明显误差，需要显式的证据验证机制来提升多视图多模态推理的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的多阶段验证与纠错框架 CoVeR-VQA。以 GPT-5.6 零样本预测为起点，依次进行：(1) 基于 Gemini-3.6-Flash 的视图级验证；(2) 基于 Claude-Opus-5 的先验引导联合验证；(3) 利用共享多视图场景中语义过滤的问题组与验证集先验知识的跨划分组级验证；(4) 评测器信息驱动的后处理校正。
AI.result: 在官方 GoldenViewVQA 测试集上，四阶段流水线达到 84.75% Joint Accuracy，较 GPT-5.6 零样本基线提升 13.56 个百分点，Answer Accuracy 94.92%，View Accuracy 86.44%；加入两次评测器信息驱动的后处理校正后，最终提交结果达 88.14% Joint Accuracy。
AI.conclusion: 支持视图定位是残余误差的主要来源，说明显式的证据验证对于可靠的多视图多模态推理至关重要；多阶段级联验证与纠错可显著提升联合答案-证据定位性能。

title: Fresco++: Frequency-Guided and Canonical-Consistent Optimization for Fine-Grained Head Avatar Modeling
summary: We propose Fresco++, a unified optimization framework for fine-grained and view-consistent head avatar reconstruction. Head avatar optimization is typically driven by per-view image supervision, which can lead to premature fitting of unstable high-frequency details and inconsistent local appearance across viewpoints. Fresco++ addresses these challenges by regulating both the progression of visual detail and the formation of cross-view supervision during optimization. For frequency-aware optimization, a progressive curriculum first stabilizes low-frequency structures and then introduces high-frequency constraints to recover fine facial and hair details without amplifying spurious responses at early stages. For cross-view optimization, we introduce Canonical Group Consensus, which associates local observations through shared canonical surface regions and establishes correspondence across different viewpoints. Geometric and visibility-aware screening removes unreliable observations, while the remaining multi-view evidence is aggregated in feature space to form a consensus target for supervising the current rendering. This design enforces local consistency without relying on a specific image-space parameterization and avoids additional rendering of the auxiliary view. Together, the frequency curriculum and canonical consensus provide stable optimization from coarse structures to fine details while maintaining coherent appearance across viewpoints. Extensive experiments on NeRSemble demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and cross-view consistency, while evaluations across diverse avatar representations further confirm the generality and transferability of Fresco++.

AI.tldr: Fresco++ 提出统一优化框架，通过频率感知课程学习与规范组共识，实现精细且跨视角一致的头像重建。
AI.motivation: 传统逐视角图像监督易导致不稳定高频细节过早拟合，以及跨视角局部外观不一致。需同时调控视觉细节的推进过程和跨视角监督的形成。
AI.method: 两方面设计：（1）频率感知优化：渐进式课程先稳定低频结构，再引入高频约束恢复面部与头发细节，避免早期虚假响应；（2）跨视角优化：提出 Canonical Group Consensus，通过共享规范表面区域关联局部观测并建立跨视角对应；结合几何与可见性筛选剔除不可靠观测，在特征空间聚合多视角证据形成共识目标监督当前渲染，无需特定图像空间参数化，也无需额外渲染辅助视角。
AI.result: 在 NeRSemble 上大量实验表明重建质量与跨视角一致性提升；在多种头像表示上的评估进一步验证了 Fresco++ 的通用性与可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 频率课程与规范共识协同实现从粗结构到细细节的稳定优化，并保持跨视角外观连贯，具备良好的通用性。

title: Missing Modality-Aware Calibration for Trustworthy Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Multimodal brain tumor segmentation typically leverages multiple MRI modalities, yet incomplete modality acquisition is common in clinical practice due to protocol heterogeneity and scan failures. Although recent methods maintain segmentation accuracy under missing modality conditions, they frequently overlook prediction reliability, leading to miscalibrated confidence estimates that hinder clinical adoption. Existing calibration techniques are largely modality-agnostic or assume that prediction difficulty decreases monotonically as additional modalities become available. However, in brain tumor segmentation, prediction difficulty depends primarily on which modalities are absent rather than how many, leading to combination-specific and spatially heterogeneous calibration errors. To address this, we propose Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling (MMA-LTS), a post-hoc voxel-wise confidence calibration method. It estimates a spatially adaptive temperature field conditioned on a modality-availability learnable token and a voxel-wise difficulty score. Experiments on BraTS 2020 and FeTS 2024 show that MMA-LTS improves calibration while preserving the segmentation accuracy of state-of-the-art models across diverse missing-modality scenarios, thereby enhancing trustworthiness toward clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出缺失模态感知局部温度缩放（MMA-LTS），一种事后体素级置信度校准方法，用于多模态脑肿瘤分割中的缺失模态场景，在保持分割精度的同时改善校准。
AI.motivation: 多模态脑肿瘤分割常因协议差异和扫描失败导致模态缺失。现有方法虽能维持分割精度，却忽视预测可靠性，产生校准不当的置信度，阻碍临床应用。既有校准技术多为模态无关，或假设预测难度随模态数量增加而单调下降，但脑肿瘤分割中难度主要取决于缺失了哪些模态而非缺失数量，导致组合相关且空间异质的校准误差。
AI.method: 提出缺失模态感知局部温度缩放（MMA-LTS），一种事后体素级置信度校准方法。它估计一个空间自适应的温度场，条件化于模态可用性可学习token和体素级难度分数。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020和FeTS 2024数据集上的实验表明，MMA-LTS在多种缺失模态场景下改善了校准性能，同时保持了最先进模型的分割精度。
AI.conclusion: MMA-LTS通过组合特定且空间自适应的温度场校准，提升了缺失模态脑肿瘤分割的预测可信度，有助于推动临床应用。

title: EchoDiST: Self-distillation-based joint learning for diffusion-conditioned echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation
summary: Motion estimation in echocardiography is essential for quantitative assessment of cardiac function and myocardial mechanics, but remains challenging due to image artifacts, limited image information, speckle decorrelation, and the scarcity of ground-truth displacement fields. Anatomy-guided approaches can provide structural information, yet often rely on expert-labeled myocardial segmentations. We propose EchoDiST, a framework for unsupervised echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation that integrates self-distillation-based joint learning with a diffusion-conditioned motion estimation network. Here, unsupervised motion estimation refers to learning without ground-truth displacement fields. The self-distillation strategy jointly optimizes anatomical segmentation and myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical annotations. Diffusion-based conditioning is used during training with stochastic perturbations, while inference requires only a single deterministic forward pass without iterative reverse-diffusion sampling. EchoDiST was evaluated on three echocardiographic datasets, including two external test datasets under cross-view and cross-dataset settings. Compared with seven representative learning-based methods, EchoDiST consistently improved anatomical alignment, myocardial strain assessment, and motion-derived functional and cardiac-phase assessment. These gains were statistically significant across the evaluated tasks and datasets. Overall, EchoDiST provides an effective approach for reliable myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical supervision and supports downstream quantitative assessment of cardiac function.

AI.tldr: 提出EchoDiST框架，通过自蒸馏联合学习与扩散条件运动估计网络，在有限解剖标注下实现无监督超声心动图心肌运动估计，在三个数据集上优于七个代表性方法。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图运动估计对心功能与心肌力学定量评估至关重要，但受图像伪影、信息有限、散斑去相关以及真值位移场稀缺等限制。现有解剖引导方法虽能提供结构信息，却通常依赖专家标注的心肌分割。
AI.method: EchoDiST将基于自蒸馏的联合学习与扩散条件运动估计网络相结合。其中无监督指无需真值位移场；自蒸馏策略在有限解剖标注下联合优化解剖分割与心肌运动估计；扩散条件仅在训练时引入随机扰动，推理阶段仅需一次确定性前向传播，无需迭代反向扩散采样。
AI.result: 在三个超声心动图数据集（含两个跨视角与跨数据集的外部测试集）上评估，相较于七种代表性学习方法，EchoDiST在解剖对齐、心肌应变评估以及运动衍生的功能与心动周期相位评估上均取得一致提升，且在各任务与数据集上具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: EchoDiST为有限解剖监督下的可靠心肌运动估计提供了有效途径，并支持心功能的 downstream 定量评估。

title: DLC: A Metric-Guided Dynamic Loss Controller for Multi-Objective Training
summary: In this paper, we introduce a metric-guided dynamic loss controller (DLC) for multi-objective image restoration. Conventional image restoration pipelines usually train with a fixed weighted combination of multiple losses, without changing the relative importance of fidelity, perceptual similarity, and no-reference quality during optimization. DLC is an architecture- and loss-term-agnostic training-time controller: it does not modify the restoration architecture or introduce new differentiable loss terms, but dynamically reweights the existing training losses. During training, DLC periodically evaluates the current model on a small fixed feedback subset and uses the resulting quality metrics to update the loss-weight vector through an LLM-based controller. Because DLC operates on existing loss terms rather than task-specific architectures, the same controller formulation can be instantiated across diverse image restoration training pipelines. We evaluate DLC on three restoration domains: low-light image enhancement, deraining, and real-world super-resolution, using both reference-based and no-reference quality metrics. Across these settings, DLC considers metric-dependent trade-offs during optimization and guides training toward balanced operating points across fidelity and perceptual quality. The results show that DLC can move models toward more favorable operating points across different restoration domains, supporting its role as a practical plug-in controller for multi-objective image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指标引导的动态损失控制器（DLC），在不改动网络结构和损失项的前提下，利用LLM控制器根据反馈子集上的质量指标动态调整多目标图像复原训练中各损失的权重，并在低光增强、去雨和真实超分三个任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统图像复原训练通常采用固定的多损失加权组合，在优化过程中不改变保真度、感知相似度和无参考质量之间的相对重要性，难以在多个目标之间取得平衡，因此需要一种能动态调节损失权重的训练时机制。
AI.method: DLC是一种与网络架构和损失项无关的训练时控制器：不修改复原架构、不引入新的可微损失项，而是对已有训练损失动态重加权。训练中周期性地在小型固定反馈子集上评估当前模型，并利用所得质量指标，通过基于LLM的控制器更新损失权重向量。由于作用于已有损失项，同一控制器形式可实例化到不同复原训练流程中。
AI.result: 在低光图像增强、去雨和真实世界超分三个复原领域中，结合有参考与无参考质量指标进行评估，DLC在优化过程中权衡依赖指标的取舍，引导训练走向兼顾保真度与感知质量的均衡工作点。
AI.conclusion: DLC能够推动模型在不同复原领域达到更优的工作点，可作为多目标图像复原的实用即插即用控制器。

title: Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
summary: Video world models aim to generate explorable, 3D-consistent scene videos conditioned on camera trajectories. Existing approaches often rely on external memory systems that explicitly retrieve previously observed content to mitigate scene drift during long-horizon generation. However, these auxiliary memory pathways operate outside the model's internal generative dynamics, preventing the model from intrinsically learning when and what historical information should be retrieved. We propose to internalize memory retrieval into the generation process, allowing retrieval to emerge as an intrinsic behavior of the video world model rather than relying on an external memory system. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)}, which repurposes the model's persistent internal state as a memory for historical context. A camera-conditioned retrieval gate selectively accesses relevant historical information from this state, determining \textit{what to retrieve}, while a retrieval trigger determines \textit{when to retrieve}. We further supervise the trigger with a 3D re-visibility signal, activating retrieval when previously observed content re-enters the current view while otherwise preserving the existing context. Together, these components enable the model to intrinsically acquire memory retrieval behavior and incorporate relevant historical observations into generation without a separate retrieval pathway. Across multiple base models and camera-revisit benchmarks, L2R improves long-term scene consistency while eliminating the need for an external memory bank or 3D conditions. https://jkhu29.github.io/l2r

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)，将记忆检索内化为视频世界模型的固有生成行为：利用模型的持久内部状态作为记忆，通过相机条件检索门控制“检索什么”、检索触发器决定“何时检索”，并用 3D 重可见性信号监督触发器。实验表明，L2R 在多种基模型与相机回访基准上提升了长期场景一致性，且无需外部记忆库或 3D 条件。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型在长时程生成中会出现场景漂移，通常依赖外部记忆系统显式检索历史观测来缓解。但这类辅助记忆通路运行在模型内部生成动力学之外，模型无法内在地学习何时检索、检索哪些历史信息。作者希望将检索能力内化为生成过程的固有行为。
AI.method: 提出 L2R，复用模型持久内部状态作为历史上下文记忆。设计相机条件检索门选择相关历史信息，决定“检索什么”；设计检索触发器决定“何时检索”。并使用 3D 重可见性信号监督触发器：当先前观测内容重新进入当前视野时激活检索，否则保留现有上下文。由此无需独立检索通路即可内在地获得记忆检索行为。
AI.result: 在多种基模型和相机回访基准上，L2R 提升了长期场景一致性，同时消除了对外部记忆库或 3D 条件的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆检索内化到视频世界模型的生成过程中，模型可自发学习检索行为，从而在长时程、相机回访场景下保持更好的 3D 一致性与场景一致性，且不依赖外部记忆系统。

title: ProtoSemImage: Image-Valued Prototypes with Deformable Row Alignment for Interpretable Document Classification
summary: Prototypes in classification models are almost always vectors, and a vector has no readable form. This paper asks what happens when a prototype is an image. Documents give the question a natural form, because a document can be rendered as a multi-channel image in which every token becomes a pixel, so a class representative can take the same shape and the same channel semantics as the inputs it stands for. ProtoSemImage represents each class by one or more visual archetypes: prototype images in a four-channel HSV space whose channels carry named linguistic factors. A Skip-Gram objective learns that color space end to end through a four-dimensional bottleneck, discourse boundary rows become differentiable typed difference rows, and classification reduces to 2D visual template matching: a deformable row alignment between a document image and the archetype bank, in the spirit of dynamic time warping. Because the match is a spatial pattern comparison rather than a linear readout, the model reports where an input departs from its archetype and along which channel, and a generative head decodes each archetype back into text. The image representation works: it beats an otherwise identical model with vector prototypes in all three paired seeds, by between 4.3 and 11.8 points on a ten-class task. The distance-based matching does not. A diagnostic that keeps the representation fixed and swaps only the classifier recovers the sequence baselines, which locates a 20.6-point shortfall in the matching rather than in the color compression, and a benchmark built so that a pair of documents shares a bag of words and differs only in arrangement confirms the layout-preservation it was designed for. We report both directions, because for a representation whose whole purpose is inspect ability, the failure modes are as informative as the gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProtoSemImage：将分类原型从不可读的向量改写为图像。文档渲染为四通道 HSV 多通道图像，每 token 成为像素，通道承载命名的语言因子；通过四维瓶颈以 Skip-Gram 目标端到端学习色彩空间，篇章边界行变为可微分的类型化差异行，分类退化为二维视觉模板匹配（可变形行对齐，类似 DTW）。图像表示有效（十类任务上三个配对种子均优于同构向量原型模型，提升 4.3–11.8 点），但基于距离的匹配无效：固定表示仅替换分类器的诊断显示 20.6 点缺口来自匹配而非颜色压缩，且专为词袋相同、排列不同的文档对构建的基准验证了布局保持能力。作者同时报告正向增益与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 分类模型中的原型几乎总是向量，而向量没有可读形式，缺乏可检查性（inspectability）。文档提供了自然形式：文档可渲染为多通道图像，每个 token 成为一个像素，因此类别代表可以采取与其所代表的输入相同的形状与通道语义，从而使原型具备人类可读的语言解释。
AI.method: 将文档渲染为四通道 HSV 多通道图像，每 token 为像素；用 Skip-Gram 目标通过四维瓶颈端到端学习该色彩空间；篇章边界行转为可微分的类型化差异行；分类转化为 2D 视觉模板匹配，即在文档图像与原型库之间做可变形行对齐（类比 dynamic time warping）；匹配为空间模式比较而非线性读出，可报告输入偏离原型的位置及通道；生成式头部将每个原型解码回文本。诊断实验固定表示、仅替换分类器（换回序列基线）以定位缺口来源。
AI.result: 图像表示有效：在十类任务、三个配对种子上均优于同构的向量原型模型，提升 4.3 至 11.8 点。基于距离的匹配无效：固定表示仅替换分类器的诊断可恢复序列基线，将 20.6 点缺口定位在匹配环节而非颜色压缩环节。专为词袋相同、仅排列不同的文档对构建的基准确认了模型所设计的布局保持（layout-preservation）能力。
AI.conclusion: 原型以图像（四通道 HSV 文档图像）形式表示是可行且有效的，但当前基于距离的可变形匹配是主要瓶颈而非表示本身。作者同时报告增益与失败模式，因为对于一个以可检查性为核心目的的表征，失败模式与收益同样具有信息量。

title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis for Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Decoders
summary: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) pair a visual encoder with a large language model (LLM) and perform well on diverse image-text tasks, yet their reliability is often limited by decoder attention pathologies that suppress visual evidence and exacerbate hallucinations. In this paper, we revisit visual attention sinks and uncover a structured, layer-dependent behavior: across prompts, early and late decoder layers exhibit prompt-invariant attention collapse onto the same few image regions, which we term PIS (Prompt-Invariant Sinks), whereas mid layers become prompt-conditioned and drive vision-language alignment. This split suggests that treating sinks as a uniform effect is incomplete. Building on this insight, we propose SAGE (Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis), a lightweight intervention that steers decoder attention away from PIS and toward query-dependent regions of interest (ROIs) using token-aligned ROI masks derived from standard vision backbones such as CLIP, ViT, and DINOv3. Evaluated on diverse vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM VLM families, SAGE improves visual grounding, reduces hallucinations, and yields consistent gains across public downstream vision-language benchmarks, including fine-grained visual discrimination settings where localized evidence is crucial, when instantiated with backbone-derived ROI masks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示VLM解码器注意力中存在的层级化"提示不变汇点(PIS)"现象，即早/晚层注意力固定在少数图像区域，中层才依赖提示并驱动视觉-语言对齐；据此提出轻量干预方法SAGE，将注意力从PIS引导至查询相关的ROI区域，从而提升视觉定位、减少幻觉并在多个基准上取得一致增益。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型(VLM)虽在多种图文任务上表现良好，但其可靠性受限于解码器注意力缺陷：注意力被抑制于视觉证据之外，导致幻觉加剧。作者重新审视视觉注意力汇点，发现其行为并非均匀一致，而是呈现层级依赖结构，提示以往将汇点视为统一效应的理解不完整，需针对性地加以干预。
AI.method: 作者首先识别出跨提示下早层与晚层解码器注意力发生"提示不变"地向同一批图像区域坍缩的现象，命名为PIS(Prompt-Invariant Sinks)，而中层则受提示调制并承担视觉-语言对齐。基于此提出SAGE(Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis)，一种轻量干预方法：利用标准视觉骨干网络(如CLIP、ViT、DINOv3)导出的、与token对齐的ROI掩码，将解码器注意力从PIS区域引导至与查询相关的感兴趣区域(ROI)。
AI.result: 在多种"视觉编码器+纯解码器LLM"的VLM家族上进行评估，SAGE提升了视觉定位能力、减少了幻觉，并在公开下游视觉-语言基准上取得一致性增益；在使用骨干网络导出的ROI掩码时，对依赖局部证据的细粒度视觉判别任务尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力汇点视为统一效应的观点并不完整，解码器注意力汇点具有层级分化的结构化行为(PIS)。针对该结构设计的SAGE干预能以轻量方式重塑注意力分配，有效改善视觉基础与幻觉问题，并在多种VLM架构与基准上具备良好的通用性和一致性收益。

title: Conditional Residual Prediction: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion without a Bidirectional Teacher
summary: Causal video diffusion models generate video autoregressively, which suits streaming, interactive, and long-video generation. Under standard training, however, they often yield lower generation quality than bidirectional models of the same size. Many existing approaches address this gap by initializing from or distilling a pretrained bidirectional teacher. We instead train a causal model from an image-model initialization, with no bidirectional video model at any stage. Because this path requires neither a large bidirectional teacher nor a complex distillation pipeline, it is simpler and more scalable. On this path, we find that a causal model trained on ground-truth history becomes strongly dependent on it, so that at inference errors in its own generated history propagate forward. We hypothesize that much of this dependence is unnecessary, because the current input already determines much of what the history provides. We propose Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP), a simple recipe for reducing a model's reliance on a condition: the model first predicts the target without the condition, and the condition may only add a residual on top of this prediction. Applied to history, CRP makes the model predict each chunk from the present as far as it can and use the past only for what the present cannot supply. In controlled experiments, CRP nearly closes the 6.14-point gap to a bidirectional model trained under the same setup. Scaling this recipe, we train Optica, a 2B-parameter causal video model that autoregressively generates 5-second 480p videos and reaches 82.78 on VBench with only about 15M training videos.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出条件残差预测（CRP），让因果视频扩散模型先仅用当前输入预测目标，再让历史条件只提供残差补充，从而降低对真实历史的依赖并缓解误差累积；在无需双向教师或蒸馏的情况下，CRP几乎弥合与同规模双向模型的6.14分差距，并训练出2B参数的Optica模型，在仅约1500万训练视频下VBench达82.78。
AI.motivation: 因果视频扩散模型适合流式、交互式和长视频生成，但按标准训练常低于同规模双向模型。现有方法多依赖预训练双向教师初始化或蒸馏，流程复杂、扩展性受教师规模限制。作者希望探索一条不使用任何阶段双向视频模型的更简单、可扩展路径，并解决该路径下模型过度依赖真实历史、推理时自身生成历史误差前向传播的问题。
AI.method: 从图像模型初始化训练因果视频模型，全程不引入双向视频模型。针对历史依赖问题，提出条件残差预测（CRP）：模型先在不使用条件（历史）的情况下预测目标，条件仅能在该预测之上添加残差。应用于历史时，模型尽可能从当前（present）预测每个chunk，仅用过去补充当前无法提供的部分。随后将CRP扩展到2B参数因果视频模型Optica，自回归生成5秒480p视频。
AI.result: 在受控实验中，CRP几乎弥合与同一设置下训练的双向模型之间6.14分的差距。扩展到Optica（2B参数因果视频模型）后，可自回归生成5秒480p视频，仅用约1500万训练视频即在VBench上达到82.78。
AI.conclusion: 因果视频扩散模型无需双向教师或复杂蒸馏，也能在图像模型初始化路径上缩小与双向模型的差距。CRP通过让历史仅提供残差，减少不必要的历史依赖和误差累积，是一种简单且可扩展的训练配方；Optica的结果验证了该路径在大规模因果视频生成上的有效性。

title: Beyond Resolution: Object-to-Image Ratio Mismatch in Instance Retrieval
summary: Visual instance retrieval often fails when the same object appears at different apparent sizes in the query and gallery. We show that the dominant cause is usually not resolution loss but object-to-image (O2I) ratio mismatch: the object occupies different fractions of the two images. On a controlled benchmark of 3,021 Objaverse objects rendered at five camera distances, more than 80% of the cross-distance degradation is attributable to O2I mismatch rather than resolution for 9 of 12 pretrained backbones; multi-scale architectures cut the resolution-only effect to single digits yet remain equally susceptible. The failure is also asymmetric: tight queries retrieve more reliably against wide gallery images than the reverse. Guided by this analysis, query-side scale augmentation and an OWLv2 crop reranker reach state of the art on ILIAS 100M (29.2 mAP@1000 before reranking, 42.0 after) without training or modifying the precomputed gallery index, and a LoRA fine-tune matches the query-side gains at a single forward pass, showing that O2I robustness is learnable.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出视觉实例检索在不同表观尺寸下的失败主因是物体占图像比例（O2I）失配而非分辨率损失，量化了该效应并据此提出查询端尺度增强与重排序方法，在 ILIAS 100M 上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 同一物体在查询图与库图中表观尺寸不同时常导致实例检索失败。作者旨在厘清该退化究竟源于分辨率损失还是物体-图像比例（O2I）失配，从而为跨尺度检索提供准确的问题定位与改进方向。
AI.method: 作者构建了受控基准：3,021 个 Objaverse 物体在五个相机距离下渲染，覆盖 12 个预训练骨干网络，并对比多尺度架构。基于分析结论，提出查询端尺度增强（query-side scale augmentation）与 OWLv2 裁剪重排序（crop reranker），以及无需改动画像库索引的 LoRA 微调方案。
AI.result: 在 12 个骨干中有 9 个，跨距离性能退化的 80% 以上可归因于 O2I 失配而非分辨率；多尺度架构将纯分辨率效应降至个位数但仍同样敏感。失效具有非对称性：紧致查询对宽库图检索更可靠，反之较差。方法在 ILIAS 100M 上达到 SOTA：重排序前 29.2 mAP@1000，重排序后 42.0，且 LoRA 微调在单次前向中即可匹配查询端增益。
AI.conclusion: O2I 比例失配是跨尺度实例检索的主要瓶颈，且该问题不依赖改动画像库索引即可通过查询端处理缓解；O2I 鲁棒性可通过微调学习获得，为大规模检索系统提供了低成本、免索引重建的改进路径。

title: Stop My Dancing! Understanding, Detecting and Attributing Motion-Aware Deepfake Videos
summary: Pose-guided diffusion models can now synthesize entire human figures in motion, spawning a new class of deepfakes: Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD) that have already reached hundreds of millions of viewers. To better understand this emerging threat, we construct the first MAD-specific benchmark and measurement framework, containing over 1.5 million frames that mix 1,363 real and 30,122 synthetic videos from six controllable generators, with realistic perturbations and open-world evaluation splits. Then, we dissect MAD and discover that, despite their global coherence, these videos betray faint yet reliable cues: because the model relies on limited input frames for motion synthesis, it must predict and simulate coherent movement at motion boundaries, thereby producing high-frequency artifacts along with model-specific spectral fingerprints. Based on the observations obtained from analysis on dataset, we propose MoDA, the first defense framework tailored to detect and attribute MAD videos. MoDA couples spatial semantics with steganalysis-rich frequency features via cross-domain alignment and multi-scale aggregation, achieving 94.8% in-distribution and 89.1% cross-dataset detection accuracy gains of 10% to 25% over prior work and 91.5% model attribution accuracy. MoDA achieves 81.94% accuracy on 200 clips produced by two unseen commercial MAD platforms, indicating promising zero-shot transfer, and 78.13% detection accuracy on 1,200 unseen MAD video clips (55k frames in total) collected from the open Internet. Under white-box, gray-box, and black-box adaptive attacks, MoDA maintains relatively stable detection and attribution performance while the accuracies of the baselines drop rapidly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个运动感知深度伪造(MAD)基准与测量框架(超150万帧,含1,363真实与30,122合成视频、6个生成器),揭示MAD在运动边界存在高频伪影与模型特定频谱指纹,并提出检测与归因框架MoDA,在分布内达94.8%、跨数据集89.1%检测精度,归因91.5%,并在商用平台与开放互联网数据及多种自适应攻击下保持稳健。
AI.motivation: 姿态引导扩散模型可合成整段运动中的人体,催生"运动感知深度伪造"(MAD),其受众已达数亿,构成新型安全威胁。然而目前缺乏针对MAD的专用基准与测量手段,对其可检测性认识不足。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个MAD专用基准与测量框架,含超150万帧,融合1,363真实与30,122合成视频、6个可控生成器,并包含真实扰动与开放世界评测划分。2) 剖析MAD发现:因模型依赖有限输入帧进行运动合成,须在运动边界预测与模拟连贯运动,从而产生高频伪影及模型特定频谱指纹。3) 提出MoDA框架,通过跨域对齐与多尺度聚合,将空间语义与富含隐写分析信息的频域特征耦合,实现MAD检测与归因。
AI.result: MoDA在分布内检测精度94.8%,跨数据集89.1%,较先前工作提升10%–25%,模型归因精度91.5%;在两个未见商用MAD平台的200个视频上达81.94%,显示零样本迁移能力;在开放互联网采集的1,200个未见MAD视频(共55k帧)上检测精度78.13%;在白盒、灰盒与黑盒自适应攻击下,检测与归因性能相对稳定,而基线方法精度急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: MAD虽具全局连贯性,但存在可可靠的弱线索(运动边界高频伪影与频谱指纹)。MoDA作为首个面向MAD的检测与归因框架,在多项指标与开放世界场景及自适应攻击下均优于基线,验证了频域-空域联合建模对MAD防御的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Parametric Trajectory Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion and flow models require many sequential evaluations, making generation computationally expensive. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but poses a capacity allocation problem: a student must match the teacher's iterative generation with far less sequential computation. Existing trajectory methods ask the student to reproduce teacher transitions that are highly curved at high noise, which can exceed its capacity and degrade fine detail. We introduce Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD), which lets the student parameterize teacher trajectory segments as polynomials and learn from teacher guidance along its own predicted path. PTD is designed to let the learned curvature adapt to the backbone's predictive capacity, preserving motion and diversity. The curvature head is used only in training; inference keeps the original backbone architecture. On Wan2.1-14B, four-step PTD sets a new state of the art for trajectory distillation, significantly improving dynamic quality and naturalness over PDD, the best-performing trajectory-only method on this model, under the same training setting. On the 33B audio-video MiniMax-H3, LoRA-trained PTD significantly improves diversity and naturalness over the state-of-the-art LightX2V Turbo. Blinded human votes give PTD 55.1% and 63.4% preference shares against PDD and LightX2V Turbo. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数化轨迹蒸馏（PTD），让学生模型以多项式参数化教师轨迹片段，并沿自身预测路径接受教师引导，使学习到的曲率适配主干网络的预测容量，在少步生成中提升动态质量与多样性。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散与流模型需大量顺序评估，生成计算昂贵；少步蒸馏虽降低成本，但存在容量分配问题：学生需以远少的顺序计算匹配教师的迭代生成。现有轨迹方法要求学生复现高噪声处高度弯曲的教师转移，超出其容量并损害细节。
AI.method: PTD 让学生将教师轨迹片段参数化为多项式，并沿自身预测路径从教师引导中学习，使学到的曲率自适应主干网络的预测容量，从而保留运动与多样性。曲率头仅在训练时使用，推理保持原始骨干架构不变。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1-14B 上，四步 PTD 在相同训练设置下刷新轨迹蒸馏的最优结果，动态质量与自然度显著优于 PDD。在 33B 音视频模型 MiniMax-H3 上，经 LoRA 训练的 PTD 在多样性与自然度上显著优于 LightX2V Turbo。盲测人工投票中，PTD 相对 PDD 与 LightX2V Turbo 的偏好份额分别为 55.1% 与 63.4%。
AI.conclusion: PTD 通过参数化轨迹片段与自适应曲率学习，缓解少步蒸馏的容量分配瓶颈，在不改变推理架构的前提下显著提升视频生成质量，是轨迹蒸馏的新最优方案。

title: MSGAT: Multi-Head Spiking Graph Attention with Similarity-Space Fusion for Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient computing paradigm through sparse event-driven computation, showing great potential for efficient multimodal learning. However, applying SNNs to high-level multimodal tasks, such as image-text retrieval (ITR), remains challenging, since sparse spike representations make it difficult to capture semantic structures required for cross-modal alignment. Existing spiking ITR methods rely on local alignment and additional soft-label supervision during training, while lacking awareness of structural and multi-granularity relationships. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-head Spiking Graph Attention Network (\textbf{MSGAT}) for structural modeling and equip it with dynamic attention heads to capture complementary relational patterns and enable spike-driven graph reasoning and aggregation. However, within a two-branch multi-granularity fusion framework, the fine-grained spike representations generated by MSGAT are sparse and discrete, whereas the global representations are continuous, making conventional feature-level fusion susceptible to interference across heterogeneous representations. Therefore, we introduce \textbf{Sim-Fuse}, a similarity-space fusion alignment strategy integrating coarse- and fine-grained matching relations while avoiding direct fusion of heterogeneous representations. Experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO show our method outperforms ANN methods under matched settings and existing SNN retrieval baselines. Moreover, with only two time steps, our SNN achieves comparable or superior performance to its ANN counterpart while reducing theoretical module-level energy by 55\%. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.

AI.tldr: 提出MSGAT与Sim-Fuse，将脉冲神经网络用于图文检索，实现结构建模与相似度空间融合对齐。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）虽具稀疏事件驱动、低能耗优势，但应用于图文检索（ITR）等高层多模态任务时，稀疏脉冲表示难以捕捉跨模态对齐所需的语义结构；现有脉冲ITR方法依赖局部对齐和额外软标签监督，缺乏对结构关系与多粒度关系的感知。
AI.method: 提出多头脉冲图注意力网络（MSGAT）进行结构建模，配备动态注意力头以捕捉互补关系模式，实现脉冲驱动的图推理与聚合；进一步提出Sim-Fuse，一种相似度空间融合对齐策略，在双分支多粒度融合框架中整合粗粒度与细粒度匹配关系，避免异质表示的直接特征级融合。
AI.result: 在Flickr30K与MSCOCO数据集上，方法在匹配设置下优于ANN方法及现有SNN检索基线；仅用两个时间步即达到与ANN对应模型相当或更优的性能，同时模块级理论能耗降低55%。
AI.conclusion: MSGAT结合Sim-Fuse有效解决了脉冲表示稀疏离散带来的跨模态对齐与融合难题，验证了SNN在高层多模态检索任务中的可行性与能效优势。

title: HAND: A Biologically-Inspired Activation Function that Improves Generalisation and Sample Efficiency in Image Classification
summary: DNNs exhibit robustness and generalisation issues not seen in humans. They are also far less data-efficient learners, requiring considerably more training samples to accurately classify novel exemplars. Inductive bias could help with these issues by providing in-built mechanisms to improve generalisation, and hence, reduce reliance on learning from data. We incorporate a biologically-inspired inductive bias into a new activation function, HAND (Homeostasis, Accelerating Nonlinearity, and Divisive-nomalisation), and show its effectiveness with CNNs trained on image classification. Using HAND a ConvNeXt-tiny required 25 training epochs to reach the same accuracy on ImageNet1k as the unmodified model achieved after 200 epochs. Consistent with the effects of an inductive bias, the performance gap reduced with training time and increased data augmentation. When the volume of training data was reduced and unevenly distributed between classes (Long-tailed ImageNet) the improvements in accuracy were even larger and did not reduce with increased training time. Generalisation performance with the common-corruptions data, and the ability to reject samples from unknown classes, were unaffected or improved by HAND. Results generalised across CNN architectures and training data-sets. HAND can, therefore, reduce the required training time and/or the required volume and variety of training data, helping to improve sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 将受生物启发的归纳偏置融入新激活函数 HAND（稳态、加速非线性、除法归一化），在 CNN 图像分类中显著提升样本效率：ConvNeXt-tiny 用 25 个 epoch 即可达到原模型 200 epoch 的 ImageNet1k 精度，长尾与少样本场景增益更大，泛化与拒识能力不受损或改善。
AI.motivation: DNN 存在人类不常见的鲁棒性与泛化缺陷，且数据效率低，需大量训练样本才能分类新样本。归纳偏置可通过内建机制改善泛化，从而降低对数据学习的依赖，因此作者尝试引入生物启发的归纳偏置来解决上述问题。
AI.method: 设计新激活函数 HAND（Homeostasis, Accelerating Nonlinearity, Divisive-normalisation），将生物启发的归纳偏置嵌入 CNN 中，并在图像分类任务上评测。对比对象包括 ConvNeXt-tiny 在 ImageNet1k 上的训练；同时考察训练时长、数据增强强度、训练数据量减少及类间分布不均（Long-tailed ImageNet）等条件，并检验 common-corruptions 泛化与未知类拒识能力，最后跨 CNN 架构与数据集验证。
AI.result: 使用 HAND 的 ConvNeXt-tiny 仅需 25 个训练 epoch 即达到未修改模型 200 epoch 的 ImageNet1k 精度。与归纳偏置效应一致，性能差距随训练时间增加和数据增强增强而缩小；当训练数据减少且类间不均（Long-tailed ImageNet）时精度提升更大，且不随训练时间增加而衰减。common-corruptions 泛化性能与未知类拒识能力未受影响或有所改善，结果在多种 CNN 架构和数据集上可泛化。
AI.conclusion: HAND 能减少所需训练时间以及所需训练数据的规模与多样性，从而提升样本效率。

title: OX-NeRF: 3D X-ray Tomography Reconstruction from Sparse Views Using Implicit Neural Representation
summary: NeRF and Gaussian splatting methods have been successfully applied on X-ray scenes where the views are too sparse for 3D reconstruction via classical methods. Ultra-sparse scenes with 10 or fewer views such as those with high-rate or low-dose acquisition still, however, present a significant challenge. To address this problem we present a new framework, Optimised X-ray Neural Radiance Fields (OX-NeRF), that combines cross-scene feature learning with scene-specific optimisation to reconstruct sets of related scenes. OX-NeRF employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify cross-scene features while maintaining scene-specific multi-resolution hash grids of spatial features. The paired representations are fused and passed to a multilayer perceptron (MLP); the CNN, hash grids and MLP are then jointly optimised end-to-end. Benchmarking on parallel-beam and cone-beam X-ray datasets shows OX-NeRF provides significantly higher reconstruction accuracy on ultra-sparse scenes compared to existing radiance field methods.

AI.tldr: OX-NeRF结合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化，在10视图或更少的超稀疏X射线场景中实现了优于现有辐射场方法的重建精度。
AI.motivation: NeRF与高斯泼溅已应用于视图稀疏的X射线场景，但视图少于10的超稀疏场景（如高帧率或低剂量采集）仍是重大挑战。
AI.method: OX-NeRF框架：用CNN提取跨场景特征，同时维护场景特定的多分辨率哈希网格空间特征；将两组表示融合后输入MLP，并对CNN、哈希网格和MLP进行端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在平行束与锥束X射线数据集上的基准测试表明，OX-NeRF在超稀疏场景下的重建精度显著高于现有辐射场方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨场景先验与场景特定表示的协同优化，OX-NeRF有效缓解了超稀疏X射线视图下的重建难题。

title: Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Learning for Parallel MRI Reconstruction
summary: Parallel magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction is an ill-posed inverse problem under undersampling. Multi-coil acquisition and Hankel lifting expose complementary repeated information: observations of the same anatomy across coils and repeated local k-space neighborhoods in overlapping windows. These dependencies guide recovery of missing k-space data. However, splitting lifted Hankel entries for self-supervision can place the original sample in both input and target, causing data leakage. We propose Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Reconstruction (HSSRecon), a scan-specific reconstruction framework for parallel magnetic resonance imaging. HSSRecon partitions data by physical acquisition units before Hankel lifting and applies multiplicity normalization to repeated Hankel copies in overlapping windows. Rather than learning a mapping that directly predicts missing data, the network learns a compact complex-valued Hankel subspace operator. Reconstruction is performed over the original k-space variables using a conjugategradient solver with hard data consistency. This design separates structural learning in the Hankel domain from data consistency in the physical domain: the former exploits multi-coil and local Hankel correlations, while the latter solves over unacquired degrees of freedom. We provide theoretical analyses of physicalgroup splitting and multiplicity normalization, and establish positive definiteness, uniqueness, hard data consistency, and a finite-step conjugate-gradient error bound for the system. On fastMRI brain data with three contrasts and three sampling masks, HSSRecon achieves competitive peak signal-to-noise ratio, structural similarity, and normalized mean squared error across six aggregated conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出HSSRecon，一种面向并行MRI的扫描特定自监督重建框架：按物理采集单元划分数据后再做Hankel提升，并对重叠窗口中的重复Hankel副本进行多重性归一化；网络学习紧凑的复值Hankel子空间算子，重建在原始k空间变量上用带硬数据一致性的共轭梯度求解。理论上证明了正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性与有限步CG误差界，在fastMRI脑部三对比度三掩码条件下取得有竞争力的PSNR、SSIM和NMSE。
AI.motivation: 并行MRI欠采样重建是病态逆问题。多线圈采集与Hankel提升揭示了互补的重复信息（跨线圈的同一解剖观测、重叠窗口中重复的局部k空间邻域），可用于恢复缺失k空间数据。但将提升后的Hankel条目拆分用于自监督，可能使原始样本同时出现在输入与目标中，造成数据泄漏（leakage），因此需要一种既能利用这些相关性又避免泄漏的重建框架。
AI.method: 1) 数据划分：在Hankel提升之前按"物理采集单元"（physical acquisition units）进行分组划分（physical-group splitting），从结构上杜绝同一原始样本跨输入/目标泄漏；2) 多重性归一化：对重叠窗口中重复出现的Hankel副本进行归一化，避免重复计数导致统计偏差；3) 网络不直接学习预测缺失数据的映射，而是学习一个紧凑的复值Hankel子空间算子；4) 重建在原始k空间变量上进行，采用共轭梯度（CG）求解器并施加硬数据一致性（hard data consistency），从而将Hankel域的结构学习与物理域的数据一致性解耦——前者利用多线圈与局部Hankel相关性，后者在未采集自由度上求解。理论部分对物理组划分与多重性归一化进行分析，并证明系统的正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性及有限步CG误差界。
AI.result: 在fastMRI脑部数据上，使用三种对比度与三种采样掩码，在六种聚合条件下HSSRecon在峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性（SSIM）和归一化均方误差（NMSE）上均达到有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: HSSRecon通过"物理组划分+多重性归一化"消除自监督中的数据泄漏，并以Hankel域结构学习与物理域CG硬数据一致性解耦的范式实现并行MRI重建；理论保证与fastMRI实验共同表明该方案在多种对比度和采样模式下具有稳定且有竞争力的重建性能。

title: PAM-ToD: Plug-and-Play Appearance Modeling for Cross-Time-of-Day 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Adapting a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) road scene to a new time of day requires learning appearance changes from a few anchor images while preserving consistent, real-time rendering. We propose PAM-ToD, a lightweight plug-in that learns color corrections while keeping the pre-trained 3DGS parameters fixed. PAM-ToD scales each Gaussian's existing color to model illumination changes and uses an additive term for additional brightness, such as when street lamps turn on at night. Under a simplified image formation model, unchanged surface albedo can be eliminated from the relation between source and target appearances, allowing us to learn these corrections without separately estimating albedo and illumination. The model corrects colors across the scene while allowing the corrections to vary by location and by Gaussian. To guide learning from a few anchor images, it discourages abrupt spatial changes in these corrections. We also introduce CARLA-ToD, a benchmark with matching geometry, camera poses, and moving-object trajectories across three times of day. A few target-time anchor images are used to train each plug-in, while separate views are used for evaluation. Across the static and dynamic settings, PAM-ToD achieves higher PSNR and lower LPIPS than the baselines, even when the anchor images come from a single synchronized capture across multiple cameras.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量插件 PAM-ToD，在固定预训练 3DGS 参数的前提下学习颜色校正，实现道路场景跨时段的外观适配，并发布 CARLA-ToD 基准。
AI.motivation: 将预训练 3DGS 道路场景适配到新时段，需从少量锚点图像学习外观变化，同时保持渲染的一致性与实时性；直接估计反照率与光照代价高、欠约束。
AI.method: PAM-ToD 保持预训练 3DGS 参数不变，对每个高斯已有颜色做缩放以建模光照变化，并加入加性项刻画额外亮度（如夜间路灯开启）；在简化成像模型下，从源与目标外观关系中消去不变的地表反照率，无需单独估计反照率与光照；校正量可随位置与高斯变化，并通过抑制校正的空间突变来约束少量锚点图像下的学习。
AI.result: 在静态与动态设置下，PAM-ToD 的 PSNR 高于基线、LPIPS 低于基线，即使在锚点图像来自多相机单次同步采集时也是如此。
AI.conclusion: PAM-ToD 是一种即插即用的实时跨时段适配方案，并配套 CARLA-ToD 基准（几何、相机位姿与运动物体轨迹对齐、覆盖三个时段）用于训练与独立视角评估。

title: SV-TAD: Native Sparse Convs for Efficient Temporal Action Detection
summary: To adapt billion-parameter Vision Transformers for long-video understanding, recent methods freeze the backbone and train lightweight convolutional modules. While effective for parameter-efficient training, existing adapters do not reduce inference-time computation, leaving scalability with respect to video length largely unaddressed. Token selection can reduce attention cost by pruning redundant tokens, but it breaks the spatial grid structure required by convolutional adapters. This forces an expensive dense reconstruction, nullifying much of the potential speedup. We address this by introducing native sparse 2D convolutions, a primitive that allows these adapters, for the first time, to operate directly and efficiently on dynamically pruned token sets. We integrate this primitive into SV-TAD, an adapter framework for temporal action detection, reducing VideoMAEv2-L computation by up to 64% and achieving 2.2x faster inference, while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy on THUMOS-14 and ActivityNet-1.3. When scaled to InternVideoNext-L, our approach surpasses the previous state of the art at roughly half its computational cost. Moreover, the sparse formulation naturally supports auxiliary task tokens, which improves fine-grained assembly detection on ATTACH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出原生稀疏2D卷积原语，使卷积适配器可直接高效作用于动态剪枝后的token集合，并集成到SV-TAD框架中，实现长视频时序动作检测的高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有面向十亿级参数视觉Transformer的长视频理解方法采用冻结骨干、训练轻量卷积适配器的方案，虽参数高效，但不降低推理计算量。Token选择虽可剪枝冗余token降低注意力开销，却破坏了卷积适配器所需的规则空间网格结构，被迫进行昂贵的稠密重建，抵消了加速收益。
AI.method: 提出原生稀疏2D卷积（native sparse 2D convolutions）原语，使适配器首次能够直接在动态剪枝的token集合上高效运算；并将其集成到面向时序动作检测的适配器框架SV-TAD中。
AI.result: 在VideoMAEv2-L上最多减少64%计算量，推理速度提升2.2倍，同时在THUMOS-14与ActivityNet-1.3上保持SOTA精度。扩展至InternVideoNext-L时，以约一半计算成本超越此前SOTA。稀疏公式天然支持辅助任务token，提升了ATTACH上的细粒度组装检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏2D卷积原语解决了token剪枝与卷积适配之间的结构冲突，在保持精度的同时显著降低长视频理解的推理计算成本，并可扩展至更大骨干与辅助任务。

title: S$^3$Geo: Structure-Semantic Synergistic Learning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to estimate geographic locations by matching images captured from different viewpoints, such as drone and satellite views. Existing methods mainly rely on visual representations, but often fail to jointly model fine-grained structural correspondences and semantic priors, making them prone to confusion between visually similar but semantically different regions, and thus limiting robustness under large viewpoint variations. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{S$^3$Geo}, a structure-semantic synergistic learning framework for cross-view matching. Specifically, we first introduce a Decoupled Query Pooling (DQP) module to extract a compact set of region-aware features from dense tokens, enabling explicit modeling of local structural patterns. We then design a query-level contrastive learning scheme with an optimal transport (OT)-based formulation to establish soft correspondences under cross-view spatial misalignment. Furthermore, we incorporate a Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SKD) strategy from a frozen CLIP teacher to transfer semantic priors and relational structures, thereby improving discrimination on hard negatives. By operating synergistically, the semantic priors provide robust contextual filtering, which guides the structural module to establish precise spatial alignments. Experiments on the University-1652 and SUES-200 datasets demonstrate that \textbf{S$^3$Geo} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches without increasing inference complexity, validating the effectiveness of jointly modeling structural and semantic information for CVGL.

AI.tldr: 提出S³Geo框架，通过结构与语义协同学习提升跨视角地理定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法主要依赖视觉表示，难以联合建模细粒度结构对应与语义先验，导致视觉相似但语义不同的区域易混淆，在大视角变化下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 1) 解耦查询池化（DQP）模块，从密集token中提取紧凑的区域感知特征以显式建模局部结构模式；2) 查询级对比学习结合最优传输（OT）公式，在跨视角空间错位下建立软对应；3) 语义知识蒸馏（SKD）策略，从冻结的CLIP教师模型迁移语义先验与关系结构，提升困难负样本判别力。
AI.result: 在University-1652和SUES-200数据集上，S³Geo一致优于现有最先进方法，且未增加推理复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 语义先验提供鲁棒上下文过滤，引导结构模块建立精确空间对齐；验证了联合建模结构与语义信息对跨视角地理定位的有效性。

title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
summary: Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMEO框架，通过证据接地监督与临床偏好对齐，解决超声多图报告生成中原始报告模仿与视觉监督错位的问题。
AI.motivation: 超声报告生成需跨视图聚合临床证据，但存档关键帧仅覆盖动态检查的一部分，导致原始报告模仿与视觉监督不匹配：对完整检查临床有效的内容，模型从可用图像中无法验证。由此产生临床行为对齐问题——模型需保留可见发现、避免诊断反转与无依据补全，且不能退化为保守模板。
AI.method: CAMEO（Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration）三阶段框架：Stage I 学习超声视觉-语言基元；Stage II 进行跨视图证据接地（Cross-View Evidence Grounding），将可信的可见报告要点蒸馏为多图QA与报告风格监督；Stage III 使用面向临床错误的偏好对进行临床感知偏好对齐。数据方面构建USReport-Distilled（17,670条证据接地双图训练实例）与USReport-Pref（21,869偏好对），并采用25,631条PubMedVision-US超声指令样本进行领域适配与多图指令微调。
AI.result: 在USReport-Distilled主基准上，CAMEO相较EchoVLM将BLEU-1从0.25提升至0.40，ROUGE-1从0.28提升至0.45，METEOR从0.27提升至0.43，ClinicalScore从55.02提升至74.20。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了证据接地监督、临床感知对齐与临床结构化评估对可靠超声报告生成的价值。

title: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
summary: This paper addresses multiview RGB-D point cloud registration, aiming to estimate global rigid poses for unordered RGB-D scans and align them in a metrically consistent coordinate frame. The conventional pairwise-then-global paradigm suffers from locally optimized pairwise registration, severe error propagation and high computational burden. In particular, existing methods typically treat RGB data as a mere auxiliary matching cue and overlook the holistic geometric priors (e.g., camera poses and 3D models) encoded across image sequences. This paper introduces PointVGGT, a zero-shot framework built upon a novel \emph{foundation-then-refinement} paradigm that systematically leverages visual geometry foundation models (e.g., VGGT) as the computational backbone for robust, training-free multiview RGB-D registration. In the foundation stage, we directly recover metrically consistent global poses (without any pairwise estimation) by grounding the scale-ambiguous pose predictions of the foundation model against metric depth observations. In the refinement stage, we introduce an efficient voxelized spatial hashing mechanism that exploits the globally coherent 3D reconstruction (induced by the foundation model) as a shared spatial anchor, enabling dense multiview correspondences in near-linear time. On top of this, an IRLS-based robust motion-only bundle adjustment is performed using a conjugate gradient solver to jointly minimize the correspondence and reprojection residuals for multiview pose refinement. Extensive experiments on indoor/object-centric/outdoor datasets verify the outstanding zero-shot registration accuracy and computational efficiency of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PointVGGT，一个基于“基础模型+精化”范式的零样本多视图 RGB-D 点云配准框架，利用视觉几何基础模型直接恢复全局位姿，并通过体素化空间哈希与 IRLS 鲁棒优化实现高效精化。
AI.motivation: 传统“先成对、后全局”范式存在成对配准局部最优、误差传播严重、计算开销大的问题；现有方法将 RGB 数据仅当作辅助匹配线索，忽略了图像序列中蕴含的整体几何先验（如相机位姿与 3D 模型）。
AI.method: 提出“基础-精化”（foundation-then-refinement）零样本框架。基础阶段：以 VGGT 等视觉几何基础模型为骨干，将其尺度模糊的位姿预测对齐到度量深度观测，直接恢复度量一致的全局位姿，无需任何成对估计。精化阶段：引入高效体素化空间哈希机制，利用基础模型产生的全局一致 3D 重建作为共享空间锚点，以近线性时间建立稠密多视图对应；并在其上执行基于 IRLS 的鲁棒 motion-only bundle adjustment，用共轭梯度求解器联合最小化对应残差与重投影残差以精化多视图位姿。
AI.result: 在室内、物体中心与室外数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法在零样本配准精度与计算效率方面的优越表现。
AI.conclusion: PointVGGT 通过系统性地利用视觉几何基础模型，摆脱了传统成对-全局范式，实现了鲁棒、免训练且度量一致的多视图 RGB-D 配准，兼具高精度与高效率。

title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
summary: Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出TAM（Task-Aware Memory Distillation）框架，通过将冻结教师的知识组织为有界可检索的历史记忆，利用跨样本预测结构提升时空预测的学生模型性能，且不增加推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏在时空预测中独立地逐样本匹配输出或特征，未能充分利用跨样本的预测结构。利用这种结构需要能反映各任务动态特性的表示与历史参照，现有方法缺乏相应机制。
AI.method: TAM构建冻结教师知识的有界可检索历史记忆：记忆条目编码潜在特征、预测变化量或流残差；任务特定选择规则识别相关历史参照。学生模型或匹配教师在共享参照上的相似度分布，或回归以观测为条件的残差原型。这些目标与监督预测及常规蒸馏互补。教师、记忆与辅助适配器仅在训练时使用，学生推理过程不变。
AI.result: 在视频预测、天气预报和交通流预测上跨多种师生配置评估。四次配对运行平均：在全部六个视频数据集上提升SSIM，在五个数据集上降低MSE。平均配对MSE降低：KittiCaltech 1.86%、WeatherBench（gSTA教师）1.93%、TaxiBJ 1.01%。
AI.conclusion: 历史教师监督在不同预测任务中均有效，且不增加学生推理成本，验证了利用跨样本历史知识进行蒸馏的实用价值。

title: Revisiting Handcrafted Minutiae Detection: A Simple and Effective Open Source Baseline for Modern Fingerprint Workflows
summary: Handcrafted minutiae detection algorithms remain fundamental to biometric science and forensic practice due to their full auditability, adherence to international standards, and operational independence from training datasets or GPU hardware. However, current open-source traditional baselines are severely outdated, relying almost exclusively on legacy C/C++ codebases that lack seamless integration with modern scientific software ecosystems. To bridge this gap, the present work introduces SBMEX (Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction), a fast and deterministic minutiae detection method integrated into the open source \texttt{pyfing} package. SBMEX achieves high computational throughput by employing a dual Look-Up Table architecture that replaces runtime neighborhood scanning during Crossing Number computation and skeleton tracking. Additionally, it incorporates a continuous quality scoring framework driven by tracking path length, dual ridge-valley skeleton fusion, and spatial density decay. Rigorous evaluation on NIST SD302 datasets demonstrates that SBMEX delivers feature extraction accuracy comparable to or outperforming traditional open-source baselines without fine-tuning, while achieving a drastic reduction in minutiae detection latency relative to classical Crossing Number Python implementations.

AI.tldr: SBMEX是一种基于骨架的快速确定性细节点检测方法，集成于开源pyfing包，通过双查找表架构与连续质量评分框架，在NIST SD302上实现与传统基线相当或更优的精度，并显著降低检测延迟。
AI.motivation: 手工细节点检测算法因完全可审计、符合国际标准且不依赖训练数据或GPU硬件，仍是生物特征科学与取证实践的基础。但现有开源传统基线严重过时，几乎全部依赖老旧C/C++代码库，难以与现代科学软件生态无缝集成。
AI.method: 提出SBMEX（Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction）：采用双查找表架构，替代Crossing Number计算与骨架跟踪中的运行时邻域扫描以提升吞吐；并引入由跟踪路径长度、双脊-谷骨架融合与空间密度衰减驱动的连续质量评分框架。
AI.result: 在NIST SD302数据集上的严格评估表明，SBMEX无需微调即可达到与传统开源基线相当或更优的特征提取精度，同时相比经典Crossing Number的Python实现大幅降低细节点检测延迟。
AI.conclusion: SBMEX为现代科学软件生态提供了一种快速、确定性的细节点检测方案，兼顾标准符合性与工程可用性。

title: DisFace3DNet: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement
summary: Facial attractiveness prediction usually assigns one overall rating, leaving the roles of shape, appearance, and viewing conditions implicit. We propose DisFace3DNet, which uses 3D component disentanglement to learn seven component reference scores from overall ratings with auxiliary weak semantic supervision, without human-labeled component targets. Designated 3D representations and image cues feed jointly learned routes for identity, skin, hair, light, background, expression, and pose. A constrained fit then combines five static and two signed dynamic scores into the overall rating, exposing each component's numerical contribution and supporting component-specific comparisons across images. On SCUT-FBP5500, DisFace3DNet achieves a Pearson correlation of $0.8904\pm0.0063$ (mean $\pm$ standard deviation across five folds) with average human ratings; its component terms reconstruct every held-out prediction to numerical precision. Skin, hair, and facial shape account for the largest component-wise prediction variation. Human evaluation supports the score directions for facial shape, skin, and hair; expression agreement is weaker. DisFace3DNet thus connects overall prediction to quantitative analysis of the facial and contextual cues entering each estimate.

AI.tldr: 提出DisFace3DNet，通过3D部件解耦，在无人工标注部件目标的情况下，从整体评分中学习七个部件参考分，并显式给出各部件对整体吸引力的数值贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有面部吸引力预测通常只输出一个整体评分，使得人脸形状、外观及拍摄条件等因素的作用被隐含，缺乏可解释性与部件级分析能力。
AI.method: 设计指定的3D表示与图像线索，分别输入联合学习的身份、皮肤、头发、光照、背景、表情与姿态七条路径；借助辅助弱语义监督，从整体评分中学习各部件参考分；再通过约束拟合将五个静态分与两个带符号动态分组合为整体评分，从而暴露各部件的数值贡献并支持跨图像的部件级比较。
AI.result: 在SCUT-FBP5500上，五折平均Pearson相关系数为0.8904±0.0063；部件项能以数值精度重建所有留出预测；皮肤、头发和面部形状带来的部件级预测变异最大；人工评估支持面部形状、皮肤和头发的评分方向，表情一致性较弱。
AI.conclusion: DisFace3DNet将整体吸引力预测与对影响估计的面部及情境线索的定量分析相连接，实现了可解释的部件级吸引力建模。

title: Perceptually Grounded and Semantics-Aware Evaluation for Holistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Holistic and semantics-aware co-speech gesture generation has advanced rapidly, yet evaluation remains behind: objective metrics do not consistently reflect human perception, and semantic appropriateness remains difficult to quantify. We present a perceptually grounded and semantics-aware benchmark that combines standardized model comparison, human-centered metric validation, and fine-grained semantic evaluation. We first curate a list of 13 objective metrics covering different aspects, including distributional similarity, geometric fidelity, kinematic quality, cross-modal synchrony, and semantic appropriateness. For the semantic-appropriateness category, we propose a new metric, Semantic Gesture Preservation (SGP), which measures how far semantic gestures in the ground truth are preserved in the generated gestures. For this, we augment the BEAT2 dataset's annotations using a multi-modal LLM. We then conduct a perceptual study where 101 participants score generated gestures among five dimensions, including human-likeness, motion diversity, absence of animation errors, speech timing and content match. We systematically analyze objective metric--subjective score correlations. Unlike Semantic Score (SC), which shows no significant association with the evaluated perceptual dimensions, SGP is selectively aligned with speech-aware human judgments. We construct five target-specific composite metrics aligned with the subjective dimensions. These composites improve perceptual alignment across all five dimensions, with the largest gains for absence of animation errors and content match, indicating that complementary objective signals can better approximate human judgments than individual metrics alone. Overall, our results show that objective metrics require validation against subjective evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个感知基础且语义感知的语音手势生成评测基准，包含13项客观指标、新增语义手势保留（SGP）指标，以及101人参与的五维主观评分研究，并构建了与主观维度对齐的复合指标。
AI.motivation: 语音手势生成技术发展迅速，但评测方法滞后：客观指标与人类感知不一致，语义恰当性难以量化，因此需要将客观指标与主观评价进行系统验证。
AI.method: 整理13项覆盖分布相似性、几何保真度、运动学质量、跨模态同步与语义恰当性的客观指标；提出SGP指标衡量生成手势对真值语义手势的保留程度，并用多模态大语言模型增强BEAT2数据集标注；开展101名参与者、五个维度（拟人性、动作多样性、无动画错误、语音时序匹配、内容匹配）的感知研究，分析客观-主观相关性并构建五个目标特异复合指标。
AI.result: 语义评分（SC）与所评估的感知维度无显著关联，而SGP与语音相关的人类判断选择性对齐；五个复合指标在全部五个维度上改善感知对齐，在无动画错误和内容匹配上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 互补的客观信号比单一指标更能逼近人类判断，客观指标必须经过主观评价验证；该基准为语音手势生成提供了感知基础且语义感知的标准化评测框架。

title: VESSI - VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations
comment: 12-page main manuscript, 3 main figures; supplementary material included
summary: Automated video surveillance analysis has become a critical component of intelligence infrastructures and Law Enforcement agencies. Traditional systems lack the semantic module for comprehensive situational awareness and forensic tasks, limiting their ability to interpret events meaningfully or support post-incident investigations. This slows operational insight and increases the burden on human analysts. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer promising pathways to bridge this gap. To address this, we propose VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations (VESSI), a VLM-based framework designed to enhance automated video surveillance analysis through prompt-driven interrogation of video sequences where salient visual features are converted into textual descriptions. We test our framework with four state-of-the-art models. Since most datasets for this task are unlabeled, we also propose the Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS) to assess VLM performance. Experimental results show that our solution substantially improves the analysis capabilities of human operators and enhances the flexibility of automated surveillance systems. In our evaluation, the most reliable model flagged potentially relevant activity in more than 66% of the videos while reducing review time by more than 85%, offering a practical balance between selectivity and efficiency. The model ordering produced by the reference-free CMUS evaluation was reproduced by the normal-video CMUS evaluation and matched the false-positive-rate ordering obtained from 5,909 manually referenced frames. This agreement supports the operational use of the score within the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 提出VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations (VESSI)框架，利用视觉语言模型对监控视频进行提示驱动式审讯，并设计无参考的Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS)评估指标；最优模型在66%以上视频中标记潜在相关活动，同时减少85%以上审查时间。
AI.motivation: 传统自动视频监控分析缺乏语义模块，难以实现全面的态势感知与取证任务，无法有意义地解释事件或支持事后调查，导致运营洞察迟缓并加重人工分析员负担。近期视觉语言模型（VLM）的进展为弥合这一差距提供了可能路径。
AI.method: 提出VESSI（VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations）框架，基于VLM，通过提示驱动的方式对视频序列进行审讯，将显著视觉特征转换为文本描述；使用四种最先进模型进行测试。由于该任务多数数据集无标注，进一步提出复合模型效用得分CMUS（Composite Model Utility Score）来评估VLM性能。
AI.result: 实验表明该方案显著提升人工操作员的分析能力并增强自动化监控系统的灵活性。最可靠模型在超过66%的视频中标记出潜在相关活动，同时将审查时间减少85%以上，在选择性效率之间取得实际平衡。无参考CMUS评估产生的模型排序被普通视频CMUS评估复现，并与从5,909个手工标注帧获得的假阳性率排序一致。
AI.conclusion: CMUS评分在评估设定下的排序一致性支持其实际运营使用，VESSI框架可有效提升视频监控分析的语义理解能力并减轻人工负担。

title: HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution
summary: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. We address both issues while retaining its $2048^{3}$-level precision. Second, we scale diffusion generation to sequences of up to 300K geometric tokens through a redesigned DiT architecture and large-scale distributed training optimizations, reducing training time per step from approximately ten minutes to ten seconds. Third, subsequent refinement cannot fully compensate for errors introduced during initial generation; we therefore strengthen both global shape and local detail in the initial generation stage, and the resulting single-stage model surpasses prior two-stage pipelines with $512^{3}$ refinement. Finally, we introduce a fine-grained image-3D cross-modal interaction mechanism that strengthens correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens, improving the recovery of object-specific structures. We evaluate geometric fidelity using alignment metrics derived from silhouettes and normal fields. Hi3D 3.0 outperforms four commercial systems across all reported metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision, compared with 21.7% recall for the strongest competitor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hi3D 3.0图像到3D生成系统，其几何模型Twinkle3D可在2048³分辨率生成水密三角网格，通过四项几何保真度改进，在轮廓和法向量对齐指标上超越四个商业系统，铭文恢复率达82.1%、精确率98.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成虽能生成与输入图像相似的物体，但难以复现物体特有的具体几何细节，铭文、品牌标识和重复结构常被扭曲或丢失，而这些对物体身份识别至关重要。已有高精度表示（O-Voxel/FaithC）存在表面质量差、非水密几何问题，且后续精修无法完全补偿初始生成阶段的误差。
AI.method: Twinkle3D沿四个维度推进高保真几何生成：（1）解决O-Voxel/FaithC的表面质量差与非水密问题，同时保留2048³级精度；（2）通过重新设计的DiT架构和大规模分布式训练优化，将扩散生成扩展至最多30万几何token序列，单步训练时间从约10分钟降至10秒；（3）在初始生成阶段同时强化全局形状与局部细节，使单阶段模型超越此前带512³精修的两阶段流程；（4）引入细粒度图像-3D跨模态交互机制，强化视觉证据与几何token的对应关系，提升物体特有结构的恢复能力。
AI.result: 采用基于轮廓和法向场的对齐指标评估几何保真度。Hi3D 3.0在所有报告指标上超越四个商业系统，铭文字符恢复率达82.1%、精确率98.2%，而最强竞争对手的召回率仅为21.7%。
AI.conclusion: Hi3D 3.0通过高分辨率水密网格生成、扩散规模化、单阶段全局-局部联合建模及跨模态交互机制，显著提升图像到3D生成的物体特异性保真度，尤其擅长恢复铭文等关键细节，整体性能优于现有商业系统。

title: Towards Unified Evaluation of Prompt Enhancers for Video Generation
summary: Modern video generators can realize increasingly complex visual narratives, positioning the prompt enhancer (PE) as a critical bridge from concise user instructions and multimodal references to structured cinematic plans. However, existing PE evaluation relies on rendered videos, imposing substantial computational and human costs, slowing PE training and iteration, and conflating PE quality with downstream generator behavior. To address this gap, we introduce PEBench, the first unified benchmark for direct PE evaluation across text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video prompt enhancement. It comprises 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets, spanning 35 fine-grained tasks with diverse temporal, cinematic, audiovisual, and multi-reference requirements. In addition, we develop PEBench evaluation, an evidence-grounded framework that combines modality-aware fact extraction with rubric-based assessment across 24 criteria.
