Our systematic evaluation of representative open- and closed-source PE methods reveals an emerging shift from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning, while the caption-reconstruction and forward-refinement methods show complementary strengths in cinematic coverage and semantic fidelity or internal coherence, respectively. Human validation shows that PEBench scores align closely with expert judgments of enhanced prompts and downstream videos from Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3, indicating that prompt-level evaluation reliably reflects downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 提出PEBench，首个无需渲染视频即可直接评估提示词增强（PE）的统一基准，覆盖T2V、I2V与R2V，含1,100专家校验案例与1,005视觉素材，配套证据驱动的24项标准评估框架，并以人工验证证明其评分可可靠反映下游生成效用。
AI.motivation: 现有PE评估依赖渲染视频，计算与人工成本高，拖慢PE训练与迭代，且将PE质量与下游生成器行为混为一谈，缺乏对PE本身能力的直接、统一衡量。
AI.method: 构建PEBench：1,100个专家校验案例、1,005个视觉素材，覆盖35个细粒度任务，涵盖时序、电影感、视听与多参考需求，支持文生视频、图生视频、参考生视频三类提示词增强；并提出PEBench evaluation，结合模态感知的事实抽取与基于量规的24项标准评估，对代表性开源与闭源PE方法进行系统评测。
AI.result: 评测揭示PE正从细粒度描述性扩展转向意图保持的电影化规划；caption-reconstruction与forward-refinement方法分别在电影化覆盖与语义保真、内部连贯性上呈互补优势；人工验证显示PEBench分数与专家对增强提示词及Wan3.0、MiniMax-H3下游视频的评判高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 提示词层面的直接评估可可靠反映下游效用，PEBench为提示词增强提供了低成本、可复现、统一化的评测途径，并为方法改进方向（意图保持的电影化规划、互补策略融合）提供依据。

title: Streaming-Aware Diffusion for Real-Time Video Super-Resolution via Cross-Step Attention
summary: Real-time video super-resolution requires high spatio-temporal fidelity under strict latency constraints, challenging diffusion models due to their iterative sampling cost and limited temporal coordination. We propose a streaming-aware framework that adapts pretrained single-image latent diffusion models for efficient video super-resolution (VSR) by exploiting the sequential structure of video streams. Our Cross-Step Attention mechanism reuses intermediate denoising features across adjacent frames and diffusion steps, enabling temporal information exchange without explicit temporal modeling. We further introduce Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling, which aligns adjacent diffusion states and provides cleaner intermediate representations for cross-step conditioning, improving temporal coherence. These components are integrated into a streaming inference pipeline that incrementally propagates latent states across frames, reducing the effective computational complexity from $O(N \cdot S)$ to $O(N + S)$ for $N$ frames and $S$ diffusion steps. Experiments on REDS4 and YouHQ40-Test demonstrate improved perceptual quality and temporal realism while maintaining frame-wise stability. Our method achieves over 40 FPS at $512 \times 512$ resolution after cold start, enabling real-time VSR without explicit temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出流式感知框架，将预训练单图潜在扩散模型改造为高效的实时视频超分（VSR），通过跨步注意力与轨迹耦合扩散调度实现帧间时序信息复用，将计算复杂度从O(N·S)降至O(N+S)，在512×512下冷启动后超40 FPS。
AI.motivation: 实时VSR需要在严格延迟约束下同时保证高时空保真度，而扩散模型因迭代采样开销大、缺乏时序协同而难以胜任。
AI.method: 一是跨步注意力（Cross-Step Attention），在相邻帧与相邻扩散步之间复用中间去噪特征，无需显式时序建模即可实现时序信息交互；二是轨迹耦合扩散调度（Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling），对齐相邻扩散状态并提供更干净的中问表示以支持跨步条件化；二者集成进流式推理管线，逐帧增量传播潜在状态。
AI.result: 在REDS4与YouHQ40-Test上，感知质量与时序真实感提升，同时保持逐帧稳定性；计算复杂度由O(N·S)降为O(N+S)；512×512分辨率下冷启动后达40+ FPS，实现实时VSR。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式时序建模，即可将预训练单图潜在扩散模型适配为实时流式VSR，兼顾效率与时空质量。

title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
summary: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.

AI.tldr: 提出直接用模型预测自监督预训练表征并以自身预测作为条件，替代协同去噪的双轨迹方案，从而省去第二条ODE与表征专用去噪调度，收敛更快且生成质量更高。
AI.motivation: 协同去噪DINO等预训练表征虽能显著提升flow matching的训练速度与质量，但引入第二条去噪轨迹并依赖精心设计的调度，增加复杂度。本文希望保留表征引导的收益、同时简化流程。
AI.method: 直接预测预训练表征，再将模型自身对该表征的预测作为条件输入，从而无需第二条ODE与任何表征专用去噪调度。
AI.result: 收敛明显更快、FID更优：在ImageNet上以比先前方法少2倍的epoch超越潜在空间最优结果；在像素空间相比同类先前方法FID改善超过20%。
AI.conclusion: 支持一个简单原则：“不要对可以直接预测的东西做去噪”。代码已开源。

title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Memory Forcing，一种少步流式视频扩散方法，通过Archive & Working Banks缓存分区与Bank-aware RoPE，在不增大缓存的前提下缓解"中段遗忘"，在长视频生成上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散系统采用固定大小KV缓存，通常仅保留起始帧与最近帧；一旦事件滑出该窗口，后续帧便无法再对其进行注意力计算，导致"中段遗忘"，长片段生成质量下降。
AI.method: 将KV缓存划分为sink、archive与working三个区域（Archive & Working Banks），在固定内存下同时保留多样的中间事件与近期运动信息；并引入Bank-aware RoPE，在注意力计算时重新分配时间索引，避免绝对时间索引漂移出训练范围，使各bank保持可区分。
AI.result: 在1.3B规模下，Memory Forcing在长片段上表现领先，在所有报告四种长度的方法中5s到60s的性能下降最小，并在"离开-返回"场景下保持主体与场景一致性；同一设计扩展至Wan2.2 5B后，生成的视频在物理合理性、真实感与动态性上更优，为该forcing路线下首个公开的5B模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过缓存分区保留被遗忘的中间历史并配合索引重分配机制，Memory Forcing在不增加缓存开销的条件下显著提升长时长流式视频生成质量，且具备良好的规模可扩展性。

title: From Video Clips to Creation Trajectory: Sora100K for AI-Native Video Creation
summary: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Sora100K 数据集，将 AI-Native 视频创作建模为结构化"视频创作轨迹"，包含生成根节点、单轮编辑边与多轮编辑完整轨迹三类子集，并基于 LTX-2 模型进行轻量适配验证其监督价值。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多为孤立的视频片段，将视频生成与视频编辑视为相互独立的任务，而非视频创作流程中相互衔接的阶段，缺乏对迭代式视频创作工作流的建模与数据支撑。
AI.method: 将视频创作轨迹按结构角色分解为三部分：文生视频生成记录（roots）、单轮视频编辑记录（editing edges）、多轮视频编辑记录（完整轨迹）；使用 VLM 为生成根分配语义标注、为编辑边分配编辑操作标注；通过严格的构建流程重建 source-to-edit 谱系、编辑顺序与中间视频状态，并进行质量控制；最后对 LTX-2 模型做轻量适配以评估 Sora100K 的监督价值。
AI.result: 轻量适配在当前结果中显示视觉质量、多镜头生成与跨镜头一致性均有提升；同时 successive-turn 评估表明，遵循多轮编辑指令仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: Sora100K 为超越孤立视频片段、面向结构化视频创作轨迹的 AI-Native 视频创作建立了新的数据基础，数据集与补充材料已公开。

title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
summary: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill-V——可验证的自演化技能库，将技能表示为带版本、可证伪的契约，通过环境反馈驱动技能的新增与修订，并在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别达到95.3%和85.9%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化技能库主要靠"积累新知识"来提升：失败会催生新技能，但已存储技能很少在新证据到来时被重新审视。仅靠增长无法保证可靠性：检索到的技能可能不适用于当前任务条件，已有技能也可能编码了错误的操作边界。因此可靠的技能演化不仅需要新增知识，还需要对已有知识进行检验与修订。
AI.method: 1) 将技能表示为带版本的、可证伪的契约，把语义意图与可观测的行为判据相链接，使存储知识可被检验；2) 以环境结果为驱动：任务失败促成技能新增，契约评估与任务结果之间的不一致则引导对已有技能边界的修订；3) 修订须通过验证：保留受保护的语义约束，并在历史回放证据上满足评分-结果指标的非退化条件；4) 采用适用性感知过滤器，排除被高置信判定为不适用于当前任务的候选技能。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上成功率分别为95.3%与85.9%，且技能库比面向增长（growth-oriented）的基线更紧凑；适用性感知过滤减少了错误的技能调用；基于结果驱动的修订纠正了错误设定的技能边界，且未使先前已观测证据上的表现退化。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的技能演化不止于积累经验：技能库必须学会保留哪些知识、何时修订，以及何时应当应用。

title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
summary: Generating physically plausible videos for solid-gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG, a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid-gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phasespecific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid-gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: PAVG是一种面向固-气动力学与相互作用的相感知视频生成器，采用双分支架构分别建模固体与气体动力学，并通过时空交叉注意力捕捉相间物理交互，同时构建了70万余条物理轨迹的仿真语料库。
AI.motivation: 固-气动力学视频生成具有挑战性：不同相具有截然不同的动力学特征，却又通过物理相互作用耦合在一起，现有方法难以同时兼顾相特异性运动与跨相物理一致性。
AI.method: 提出PAVG相感知视频生成器，采用双分支架构显式建模固体与气体各自的动力学；利用时空交叉注意力机制刻画两相之间的物理相互作用；并构建包含70万条以上物理轨迹的仿真语料库，覆盖多种固体、气体及固-气交互场景。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，与现有方法相比，PAVG生成的视频在运动贴合度、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过双分支相分离建模与跨相交互建模相结合，并辅以大规模仿真数据，PAVG能够生成兼具相特异性运动与跨相物理一致性的固-气动力学视频。

title: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
summary: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、模型无关的Vantage框架，通过"寻视"推理定位问题相关视角并融合3D几何证据，提升多视角空间理解。
AI.motivation: 现有基于稀疏输入视角的多视角空间推理，使VLM被限制在固定视角内理解场景与推断空间关系，导致跨视角对齐脆弱、几何到语言存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Seek-and-View推理范式，寻找隐含的跨视角空间证据；实现Vantage框架，将VLM与3D基础模型配对，包含视角锚定推理阶段（问题分析与视角规划）和几何锚定证据增强阶段（合成并注入视觉证据到最终推理），无需训练且与模型无关。
AI.result: 在六个VLM、五个基准上，无需微调即取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过视角锚定推理揭示空间证据，Vantage显著降低对语言式跨视角对齐的依赖，提升多视角空间理解能力。

title: Fast Pose Tracking of Rigid Objects with Compact Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级跟踪模块，基于相对位姿约束的位姿图优化，无需重建即可实现长时程6D位姿跟踪，兼顾精度与实时性。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程6D位姿跟踪方法依赖昂贵的初始化（onboarding）或需全程维护重建模型，难以满足机器人操作与增强现实对即用、实时跟踪器的需求。
AI.method: 在多种对应关系估计方法之上叠加轻量跟踪模块；核心是在位姿图中放弃基于点的优化，仅使用相对位姿约束，并根据几何对齐推导出的不确定性对约束加权，使优化与对应点数量无关，同时避免直接引入含噪点测量。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准上，跟踪精度与基于重建的跟踪器相当，而优化开销仅为后者的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑可靠的位姿图优化可在显著降低计算成本的同时提供长时程一致性，说明长时程6D跟踪无需依赖重建即可高效实现。

title: From Pixels to Structure: Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Document OCR and Structured JSON Extraction
comment: 17 pages. Published in Document Analysis and Recognition - ICDAR 2026, LNCS vol. 16974, Springer. Code: https://github.com/uddipan77/Analysis-of-Lightweight-Vision-Language-Models-for-Document-OCR-and-Structured-Output-Generation
summary: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文对八种开源轻量级视觉语言模型（≤7B）在三个高校遗产馆藏上的 OCR-to-JSON 结构化提取进行对比研究，采用零样本、少样本与微调设置，结合约束感知协议与多维度指标评估，并验证超参优化、图像预处理与多阶段训练的独立影响，证明适配良好的轻量 VLM 可作为私密、可持续的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 大规模闭源 VLM 虽在文档理解上表现优异，但依赖商业 API，在机构档案场景中面临数据自主性、持续成本与超大规模计算环境足迹等问题；遗产数字化尤为突出，因文档包含历史手写、领域术语（珠宝、史前、建筑）及非标准版式，需要高维结构化提取。
AI.method: 对 8 个开源轻量级 VLM（≤7B 参数）在 3 个高校遗产馆藏上进行 OCR-to-structure 比较研究：输入文档图像，模型需提取文本并生成符合 schema 的 JSON。采用约束感知协议，覆盖零样本、少样本与微调设置；以 CER、ANLS*、mAP-F1 衡量提取保真度与结构化输出质量；并以微调为基线，分别检验（i）超参数优化、（ii）经典图像预处理（光照平坦化、去噪、CLAHE）、（iii）多阶段训练的独立作用。
AI.result: 实验显示，经过精细适配的 ≤7B 参数 VLM 在遗产馆藏 OCR-to-JSON 任务上可达到可持续、私密且高性能的效果；同时分析了数据集专属微调与单一多数据集联合检查点之间的权衡——联合训练使单模型可跨馆藏运行，但可能造成数据集间性能迁移/偏移。
AI.conclusion: 精心适配的轻量级开源 VLM 可作为手工转录或商业黑盒系统的可持续、私密、高性能替代方案，并为寻求机构可控 OCR-to-JSON 提取的遗产机构提供可操作的实施指南。

title: From Suppression to Repair: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Localized Distribution Alignment
summary: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法ResOT，通过局部分布对齐修复表示，抑制LVLM目标幻觉。
AI.motivation: LVLM目标幻觉严重，直接抑制隐藏表示中幻觉相关分量会损失有用信息并削弱多模态能力。
AI.method: 将主导幻觉方向从忠实子空间投影去除，形成低维残差子空间；在该子空间内用高斯最优传输（OT）对齐幻觉分布与忠实分布，得到最小改动修复目标；推理时自适应控制每个token状态向OT目标移动的程度。
AI.result: 在三个代表性LVLM上，ResOT大幅减少目标幻觉，同时提升图像描述质量和多基准多模态性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOT是一种免训练、推理时的表示修复方法，能在不牺牲多模态能力的前提下有效缓解幻觉。

title: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
summary: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.

AI.tldr: VEDJE是一种视频检索方法，通过在采样帧内压缩特征、在可复用缓存中保持特征独立表示，并利用特征变化预测作为辅助训练信号，在不增加查询时开销的情况下提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 视频检索需要区分包含不同事件的相似场景。联合匹配能提升检索效果，但对每个查询都处理丰富的视频表示成本高昂，因此需要一种能在保持检索精度的同时降低查询时计算成本的方法。
AI.method: VEDJE在采样帧内压缩特征，同时在可复用缓存中保持各特征的独立表示；并引入特征变化预测作为辅助训练信号，以提升从压缩缓存中的检索效果，且不增加查询时的计算负担。
AI.result: 在MSR-VTT、MSVD、DiDeMo和ActivityNet数据集上，VEDJE在双向检索中相比匹配的第一阶段检索器均提升了R@1。在MSR-VTT上，配合微调的VideoCLIP-XL第一阶段，文本到视频R@1达到59.8。在VideoPrism配置下，将每视频缓存缩小四倍至12 KiB，文本到视频召回率损失在0.2个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 精确的视频搜索可以基于紧凑的证据表示运行，这些表示只需编码一次，即可在新查询到来时重复使用。

title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/
summary: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.

AI.tldr: FreeInpaint：无需相机位姿的前馈式3D场景修补框架，从无位姿多视角图像直接生成完整且3D一致的重建场景。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景修补方法通常依赖精确标定的相机位姿，限制了其在随手拍摄（in-the-wild）场景中的适用性，并带来额外预处理开销。
AI.method: 将3D基础模型扩展以支持掩码输入：1) 可学习掩码注意力（Learnable Mask Attention），保留可靠观测的空间锚定，使掩码区域在深层逐步吸收上下文，缓解跨视角对应关系推理被破坏的问题；2) 支撑令牌精修（Support Token Refinement），注入扩散生成的支撑证据作为置信度加权辅助令牌，精修遮挡严重区域，同时保持原始空间锚。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，FreeInpaint取得更优的修补质量，摆脱对预计算相机位姿的依赖，并保持快速推理速度。
AI.conclusion: FreeInpaint将3D重建与场景修补桥接，实现无位姿、前馈式且3D一致的场景补全。项目主页：https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/。

title: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出相对图像块响应学习（PRL），通过比较同一图像块在两个混合视图间的"响应"变化来学习，避免了对图像块直接赋予源标签的不精确问题，在八个标准基准和三个真实场景基准上平均平衡准确率分别超越此前最佳方法4.3%和5.9%。
AI.motivation: 生成模型可合成高度逼真图像，增加了虚假信息与视觉伪造风险，因此AI生成图像检测愈发重要；可靠的检测器需对未见生成器泛化、对真实场景中未见扰动保持鲁棒。现有检测器多基于独立采集或对齐的真实-生成图像对训练，近期方法在对齐对上构建"混合视图"（将真实图像的部分图像块替换为生成对应块）。但作者发现自注意力会让真实与生成图像块相互交互，导致每个图像块的特征不再仅反映其自身来源，这种上下文偏移使得逐块源标签成为不精确的目标。
AI.method: 提出相对图像块响应学习（PRL），不再对每个图像块打标签，而是比较同一图像块在对齐对的两个混合视图间的表现，从"图像块响应"（即其分数在两视图间的变化）中学习。具体包含三个目标：(i) 相对响应目标，在上下文偏移下提供精确监督，度量"源被改变"图像块相对"源未改变"图像块的响应，后者仅对偏移本身做出响应；(ii) 参考一致性目标，为偏移提供可靠参照，使每组源未改变图像块作为整体协同移动；(iii) 面积排序目标，由于两视图含不同数量的生成内容，要求生成面积更大的视图拥有更高的平均图像块分数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PRL性能优越，在八个标准基准和三个真实场景基准上平均平衡准确率分别超越此前最佳方法4.3%和5.9%。
AI.conclusion: PRL通过相对图像块响应学习规避了上下文偏移导致的逐块源标签不精确问题，借助相对响应、参考一致性与面积排序三个目标实现精确监督与可靠参照，验证了其在跨生成器泛化与真实场景鲁棒性上的有效性。

title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
summary: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMS，一个轻量级免训练框架，通过自适应协调视觉、预填充文本与生成上下文来抑制LVLMs的幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的幻觉问题依然突出。现有免训练方法多依赖对比解码或视觉增强来提升视觉证据的相对影响，但一个根本问题尚未被回答：LVLMs能否动态调节不同上下文来源的贡献以抑制幻觉？本文正是从这一动机出发，量化分析模型在解码时如何协调多源上下文，并探究该内在行为能否指导幻觉缓解。
AI.method: 本文提出AIMS（Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering）。其核心做法是：为视觉、预填充文本和生成文本三个上下文域构建紧凑原型（prototypes），并估计它们与当前query的亲和度（affinity），据此确定逐注意力头的steering权重；随后将得到的多源steering方向作用于query表示，实现自适应上下文整合，无需额外训练或辅助前向传播。
AI.result: 在多种LVLMs与多种解码策略上的大量实验表明，AIMS能有效缓解物体幻觉，同时保持具有竞争力的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: LVLMs具备可利用的内在视觉关注倾向以引导自适应视觉steering，且文本上下文同样有助于幻觉缓解；基于此洞察的AIMS验证了动态调节多源上下文贡献这一思路在免训练条件下抑制幻觉的可行性与有效性。

title: Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows
summary: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的时空预测骨干网络 MIDAPN，通过多媒体身份感知图与时序棱镜卷积，实现数值"多变量"与"多模态"预测任务的通用建模。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型依赖特定范式的关系、融合与时序模块，难以在数值型"多变量"与预对齐叙事流"多模态"场景间共享统一骨干，阻碍了通用预测架构的发展。
AI.method: 1）MIDAG：媒体预对齐后，从静态本质、动态行为、潜在共性三个维度重新刻画身份，生成跨媒体的变量依赖亲和度，并由 CIM 进行上下文身份调制以细化判别性聚合；2）SPConv：自动执行层次化时序分析，平衡粗粒度趋势与细粒度细节，其自适应搜索引导机制配置尺度高效架构用于时序维度重建。
AI.result: 在 13 个"多变量"与 12 个"多模态"数据集上与 16 个 SOTA 模型对比，并针对 14 个时间序列基础模型与融合预训练语言模型进行长上下文比较，MIDAPN 均表现出一致优越性及广泛的骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦而协同的组件共同解决媒体身份解耦与时序尺度失配问题，验证了统一骨干在数值与叙事流预测场景下的通用性与有效性。

title: Does Target Alignment Mean Target Recovery? An Evidence-Ladder Study of Adversarial Claims on Contrastive Encoders
summary: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.

AI.tldr: 对抗攻击视觉语言模型时，受害者空间的相似度分数（VTS）并不能可靠预测独立模型对目标文本的恢复；VTS 只在固定的鲁棒编码器内部具有信息量。
AI.motivation: 通常将受害模型的相似度分数（VTS）作为对抗攻击成功的证据，但该分数是否真能预测独立模型的目标恢复能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建测量工具：受攻击几何之外的监督评判器、真实目标混合对照、打乱目标负样本，以及由50%目标图像混合推导的参考水平；两项预注册研究在三种扰动预算下比较六种对比编码器在匹配攻击下的表现。
AI.result: 鲁棒训练编码器（FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TRADES）比原始 CLIP 或 SigLIP 迁移出显著更多独立证据，全部八组对比均在 bootstrap 下限处拒绝；但无任何单元达到混合推导的参考水平，最优三个单元处于其复制带内，实用恢复仍未决；鲁棒编码器内每样本对齐增益与证据增益相关（ρ=0.24–0.51），原始 CLIP 内相关性一致为零，跨编码器无单调对齐-证据关系。
AI.conclusion: VTS 仅在固定鲁棒编码器内部具有信息量，并据此提出替代性的报告协议。

title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
summary: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LGWM，一种无解码器、动作条件化的 GUI 世界模型，直接在表示空间中预测下一屏表示，将 GUI 智能体的安全验证转化为向量比较，在 RSWT-BENCH 上以 0.987 AUC、17ms/次 达到强闭源 VLM 水平。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体安全是"转场"属性而非"屏幕"属性：同一登录界面，点击 Sign in 后出现属正常，点击 View order 后出现即为攻击。因此仅检查屏幕的监控器可被复用合法页面绕过；判断转场需要"动作后应发生什么"的预期。现有 GUI 世界模型虽能给出预期，但以文本、代码或图像形式输出，需第二模型比对，代价高且引入额外不确定性。
AI.method: 提出 LGWM：一种无解码器（decoder-free）、动作条件化的世界模型，直接在观测编码空间中预测下一屏的表示，在 185 万条真实 GUI 转场上训练，无需语义标注。验证退化为表示向量的比较；同时利用残差方向判断违规是否有害。构建 RSWT-BENCH 诊断基准：每个凭证界面同时出现在合法与劫持转场下，使仅看屏幕的检测器在构造上即为随机水平。
AI.result: 免训练评分达 0.987 AUC，单次决策 17 ms，与最强闭源 VLM 相当，比生成式 GUI 世界模型高约 10 个 AUC 点且延迟低三个数量级以上；残差方向在区分有害/良性违规上达 0.953 AUC，而提示式 VLM 接近随机。进一步分析表明其预测是可用的未来状态而非异常分数。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型此前主要充当模拟器或规划器；本工作指出其第三种角色——验证，并论证在表示空间中进行预测是该角色的自然设计。

title: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
summary: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).

AI.tldr: 提出SightCAD框架，将视角可行性作为一等约束，联合训练视角选择器与CAD生成VLM，在场景嵌入和遮挡条件下实现参数化CAD重建。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD重建方法假设可从任意角度无限制拍摄物体，但真实物体常嵌入场景（靠墙、卡角落、置于地面），导致视球大部分视角不可达，剩余视角信息量不均等。
AI.method: 将标准CAD基准物体嵌入真实室内场景，基于离散视球施加物理导出的可见性约束；用学习的视角选择器为VLM选择K个可行视角，VLM生成可执行CadQuery代码，以执行实体的几何保真度评分；由于奖励在离散视角选择、自回归生成和CAD内核执行后才产生，采用视角选择器与CAD生成VLM联合训练的范式。
AI.result: 学习的选择策略显著偏离随机、均匀和覆盖贪心策略，在K∈{1,…,5}预算下比表面积最大化(SA-max)最高提升6.4 IoU点；在DeepCAD和Fusion360场景嵌入遮挡多视角渲染上分别比最佳基线提升+21和+17有效mIoU点；在T-LESS工业基准和MP6D金属零件基准的合成与真实图像上均超过强基线，且可执行程序率最高（无效代码率≤1.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 将视角可行性视为一等约束并进行视角选择与CAD生成联合训练，可有效应对真实场景中的遮挡与视角受限问题，显著提升CAD重建的几何保真度与代码可执行性。

title: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures/tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 (under review). Code: https://github.com/panagiotisq/CELL
summary: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.

AI.tldr: CELL方法端到端学习逐对应置信度用于事件相机-LiDAR地图定位，通过可微概率PnP避免深度偏置，在M3ED和DSEC上降低中位平移误差至多26.9%。
AI.motivation: 事件相机对LiDAR地图定位可建模为渲染深度视图与事件图像间的稠密光流估计及PnP求解。现有管道依赖几何一致性，但未显式建模对应关系的可靠性或姿态信息量（某对应约束相机姿态的强度）。直接用逐对应误差约束置信度学习会受深度偏置影响：小像素误差多位于大深度处，姿态信息量低。
AI.method: CELL通过可微概率PnP端到端学习逐对应置信度，其对数配分项鼓励产生更受约束姿态分布的权重配置。置信度用途有三：(i)在解耦训练方案中重加权光流监督，将姿态梯度排除出光流/边缘主干；(ii)测试时驱动概率化对应选择；(iii)结合网络边缘概率加权最终边缘匹配精化。另设计部分补全深度表示，在不跨大间隙幻觉的前提下增加信号。
AI.result: 在M3ED和DSEC上，完整系统在多数评估序列中优于LEAR基线：中位平移误差最多降低26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低15.8%。
AI.conclusion: 显式通过姿态端到端学习逐对应置信度可缓解深度偏置，提升事件相机-LiDAR地图定位精度。

title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文用信号检测论分解视觉语言模型在灾损评估中的保守决策问题，定位并操纵一个与恐惧相关的affective circuit，从而在推理阶段提升危险召回。
AI.motivation: VLM在灾后损伤评估中虽整体准确率尚可，但倾向于不宣布危险，导致召回率低；作者试图诊断并纠正这种过度保守的决策倾向。
AI.method: 采用信号检测论将决策行为分解为感知能力(d')与判定标准(c)；基于"恐惧使人类风险规避"的发现，利用机制可解释性定位与恐惧相关的affective circuit，并通过activation steering进行因果操纵；在基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的两阶段SeisMLLM流程上测试，用稀疏神经元knockout和分布式steering在留出情感数据上做因果验证。
AI.result: SeisMLLM-1K测试集上仅标记27.0%的真正不安全建筑，从不产生假Red，c=+1.354，d'=1.521；恐惧方向注入使Red召回升至75.7%(p<0.001)，减去该方向则完全抑制Red预测；归一化随机方向与匹配的happy方向无显著效应；机制为判定标准移动(c=-1.515)而非辨别力提升(d'=-0.493)。
AI.conclusion: VLM决策可在推理阶段无需重训练地进行调整；机制可解释性可用于诊断和控制工程应用中的VLM决策行为。

title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
summary: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.

AI.tldr: 提出首个数据视频理解基准 DataVista，含 961 个真实数据视频与 6,775 道题，按三级能力框架组织；19 个主流多模态大模型评测显示最优模型仅 70.0%，远低于人类专家，叙事理解类题目表现最差。
AI.motivation: 数据视频综合了数据可视化与视频叙事，在新闻报道和商业分析中被广泛使用。其理解需要准确读取动画图表中的数据、跨图表与跨时间整合证据，并理解叙事组织与视觉设计如何传递信息。然而现有基准要么针对通用视频，要么针对静态图表，数据视频理解尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 构建 DataVista 基准：收集 961 个真实世界数据视频，设计 6,775 道评测问题，覆盖五个主题领域；采用三级递进能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解），包含 10 种细粒度题型；并对 19 个主流多模态大模型进行系统评测与消融分析（帧数、字幕）及错误模式归纳。
AI.result: 表现最佳的 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率为 70.0%，仍远低于人类专家水平；模型在因果推理和叙事结构上表现最差。增加帧数与添加字幕主要提升数据感知和时序推理，对叙事理解增益有限。分析还识别出图表读取、证据判断和指令理解方面的典型失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 数据视频理解对现有多模态大模型仍具显著挑战，尤其在高层叙事理解方面；DataVista 为该方向提供了首个系统评测基准，并揭示模型关键失败模式。基准已开源：https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista。

title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
summary: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EUA-Cal，利用早期模型作为不确定性锚点进行校准，通过早期预测正则和原型结构正则缓解过自信，在图像分类和多选题任务上优于现有校准方法。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络（含大语言模型）在训练或微调过程中易产生过自信。作者观察到一致现象：早期模型校准更好，继续训练虽带来微弱准确率提升，却显著增加校准误差。分析表明早期模型在预测和特征中保留了不确定性感知，但随训练推进逐渐丢失。
AI.method: 提出 EUA-Cal（Early model as Uncertainty Anchor for Calibration）。包含两个正则项：早期预测正则（early prediction regularization）以保留早期预测不确定性；原型结构正则（prototype structure regularization）以利用早期特征空间中反映的不确定性，二者协同缓解过自信。
AI.result: 在图像分类和多选题问答任务、八种不同模型上的大量实验表明，EUA-Cal 优于当前最先进的校准方法。
AI.conclusion: 早期模型可作为不确定性锚点，通过正则化保留其不确定性感知，从而有效缓解训练/微调中的过自信问题，提升校准性能。

title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: ViMoD 是一个轻量框架，通过可恢复的粗粒度聚合表示与自适应细粒度 token 路由，在保持紧凑视觉上下文的同时按推理阶段动态接入原始视觉证据，在 20% token 预算下显著优于一次性压缩基线。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像产生长视觉 token 序列，使多模态大模型多步推理计算代价高昂。现有一掷式剪枝与聚合方法在解码前将视觉 token 压缩为固定上下文，但推理过程中对视觉证据的需求会随阶段变化，固定压缩上下文难以保留各阶段所需的全部细节。
AI.method: 提出 ViMoD，包含两个组件：1) DART（Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens）：学习内容自适应的分组与聚合容量，构建紧凑的 Coarse 表示，并链接可恢复的原始 Fine token；2) TRACE（Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence）：利用解码历史预测即将到来的证据需求，对活跃 Fine-token 组进行选择、保留或替换。被选中的 Fine token 在冻结骨干中增强持久 Coarse 上下文，实现阶段特定证据访问而无需持续关注全部视觉 token。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，ViMoD 在 20% 目标视觉 token 预算下于全部八个推理基准上超越所有评估基线，平均归一化得分相对最强一次性基线提升 39.0%。额外可训练参数仅占冻结骨干的 0.0546%。
AI.conclusion: ViMoD 证明：以极低参数开销维护紧凑粗粒度上下文并按推理阶段动态路由细粒度证据，可有效缓解固定压缩上下文与动态证据需求之间的矛盾，在低 token 预算下显著提升 MLLM 多步推理性能。

title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
summary: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

AI.tldr: LIVIN：基于30个真实"有人居住"家庭数字孪生的空间与具身智能基准，含人在回路构建流程，评测3D检测、重建、导航与移动操作四任务。
AI.motivation: 现有家庭仿真资源难以同时兼顾规模化、真实世界对应性与交互可用性；真实家居中的生活化物品摆放与空间约束对机器人运动与交互至关重要，但缺乏忠实且可交互的复刻资源。
AI.method: 构建30个多样化真实居住家庭的数字孪生，保留观测到的房间布局、家具配置与日常物品。采用人在回路工作流：实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成与摆放，每个阶段的中间结果均由人工对照原始观测进行复核与修正。
AI.result: 在LIVIN上评测四类任务：3D检测、3D重建、导航与移动操作。结果显示现有方法仍受困于密集物体摆放、遮挡、有限自由空间及受限交互区域。
AI.conclusion: LIVIN有望推动真实家庭环境中的具身AI研究，从空间理解到机器人交互，最终将具身智能带入日常家居环境。

title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了ECCV 2026第四届Perception Test挑战赛，聚焦空间智能，设置视频问答与城市尺度行走视频两类新赛道，并总结各赛道获胜方案。
AI.motivation: 延续Perception Test挑战赛系列，推动多模态模型在空间智能方向的研究，并通过新增城市尺度视频赛道拓展评测范围。
AI.method: 在ECCV 2026组织第四届工作坊，设置四个赛道：原基准的多选题视频问答与定位视频问答，以及基于城市尺度行走视频的新赛道KilometerAudio和KilometerVision；介绍新基准并汇总获胜方案。
AI.result: 各赛道均产生获胜方案，包括一个在所有赛道均取得满意表现的通用模型；新增城市尺度赛道的获胜方案表明，复杂空间与多模态推理可通过高成本的智能体式流程解决。
AI.conclusion: 复杂空间及多模态推理依赖昂贵的智能体式流程，而多模态模型单独使用仍面临较大困难。

title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE TPAMI for possible publication
summary: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

AI.tldr: 提出 DVLA-RL++，通过语义净化与反事实强化学习门控缓解小样本学习中上下文的污染，提升原型稳定性与跨域识别精度。
AI.motivation: 小样本学习借助文本语义补偿视觉观测不足，但图文高度一致既可能源于物体内在属性，也可能来自偶然上下文，导致支持集原型受到上下文污染。
AI.method: 在 DVLA-RL 基础上引入互补语义净化（CSP）与反事实强化学习门控（CRG）。CSP 从支持样本生成内在描述与干扰描述，与各支持 token 做一致性比较；以歧义相关的拒绝边界进行稀疏证据分配，并用内在语义锚填补未分配质量作为回退。CRG 以兼顾识别性能与干扰暴露的奖励学习逐层语义融合强度，并通过同一 episode 上独立执行的参考轨迹提供配对学习信号。
AI.result: 理论分析将保留证据与锚质量关联到原型稳定性，并给出无偏 on-policy 梯度估计的条件；在标准、细粒度与跨域基准上取得最优精度，较 DVLA-RL 平均提升 1.4%。
AI.conclusion: DVLA-RL++ 通过区分内在语义与上下文干扰、并结合强化学习式层间门控，有效提升小样本原型的鲁棒性与识别性能。

title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContourVLA，将广义指代分割(GRES)重构为闭环视觉运动过程，以可编辑轮廓作为策略状态，并引入EASS感知调度与DECT-GRPO强化学习优化，在gRefCOCO上gIoU提升最高8.7点，并在RefCOCO系列全部8个split上取得最高mIoU。
AI.motivation: GRES需在识别可变数量语言指定目标的高层语义与精确边界勾勒的细粒度视觉证据之间动态平衡。现有级联视觉-语言架构依赖静态特征接口与单次掩码预测，限制了自适应感知与几何校正能力。
AI.method: 提出ContourVLA视觉-语言-动作策略，将GRES建模为闭环视觉运动过程：可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态，调节多模态感知并由几何动作块更新。Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS)结合轮廓引导的双向边界采样与状态条件下的多层级多模态特征路由。在监督初始化后，采用DECT-GRPO联合优化离散grounding与连续轮廓动作，利用实例级credit，其rollout奖励与credit来自考虑假阳性与漏检的软预测-目标对应关系。
AI.result: 在gRefCOCO val、testA、testB上gIoU分别较最强基线提升8.7、2.8、2.7点；在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg全部8个split上取得最高mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 将GRES重构为以轮廓为策略状态的闭环视觉运动过程，配合进化感知调度与带熵credit传输的GRPO优化，可有效提升指代分割的自适应感知与几何校正能力，显著超越现有基线。

title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification
summary: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的反事实数据增强策略，通过"擦除"病灶生成健康乳腺钼靶图像以扩充训练分布，在VinDr-Mammo数据集上提升多种分类器架构的敏感度。
AI.motivation: 计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在乳腺筛查中因漏诊（假阴性）而导致检测和治疗延迟，假阴性是其关键局限。为解决该问题，需要丰富训练分布以改善模型对病灶的识别能力。
AI.method: 在BI-RADS 1（健康）钼靶图像上训练去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），并采用基于RePaint的采样策略，在标注的病灶边界框内修复生成逼真的正常组织。生成的健康反事实图像以真实健康组织替换病灶区域，同时保留患者特有的解剖结构。可应用于四种代表性分类器架构：ConvNeXt（CNN）、ViT（视觉Transformer）、Mammo-CLIP（视觉-语言模型）和FPN-MIL（多尺度注意力多实例学习）。
AI.result: 真实与生成图像间的相似度指标支持结构保留效果；放射科医师评估确认生成图像逼真度与原数据集质量一致。在VinDr-Mammo数据集上，所有架构的敏感度均有提升，尤其在80%固定特异度下提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 该反事实数据增强策略通过生成逼真健康图像扩充训练集，有效提升多种分类器的敏感度，有助于构建更可靠的乳腺癌CAD系统。代码已开源。

title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
summary: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Connected Self Forcing，通过重连自回归分块间的梯度路径并引入 shortcut gradient replay 降低显存开销，在不改变推理流程的前提下提升长视频生成的视觉质量与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: Self Forcing 通过自 rollout 训练缓解 exposure bias，但为控制显存会 detach 历史 KV 缓存，从而保留前向依赖却切断反向梯度路径，导致早期上下文的生成无法接收来自后续预测的反馈。
AI.method: 提出 Connected Self Forcing：跨自回归分块重连梯度路径，使梯度经由生成的 latent 传回产生它们的计算过程，而不仅限于历史 KV 写入；并设计 shortcut gradient replay，在不保留完整 rollout 计算图的情况下恢复跨块梯度。结合 distribution matching distillation 进行训练。
AI.result: 在自回归视频生成实验中，长时程视觉质量与时间一致性均获得提升，且推理流程保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 历史分块可依据其直接监督信号及对后续生成的贡献共同训练，实现更连贯的长视频生成。

title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at the 10th On-Board Payload Data Compression Workshop (OBPDC 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 12-14 October 2026
summary: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究星上舰船检测以按内容选择下传数据，构建了基于68幅Maxar场景的数据集并训练YOLOX-S，量化部署于Versal VC1902的DPU上，并提出多种下传模式以权衡保留舰船与下传数据量。
AI.motivation: 甚高分辨率对地观测卫星获取的数据量超过其存储与下传能力，而海事监视中舰船仅占每幅场景的极小部分，因此需要按内容而非逐像素压缩来选择下传数据，以缓解星上数据瓶颈。
AI.method: 研究沿三条主线：(i) 数据与算法——基于68幅带标注的Maxar场景、43类舰船构建受控数据集，并训练YOLOX-S检测器；(ii) 嵌入式部署——对检测器量化后部署于Versal VC1902的DPU，检测质量损失有限，每场景处理耗时数秒；(iii) 数据缩减——提出多种下传模式，从仅元数据到舰船裁剪、含检测的瓦片以及背景退化的整幅场景，并依据实测检测误差估计各模式在舰船保留率与下传数据量之间的权衡。
AI.result: 在密集港口与海岸场景中，瓦片模式以29%的场景数据量保留98%的舰船，裁剪模式以3%的数据量保留83%的舰船。
AI.conclusion: 星上舰船检测可作为传统星上压缩的补充手段，通过按内容选择性下传有效缓解数据瓶颈；不同下传模式在舰船保留率与数据量之间提供可调的权衡，其中瓦片模式在保持高舰船保留率的同时显著降低下传量。

title: Stride Independent Patching for Deep Learning
summary: This paper presents semi-automatic stride-independent patching (SSP) as an alternative to automatic stride-dependent patching techniques. SSP uses user or expert input to position predefined patches over one or more objects of interest. To evaluate its effectiveness, three patch-based datasets were created using SSP, overlapping patching (Overlap), and non-overlapping patching (Noverlap). DeepLabV3+ models with ResNet50, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 backbones were trained sepa-rately on each dataset. Quantitative evaluations were performed on the respective test splits and a common external test set. SSP generally achieved higher segmentation scores on the test splits and required the shortest model training time across all three backbones. On the external test set, SSP achieved the highest average precision and F1-score across backbones, whereas Noverlap achieved the highest average recall. These preliminary results demonstrate that the potentially greater spatial coverage of Noverlap and Overlap does not generally translate into better segmentation perfor-mance and that SSP offers a favorable balance between segmentation performance and model training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出半自动步幅无关分块方法SSP，并验证其在分割性能与训练时间上的优势。
AI.motivation: 自动分块方法依赖步幅参数，评估SSP能否以更优的性价比替代自动分块成为本文动机。
AI.method: 由用户或专家输入确定预定义分块位置，构建SSP、重叠分块与非重叠分块三个数据集，分别训练三种骨干网络的DeepLabV3+模型并做定量评估。
AI.result: SSP在测试划分上分割得分更高且训练时间最短；外部测试集上跨骨干网络取得最高平均精度与F1值，非重叠分块取得最高平均召回率。
AI.conclusion: 非重叠与重叠分块更大的空间覆盖并不必然带来更好的分割性能，SSP在分割性能与训练时间间取得良好平衡。

title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
summary: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于空间标记与简短注释（画布指令）的图像编辑新接口及模型VibeEdit，在相似物体场景中实现精准区域定位与编辑，多项指标显著优于文本指令基线。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑中，描述“改什么”通常容易，但在多个相似物体并存时，准确指定“改哪个对象或区域”十分困难，仅靠文本提示难以高效消歧。
AI.method: 引入画布指令接口：用户在图像上直接放置空间标记并附加简短注释，共同指定编辑位置与内容，支持物体增删、替换、属性修改与移动，无需单独文本提示。构建155万组带物体掩码和结构化编辑描述的源-目标编辑对，并在训练中渲染为画布指令。基于Qwen-Image-Edit，采用层解耦条件机制分别编码源图像与画布指令；训练分两阶段：区域加权监督微调，随后基于评分标准的强化学习，以提升编辑完成度、局部质量与非编辑区域保持。
AI.result: 在独立构建、人工整理的419例强调相似物体目标选择的基准上，VibeEdit取得VLM评分79.9、区域外PSNR 32.8 dB；表现最佳的文本指令基线FireRed分别为67.4和24.0 dB。
AI.conclusion: 空间标记加简短注释的画布指令能有效解决相似物体场景下的目标选择难题，配合层解耦条件与分阶段训练，VibeEdit在编辑质量与未编辑区域保真度上均显著优于文本指令方法。

title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
summary: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

AI.tldr: 提出空间画布界面与Compo模型，将海报生成从文本提示转为空间化"合成"，实现更强的构图可控性。
AI.motivation: 文本提示是一种间接接口，用户需将本质为二维的构图意图压缩为一维词序列，导致构图意图表达困难、可控性弱。
AI.method: 提出Spatial Canvas Interface，支持语义、身份、文本、像素四类绑定，并配以针对各元素与全局外观的Text Specifications；基于预训练图像编辑模型改造出Compo，支持直接推理与agentic模式（高层请求自动转译为规划好的空间画布）；训练上构建可扩展流水线，自动生成各绑定类型及其组合的监督数据，无需从头训练专用海报生成器；同时提出评估各绑定类型及联合构图遵从度的基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，Compo在构图可控性上优于通用图像生成模型与专用海报生成系统，同时保持高视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将意图指定与视觉生成解耦，本工作推动海报生成从prompting转向composing。

title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Long, Findings). Code: https://github.com/sony/syn-omni
summary: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.

AI.tldr: 提出Syn-Omni统一框架，通过正交模态专家LoRA与渐进协同路由，实现全模态嵌入中通用语义与模态专有特征的结构化分离与可控跨模态协作。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法通常在混合模态数据上使用单一共享参数空间，缺乏通用表示与模态专有表示之间的结构分离，限制了多模态异质输入的建模能力。
AI.method: 1) OME-LoRA（正交模态专家LoRA）：将适配分解为共享LoRA路径（通用语义）与模态专家LoRA路径（模态感知专化）；2) PSR（渐进协同路由）：使专家先建立模态专有先验，再逐步与其他模态专家交互以实现跨模态协同。
AI.result: 在涵盖图像、视频、音频及视听模态的81项多样化任务上，Syn-Omni持续优于全模态基线方法，验证了结构化专化与跨模态渐进协作的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化模态专化与渐进式跨模态协作，可有效解决全模态嵌入中共享与专有表示混淆的问题，为统一全模态适配提供了可行框架。

title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
summary: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出动态向量解码方法DVD，将2D/3D感知表示统一转换为1D向量序列并映射为紧凑离散token，通过轻量解tokenizer与MLLM对接，在多个2D/3D基准上性能领先且显著降低token开销与推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型感知方法存在两种局限：基于文本坐标表示导致token开销过大；固定范围量化受范围与精度约束，难以适应空间范围无界、定位精度要求高的3D场景。需要一种统一且高效的表示方法。
AI.method: DVD先将多样感知表示（2D边界框、2D掩码、3D边界框）转化为1D向量序列，再映射到高维空间的紧凑离散token；随后用轻量级de-tokenizer将MLLM输出的token解码回原始2D/3D感知表示，实现与MLLM的无缝集成。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim、nuScenes等2D与3D感知基准上，DVD在2D和3D任务中均取得优越性能，并显著降低token开销与推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: DVD为将感知能力集成到MLLM提供了高效且通用的框架，克服了现有方法的固有局限，统一了2D与3D感知任务的表示。

title: Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Slot3R，一种免训练、集合关联式的流式三维重建改造方法：解耦"空间位置作为索引地址"与"观测是否必须融合"，允许同一地址共存多个状态，在冻结 Point3R 主干的前提下提升精度与显存可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 流式三维重建需在处理不断扩张的场景时保留每一帧的证据。空间记忆天然适合这一任务，因为它按重建出的三维位置组织历史信息。但 Point3R 同时用空间邻近性来完成两件事：将新观测与已有记忆条目关联，以及决定是否将其融合，从而把"共位"与"状态同一性"混为一谈。由于指针（pointer）是对图像块的摘要，邻近的指针可能编码不同的表面、视角或可见性条件；在后续帧有能力消歧之前就对其取平均，会破坏互补证据。
AI.method: 核心主张是：位置应决定寻址地址，而不应决定观测是否必须合并。Slot3R 将这一原则实现为一种免训练、集合关联（set-associative）式的改造：在共享地址处允许多个状态共存，同时保持预训练的 Point3R 主干冻结。此外引入有界稀疏读出（bounded sparse readout），将持久化存储与逐帧解码器访问进一步解耦。
AI.result: 在 300–500 采样帧设置下，Slot3R 将 Point3R 的点云精度误差（Acc）在 7Scenes 上降低 57.1%–63.1%，在 NeuralRGBD 上降低 64.0%–72.0%；在全部三个位姿基准上降低了 Sim(3) 对齐的绝对轨迹误差（ATE），并在视频深度估计上保持竞争力。在相同协议下，它可在 600–1000 采样帧的全部评测设置中完成运行，速度约 19 FPS，而 Point3R 与 InfiniteVGGT 在 800 帧及以上出现显存溢出。
AI.conclusion: Slot3R 表明，将空间位置的"寻址"功能与"融合"决策解耦，可有效避免因过早平均而损失互补证据，在无需训练、不修改主干的情况下显著提升流式三维重建的精度、位姿估计与长序列显存可扩展性。

title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多智能体自我中心世界模型（ME-World），将多智能体自我中心世界建模定义为多智能体在共享环境中通过细粒度动作交互的同步自我流生成问题，并通过共享token序列联合去噪、跨视图姿势条件与共享环境记忆来提升共享世界一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心世界模型多针对单一智能体，而真实具身场景常涉及多智能体在共享环境中动作与交互。现有多智能体世界模型依赖粗粒度动作（如移动、相机控制或离散指令），细粒度具身交互尚未被充分探索。该任务面临跨视图动作一致性、共享环境一致性以及交互诱导状态更新的传播一致性等挑战。
AI.method: 提出ME-World：在共享token序列中联合去噪多个自我流；以所有智能体的目标视图姿势为条件对每个流进行调节；并利用共享环境记忆来支撑生成。在真实与合成多智能体数据上训练与评估，并引入共享世界一致性指标，涵盖环境一致性、更新一致性与身份一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，与现有方法相比，ME-World在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持与视频质量方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: ME-World为多智能体细粒度具身交互下的自我中心世界建模提供了统一框架，通过共享token去噪、跨视图姿势条件与共享环境记忆实现同步多流生成，并由新提出的共享世界一致性指标验证其有效性。

title: From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms.
