Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: Being-M0.7 提出一种潜在世界-动作模型，通过混合模态人类数据的预训练、机器人中训练与动作后训练，将视觉-运动先验迁移到人形机器人的全身运动-操作控制中。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人的运动-操作需要协调的全身运动并依赖未来场景演化，但真实机器人演示数据稀缺；人类视频与运动数据虽具可扩展性，却存在模态不配对、且人类运动无法直接对应可执行机器人动作的问题。
AI.method: 1）构建超过1万小时以人为中心的语料，整合纯视频、纯运动与配对视频-运动三种流；2）预训练阶段联合预测未来潜在视觉状态与运动，使视觉表征编码未来运动学；3）机器人中训练将粗粒度先验适配到机器人视角与身体动力学；4）动作后训练中，动作专家通过门控交叉注意力，将冻结适配先验的视觉预测表征与当前图像、本体感受结合，生成可执行全身指令。
AI.result: 在 SIMPLE 基准上取得相比基线最高的总体成功率，并在真实世界 Unitree G1 运动-操作任务上达到与最强基线相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过分阶段迁移混合模态人类视觉-运动先验，可有效缓解人形机器人演示稀缺问题，实现可执行的全身运动-操作控制。

title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
summary: In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present \method{}, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a \emph{deflated Hessian} that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 \method{} consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 \method{} improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50\% to 68.17\% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, \method{} achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一的低秩辅助W4A4 PTQ框架，将低秩补偿与残差量化建模为耦合标定问题，通过deflated Hessian与激活噪声代理项联合优化，以更低秩和更快量化取得更优的扩散模型与LLM量化性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer中4-bit权重-激活后训练量化（W4A4 PTQ）损失较大，低秩分支可缓解该问题。但现有低秩PTQ方法存在两点不足：一是将低秩补偿与残差量化分离优化，往往需要更高秩；二是依赖二阶权重更新却未显式建模激活量化误差，该误差在4-bit下尤为显著。
AI.method: 提出\method{}框架，将低秩辅助的W4A4 PTQ统一建模为耦合标定问题，并由联合目标推导基于优化的求解器。通过消去输出侧低秩因子得到deflated Hessian，对已被低秩分量捕获的残差误差进行折扣；同时引入激活噪声代理项以抑制激活量化误差。
AI.result: 在五个扩散主干上，rank-4 \method{}的PSNR与LPIPS一致优于rank-4 SVDQuant；在SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell和FLUX.1-dev上以8倍更小的秩和最高6.25倍更快的量化速度超越rank-32 SVDQuant。在Qwen3-8B LLM上，rank-4 \method{}将MMLU准确率从61.50%提升至68.17%（对比rank-32 SVDQuant）。
AI.conclusion: \method{}以显著更低的秩和量化成本实现了更好的W4A4性能，验证了耦合标定与激活误差显式建模的有效性。

title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://sepgen.github.io/
summary: A 4D audio-visual scene comprises a video, the dynamic geometry it depicts, and the sound sources that populate it, each with its own position and trajectory. Rendering such a scene from a novel viewpoint requires that every source be available as an individual waveform, so that it can be localized in the scene and propagated to the observer before the signals are mixed. Joint audio-video generators can synthesize the video and its soundtrack, but the soundtrack is emitted as a single audio-mix in which the sources are not individually accessible. We present SepGen, which extends a pretrained audio-video generator to emit the video, the mixed soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in one joint sampling run. SepGen supports two complementary modes: generation and separation. In generation mode, each source caption specifies what its stem contains. A two-speaker dialogue, for example, comes out as one stem per speaker in the original turn order. In separation mode, the input audio-mix remains clean while the captions specify what to extract, so the model can decompose a recording from a free-text description. We evaluate generation on scenes synthesized from text, and separation on scenes rendered by other generators and on real recordings of speech, music, and sound effects. Given an audio-mix and captions that carry the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators, most clearly on speech, and it keeps the lead when the lines are removed from the captions. Code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://sepgen.github.io/

AI.tldr: SepGen 扩展预训练音视频生成器，在单次联合采样中同时生成视频、混合音轨以及每条字幕对应声源的独立波形，兼具生成与分离两种模式。
AI.motivation: 4D 音视频场景的新视角渲染要求每个声源以独立波形形式存在，以便定位并在混合前传播到观察者；但现有联合音视频生成器只能输出不可拆分来源的单一混合音轨。
AI.method: 在预训练音视频生成器基础上扩展，一次联合采样输出视频、混合音轨及每个带字幕声源的一条波形；支持生成模式（字幕说明各声源内容）与分离模式（输入混合音频保持干净，字幕指定提取目标）。
AI.result: 在文本合成场景上评估生成，在其他生成器渲染场景及真实语音、音乐、音效录音上评估分离；给定混合音频和含台词的字幕时性能优于语言条件分离器，语音上优势最明显，且台词从字幕中移除后仍保持领先。
AI.conclusion: SepGen 通过联合采样实现声源级可分离的音视频生成，统一了生成与分离任务，并在多项评测中超越语言条件分离基线。

title: Bernoulli Flow Models: Self-Consistent Generative Modeling for Binary Data
summary: Binary diffusion models typically require a large number of function evaluations (NFEs) to generate high-quality samples, making practical inference computationally expensive. Reducing NFEs while preserving sample quality without distillation or additional training remains a significant challenge. Existing binary diffusion models define a discrete one-step forward path and then derive the reverse posterior. In low-NFE settings requiring cross-step sampling, they approximate the true multi-step likelihood with a single-step likelihood transition, which severely degrades sample quality. To address this fundamental limitation and decouple the generative dynamics from fixed discrete time steps, we propose Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM). Rather than relying on sequential one-step Markov diffusion chains, BFM defines a unified continuous global Bernoulli probability flow path between data distributions and pure noise, from which we derive analytical closed-form posterior transitions over arbitrary time intervals. Consequently, reducing the inference NFE is no longer an approximation based on skipping discrete steps; it only requires re-evaluating the analytical posterior over a new time grid. This eliminates the structural training-inference mismatch inherent to discrete chains and yields self-consistent low-NFE sampling. Experiments show that BFM is highly robust to aggressive NFE reduction. On LSUN Churches 256x256, a BFM trained with 256 steps achieves an FID of 9.22 using only 16 sampling steps, whereas the state-of-the-art discrete baseline degrades to 204.10. BFM also remains competitive with continuous and discrete generative baselines under standard full-step inference. These results establish BFM as a theoretically rigorous, self-consistent, and practically effective framework for fast binary data generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM)，用连续全局 Bernoulli 概率流替代离散一步马尔可夫链，导出任意时间区间的闭式后验转移，实现无需蒸馏的低 NFE 自洽采样。
AI.motivation: 现有二值扩散模型需大量函数评估（NFE）才能生成高质量样本，推理代价高。其定义离散一步前向路径并推导反向后验，在低 NFE 跨步采样时用单步似然近似真实多步似然，造成严重质量下降，且存在训练-推理结构性不匹配。
AI.method: 不依赖顺序一步马尔可夫扩散链，BFM 在数据分布与纯噪声之间定义统一的连续全局 Bernoulli 概率流路径，并由此推导任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移。降低 NFE 时只需在新时间网格上重新计算解析后验，而非跳过离散步的近似。
AI.result: BFM 对激进 NFE 削减高度鲁棒。在 LSUN Churches 256x256 上，以 256 步训练的 BFM 仅用 16 采样步即达 FID 9.22，而最先进的离散基线退化至 204.10；在标准全步推理下亦与连续与离散生成基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: BFM 消除了离散链固有的训练-推理不匹配，实现自洽的低 NFE 采样，是一个理论严谨、自洽且实用的快速二值数据生成框架。

title: CoPoE: Multimodal Fusion via Decomposable Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts for Missing-Modality Alzheimer's Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis benefits from integrating heterogeneous clinical, imaging, genomic, and biomarker evidence, but clinical cohorts frequently suffer from irregular modality missingness. Existing fusion methods often synthesize absent inputs, risking the introduction of artificial surrogates, or pool available signals into uninterpretable latent spaces. We present CoPoE (Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts), a disease-coordinate framework that maps multimodal evidence into a structured latent space partitioned into four distinct biological and clinical axes: genetic Risk, molecular Pathology, Neurodegeneration, and clinical Stage (R/P/N/S). Each observed modality parameterizes a diagonal Gaussian expert over the full RPNS vector, and a masked Product-of-Experts architecture fuses only the available modalities. Consequently, absent modalities add no factor to the fusion path, allowing the network to preserve a robust, decomposable posterior for any non-empty modality subset without synthetic imputation in the RPNS path. Through extensive missing-modality experiments on the ADNI dataset, CoPoE achieves the best all-modality performance and the highest mean AUROC across all 15 observed-subset evaluations among standardized missing-modality fusion baselines under a shared non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark, while substantially improving raw-probability ECE, Brier score, and NLL. Furthermore, PET-supervised probing shows evidence enrichment within the pathology (P) block under full modalities, with tau-related signal retained even when direct fluid biospecimen inputs are withheld. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/CoPoE.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoPoE（Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts），将多模态阿尔茨海默病（AD）证据映射到由遗传风险(R)、分子病理(P)、神经退行(N)、临床分期(S)四个轴组成的结构化潜空间；每个观测模态参数化一个对角高斯专家，用掩码 Product-of-Experts 仅融合可用模态，缺失模态不参与融合路径，从而无需合成填补即可获得可分解后验。
AI.motivation: 多模态 AD 诊断需整合临床、影像、基因组与生物标志物等异质证据，但真实队列普遍存在不规则模态缺失。现有融合方法或合成缺失输入（引入人工替代物），或把可用信号汇入不可解释的潜空间，缺乏可解释性与缺失鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出疾病坐标框架 CoPoE：定义 RPNS 四轴结构化潜空间（遗传 Risk、分子 Pathology、神经退行 Neurodegeneration、临床 Stage）；每个观测模态对完整 RPNS 向量参数化一个对角高斯专家；采用掩码 Product-of-Experts 融合，缺失模态在融合路径上不贡献因子，因此任意非空模态子集都能得到稳健、可分解的后验，RPNS 路径无需合成插补。在 ADNI 数据集上开展大量缺失模态实验，并做 PET 监督探测分析。
AI.result: 在共享的非 PET ADNI 嵌入基准下，CoPoE 取得最佳全模态性能，并在全部 15 个观测子集评估中取得最高平均 AUROC（对比标准化缺失模态融合基线）；同时显著改善原始概率的 ECE、Brier 分数与 NLL。PET 监督探测显示全模态时病理(P)块存在证据富集，且在撤除直接体液生物样本输入时仍保留 tau 相关信号。
AI.conclusion: CoPoE 通过疾病坐标潜空间与掩码专家乘积融合，在不做合成插补的前提下实现了对任意非空模态子集的稳健、可解释多模态融合，并在 ADNI 上优于现有缺失模态融合基线；其 RPNS 分块还表现出与生物学证据（如 tau）对应的可解释性。

title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://dingkai0302.github.io/wam-cache/
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable generalist robot manipulation by conditioning an action expert on representations from a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). In closed-loop control, the video DiT runs at every chunk to encode the current observation into layerwise key-value (KV) pairs that the action expert queries. This prefill dominates the per-chunk computational cost, yet existing training-free accelerations leave it fully dense. We present WAM-Cache, a training-free framework that retains layerwise key-value representations across chunks and recomputes only a sparse refresh set of tokens. Crucially, we find that the intuitive heuristic of refreshing visually drifted tokens plateaus far below the dense baseline, even with an oracle predicting ground-truth KV drift. Downstream action accuracy is instead governed by where the action expert attends, not by what moved. WAM-Cache therefore selects the refresh set by uniting the action expert's cross-attention with visual latent surprise, complemented by a strict age bound that suppresses compounding error. On Fast-WAM, WAM-Cache cuts video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world experiments, while staying within 0.7-1.8 percentage points of the dense policy in simulation and 2.5 points on a real robot.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的WAM-Cache框架，通过跨chunk复用视频DiT的逐层KV并稀疏刷新，在不损失过多性能的前提下降低动作模型预填充算力。
AI.motivation: World Action Models（WAMs）在闭环控制中需每个chunk运行视频DiT进行预填充编码观测，该预填充占据主要计算成本，而现有免训练加速方法仍保持全密集计算，亟需针对性稀疏化方案。
AI.method: WAM-Cache跨chunk保留逐层KV表示，仅重算稀疏刷新集合。研究发现基于视觉漂移的直觉启发式效果不佳（即便有oracle预测真值KV漂移），下游动作精度由动作专家的注意力位置决定。因此刷新集合结合动作专家的交叉注意力与视觉潜变量surprise，并加入严格年龄上界以抑制误差累积。
AI.result: 在Fast-WAM上，于RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及真实实验中，视频DiT预填充FLOPs降低32-42%；仿真中与密集策略差距在0.7-1.8个百分点内，真实机器人上为2.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作精度由动作专家关注位置而非视觉变化驱动，基于此设计的稀疏刷新策略可在免训练条件下显著降低预填充计算，并保持接近密集基线的控制性能。

title: WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Despite recent advances in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robotic manipulation, their performance remains sensitive to changes in camera configuration. The problem becomes more evident in cross-setup deployment, as reproducing the exact camera pose used for training is nearly impossible. Unlike fixed external views, wrist views are more challenging because the camera moves with the robot, causing even small mounting variations to alter fine-grained geometric cues. To address this, we propose WARP-VLA, a camera-view robust VLA for diverse wrist camera configurations. WARP-VLA adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture where individual experts learn view-specific feature transformations, and a router combines them based on implicit view information. This allows the policy to be deployed without requiring camera extrinsic parameters as additional input. Through experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, WARP-VLA improves the average success rate of pi-0.5 from 39.2% to 78.3% under wrist-view perturbations. The real-robot experiments further show that the feature-level adaptation learned in simulation successfully transfers to diverse deployment settings. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release our wrist viewpoint robustness benchmark and a plug-and-play implementation.

AI.tldr: WARP-VLA：面向手腕相机配置鲁棒性的VLA模型，采用MoE架构学习视角特定特征变换，无需外参输入，在LIBERO上大幅提升扰动下成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型对相机配置变化敏感，跨设置部署时难以复现训练相机位姿。手腕视角更棘手，因相机随机器人运动，微小安装偏差即改变细粒度几何线索。
AI.method: 提出WARP-VLA，采用Mixture-of-Experts架构：各专家学习视角特定特征变换，路由器基于隐式视角信息组合专家输出，无需相机外参作为额外输入。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，手腕视角扰动下将pi-0.5平均成功率从39.2%提升至78.3%；真实机器人实验表明仿真中学到的特征级自适应可迁移到多样部署设置。
AI.conclusion: WARP-VLA有效提升手腕视角配置下的鲁棒性，并释放手腕视角鲁棒性基准与即插即用实现以促进复现与后续研究。

title: CoCam4D: Geometry-Aware Cooperative 4D Perception for Camera-Only Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles often suffer from limited perception due to occlusions, blind spots, limited sensor range, and the complex nature of surrounding environments. Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) addresses these challenges by allowing vehicles to share sensory information and reconstruct the scene cooperatively. However, camera-only perception remains fundamentally limited by the uncertainty of distance-dependent monocular depth estimation. We propose CoCam4D, a Bayesian framework for collaborative perception that explicitly models geometric uncertainty. It uses a VGGT-based feedforward network to generate 3D Gaussian scene representations with associated uncertainty estimates, enabling multiple vehicles or agents to efficiently combine their observations. By sharing compact Gaussian primitives, reliable observations from one agent can reduce the depth uncertainty of another without requiring LiDAR sensors. To support real-world deployment, we introduce Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs), a compact 35-byte representation designed for efficient C-V2X communication. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms recent vision-only methods, achieving improvements of 11.48% on OPV2V+ and 10.62% on DAIR-V2X-C, demonstrating the potential of geometrically grounded collaborative perception for LiDAR-free autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCam4D，一种显式建模几何不确定性的贝叶斯协同感知框架，基于VGGT前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示，实现无LiDAR的多车协同感知。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶常因遮挡、盲区、传感器范围有限及环境复杂而感知受限。多智能体协同感知可共享信息协同重建场景，但纯相机感知受单目深度估计不确定性制约，且依赖LiDAR成本高、难部署。
AI.method: CoCam4D采用贝叶斯框架显式建模几何不确定性；使用基于VGGT的前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示；多车通过共享紧凑高斯基元融合观测，用可靠观测降低他车深度不确定性；并提出35字节的动态物体基元(DOPs)以支持C-V2X高效通信。
AI.result: 在OPV2V+上提升11.48%，在DAIR-V2X-C上提升10.62%，持续优于近期纯视觉方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何接地(geometrically grounded)的协同感知在无LiDAR自动驾驶中具有潜力。

title: Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published in Proceedings of the Intelligent Robotics FAIR 2026 (IntRob '26), June 18-19, 2026, Budapest, Hungary, ACM
summary: Deploying intelligent robotic systems that interact with humans through gestures requires neural networks capable of recognizing diverse temporal patterns. We present a systematic benchmark of ten abstract sequential tasks--five permutation-invariant (set) and five order-dependent (sequence) problems--evaluated across eighteen neural network architectures spanning recurrent, convolutional, attention-based, and set-function families. Beyond the core architecture-task grid, we explore numerous preprocessing and target-variable transformations, yielding more than 250 distinct experimental configurations. All variants are trained and tested under strictly identical conditions (fixed random seeds, shared hyperparameters, shared data splits) to ensure fair and reproducible comparison. Ranking across all ten tasks reveals four consistently top-performing architectures--BiGRU, TCN, Conv1D, and GRUReLU--all compact enough for real-time deployment (under 2,000 parameters in the benchmark setting). Based on this ranking, we apply three architecturally diverse top models (BiGRU, TCN, and GRUReLU) to a practical robotics problem: estimating the execution speed of dynamic arm gestures from skeletal keypoint sequences. Three speed interpretations (peak count, period time, and mean spike spacing) are evaluated on a custom dataset of eight traffic-related gesture classes comprising 256,710 frames recorded via OpenPose. The best configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.198 on the peak-count interpretation, corresponding to roughly 5% relative error, while the period-time interpretation reaches approximately 4% relative error, and the mean spike spacing interpretation approximately 8% relative error. These results demonstrate that neural networks can reliably estimate gesture speed from skeletal data, opening a path toward speed-aware gesture-controlled robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 系统基准测试18种神经网络架构在10类序列任务上的表现，筛选出4个轻量最优模型，并将其应用于机器人手势速度估计，取得约4%–8%的相对误差。
AI.motivation: 手势交互的智能机器人系统需要能识别多样时间模式的神经网络，但缺乏跨架构、跨任务的系统性对比，也缺少对"手势执行速度"这一动态属性的可靠估计方法。
AI.method: 构建包含10个抽象序列任务（5个置换不变集合任务、5个顺序依赖序列任务）的基准，评估循环、卷积、注意力及集合函数等18种架构；在此基础上组合多种预处理与目标变量变换，形成超过250种实验配置，并采用固定随机种子、共享超参数与数据划分保证公平可比。随后用BiGRU、TCN、GRUReLU三个最优架构，从OpenPose骨架关键点序列估计动态手臂手势速度，测试峰值计数、周期时间、平均尖峰间距三种速度解释。
AI.result: BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU四个架构在全部10个任务上稳定表现最佳，且参数量均低于2000，适合实时部署。在含8类交通相关手势、256710帧的自建数据集上，最优配置的峰值计数解释平均绝对误差为0.198（约5%相对误差），周期时间解释约4%相对误差，平均尖峰间距解释约8%相对误差。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络能够从骨架数据可靠估计手势速度，为速度感知型手势控制机器人系统提供了可行路径。

title: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AutoRegressive Retriever（ARR），一种能利用已检索项内容迭代更新查询嵌入的多模态检索模型，并通过监督微调与强化学习联合优化，在域内和零样本检索上平均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 传统通用多模态检索将查询编码一次后即按嵌入相似度独立排序，效率高但查询表示固定不变；即使已检索到的条目有助于澄清真实信息需求，查询也无法据此调整，限制了检索效果。
AI.method: ARR 在"检索一个条目"与"更新查询嵌入"之间交替进行，最后用最终嵌入对全库排序。训练分两阶段：监督微调通过逐步对比监督使编码器学会利用反馈；强化学习将反馈条目的选择视为动作，以相关条目最终倒数排名为奖励优化选择策略。同时引入查询侧适配器，使优化可在固定条目索引上进行。
AI.result: ARR 在域内与零样本基准上均取得强检索表现，平均超过所比较的基线。进一步分析表明：反馈在推理阶段能提升检索效果；且带反馈的训练即使在尚未观测任何条目之前，也改善了初始查询嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 通过让查询嵌入在检索过程中自回归地吸收已检索内容，并结合监督与强化学习优化反馈选择，ARR 突破了传统一次性编码检索的局限，且其反馈训练带来的收益可迁移到初始查询表示，为多模态检索提供了一种可迭代、可优化的新范式。

title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
summary: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MultiWorldBench，一个针对多人世界模型的诊断性 Minecraft 基准，覆盖七类任务套件与十项能力，并对 Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld 及 Engine GT 进行评测，发现现有生成系统在多视图一致性与持久性上远逊于引擎真值。
AI.motivation: 多人世界模型要求多个独立控制的视角在同一持久共享世界中保持一致，但现有评测缺少针对该能力的系统性诊断工具，因此需要构建细粒度基准以揭示生成系统在跨视图一致性、共享状态同步、持久性等方面的缺陷。
AI.method: 构建 MultiWorldBench 基准，包含 495 个案例配置，涵盖七类任务套件与十项能力（独立控制、跨视图运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互、延迟重访等）。以 Engine GT 作为参照，评测 Solaris、Gamma-World 和 MineWorld 三个生成系统，并结合自动评测与人类偏好进行排序与相关性分析。
AI.result: 十项能力平均分：Gamma-World 21.39 最高，其次 Solaris 20.88，MineWorld 1.89，Engine GT 91.69。Gamma-World 在控制、共享状态与重访能力上较优，Solaris 在跨视图运动与竞态一致性上领先。但所有生成系统在状态持久性上得分不超过 8.00，结构一致性不超过 1.33，且在空间推理与建筑身份保持上无一成功。人类偏好排序与自动评测高度一致，维度级 Spearman 相关性均值为 0.96。
AI.conclusion: 现有生成系统即使能产生看似合理的单视角画面，也尚未构成连贯的多人世界；MultiWorldBench 揭示了其在持久性、结构一致性与空间推理方面的根本性不足。

title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $Φ$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
summary: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $Φ$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $Φ$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $Φ$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $Φ$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在ESA Φsat-2卫星上部署轻量级海洋异常检测流程的经验：涵盖开发、星上集成与发射后适配，重点揭示仿真数据与在轨数据的显著差异，并通过基于真实L1影像的重训和更优标注策略显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 星上AI可提升对地观测系统的响应速度与带宽效率，但将算法真正部署到资源受限的卫星硬件并保证其在真实在轨数据上的有效性仍缺乏系统经验。本文旨在以Φsat-2任务为例，总结星上AI应用从开发到在轨适配的实践路径与关键挑战。
AI.method: 在ESA Φsat-2任务上开发并集成轻量级海洋异常检测流程，包含海陆分割、海洋区域自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测以及可选的异常类型表征。发射前使用模拟Φsat-2影像进行训练与验证，评估算法性能及与资源受限星上硬件的兼容性；在任务环境中完成集成与功能验证后，利用真实Level-1影像和针对模糊海洋区域改进的标注策略进行重训。
AI.result: 发射前的仿真数据训练与验证表明流程具备星上可行性；但真实Φsat-2数据上的早期实验显示仿真数据与在轨数据存在显著不匹配。采用改进标注策略在真实Level-1影像上重训后，性能得到大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: Φsat-2经验表明：星上部署该应用可行；稳健的标注策略与传感器感知设计至关重要；基于仿真的开发有助于降低飞行前风险；而可靠的科学验证必须依赖具代表性的在轨数据，并应与功能验证明确区分。

title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

AI.tldr: 提出 Memento 3：冻结 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续构建显式世界模型，以自然语言规则手册＋可执行代码实现预测与规划，在 ARC-AGI-3 与 Atari Pong 上取得强结果。
AI.motivation: 在不熟悉环境中行动需推断世界运作方式并随新证据修正，但有限观测可支持多个均能解释历史交互、却对未见状态预测不同的世界模型，因此需要持续学习显式世界模型的机制。
AI.method: 智能体以自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录关于环境动态的可修订假设，对未知部分保持欠指定；再将规则手册编译为可执行代码用于预测与规划。通过“观测—反思—规则修订—编译—验证”的持续循环，利用预测误差精化规则与代码；仅当 LLM 判定代码忠实于规则手册且逐单元精确回放复现观测转移时，才接受更新代码。采用群体扩展并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据并以其预测引导探索。整个过程底层 LLM 保持冻结，被视为模型式递归自我改进（RSI）路径。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的所有关卡，平均相对人类动作效率（RHAE）达 100.0，仅使用人类动作数的 44%；在 Atari Pong 案例研究中，学习到的反馈控制器在三个不同开局回合中均以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 LLM 智能体可通过外部记忆与验证式世界模型更新，实现自主探索、世界模型修正与基于已验证更新的后续学习，构成一条模型式递归自我改进路径，并在复杂基准与具体控制任务上表现优异。

title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究了紧凑触觉运动表示能否在不同重力条件下分类物体旋转。将模拟GelSight Mini的稠密光流聚合为7x9网格的126维特征，用于分类地球、火星、月球和轨道重力下负载诱发旋转的方向。重力仅解释1.6%的特征方差，但仅在地球数据上训练的XGBoost从地球94.4%降至轨道75.9%；跨四种重力域训练的单一模型达96.3%总准确率（各域95.1%-97.0%），并可降至40维特征保持95.7%准确率，单次推理仅需0.14 ms。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的触觉传感器虽提供丰富接触信息，但高分辨率图像处理对空间机器人等资源受限平台代价高昂。研究旨在验证紧凑触觉运动表示能否在不同重力条件下实现物体旋转分类，并考察重力引起的域偏移对模型迁移性的影响。
AI.method: 从模拟的GelSight Mini中提取稠密光流，聚合到7x9网格形成126维特征，用于分类地球、火星、月球和轨道重力下负载诱发的旋转方向；对比仅地球数据训练的模型与跨四种重力域训练的单一模型（不使用重力作为输入），并进行特征降维与推理时延测试。
AI.result: 重力导致特征出现小幅但显著的偏移，解释1.6%方差（R2=0.016）。仅地球数据训练的XGBoost在地球上准确率94.4%，轨道降至75.9%；跨四域单一模型总准确率96.3%，各域95.1%-97.0%。特征可降至40维仍保持95.7%准确率，XGBoost单次推理仅0.14 ms。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭地球重力下的性能不足以确立触觉感知在空间机器人操作中的迁移性，需在训练与验证中考虑重力诱发的域偏移。

title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.

AI.tldr: 提出"数据空间迭代"(data-space iteration)少步生成框架，彻底移除流匹配中的时间步离散化，起始于噪声由共享生成器直接在数据空间精炼预测，并与DMD蒸馏结合。在ImageNet 256×256类条件生成上超越标准离散化基线，达到或超过经调度搜索优选的变体，且无需针对特定调度训练。
AI.motivation: 流匹配虽可扩展，但从学得的概率流采样需要大量网络评估。蒸馏可降至一步或少步，但一步生成常损失质量，因此少步生成为实用工作区间。现有多步方法沿概率流迭代，需固定且人工选择的时间步离散化；该离散化多靠启发式选取、调参昂贵，且当精炼难度随样本或空间位置不同而变化时显得局限。
AI.method: 提出数据空间迭代框架，从头去除流离散化：从噪声出发，共享生成器直接在数据空间精炼预测，每次迭代都训练为在其容量允许范围内产生最佳样本。该表述以最小改动集成分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)，从而在匹配训练设置下对迭代方法进行受控比较。
AI.result: 在类条件ImageNet 256×256上，数据空间迭代优于标准离散化基线，并达到或超过经调度搜索选出的变体，且无需调度特定训练。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，数据空间迭代为快速生成提供了一种简单有效的替代离散化流空间迭代的方案。

title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
summary: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

AI.tldr: SuperNav 通过为预训练 MLLM 配备专用智能体框架（而非导航微调），将请求理解与决策交给 MLLM、把运动执行委托给导航工具，在实例级、多目标和需求驱动任务上超越四个基线，并验证了跨环境适用性。
AI.motivation: 通用服务机器人需要同时具备任务通用性与场景通用性，能在陌生环境中响应多样化的人类请求。现有方法通过微调多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）直接预测导航动作，导致行为受限于导航训练数据的覆盖范围，难以泛化到新请求与新环境。
AI.method: 核心思路是让 MLLM 保持通用能力，专注请求解析、场景理解与决策，将运动执行委托给导航工具。作者提出 SuperNav：在不做导航专项微调的前提下，为预训练 MLLM 配备专用智能体框架（agent harness），包含 Navigation Skills（导航技能）、面向智能体的物理交互工具（Tools），以及任务进度与上下文管理；并通过统一的视觉点（visual-point）接口连接决策与运动，允许模型直接在图像中指定目标点，并依据执行反馈修正决策。
AI.result: 在实例级、多目标和需求驱动（demand-driven）任务上，SuperNav 优于四个对比基线；在 HM3D 上的类别级（category-level）评测以及在真实四足机器人上的部署，进一步验证了其跨环境适用性。
AI.conclusion: 无需对 MLLM 进行导航专项微调，通过“通用模型负责决策 + 工具负责执行”的智能体框架设计，即可在保持通用性的同时实现跨任务、跨环境的可持续导航。

title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
summary: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

AI.tldr: 提出JWS，一种单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行概率降水临近预报，结合掩码异步扩散与评分规则目标，实现少步生成，在SEVIR和MeteoNet上达到SOTA且训练与推理成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型用于概率降水临近预报时，常依赖单独训练的有损压缩或确定性预报组件，且因迭代去噪导致推理代价高昂。
AI.method: JWS在雷达空间直接建模，简化训练与推理并消除压缩不确定性；提出Masked Asynchronous Diffusion（掩码异步扩散），一种时间步采样方案，在保留干净上下文的同时使扩散训练适配高维时空数据；并采用简单评分规则目标（scoring-rule objective），使训练与概率预报对齐并支持少步生成。
AI.result: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上，JWS取得最先进的概率预报性能，同时降低训练与推理成本；最小模型参数更少，推理速度提升超过17倍，仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 单阶段、雷达空间的扩散建模结合掩码异步扩散与评分规则目标，可在降低计算成本的同时实现高质量少步概率降水临近预报。

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出 EgoVoice 框架，用于训练与评估主动式第一人称视角语音助手，解决"何时说话与说什么"的联合决策问题。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 AR 助手正向连续现实交互演进，需基于第一人称视频与音频感知用户活动并主动提供语音指导，而无需显式提问。已有研究分别在主动式视频助手、口语对话系统和第一人称任务理解上取得进展，但均未处理从连续第一人称流中联合决定干预时机与内容的问题。
AI.method: 基于 HoloAssist 真实人类指导者的视频录制，通过声源分离与语音重合成构建干净音频流；将每个视频会话转换为模型需在每一时刻决定保持沉默或提供语音指导的格式。在此基础上微调一个全模态 LLM，并使用直接偏好优化（DPO）进一步改进其主动干预行为。
AI.result: 在闭源与开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少能产生时机恰当、有意义的主动干预；EgoVoice 相比零样本骨干模型在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好上均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: EgoVoice 为主动式第一人称语音助手提供了可训练、可评估的框架，验证了数据构建、全模态微调与偏好优化相结合对提升主动干预质量的有效性。

title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
summary: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向真实教育场景的手写答题过程识别数据集HANS与噪声感知端到端框架NA-GOT。
AI.motivation: 智能批改与自动评分是智慧教育的关键基础设施，但现有文档解析与手写识别基准多针对结构良好的印刷文档或孤立数学表达式，缺乏能刻画学生答题卡复杂特性的数据集，如多行推导过程、文本与数学公式的异构混合，以及删除线等噪声伪影。
AI.method: 构建HANS数据集，涵盖数学表达式、自然语言文本、手绘表格及包括涂改与删除在内的多种噪声模式，并提供细粒度标注；在此基础上提出NA-GOT端到端框架，通过特征级轻量噪声抑制模块与解码阶段引入的噪声感知注意力机制实现两阶段噪声抑制。
AI.result: 实验表明HANS对现有方法构成显著挑战，而NA-GOT在答题过程识别的准确率与稳定性上均取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: HANS为鲁棒识别研究提供了可靠基础，NA-GOT验证了噪声抑制设计在真实教育场景手写答题识别中的有效性；数据集将在论文发表后公开。

title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.

AI.tldr: 提出 Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP) 范式：将机器人策略完全写成代码，从图像与本体感测中测量并追踪状态，决策不依赖 VLM/VLA 模型；在 RoboDojo 42 个双臂任务上达到 70.24% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 主流机器人策略将模型保留在控制回路中（VLA 直接映射观测到动作，Agent Harness 在运行时查询 VLM 做决策）。作者提出新视角：具身世界可视为"具身图灵机"，其纸带是机器人与环境状态、规则即策略；若状态能被准确表示，决策完全可以写成代码，从而摆脱模型在环。
AI.method: COAP 用代码从相机图像与本体感知中测量并追踪机器人、环境和任务状态，并据此做出全部决策。同一套代码跨回合复用，不同任务共享同一代码库，回路中不含 VLM 或 VLA。作者进一步提出以编码智能体在闭环中开发该库，实现递归自我改进（RSI）。
AI.result: 在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务上，所得代码库在测试时不使用任何模型即达到 70.24% 的成功率。COAP 的性能上界取决于状态表示的准确度与代码逻辑的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 作者将 COAP 定位为具身任务的新范式：其三大优势为显式状态（状态可存入代码）、执行性（决策可控、可灵活从失败恢复、在线快速低成本）、可扩展性（新任务复用/继承/扩展共享库，能力可跨任务累积）；因跨回合适用，还可作为 VLA 与 Agent Harness 的高效数据引擎。

title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.

AI.tldr: LeWAM：基于无解码器JEPA潜空间的双向Transformer世界动作模型，联合预测前向、后向、逆动力学与策略，实现表征对齐、闭环控制与规划性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统世界动作模型（WAMs）多依赖基于重建的表征，此类表征包含噪声与冗余信息，会干扰下游预测任务。
AI.method: 提出LeWAM，一个双向Transformer，能够在端到端训练的无解码器JEPA潜空间上同时进行前向动力学、后向动力学、逆动力学和策略预测四种模式。
AI.result: 1）对齐：线性探针从LeWAM潜空间读取机器人与物体状态的效果优于常规Le World Model（仅前向的JEPA世界模型），且对视觉干扰物的忽略能力与LeWM相当，远优于基于重建的WAM。2）行动：在同等规模下，LeWAM闭环评估结果与基于相同编码器训练的常规flow-matching策略相当，同时额外提供世界模型能力。3）规划：在WAM规划中直接采样原始动作会使MPC利用动力学模型的不准确性；改为在策略头的噪声空间中进行规划可提升这些WAM的闭环表现。
AI.conclusion: LeWAM表明，在无解码器JEPA潜空间上以双向Transformer统一多种预测模式，可同时获得更优的表征对齐、与专用策略相当的闭环控制性能，并通过在策略头噪声空间中规划改善WAM的规划表现。

title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
summary: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

AI.tldr: 提出 BrickBench 基准与 BrickAgent 环境，用于评测智能体根据文本提示设计可物理拼搭的乐高套装，从有效性、语义对齐与设计性三方面评分。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体研究缺乏对"文本条件化、可物理实现"的积木设计任务的系统评测，该任务要求智能体在离散零件库中选择零件并同时满足局部与全局约束。
AI.method: 构建 BrickBench 基准：输入提示词，智能体需产出满足语义与设计标准且可实际拼搭的装配方案；提供 BrickAgent 环境，供编码智能体构建、检查与验证设计；在三种规模与零件可用性不同的设定下，从有效性、对齐度、设计性三个维度评分。
AI.result: 领先的智能体基本能满 足可验证的物理与语义要求，但在设计性上仍不及人类设计。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在可验证约束满足方面表现良好，但在类人的设计质量上存在差距；基准与环境已公开。

title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.

AI.tldr: DreamTrue 是一个多视角、跨本体的机器人世界模型，通过图像空间动作渲染+离线几何校准、反事实后训练与具身视频奖励模型，实现动作忠实且物理合理的视频预测，在 AgiBot 上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 在现有机器人数据集上训练世界模型存在两大障碍：标定不精确会削弱动作跟随能力；数据集中失败交互覆盖不足会使预测偏向成功结果，从而难以建模真实多样的交互后果。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 将动作轨迹渲染为图像空间条件，并引入离线几何校准，使条件与目标视频对齐，从而提升跨本体的动作跟随；(2) 提出反事实后训练，通过修改已记录的动作轨迹，在更广泛的动作与接触配置下生成未来视频，扩大交互覆盖；(3) 构建涵盖机器人、物体与交互缺陷的人工标注视频数据集，训练具身视频奖励模型，在缺乏配对真值未来帧的情况下为预测提供反馈，并用其分数引导强化学习后训练，使交互结果更符合物理规律。
AI.result: 在 AgiBot 上，DreamTrue 达到了最先进的动作跟随性能，并将人工评估的交互缺陷率从 48.12% 降至 6.25%；该模型在 AgiBot World Challenge 2026 世界模型赛道中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: DreamTrue 表明，结合图像空间动作条件、几何校准、反事实后训练与基于奖励模型的强化学习后训练，可有效提升机器人世界模型的动作忠实性与物理合理性，并在标准基准与竞赛中取得领先表现。

title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
summary: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dex-One2Many 框架，从单段人类视频学习的可泛化灵巧操作策略，在仿真中训练后零样本迁移至真实多指手，在未见场景中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 从单段人类视频学习灵巧操作成本低于昂贵的机器人演示，但现有方法多为严格动作模仿，难以泛化到视频外的初始位姿、目标位姿与抓取方式；而纯强化学习虽具泛化能力，却因缺乏先验指导，在复杂多阶段任务中面临高维探索困难。本文旨在同时解决泛化性与探索效率这两大耦合难题。
AI.method: 提出 Dex-One2Many 的 real-to-sim-to-real 框架：将单段人类视频抽象为序列化场景图（sequential scene graphs）以指导强化学习。场景图作为生成式约束用于采样多样化重置状态，并为每个阶段提供稠密奖励；由于约束的是物体间关系而非精确位姿，重置状态可覆盖视频之外的物体位姿与抓取方式，从而在保证广泛泛化的同时保持探索高效。
AI.result: 在五个工具使用与操作任务中，Dex-One2Many 在已见配置下较基线提升 6.5%，在未见场景下泛化优势扩大至 71%；模型完全在仿真中训练，可零样本迁移至真实多指手。
AI.conclusion: 以场景图作为强化学习的生成式约束与稠密奖励来源，可有效调和泛化与探索的矛盾，实现从单段人类视频到真实机器人灵巧操作的零样本迁移。

title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
summary: Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms. Guided by a progression-aware state representation and a diversity-informed reward, the agent fluidly reallocates computational resources between the differencevector-based exploration of Differential Evolution (DE) and the covariance-guided exploitation of CMA-ES, while jointly regulating population size, elite preservation, and a restart mechanism to escape local optima. This allows DRL-DCO to autonomously transition between exploration-dominant, exploitation-dominant, and mixed-strategy regimes across generations. Beyond the training phase, the trained actor can operate in a supervision-free inference mode, where the internalized policy autonomously orchestrates DE and CMA-ES control from observed search states through forward inference alone, without critic evaluation or weight updates, enabling faster deployment while retaining full effectiveness. Validated on high-dimensional single-objective optimization benchmarks and the IASC-ASCE structural health monitoring benchmark, DRL-DCO achieves superior convergence accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art adaptive and hybrid evolutionary algorithms, as well as single-operator DRL-governed baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRL-DCO算法，用DDPG智能体统一调度DE与CMA-ES，实现探索与开发的动态资源分配，并在高维结构模型修正中验证了优越性能。
AI.motivation: 高维结构模型修正面临复杂非凸、参数相关的优化难题；现有混合进化算法多依赖静态架构或固定切换规则，导致搜索阶段割裂、衔接不连贯。
AI.method: 构建深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）的actor-critic智能体，将进化过程作为统一系统进行持续调控；采用进展感知状态表示与多样性奖励，动态在DE的差分探索与CMA-ES的协方差引导开发之间重新分配算力，同时联合调节种群规模、精英保留与重启机制；训练后的actor可进入无监督推理模式，仅凭前向推理编排算子。
AI.result: 在高维单目标优化基准与IASC-ASCE结构健康监测基准上，DRL-DCO的收敛精度与鲁棒性优于当前先进的自适应及混合进化算法，也优于单一算子的DRL调控基线。
AI.conclusion: 将进化算子调度建模为统一的强化学习控制问题，可自主实现探索主导、开发主导与混合策略的自适应切换，并经训练后以无监督推理快速部署且保持有效性。

title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
summary: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.

AI.tldr: 提出跨领域基准 AgenticBBO-Bench，统一预算协议下比较智能体式黑箱优化方法，并分析工具、任务信息与LLM角色三方面设计因素的影响。
AI.motivation: 黑箱优化中目标评估昂贵且受限，LLM智能体结合任务语义、计算与数学工具展现出潜力；但既有智能体BBO研究使用不同任务域和系统配置，结果难以比较，单项设计选择的作用也难以剥离。
AI.method: 构建 AgenticBBO-Bench 跨领域基准，覆盖合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计与分子设计五类任务，采用统一的有限预算评估协议；实验对比智能体式BBO与直接LLM方法及最佳数值优化器；消融/分析优化工具、任务信息与先验知识、LLM在搜索中的角色三个因素；另设五任务前沿挑战，在 Codex 智能体框架下评测七个LLM。
AI.result: 智能体BBO在全部五个领域的族平均得分高于直接LLM方法，并在四个领域超过最佳数值优化器；额外数值工具未带来一致提升；任务语义普遍有用，更具体的先验可靠性较低；数值优化器可有效吸收智能体搜索轨迹带来的收益；在前沿挑战中 GPT-6 Astra 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 处于性能-成本帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: AgenticBBO-Bench 为智能体式黑箱优化提供了可比较、可分解的统一评测平台；结果表明智能体方法整体优于直接LLM与多数数值优化器，但工具与先验的增益有条件，且LLM主要贡献在于建立高质量搜索轨迹。

title: LIFT: A Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer for Unified Retrieval and Ranking
summary: Cascaded recommender systems use the same user history for retrieval and ranking, while the two stages have access to different information at different points of an interaction. We propose the Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer (LIFT), which decomposes each interaction into ordered Request, Item, Context, and Action states and models them as a causal sequence. Retrieval reads the Request state, while ranking reads the Context state, allowing both tasks to share history modeling while preserving stage-specific information. LIFT instantiates this representation with Role-Conditioned Attention and a lightweight Pre-LN Bias. On ML-20M and Taobao, LIFT achieves the highest Joint Score among the evaluated joint models, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.9% and 3.6%, respectively. Loss-weight sweeps show favorable retrieval--ranking trade-offs, while ablations and scaling analyses further examine lifecycle sequence construction, model components, and capacity settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIFT模型，将每次交互分解为有序的Request、Item、Context、Action状态并建模为因果序列，使召回和排序共享历史建模但保留阶段特定信息，在ML-20M和Taobao上取得最优联合得分。
AI.motivation: 级联推荐系统中，召回和排序使用相同的用户历史，但两个阶段在交互的不同时点可获得的信息不同，因此需要一种既能共享历史建模又能保留各阶段专属信息的表示方式。
AI.method: 提出Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer（LIFT），将每次交互分解为有序的Request、Item、Context、Action状态并作为因果序列建模；召回读取Request状态，排序读取Context状态；采用Role-Conditioned Attention和轻量级Pre-LN Bias实例化该表示。
AI.result: 在ML-20M和Taobao数据集上，LIFT在所评估的联合模型中取得最高Joint Score，分别比最强基线提升4.9%和3.6%；损失权重扫描显示良好的召回—排序权衡；消融与扩展性分析进一步考察了生命周期序列构建、模型组件和容量设置。
AI.conclusion: LIFT通过生命周期感知的因果序列建模，实现召回与排序共享历史表示同时保留阶段特定信息，有效提升了联合建模性能，且在不同损失权重和容量设置下表现稳健。

title: Learning Multi-Step Query Rewriting via Corpus Feedback for Conversational Search
summary: Conversational Query Rewriting (CQR) turns a context dependent user turn into a standalone query for a retriever, and most methods do this in a single step from the dialogue history before retrieving once. The rewrite is therefore fixed before any corpus evidence is available to correct its reference resolution or its vocabulary. We recast CQR as a sequential retrieval problem: an agent rewrites the current turn, retrieves, and conditions its next rewrite on the returned passages. The agent acts in a typed space of three rewriting operations, resolving conversational intent into a standalone query, generating lexical reformulations, or synthesizing pseudo-documents for document-to-document matching, together with a stop action that ends the episode. We train the policy with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning against a single retrieval-quality reward, using no human rewrite annotations. Across TopiOCQA and QReCC, the agent outperforms several retrieval-aligned baselines, while remaining effective across retrieval backends and generalizing to the CAsT benchmarks without additional training. Further analysis shows that, through retrieval-reward optimization alone, the learned policy develops a behavior of grounding pseudo-documents in passages retrieved by earlier steps, substantially improving retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文将对话查询改写（CQR）重构为顺序检索问题，让智能体在多轮"改写—检索"循环中基于检索到的段落迭代修正查询，通过监督微调加强化学习训练策略，在TopiOCQA、QReCC及CAsT上取得优于检索对齐基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有CQR方法多为单步改写：在检索前基于对话历史一次性生成独立查询，改写结果被固定，无法借助语料证据纠正指代消解或词汇选择，因而限制了检索质量。
AI.method: 将CQR建模为顺序检索问题：智能体在包含三类改写操作（消解对话意图为独立查询、生成词汇重述、合成伪文档以进行文档—文档匹配）及停止动作的类型化空间中行动，先改写、再检索、再依据返回段落决定下一步改写。策略训练采用监督微调后接强化学习，奖励仅基于检索质量，不使用人工改写标注。
AI.result: 在TopiOCQA与QReCC上，智能体优于多个检索对齐基线；在不同检索后端下保持有效，并可零额外训练泛化到CAsT基准。分析显示，仅通过检索奖励优化，策略自发形成将伪文档锚定于前序步骤检索所得段落的行为，显著提升检索效果。
AI.conclusion: CQR可有效地重构为顺序检索决策问题，以检索质量作为唯一奖励即可学到有意义的改写行为，且无需人工改写标注即可跨数据集与检索后端泛化。

title: H2CE: Modeling Geo-Semantic Interactions for POI Reranking with Heterogeneous Two-Stage Cross-Encoders
summary: Point-of-Interest (POI) reranking in local search must model query-conditioned tradeoffs among lexical semantics, geospatial proximity, and numerical quality signals such as rating and review count, while remaining practical under real-time serving constraints. A close POI may only partially satisfy the query intent, while a farther one may offer stronger semantic and quality evidence. We present H2CE, a Heterogeneous Two-stage Cross-Encoder for latency-bounded POI reranking. H2CE represents numerical attributes in two complementary ways: bucketized natural-language descriptors are inserted into the cross-encoder input to support semantic--numeric attention, while exact scalar values are processed by dedicated MLPs to preserve magnitude information. The resulting semantic and numerical embeddings are fused through latent-space aggregation, enabling nonlinear interactions beyond scalar weighted sums. H2CE then applies a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 scores all candidates pointwise for scalable filtering, and Stage 2 performs head-to-head pairwise comparison among the top-$K$ candidates with Copeland aggregation, making fine-grained relative tradeoffs explicit while reducing pairwise cost from O(N^2) to O(N+K(K-1)). On a 5,743-query local search test set, H2CE achieves 67.48% NDCG@5, improving over XGBoost LTR by +22.82% absolute and over a zero-shot LLM reranker by +35.89%. The pairwise stage adds +1.98% NDCG@5 over the pointwise model alone. Ablations confirm the value of numerical features, latent aggregation, top-K pairwise reranking, and aligned training.

AI.tldr: 提出H2CE——一种面向延迟受限POI重排序的异构两阶段交叉编码器，通过语义-数值双通道表示与top-K成对比较，在5,743条查询测试集上取得67.48% NDCG@5。
AI.motivation: 本地搜索中的POI重排序需在实时服务约束下，建模查询条件下的词法语义、地理邻近性与数值质量信号（评分、评论数）之间的权衡。近距离POI可能仅部分满足查询意图，而较远POI可能具备更强的语义与质量证据，现有方法难以兼顾这种细粒度相对权衡与效率。
AI.method: H2CE采用异构双通道表示数值属性：将分桶后的自然语言描述符插入交叉编码器输入以支持语义—数值注意力，同时用专用MLP处理精确标量值以保留量级信息；两类嵌入经隐空间聚合融合，实现超越标量加权和的非线性交互。架构分两阶段：Stage 1对所有候选项逐点打分以支持可扩展过滤；Stage 2对top-K候选项进行两两比较并用Copeland聚合，将成对开销从O(N^2)降至O(N+K(K-1))。
AI.result: 在5,743条查询的本地搜索测试集上，H2CE取得67.48% NDCG@5，相较XGBoost LTR绝对提升+22.82%，相较零样本LLM重排序器提升+35.89%；成对阶段在纯逐点模型基础上再带来+1.98% NDCG@5。消融实验验证了数值特征、隐空间聚合、top-K成对重排序与对齐训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: H2CE在延迟受限条件下有效融合语义与数值信号并显式建模相对权衡，显著优于梯度提升LTR与零样本LLM重排序基线，各组件均获消融验证。

title: EVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embeddings for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Accurate and scalable visual document retrieval (VDR) requires both fine-grained page understanding and efficient indexing, yet existing approaches struggle to achieve both. OCR-based text retrieval adds preprocessing latency and can lose visual and structural cues needed to understand complex pages. Single-vector vision-language models bypass OCR, but compressing an entire page into one vector limits the granularity of query--document matching. Multi-vector retrievers with MaxSim provide finer interactions, yet demand large indexes and still leave room for accuracy improvements. We argue that overcoming these limitations requires preserving query-relevant page evidence throughout representation learning and index construction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{\textit{EVIE}} (Evidence-Vector-Informed Embeddings), a family of native visual document retrievers integrating three key innovations: (1) Evidence-judged data governance, which uses a multimodal judge to identify answer-bearing positives and filter unreliable negatives. (2) Bidirectional teacher--student learning with symmetric listwise distillation and prefix-based Matryoshka representation learning (Prefix-MRL), enabling one student checkpoint to serve six nested embedding dimensions without re-encoding. (3) Hierarchical agglomerative index compression (HAC), which clusters page tokens with spatial regularization and stores semantic centroids for single-stage MaxSim retrieval. Extensive experiments across 138 tasks from ViDoRe V1, V2, V3, and JinaVDR validate EVIE. EVIE-8B achieves 66.75 nDCG@10 on V3, exceeding the best external baseline by 1.43 points, with a four-suite average of 79.51. EVIE-4.5B with HAC retains 59.58 nDCG@10 at only 3.81 GiB per million pages, reducing vector payload by $128\times$. Together, these results improve the accuracy--storage trade-off for visual document retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EVIE，一种原生视觉文档检索器，通过证据判别数据治理、双向师生学习与 Prefix-MRL、以及分层聚类索引压缩三项创新，在提升精度的同时大幅降低存储，改善视觉文档检索的精度-存储权衡。
AI.motivation: 视觉文档检索需兼顾细粒度页面理解与高效索引，但现有方法难以两全：基于 OCR 的文本检索有预处理延迟且丢失视觉与结构线索；单向量视觉语言模型虽免 OCR，却把整页压成一个向量，匹配粒度过粗；MaxSim 多向量检索器交互更细，但索引庞大、精度仍有提升空间。作者认为突破这些限制需在表示学习与索引构建全程保留与查询相关的页面证据。
AI.method: EVIE 集成三项创新：（1）证据判别式数据治理：用多模态评判器识别含答案的正样本、过滤不可靠负样本；（2）双向师生学习：结合对称 listwise 蒸馏与基于前缀的 Matryoshka 表示学习（Prefix-MRL），使单个学生检查点可服务六种嵌套嵌入维度而无需重编码；（3）分层凝聚索引压缩（HAC）：对页面 token 做带空间正则的聚类，存储语义质心以支持单阶段 MaxSim 检索。
AI.result: 在 ViDoRe V1、V2、V3 与 JinaVDR 共 138 项任务上验证：EVIE-8B 在 V3 上达 66.75 nDCG@10，超最佳外部基线 1.43 分，四套件平均 79.51；EVIE-4.5B 配合 HAC 在每百万页仅 3.81 GiB 下保持 59.58 nDCG@10，向量负载降低 128 倍。
AI.conclusion: EVIE 通过在全流程保留查询相关页面证据，同时提升检索精度并降低索引存储，改善了视觉文档检索的精度-存储权衡。

title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) Task
summary: In this paper, we provide an overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) task. Building on the success of the NTCIR-18 core task AEOLLM, we proposed AEOLLM-2 for NTCIR-19 to further investigate automatic evaluation methods for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in long-form text generation scenarios. In AEOLLM-2, we introduced a new subtask, Deep Research Evaluation, which focuses on the automatic evaluation of long-form deep research reports generated by LLMs. Participants developed evaluation methods to automatically assess the quality of these reports, and the performance of each method was measured by comparing its scores against human-annotated ground-truth labels. This year, we received 91 runs from 10 teams in total. This paper describes the background of the task, the dataset construction, the evaluation measures, the participants' methods, and the final evaluation results.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了NTCIR-19的AEOLLM-2任务，重点在于长文本生成（尤其是深度研究报告）的LLM自动评估方法研究，共收到10支团队的91次提交，并报告了数据集构建、评测指标、参赛方法与最终结果。
AI.motivation: 在NTCIR-18核心任务AEOLLM成功的基础上，进一步探索大语言模型（LLM）的自动评估方法，特别是面向长文本生成场景的自动评估需求，因为长文本（如深度研究报告）的质量评估难度更高、现有方法不足。
AI.method: AEOLLM-2新增"深度研究评估"（Deep Research Evaluation）子任务，聚焦于对LLM生成的长文本深度研究报告进行自动评估；参赛者需开发自动评估方法，通过将其打分与人工标注的真值标签（ground-truth labels）进行比较来衡量各方法性能。本概述论文介绍了任务背景、数据集构建、评测方法、参赛者方法及最终评测结果。
AI.result: 本年度共收到来自10支团队的91次运行（runs）提交。
AI.conclusion: AEOLLM-2作为NTCIR-19任务，延续并拓展了LLM自动评估研究，新增长文本深度研究报告的自动评估子任务，为长文本生成质量评估提供了基准与比较平台。

title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
summary: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast, a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54-72 more clean hits (requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling) than TF-IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1-58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10-18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B. Candidate-relative differences thus complement query relevance in selecting compact reranking inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的技能选择器 SkillContrast，通过对比检索到的相似技能并保留差异文本及局部上下文，为预训练重排器提供紧凑输入，在 SameCapRisk-Bench 上优于 TF-IDF 查询选择。
AI.motivation: 相似智能体技能常共享指令，仅在适用条件上存在差异；基于查询的文本选择可能保留共享指令却忽略这些关键区别，导致检索到有用技能时同时带入其标记为高风险的“兄弟技能”。
AI.method: SkillContrast 为免训练（training-free）选择器：先检索技能，再对检索到的技能进行两两对比，抽取其中差异化的文本并附上局部上下文，将结果交由预训练重排器（reranker）打分。评估在 SameCapRisk-Bench 的 1,235 条请求上进行，覆盖 2 种检索器与 2 种重排器规模，并采用等输入长度（length-matched）组件替换消融。
AI.result: 在相同单候选输入长度下，SkillContrast 比 TF-IDF 查询选择多出 54–72 个 clean hits（即检索到有用技能而未检索到其标记高风险兄弟技能的请求）。等长度组件替换表明，差异文本是主要贡献来源，上下文效应较小且混合。相较完整技能体，Token 用量减少 51.1–58.8%；在 0.6B 模型上 clean hits 少 10–18 个，在 4B 模型上持平或更高。
AI.conclusion: 候选相对差异（candidate-relative differences）可与查询相关性互补，用于构建紧凑的重排输入；SkillContrast 在显著降低输入 Token 成本的同时保持甚至提升重排效果，尤其在大规模重排器上表现更佳。

title: Chaos in the Text: Revealing the Modality Preference in Mixed-Modality Retrievers
summary: Dense retrievers have made significant progress on text and image corpora, but whether these capabilities extend reliably to mixed corpora containing text, image, and fused text-image documents remains unclear. In this paper, we systematically examine retrievers across architectures and find that their performance is highly sensitive to modality composition. As image documents are progressively replaced with semantically corresponding text representations, retrieval performance follows a pronounced V-shaped curve, remaining strong on single-modality corpora but degrading substantially when modalities coexist. In particular, irrelevant text causes more severe degradation than an equal number of irrelevant images, a phenomenon we term Chaos in the Text. Further analysis reveals modality preference, whereby text representations receive systematically higher similarity scores, allowing irrelevant text to outrank relevant images. To mitigate this bias, we introduce Trident, which constructs text, image, and fused text-image views of each document as co-equal positives and jointly optimizes relevance discrimination and positive-view balance through Multi-Positive View InfoNCE. Experiments across visual document and natural image benchmarks show that trident improves mixed-modality retrieval on both CLIP-based and VLM-based architectures, reduces sensitivity to modality composition and text distractors, and increases average single-modality retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了稠密检索器在文本、图像及图文融合混合语料上的表现，发现性能对模态构成高度敏感，呈明显V型曲线，并提出Trident方法通过多正视图InfoNCE缓解模态偏好偏差，提升混合模态检索效果。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索器在纯文本和纯图像语料上已取得显著进展，但其能力能否可靠迁移到包含文本、图像以及图文融合文档的混合语料尚不明确。作者希望系统考察不同架构检索器在混合模态语料上的表现，并揭示其失效机制。
AI.method: 作者跨多种架构系统评估检索器在不同模态构成下的性能。为缓解发现的模态偏好偏差，提出Trident：为每个文档构建文本、图像、图文融合三种"共等正样本"视图，并通过Multi-Positive View InfoNCE联合优化相关性判别与正视图平衡。
AI.result: 实验发现：随着图像文档被语义对应的文本表示逐步替换，检索性能呈明显的V型曲线，单模态语料上表现良好，而模态共存时性能大幅下降；无关文本比等量无关图像造成更严重的退化（称为"Chaos in the Text"）；文本表示获得系统性更高的相似度分数，使无关文本能压过相关图像。在视觉文档和自然图像基准上，Trident在CLIP和VLM两类架构上均提升混合模态检索性能，降低对模态构成和文本干扰项的敏感性，并提高单模态检索的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 稠密检索器的性能强烈依赖模态构成，存在显著的模态偏好偏差，尤其在文本干扰下退化严重。Trident通过构建共等正视图并采用Multi-Positive View InfoNCE优化，能有效缓解该偏差，在多种架构和基准上实现更稳健的混合模态与单模态检索。

title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
summary: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍"Project Greenhouse"项目，验证仅用少量GPU即可端到端训练完全开放、自主的智能体检索模型。首个里程碑是构建点式解码器重排序器，采用"从零预训练+监督微调"两步法，不依赖第三方开源权重骨干，并开放模型检查点等全部训练工件。
AI.motivation: 主流做法依赖第三方开源权重骨干模型，导致训练过程不完全可控。作者提出更根本的假设：用有限算力即可构建完全开放、主权自主的智能体检索模型，从而实现对训练全流程的端到端掌控。
AI.method: 采用简洁的两步配方：从常用公开数据集出发，先从头预训练，再进行监督微调，构建点式解码器重排序器。不依赖任何第三方开源权重骨干，全部训练仅使用少量GPU完成，并公开数据、代码、配置及Gaggle系列模型检查点。
AI.result: 成功训练出具有竞争力的点式解码器重排序器，大部分实验仅用少量GPU完成，证明在有限算力下从零构建开放重排序模型是可行的，并发布了支持透明、独立复现的全部工件与模型检查点。
AI.conclusion: Project Greenhouse首次验证了以有限算力构建完全开放、自主可控的智能体检索模型的可行性，为更广泛假设的验证迈出第一步，其全部工件与检查点的公开也促进了可复现研究。

title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with reproduction information and an evidence inventory
summary: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NativeScope，一种"先定范围、再排序"（scope-then-rank）的检索方法，利用数据系统已存储的结构信息（章节归属、会话边界、原生顺序），在已知锚点与关系时把问题表示为 q -> (A, r, B)，先通过 belonging/before/after 算子选取原生单元，再用目标词 B 对范围内文本块排序。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索（dense retrieval）通常仅按文本块与问题的语义相似度排序，忽略了数据系统中已存在的结构信息，如章节成员关系、会话边界与原生顺序。作者希望利用这些现成结构，将检索从"全实例相似度排序"转为"结构化范围约束下的排序"。
AI.method: 提出 NativeScope：将查询表示为 q -> (A, r, B)，锚点 A 与关系 r 通过 belonging、before、after 三种算子选出原生单元，目标词 B 仅对与所选范围重叠的文本块排序；并提出内部变体 NS-FullQ，用完整问题对同一批候选排序。实验在来源于 QASPER 与 LongMemEval 的 200 条受控文档与记忆记录上进行，检索预算为 1,024 token。还测试了自动 Top-1 锚点设置。
AI.result: NativeScope 在文档上的原生单元召回率为 89.28%，记忆为 72.50%，相较实例级 Dense RAG 分别提升 42.75 和 22.00 个百分点。NS-FullQ 分别为 87.78% 和 68.50%，与 NativeScope 的差异不具决定性，说明主要增益来自关系化范围定位（relational scoping），而非更短的排序查询。在自动 Top-1 锚点下，记忆召回率降至 35.50%。
AI.conclusion: 当锚点坐标与原生关系可靠时，NativeScope 效果显著；但硬范围（hard scoping）会继承来自定位接口的误差，自动锚点识别会大幅降低召回率。主要收益来源于关系化范围定位而非查询表述长度。

title: Compact and Efficient Indexes for Learned Sparse Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering 2027 (IEEE ICDE 2027)
summary: This paper investigates how to substantially reduce the memory footprint of learned sparse retrieval indexes without sacrificing the efficiency of state-of-the-art retrieval data structures. Building on SEISMIC, we revisit both levels of its design: the inverted index used to select candidates and the forward index used to score them. For the inverted index, we replace costly per-block summaries with medoids, namely existing documents elected as block representatives, collapsing the per-block metadata from a sparse vector to a single document identifier. For the forward index, we compress both components and values. We reorder the vocabulary to place co-occurring components closer together and encode the resulting $Δ$-gaps with DOTPACKING8, a SIMD-friendly bit-packing scheme that fuses decompression with dot-product evaluation; values are quantized with compact per-component 4-bit codebooks fitted to each component's distribution. We further introduce JUMPDOT, a blocked dot-product kernel tailored for queries that contain only a few non-zero entries. Our forward-index compression is independent of SEISMIC and can be plugged into any system relying on forward-index-based scoring, as we demonstrate by integrating it into KANNOLO. A comprehensive evaluation on MS MARCO with three state-of-the-art learned sparse encoders shows that our solutions markedly improve the speed-space trade-off of learned sparse retrieval: at equal accuracy, our indexes answer queries up to 5.3x faster than the best competitor while using about 3x less memory, and in the most memory-constrained regime, they remain up to 1.9x faster while using up to 3.9x less memory.

AI.tldr: 本文在SEISMIC基础上重新设计了学习型稀疏检索的两级索引结构：倒排索引用medoids替代逐块摘要，前向索引则压缩分量与数值，并引入JUMPDOT核。在MS MARCO上，等精度下查询最快提升5.3倍、显存占用降低约3倍。
AI.motivation: 学习型稀疏检索索引的显存占用较大，如何在保持先进检索数据结构效率的前提下显著降低内存足迹，是本文的核心问题。
AI.method: 沿用SEISMIC双级设计进行改造。倒排索引层面，用medoids（将已有文档选为块代表）替代昂贵的逐块摘要，把每块元数据由稀疏向量压缩为单一文档ID。前向索引层面同时压缩分量与数值：对词表重排序使共现分量相邻，用DOTPACKING8对Δ间隔进行SIMD友好的位打包编码，将解压与点积求值融合；数值则用紧凑的逐分量4比特码本量化。此外提出面向少量非零项查询的分块点积核JUMPDOT。该前向索引压缩与SEISMIC解耦，可插入任意基于前向索引打分的系统，并已在KANNOLO上验证。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO上使用三种先进学习型稀疏编码器评测，本方案显著改善速度-空间权衡：等精度下查询速度最高比最优竞争者快5.3倍，内存用量约少3倍；在内存最受限的场景下仍快至1.9倍，内存最多少3.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过重构倒排与前向索引的存储与计算方式，可在不牺牲检索精度的前提下大幅压缩学习型稀疏检索索引的内存，并同时提升查询效率。

title: Language Models for Page-Level Layout Decisions in E-commerce Search
comment: Accepted at the OARS Workshop, ACM RecSys 2026
summary: E-commerce search pages are critical touchpoints for millions of online shoppers. While traditional search engines return a ranked list of results, modern E-commerce search pages increasingly incorporate recommender system modules -- for example, secondary stacks that surface alternative product groupings at specific positions. When introduced appropriately, secondary stacks can improve user engagement; however, suboptimal placement may disrupt browsing flow and degrade the primary results. Unlike traditional search ranking, where evaluation techniques such as interleaving are well established, evaluating page-level layout changes e.g., when and where to insert a secondary stack remains challenging without costly online A/B testing. To address this, we study offline methods for evaluating whether a given layout decision -- specifically, the inclusion of a secondary stack at a particular position -- is beneficial to users. We investigate language models as scalable evaluators by comparing direct prompt-based, prompt-derived feature, and representation-based methods. Our results show that representation-based approaches consistently outperform prompt-based judging in predicting user engagement, suggesting they provide a reliable foundation for offline layout evaluation in E-commerce search.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电商搜索页面中"二级堆叠"模块插入位置决策的离线评估方法，比较直接提示、提示衍生特征与表示三类语言模型评估器，发现基于表示的方法在预测用户互动上稳定优于提示式判断。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索页日益引入推荐模块（如特定位置展示备选商品分组的二级堆叠）。合适插入可提升互动，但位置不当会打断浏览流并损害主结果。不同于传统搜索排序已有交错实验等成熟评估手段，页面级布局变更（何时、何处插入二级堆叠）缺乏低成本评估方案，往往只能依赖昂贵的在线A/B测试，因此需要可扩展的离线评估方法。
AI.method: 将语言模型作为可扩展的离线评估器，针对"是否在特定位置加入二级堆叠"这一布局决策，比较三类方法：(1) 直接基于提示的判断；(2) 由提示衍生的特征；(3) 基于表示的方法。以用户互动作为预测目标进行评估。
AI.result: 基于表示的方法在预测用户互动方面持续优于基于提示的判断，表明其为电商搜索离线布局评估提供了可靠基础。
AI.conclusion: 表示型语言模型评估器是电商搜索页面级布局决策离线评估的可靠方案，可在不进行昂贵在线A/B测试的前提下辅助判断二级堆叠的插入位置是否对用户有益。

title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
summary: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores.
