In this paper, we propose \textsc{Sera}, a \underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation framework that complements temporal modelling with degradation semantics. Guided by battery domain expertise, \textsc{Sera} extracts degradation semantics from time series and constructs two complementary representations using rule-based knowledge and LLM-based interpretation. The representations are independently encoded and integrated with the representation learned by temporal models through gated aggregations. Experiments on the mainstream benchmark across multiple prediction horizons and different temporal models show that \textsc{Sera} consistently improves forecasting performance, achieving up to a 37.3\% reduction in prediction error over the temporal baseline and enhanced generalizability. Counterfactual analysis examines how forecasts respond to changes in degradation semantics to assess interpretability. The results show that prediction responses are consistent with the meanings of key degradation descriptors across tested horizons. Together, these findings demonstrate that structured degradation semantics and effective aggregation can improve forecasting accuracy and support reliable and interpretable battery health forecasting for advanced battery management.

AI.tldr: 提出Sera框架，将退化语义与时间序列模型结合用于电池SOH预测，最高降低37.3%预测误差并提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 电池SoH预测对电池管理至关重要，但受非线性退化与电池间异质性影响而困难。现有数据驱动方法主要依赖时序模型从数值时间序列学习，未显式表征高层退化特征，而这些特征可为预测提供退化指导并提升可解释性。
AI.method: 提出Sera（语义表征聚合）框架，以退化语义补充时序建模。在电池领域知识指导下，从时间序列中抽取退化语义，基于规则知识与LLM解释构建两种互补表征；两种表征独立编码，并通过门控聚合与时序模型学习的表征融合。
AI.result: 在主流基准上跨多个预测时域与不同时序模型实验显示，Sera持续提升预测性能，相较时序基线最高降低37.3%预测误差，并增强泛化性。反事实分析表明预测响应与关键退化描述符语义在被测时域上保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的退化语义与有效聚合可提升预测精度，并支持可靠、可解释的电池健康预测，服务于先进电池管理。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Optimization for Physics-Aware Highway Trajectory Prediction
summary: Accurate trajectory forecasting and well-defined predictive uncertainty are crucial for reliable, safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Most trajectory prediction approaches provide point estimates only, while uncertainty-aware approaches typically quantify uncertainty only in the trajectory space. In physics-aware approaches, uncertainty in the predicted motion variables should be explicitly modeled and propagated through the vehicle dynamics. Otherwise, the resulting trajectory-space uncertainty may not fully reflect the variability introduced by the underlying motion prediction. Therefore, in this work, uncertainty-aware extensions of X-TRACK (X-TRACK-DE and X-TRACK-MCD), a physics-aware trajectory prediction framework, are proposed. The proposed framework predicts future vehicle motion variables and models both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties by propagating motion space uncertainty to trajectory space. Additionally, conformal prediction is applied to the trajectory space predictive covariance to construct uncertainty regions targeting a desired marginal coverage level. Evaluation on the highD dataset shows that X-TRACK-DE improves trajectory prediction accuracy over the deterministic baseline, while both uncertainty-aware variants provide predictive uncertainty that can be conformally calibrated to the desired marginal coverage level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出X-TRACK的两种不确定性感知扩展（X-TRACK-DE与X-TRACK-MCD），在物理感知轨迹预测框架中显式建模运动变量的偶然与认知不确定性并传播至轨迹空间，再以共形预测校准预测协方差以构造满足目标边际覆盖率的置信区域。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶等安全关键应用需要准确的轨迹预测与明确的不确定性度量。现有轨迹预测方法多只给点估计，不确定性感知方法通常仅在轨迹空间量化不确定性；而物理感知方法若不在预测的运动变量上显式建模并传播不确定性，得到的轨迹空间不确定性将无法充分反映底层运动预测带来的变异性。
AI.method: 基于物理感知轨迹预测框架X-TRACK，提出X-TRACK-DE与X-TRACK-MCD两种不确定性感知扩展：预测未来车辆运动变量，同时建模偶然不确定性与认知不确定性（分别对应深度集成与蒙特卡洛Dropout），并将运动空间不确定性传播至轨迹空间；进一步对轨迹空间的预测协方差应用共形预测，构造以目标边际覆盖率为导向的不确定性区域。
AI.result: 在highD数据集上的评估表明：X-TRACK-DE相较确定性基线提升了轨迹预测精度；两种不确定性感知变体所提供的预测不确定性均可通过共形校准达到期望的边际覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 在物理感知轨迹预测中将不确定性建模于运动空间并传播至轨迹空间，可给出更贴合运动预测变异性的不确定性表达，且结合共形预测可实现具有覆盖保证的不确定性区域，兼顾精度与可靠性。

title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
summary: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.

AI.tldr: NanoProof是首个完全开源的Lean 4因子化执行引导定理证明器，训练数据、抽取工具、训练流程与权重全部公开，可端到端复现。在MiniF2F-Test上pass@16达50.8%，超越同类系统HyperTree Proof Search与ABEL，且计算量分别减少约90倍与7倍，比AlphaProof少四个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 现有强开源定理证明器多由大型预训练语言模型微调而来，未公开训练数据与流程，难以复现和可持续研究。作者希望证明因子化执行引导类证明器可用有限资源从零重建，并推动计算高效、可访问的训练与评测。
AI.method: 构建并发布结构化证明树数据集，以及用于在Lean 4形式化验证器内进行程序化交互与数据抽取的工具；采用因子化执行引导（factorized execution-guided）训练流程，并以计算效率为核心目标。
AI.result: 在MiniF2F-Test上取得50.8% pass@16，超过同类的HyperTree Proof Search与ABEL；相比二者计算量分别约为1/90和1/7，比AlphaProof少四个数量级以上的计算。
AI.conclusion: NanoProof表明因子化执行引导类证明器能够以适中资源从零构建，同时具备完整开源与可复现性；虽存在更强的开源权重证明器，但其依赖大模型微调且不公开数据与流程。

title: Constructing Structured Decision Sources for Consensus-Based Pseudo-Label Learning
summary: Consensus can make pseudo-label learning more reliable, but only when its predictors contribute genuinely different evidence. Multiple models that repeat the same boundary provide additional votes without additional information. We address this problem by con structing decision sources through controlled changes to within-class structure. Starting from a shared graph representation, we vary center granularity and neighborhood mixing, reproduce each resulting source to test its stability, and select a complementary subset using node pair coassignment. Unanimous predictions from the selected sources are then ranked for student training. On the public fixed splits of Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed, evaluated with five random seeds, the constructed sources improve fixed-budget training pseudo-label precision by 1.19 to 4.39 percentage points over three conventionally initialized GCN sources. Under matched structural filters, three-source consensus is more precise than each constituent source in all 45 dataset slot eed comparisons. The gains are strongest in pseudo-label quality: downstream accuracy remains competitive but does not lead on every dataset. These results identify source construction rather than model count alone as an important design problem for consensus-based pseudo-label learning.

AI.tldr: 该文通过受控改变类内结构来构造互补的决策源，并用节点对共指派选取互补子集，再以一致预测排序生成伪标签；在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 上，固定预算伪标签精度提升 1.19–4.39 个百分点，但下游准确率仅持平而非全面领先。
AI.motivation: 共识（consensus）能提升伪标签学习的可靠性，但前提是各预测器提供真正不同的证据。多个模型若重复同一边界，只会增加投票数而不增加信息量。因此，问题不在模型数量，而在于决策源的构造。
AI.method: 1) 从共享图表示出发，通过受控改变类内结构构造决策源：变化中心粒度（center granularity）与邻域混合（neighborhood mixing）；2) 对每个得到的源进行复制以检验其稳定性；3) 使用节点对共指派（node pair co-assignment）选取互补子集；4) 将所选源的“一致预测”（unanimous predictions）进行排序，用于学生模型训练。
AI.result: 在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 的公开固定划分上、五个随机种子下评估：构造的源相比三个常规初始化的 GCN 源，将固定预算训练的伪标签精度提升 1.19–4.39 个百分点。在匹配结构过滤器下，三源共识在所有 45 个“数据集×槽位×种子”比较中都比各组成源更精确。增益主要体现在伪标签质量上；下游准确率保持竞争力，但并非在每个数据集上都领先。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对基于共识的伪标签学习而言，“源构造”而非单纯的模型数量，是一个重要的设计问题。

title: Beyond Action Entropy: Quotient-Space Exploration for Genome-Scale Metabolic Model Repair
summary: Repairing scientific models from functional observations differs fundamentally from supervised prediction: feedback may certify a solution without revealing which structural correction is responsible. We study this setting for genome-scale metabolic model (GEM) repair, where multiple reaction edits can explain the same phenotypes and many apparently distinct edits correspond to the same biological mechanism. This many-to-one structure creates a hidden failure mode for conventional exploration: diversity in the output space need not translate into diversity of scientific hypotheses. We introduce QuotientPO, which collapses equivalent repairs into canonical mechanisms and optimizes exploration directly over the resulting quotient space. To make quotient exploration informative under finite rollouts, we derive a kernelized Rényi estimator that resolves graded crowding among distinct repair cores beyond coarse exact-match counts. On 2,212 held-out GEMs, QuotientPO improves Success@32 from 17.93% to 20.10% (+12.1% relative) while consistently increasing distinct successful-core discovery under the same sampling budget. These results establish quotient-space exploration as a principled approach to mechanism-level discovery under verifier-induced equivalence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出QuotientPO，将基因组尺度代谢模型（GEM）修复中彼此等价的反应编辑折叠为规范机制，并在商空间上直接优化探索，配合核化Rényi估计器解决有限采样下的机制拥挤问题，在2,212个GEM上提升Success@32并增加成功机制核的发现多样性。
AI.motivation: 修复科学模型与监督预测存在本质差异：反馈只能证明某个解可行，却不指明是哪一项结构修正起了作用。在GEM修复中，多种反应编辑可解释同一表型，且许多看似不同的编辑实为同一生物机制。这种多对一结构导致一个隐蔽的失败模式：输出空间上的多样性未必等同于科学假设层面的多样性。
AI.method: 提出QuotientPO：将等价修复折叠为规范机制，并在所得商空间上直接优化探索。为使商空间探索在有限rollout下具有信息量，推导了一个核化Rényi估计器，用于区分不同修复核心之间分级式的拥挤程度，而非仅依赖粗略的精确匹配计数。
AI.result: 在2,212个留出GEM上，QuotientPO将Success@32从17.93%提升至20.10%（相对提升12.1%），并在相同采样预算下持续增加成功核心的发现数量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在验证器诱导的等价关系下，商空间探索是进行机制层面发现的一种有原则的方法。

title: Evi-VN: Hard Region Guided Virtual Node Evidence Injection for GNN-Based Fraud Detection
summary: Online platforms contain growing numbers of bots, deceptive reviewers, and scam accounts that imitate legitimate users. Such camouflage blurs graph neighborhoods and behavioral attributes, making it difficult for graph neural networks (GNNs) to distinguish both well-disguised fraudsters and legitimate users. Across diverse GNNs, we observe overlapping errors on a shared hard region, suggesting the presence of latent fraud evidence that graph topologies and standard features fail to capture. Fraud-specific GNNs can mitigate particular graph pathologies, yet they still make limited use of heterogeneous evidence such as structured records, text, images, and audio; uniform multimodal fusion may also disturb nodes already handled reliably by the graph. We propose Evi-VN to learn and correct these shared blind spots rather than build another fraud detector. To our knowledge, Evi-VN is the first graph fraud detection framework to use feature isolated evidence chains to correct hard regions shared across GNNs. Its evidence chains connect behavior, content, and context across structured, textual, visual, and acoustic sources, helping expose camouflage that graph neighborhoods may miss. Crucially, Evi-VN selectively applies this evidence only to likely hard samples via virtual class nodes, preserving both the reliable predictions and the input design of existing GNNs. Shared hard regions also let Evi-VN enhance generic, fraud-specific, and unseen GNNs even with imperfect evidence models. Experiments across bot, fake-review, refund-evidence, and telecom-fraud tasks validate these advantages.

AI.tldr: 提出Evi-VN框架，利用特征隔离的证据链纠正在多种GNN间共享的难样本区域，并通过虚拟类节点选择性地注入多模态证据，从而增强通用、欺诈专用及未见过的GNN。
AI.motivation: 在线平台中机器人、虚假评论者和诈骗账号不断模仿正常用户，其伪装模糊了图邻域和行为属性，使GNN难以区分精心伪装的欺诈者与正常用户。作者观察到不同GNN在共享的"难区域"上出现重叠错误，说明存在图拓扑和标准特征未能捕获的潜在欺诈证据。现有欺诈专用GNN虽能缓解特定图病理，但对结构化记录、文本、图像、音频等异构证据利用有限，且统一的多模态融合可能干扰已被图可靠处理的节点。
AI.method: Evi-VN不构建新的欺诈检测器，而是学习并纠正跨GNN共享的盲区。它是首个使用"特征隔离证据链"（feature isolated evidence chains）来纠正GNN共享难区域的图欺诈检测框架。证据链跨结构化、文本、视觉和声学来源连接行为、内容与上下文；通过虚拟类节点（virtual class nodes）仅在可能的难样本上选择性应用证据，从而保留现有GNN的可靠预测与输入设计。
AI.result: 在机器人、虚假评论、退款证据和电信欺诈四类任务上验证了Evi-VN的优势：即使证据模型不完美，也可增强通用、欺诈专用及未见过的GNN。
AI.conclusion: 跨GNN共享的难区域为Evi-VN提供了可迁移的纠正信号，使其能选择性融合多模态证据而不破坏原有可靠预测；该框架在多种欺诈任务与不同GNN上均展现有效性。

title: Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising
summary: Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before the first memorized sample appears, with an onset that follows the same $O(n)$ scaling as the memorization time. We probe these basins with cyclic denoising, which repeatedly applies partial noising and denoising. Under the exact empirical score, we prove that cycling started near an isolated training sample recovers it and returns to it over any finite number of cycles with high probability. In trained models, cycling recovers training images from CelebA and CIFAR-10 checkpoints whose one-shot samples contain no copies, and at a CelebA checkpoint with 0.1% one-shot copies, 500 cycles raise the memorized fraction above 30%. Cycling also reveals degenerate attractors that match no single training image and fade as training proceeds, so residence in a basin does not by itself imply memorization. These findings hold on a Gaussian mixture, CelebA, and CIFAR-10 across optimizers, architectures, noise schedules, and training-set sizes, and extend to off-the-shelf Stable Diffusion v1.4, where the cycled conditional-unconditional divergence gap separates memorized from non-memorized prompts with an AUC of 0.944 and a TPR of 0.866 at 1% FPR. More broadly, what a diffusion model has memorized is a property of the geometry and stability of its learned distribution, and assessing it requires examining this structure rather than generated outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型的记忆行为在学习能量景观的几何结构中先于生成样本出现，作者将其定义为"潜在记忆"，并用循环去噪探针在训练样本周围探测出该结构。
AI.motivation: 标准记忆检测依赖一次性生成是否产生近似复制样本，只有模型输出已经失败时才暴露记忆问题，导致已发布模型在出现复制样本前缺乏有效审计手段。
AI.method: 使用评分散度与吸引域体积刻画能量景观几何；提出循环去噪探针，即反复施加部分加噪与去噪；在精确经验评分下证明循环过程会以高概率返回孤立的训练样本；在Gaussian mixture、CelebA、CIFAR-10及Stable Diffusion v1.4上进行验证，覆盖不同优化器、架构、噪声调度和训练集规模。
AI.result: 在首个记忆样本出现之前，训练样本周围已形成局部吸引域，其起始时间与记忆时间具有相同的O(n)缩放；循环去噪可从一次性样本不含复制件的检查点中恢复CelebA与CIFAR-10训练图像；在0.1%一次性复制件的CelebA检查点上，500次循环将记忆比例提升至30%以上；该方法在Stable Diffusion v1.4上将记忆化与非记忆化提示分离，AUC达0.944，1% FPR下TPR为0.866。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型记忆的内容是其学习分布几何与稳定性的属性，评估记忆需考察该结构而非仅依赖生成输出；同时循环过程也揭示了与任何单一训练图像都不匹配的退化吸引子，说明停留在吸引域内并不必然意味着记忆。

title: Camera-Noise Residuals for Face-Swap Detection: Redundant, Not Complementary, and Why
summary: Fusing a learned camera-noise fingerprint with an RGB appearance backbone is an appealing route to generator-independent deepfake detection, because the noise residual is grounded in image-formation physics rather than in the texture statistics of a particular generator. We test, on FaceForensics++, whether a Noiseprint++ residual channel carries information \emph{complementary} to an RGB Xception backbone for face-swap detection. A three-model ablation (RGB-only, residual-only, late-fusion) shows that fusion does not improve over RGB alone and that the residual branch alone is near chance. A seven-level bottleneck diagnostic localizes the cause: the noise maps do carry a discriminative signal, but it is statistical---carried by the per-sample first and second moments (mean, variance, energy) of the residual---and the per-sample \texttt{InstanceNorm} layer placed at the noise-branch input, following the TruFor template, standardizes exactly those moments away (five-fold cross-validated AUC drops from $0.747$ to $0.554$). A context-crop control rules out cropping geometry, and two fixed-fusion variants that remove the bottleneck recover the statistical signal yet still fail to beat RGB on every dataset. We conclude that, on this manipulation distribution, the noise residual is redundant with RGB rather than complementary, and we give concrete guidance for practitioners adopting noise-residual fusion for face-swap detection.

AI.tldr: 在FaceForensics++上检验Noiseprint++噪声残差与RGB Xception骨干用于换脸检测的互补性：三模型消融表明融合不优于纯RGB、残差单独接近随机水平；七级瓶颈诊断定位原因为InstanceNorm标准化抹除了残差中的统计判别信号（AUC从0.747降至0.554）；结论为该操纵分布下噪声残差与RGB冗余而非互补。
AI.motivation: 将学习到的相机噪声指纹与RGB外观骨干融合，被视为实现"生成器无关"深度伪造检测的理想路径，因为噪声残差根植于成像物理而非特定生成器的纹理统计。作者希望验证这一直觉：在换脸检测任务中，Noiseprint++残差通道是否携带对RGB Xception骨干而言互补的信息。
AI.method: 三项实验设计：(1) 三模型消融——纯RGB、纯残差、晚期融合，对比检测性能；(2) 七级瓶颈诊断——逐级剖析噪声分支，定位信号在何处丢失；(3) 上下文裁剪控制实验，排除裁剪几何因素的干扰；并设计两个移除瓶颈的固定融合变体以尝试恢复统计信号。
AI.result: 融合并未优于纯RGB；残差分支单独使用时性能接近随机水平。瓶颈诊断显示噪声图确实携带判别信号，但该信号是统计性的——由残差的逐样本一阶与二阶矩（均值、方差、能量）承载，而依照TruFor模板置于噪声分支输入的逐样本InstanceNorm恰好将上述矩标准化抹除，五折交叉验证AUC由0.747跌至0.554。上下文裁剪控制排除了裁剪几何的影响；两个去掉瓶颈的固定融合变体虽恢复了统计信号，但在所有数据集上仍无法超越RGB。
AI.conclusion: 在该操纵分布下，噪声残差与RGB信息冗余而非互补。作者据此为采用噪声残差融合进行换脸检测的研究者提供了具体实践指导。

title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance. Across nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games, training with Jev outperforms a standard RL learner, including where the learner makes no progress alone, while the model itself remains untrained. To our knowledge, we present the first use of Jev within the RL learning process and establish a frozen decision model as a usable component of RL training, inviting further exploration of how Jev and other advanced decision models can improve RL.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将冻结的决策模型Jev作为组件嵌入RL训练过程（参考策略、探索评判、回放评分），在保持模型不训练的前提下，于9个MiniGrid任务与3个Atari游戏中优于标准RL学习器。
AI.motivation: 基础模型可缓解RL在样本效率与迁移上的弱点，但其逐token生成使查询串行且代价高；Jev作为决策模型可在单次前向传播中给出校准的、带类型的答案，但现有研究未考察其自身决策能力及其作为RL训练组件的作用，Jev此前仅被当作单领域黑盒使用。
AI.method: 首先分析RL系统各组件对其所消费答案的需求，确认Jev除价值函数的基数用途外均可满足；将剩余组件定义为若干位置，每个位置可有多种角色。随后设计算法，将Jev部署在三个位置：参考策略、探索评判器、回放评分器，分别改进样本效率、探索与学习性能。
AI.result: 在九个MiniGrid任务和三个Atari游戏上，使用Jev的训练优于标准RL学习器，包括学习器自身无进展的场景，而Jev模型本身保持未训练状态。
AI.conclusion: 这是Jev在RL学习过程中的首次应用，确立了冻结决策模型作为RL训练可用组件，并鼓励进一步探索Jev及其他先进决策模型如何改进RL。

title: What is the goal of unsupervised machine learning?
summary: Unsupervised learning is one of the main branches of machine learning. Here I argue that unlike the other branches of machine learning (supervised and reinforcement learning), unsupervised learning is a rather heterogenous field that can serve several different goals. It seems futile to try to define one single goal for unsupervised learning. I identify four different goals for unsupervised learning: 1) Estimating the distribution, 2) Generating new data points, 3) Extracting features for downstream tasks, and 4) Understanding the data.

AI.tldr: 本文论证无监督学习是一个异质领域，无法用单一目标定义，应识别为四个不同目标：估计分布、生成新数据、为下游任务提取特征、理解数据。
AI.motivation: 作者认为，与监督学习和强化学习不同，无监督学习并非围绕一个统一目标组织，因此试图为其定义单一目标是徒劳的；论文旨在澄清这一领域的目标异质性。
AI.method: 这是一篇观点/立场性论文，通过概念分析而非实验方法，对无监督学习的目标进行界定与分类，将其概括为四类：分布估计、数据生成、特征提取、数据理解。
AI.result: 作者提出无监督学习包含四个相互独立的目标，而非单一目标，从而说明该领域的异质性。
AI.conclusion: 无监督学习应被视为服务多种不同目标的异质领域，追求统一定义并不现实，明确区分四类目标有助于研究定位与评价。

title: Does an Illumination Prior Help Face-Swap Detection? A Controlled Study of Temporal Self-Blended Images
summary: Self-blended images are widely used to train face-swap detectors, but primarily capture blending artifacts. We investigate whether adding illumination inconsistencies improves detection. Temporal Self-Blended Images (T-SBI) transfer lighting statistics between frames of the same video, with the mismatch controlled by luminance difference (ΔL). Using five training regimes and a three-seed comparison of high- and low-ΔL training, we find no evidence of illumination-specific improvements. AUC differences remain within seed variability across four datasets, and an analysis of 506,328 attribute-binned samples shows no preferential reduction in errors under harsh lighting. Instead, T-SBI shifts prediction scores, changing optimal thresholds by approximately 0.34 on FaceForensics++ and 0.30 on Celeb-DF, making comparisons at a fixed threshold misleading. However, T-SBI improves robustness to heavy JPEG compression on DFDC (AUC 0.780 versus 0.696), potentially reflecting greater reliance on low-frequency cues. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating training methods against their intended targets and accounting for threshold effects.

AI.tldr: 本文检验在自混合图像中引入光照不一致性是否有助于提升换脸检测性能，提出时序自混合图像（T-SBI）方法，发现其并无光照针对性改善，但会显著偏移预测分数与最优阈值，并提升对重度JPEG压缩的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自混合图像（SBI）被广泛用于训练换脸检测器，但其主要捕捉的是混合伪影，而非光照不一致等更本质的伪造线索。作者希望验证：在同一视频的不同帧之间迁移光照统计信息（即人为制造光照不匹配）能否带来检测性能提升，尤其是对强光照条件下的样本。
AI.method: 提出时序自混合图像（T-SBI）：在同一视频的帧间迁移光照统计量，并以亮度差ΔL控制不匹配程度。采用五种训练方案，并对高ΔL与低ΔL训练进行三种子（three-seed）对比。在四个数据集上评估，并对506,328个按属性分箱的样本进行误差分析，考察强光照下误检是否被优先降低。
AI.result: 未发现光照特异性的性能提升：AUC差异均在种子波动范围内；属性分箱分析也未显示强光照下误差被优先减少。T-SBI会整体偏移预测分数，使最优阈值在FaceForensics++上移动约0.34、在Celeb-DF上移动约0.30，因此在固定阈值下比较会产生误导。不过在DFDC上，T-SBI提升了对重度JPEG压缩的鲁棒性（AUC 0.780 vs 0.696），可能反映模型更依赖低频线索。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，针对预期目标评估训练方法、并考虑阈值效应至关重要。T-SBI并未实现预期的光照鲁棒性改进，反而主要通过分数偏移和对低频线索的依赖改变了检测行为。

title: Addressing Overcommitment in the Reasoning of Gendered Economic Memes under Multimodal Ambiguity
summary: Multimodal meme understanding is increasingly used to analyze socially sensitive content, yet existing models often exhibit biased behavior when interpreting economic dependence and social roles under ambiguity. Many memes express economic relationships through sparse text or symbolic visual cues, providing insufficient evidence for gendered attribution. In such underspecified settings, models tend to rely on pretraining correlations, leading to hallucinated and stereotypical economic role assignments. In this work, we study gendered economic dependence in image-text memes through the lens of contextual sufficiency and identify epistemic overcommitment-inferring roles without adequate evidence-as a primary source of bias. We propose CGER-Net, a context-grounded multimodal framework that estimates whether the input provides sufficient evidence for gendered economic reasoning and applies evidence-gated inference to enable confident attribution when cues are explicit while favoring principled abstention otherwise. We evaluate CGER-Net on EconMeme-GE, a curated dataset of image-text memes annotated as Men, Women, Neutral, or Ambiguous. Across strong contemporary multimodal baselines, CGER-Net reduces Gender Overcommitment Rate by up to 44% on ambiguous instances while maintaining comparable accuracy on unambiguous cases. Human evaluation further shows that 79% of generated rationales are judged as epistemically aligned with the available evidence. These results highlight the importance of modeling when not to infer for reliable and responsible multimodal analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图文迷因中性别化经济依赖的偏见问题，提出CGER-Net框架，通过证据门控推理在证据充分时进行归因、否则原则性弃权，从而显著降低模糊情形下的性别过度归因率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态迷因理解模型在处理经济依赖与社会角色时存在偏见：许多迷因通过稀疏文本或符号化视觉线索表达经济关系，证据不足以支持性别归因。在这种欠定（underspecified）场景下，模型倾向依赖预训练相关性，导致幻觉性和刻板印象化的经济角色分配。作者将这种"缺乏充分证据却仍推断角色"的现象称为认知过度承诺（epistemic overcommitment），并视其为偏见的主要来源。
AI.method: 提出CGER-Net，一个基于上下文接地（context-grounded）的多模态框架。该框架首先估计输入是否为性别化经济推理提供充分证据，然后采用证据门控推理（evidence-gated inference）：在线索明确时进行有信心的归因，证据不足时倾向于原则性弃权（principled abstention）。同时构建EconMeme-GE数据集，对图文迷因标注为Men、Women、Neutral或Ambiguous四类。
AI.result: 在多个强当代多模态基线上，CGER-Net在模糊实例上将性别过度归因率（Gender Overcommitment Rate）最多降低44%，同时在非模糊案例上保持可比精度。人工评估显示，79%的生成理由被判定为与可用证据在认知上一致（epistemically aligned）。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了建模"何时不应推断"对于可靠且负责任的多模态分析的重要性，为缓解欠定场景下的性别偏见提供了有效路径。

title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights
summary: Standard weight decay treats each weight matrix as a vector and ignores its spectral structure. We introduce spectral weight decay, a post-step decoupled nuclear-norm update that applies additive rather than multiplicative spectral shrinkage. We connect the update to approximate proximal descent and show that its sensitivity to update order can exceed that of conventional $\ell_2$ weight decay near rank deficiency. Across LLaMA models with $124$M to $500$M parameters, spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss. At $500$M and a $4\%$ distortion budget, it reaches $1.89\times$ compression and $1.18\times$ GPU inference speedup, compared with $1.14\times$ and $1.01\times$ after standard weight decay. Under fixed-horizon training with $60\%$ label noise, it also improves final mean clean-test accuracy over matched $\ell_2$ regularization by up to $17.8$ points on MNIST and $4.6$ points across four BERT-base tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SpectralWD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"谱权重衰减"(spectral weight decay)，一种步后解耦的核范数(additive而非乘性谱收缩)更新方法，可降低有效秩、提升压缩与推理效率，并在标签噪声下提高泛化精度。
AI.motivation: 标准权重衰减将每个权重矩阵视为向量，忽略了其谱结构，无法有效控制矩阵的秩结构，从而限制了模型压缩潜力与正则化效果。
AI.method: 提出谱权重衰减：一种步后(post-step)解耦的核范数(nuclear-norm)更新，采用加性而非乘性的谱收缩。将其与近似近端下降(proximal descent)建立联系，并分析其对更新顺序的敏感性——在接近秩亏(rank deficiency)时该敏感性超过常规L2权重衰减。
AI.result: 在124M至500M参数的LLaMA模型上，谱权重衰减降低有效秩，并在匹配验证损失下改善SVD-LLM压缩效果：500M模型、4%失真预算下达到1.89×压缩与1.18× GPU推理加速，而标准权重衰减仅为1.14×与1.01×。在60%标签噪声的固定时域训练中，相比匹配的L2正则化，其干净测试集平均精度最高提升17.8个点(MNIST)及4.6个点(四个BERT-base任务)。
AI.conclusion: 谱权重衰减通过加性谱收缩直接调控权重矩阵的谱结构，在压缩效率、推理加速和噪声鲁棒性方面优于标准L2权重衰减，是一种有效的正则化与压缩协同方法。

title: Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives
summary: We introduce Timer-M1, a pretrained multivariate time series foundation model that learns with primitives for zero-shot forecasting. Across domains, time series share elementary temporal and relational patterns, termed primitives, yet differ in how these primitives manifest and evolve across different contexts. Despite progress in zero-shot and task-general forecasting, existing foundation models may still struggle to generalize to complex real-world scenarios. To this end, we develop a primitive-based data synthesis and pretraining pipeline. The synthesis pipeline generates series with temporal primitives shared across domains and then assembles real and generated series into multivariate samples using relational primitives. Afterwards, samples are organized into episodes by assigning distinct channel roles as target variates, past-only covariates, and known-future covariates, ensuring that the model is optimized on predictable variates using available exogenous information. Technically, Timer-M1 further adapts gated two-dimensional Transformer blocks that dynamically allocate cross-variate attention across layers. Across three large-scale forecasting benchmarks, Timer-M1 ranks first on both FEV and TIME and second on GIFT-Eval among most recent time series foundation models. These results support effective primitive-based pretraining as a route to robust general forecasting technique across domains and task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Timer-M1，一种基于"基元（primitives）"预训练的多元时间序列基础模型，用于零样本预测，并在多个大规模基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 跨领域时间序列共享基本的时序与关系模式（基元），但其具体表现和演化方式因情境而异。现有零样本与任务通用预测的基础模型在复杂真实场景中泛化能力仍不足。
AI.method: 构建基于基元的数据合成与预训练流水线：合成流水线生成跨领域共享的时序基元序列，并利用关系基元将真实与生成序列组装为多元样本；随后按通道角色（目标变量、仅历史协变量、已知未来协变量）将样本组织为episode，使模型在可利用外生信息下优化可预测变量。模型层面，Timer-M1采用门控二维Transformer块，在层间动态分配跨变量注意力。
AI.result: 在三个大规模预测基准上，Timer-M1在FEV和TIME上排名第一，在GIFT-Eval上排名第二（在近期时间序列基础模型中）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持基于基元的预训练是通往跨领域、跨任务设置的稳健通用预测技术的有效路径。

title: Uncovering and Fixing Collider Bias in Bayesian PINNs
summary: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks (B-PINNs) are a popular framework for parameter and state inference from sparse or noisy observations. They are commonly formulated via a collider structure, in which physical and trajectory parameters are assumed to be a priori independent and become coupled through virtual likelihoods on differential-equation residuals that enforce physical consistency. We show that this modeling choice can induce severe systematic bias in the posterior over physical parameters: even when the prior is favorably centered on the ground-truth parameters, the resulting posterior can drift away and concentrate far from them. As a remedy, we advocate a hierarchical chain model in which physics generates trajectories, which in turn generate observations. The chain model does not suffer from this posterior bias, but it poses a harder, so-called doubly intractable, inference problem due to a physics-dependent normalization constant. This challenge can be resolved by discretizing the underlying stochastic dynamics, after which the chain posterior can be sampled exactly with particle MCMC. We identify two distinct mechanisms characterizing the collider bias, derive analytical approximations of their magnitudes, and establish diagnostic criteria for predicting when standard B-PINNs remain reliable. Experiments confirm the predicted bias and show that the chain formulation successfully avoids it.

AI.tldr: B-PINN常用的碰撞结构会系统性偏差物理参数后验，本文提出层级链式模型避免该偏差，并通过离散化+粒子MCMC实现精确采样。
AI.motivation: B-PINNs在稀疏/噪声观测下广泛用于参数与状态推断，但其将物理参数与轨迹参数先验独立、仅通过方程残差的虚拟似然耦合的碰撞结构，可能导致物理参数后验系统性漂移，偏离真值，需要揭示并解决该偏差。
AI.method: 作者提出层级链式模型：物理→轨迹→观测，避免碰撞偏差；该链式后验因含依赖物理的归一化常数而双重难解，通过对底层随机动力学离散化，使链式后验可用粒子MCMC精确采样；并解析刻画偏差机制并给出近似与诊断准则。
AI.result: 识别出碰撞偏差的两种不同机制，推导出其幅度的解析近似，并建立判断标准B-PINN何时仍可靠的诊断准则；实验验证了预测的偏差，且链式模型成功规避该偏差。
AI.conclusion: 标准B-PINN的碰撞结构会引入系统性后验偏差，应改用层级链式模型；虽然其推断双重难解，但通过离散化与粒子MCMC可精确采样，实验证明该方案有效。

title: Correlational Training of Morphological Neural Networks
summary: Neural networks are typically trained using first-order methods and back-propagation. It is unclear whether this approach is optimal for morphological layers whose weight Jacobians are sparse and whose resulting parameter gradients can be poor. In this work, we propose a novel weight update method for morphological neural networks inspired from the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) scheme. We view each morphological perceptron as an instance of the learning from experts' advice problem in logarithmic space, and use a correlation-based reward that favors inputs aligned with the desired output change, regardless of whether a strong gradient signal has reached their weight. We empirically evaluate our approach by training fully connected layers both as stand-alone models and as parts of larger transformer networks. Across nine benchmarks, correlational training yields improvements on eight, by up to 32.84 percentage points, while substantially reducing run-to-run variability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种受乘法权重更新（MWU）启发的形态学神经网络权重更新方法，用相关性奖励替代梯度信号，在九个基准中的八个上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 形态学层的权重雅可比矩阵稀疏，导致参数梯度质量差。传统一阶方法与反向传播是否适用于此类层尚不明确，因此需要探索更适合形态学感知机的训练方案。
AI.method: 将每个形态学感知机视为对数空间中的专家建议学习问题，采用相关（correlation）为基础的奖励机制：偏好那些与期望输出变化方向一致的输入，而不依赖强梯度信号是否传递到其权重。这是对乘法权重更新（MWU）方案的改造。
AI.result: 在九项基准上，将全连接层作为独立模型以及作为大型Transformer网络的一部分分别进行训练评估，相关性训练在其中八项上取得提升，最高提升32.84个百分点，同时显著降低了多次运行的方差。
AI.conclusion: 相关性训练为形态学层提供了一种优于传统梯度方法的权重更新途径，在精度和稳定性上均有改善，具备作为形态学神经网络通用训练范式的潜力。

title: TraceRelay: Attention-Aligned Recurrence over Rolling Traces
summary: We present TraceRelay, an attention-aligned recurrent architecture that distributes persistent representations over a rolling sequence of low-dimensional traces. Local right looking attention forms increments from lower-layer representations; delivery is delayed until all attended inputs are in the causal past. A fixed additive phase recurrence accumulates the delayed increments, and left-looking attention reads the resulting residual augmented stream. A stride-wise prefix sum supports parallel prefill and bounded-buffer continuation. We study 36 small-model runs on Equal Repeats, bounded Dyck closing-type prediction, and causal Most-Freq generation, using three seeds per setting. At trained length 256, Equal Repeats models with recurrent phase inheritance reach 98.81-99.69% accuracy versus 50.73-51.63% for separately trained variants without inheritance, despite the latter receiving more updates. Accuracy drops sharply at lengths beyond the training range. At the longest evaluated lengths, models with more dimensions in the middle layer's recurrent traces perform better on Dyck (76.34% versus 55.49% close accuracy at length 4096), whereas models with fewer trace dimensions perform better on five-symbol Most-Freq (70.74% versus 55.60% exact generation at length 1024). These contrasting cases motivate further study of how the size of recurrent representations should be chosen for different tasks, without establishing a general rule across tasks or model configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出TraceRelay：一种注意力对齐的循环架构，将持久表示分布于滚动低维迹序列，支持并行预填充与有界缓冲续算。在Equal Repeats等三项任务36次小模型实验中，相位继承显著提升训练长度内精度，超长时精度骤降；循环迹维度对Dyck与Most-Freq的影响方向相反，未形成通用规则。
AI.motivation: 探索如何在注意力与循环机制结合下分布持久表示：通过将表示沿滚动低维迹序列递送，实现因果对齐的延迟聚合与并行化，同时考察循环表示规模对不同任务的影响。
AI.method: TraceRelay采用右看局部注意力从低层表示生成增量，待所有被关注输入进入因果过去后再递送；固定加法相位循环累积延迟增量，左看注意力读取残差增强流；以跨步前缀和实现并行预填充与有界缓冲续算。在Equal Repeats、有界Dyck闭合类型预测、因果Most-Freq生成上进行36次小模型实验，每设置3个种子。
AI.result: 训练长度256时，具备循环相位继承的Equal Repeats模型准确率达98.81–99.69%，而无继承的独立训练变体仅50.73–51.63%，尽管后者更新更多；超出训练长度后精度急剧下降。最长评估长度下，中间层循环迹维度较多者在Dyck上更优（长度4096闭合准确率76.34% vs 55.49%）；维度较少者在五符号Most-Freq上更优（长度1024精确生成70.74% vs 55.60%）。
AI.conclusion: 相位继承对训练范围内序列建模至关重要，但长度外推能力有限；循环表示维度对任务的影响呈任务依赖性对比，尚不能形成跨任务或跨模型配置的通用选择规则，需进一步研究不同任务下循环表示规模的选取。

title: The Ball and the Box: Two Geometries of Computation in Superposition
summary: Neural representations can encode more features than they have dimensions, a phenomenon known as superposition. We study the dimension needed to compute Boolean gates from such representations. For a single threshold layer with a Gaussian random dictionary and uniformly random sparse Boolean inputs, we derive sharp dimension thresholds under two error criteria. A vanishing expected error count can require more dimensions than correctness of every output with high probability. Shared reads explain the gap: rare realizations can produce many errors at once. The expected-count threshold has ball geometry, while joint reliability has box geometry when a gate is evaluated on every feature tuple. Optimizing shared readout weights and biases gives explicit thresholds for conjunction, disjunction, and majority. For pairwise conjunction, the analysis also describes the transition near the threshold, in agreement with exact simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究叠加表征下计算布尔门的维度需求，针对高斯随机字典与均匀随机稀疏布尔输入的单阈值层，在两种误差准则下推导出尖锐的维度阈值，并给出合取、析取与多数门的显式阈值。
AI.motivation: 神经表征能以少于特征数的维度编码大量特征（叠加现象），然而在此类表征上计算布尔门所需的维度尚缺乏精确刻画，尤其是不同误差准则下的维度需求差异及其几何机制有待阐明。
AI.method: 考虑单阈值层，采用高斯随机字典与均匀随机稀疏布尔输入，在"期望错误数趋于零"与"所有输出高概率正确"两种误差准则下推导维度阈值；通过联合优化共享读出权重与偏置，得到合取、析取、多数门的显式阈值，并分析阈值附近的转变行为。
AI.result: 推导出两种误差准则下的尖锐维度阈值：期望错误数准则所需维度低于逐输出高概率正确准则。共享读出解释了该差距——稀有实现可同时引发大量错误。期望错误数阈值具球几何，而在每个特征元组上评估门时联合可靠性呈盒几何。对成对合取，分析刻画了阈值附近的转变，且与精确仿真一致。
AI.conclusion: 不同误差准则下的维度阈值存在本质差异，源于共享读出导致的误差聚集效应，并对应不同的几何结构；所得显式阈值与仿真吻合，为理解叠加表征的计算容量提供了精确理论刻画。

title: SR-TTA: Spatial-Redundancy Test-Time Adaptation for Interference-Robust Respiration Sensing
summary: Future 6G networks aim to expose sensing as a native service by reusing communication infrastructure. We study respiration sensing on a cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) base station, where a 64-antenna channel must be fused into a breathing waveform. The state-of-the-art hand-crafted fusion is near-optimal in benign conditions. It collapses, however, under strong in-band motion interference, whose frequency falls inside the respiration band. We show that a learned complex-weight beamformer recovers respiration by spatial nulling, and that the remaining gap to a per-recording oracle can be closed at deployment by label-free test-time adaptation. Crucially, we identify which label-free signal makes this work. Frequency- and variance-based criteria cannot separate an in-band interferer from breathing. Our spatial-redundancy test-time adaptation (SR-TTA), which maximizes consistency across random antenna subsets under an out-of-band spectral veto, preserves benign performance in our tests. The respiration-rate error drops from 5.8 to 0.8 breaths per minute (bpm) under simulated in-band interference, and the pipeline maps onto the Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture as O-RAN distributed-unit (O-DU) range-gating, an adaptation xApp, and a calibration rApp. On real testbed recordings, a one-time cross-subject calibration plus SR-TTA reduces failures from 47% to 7%, drawing level with the hand-crafted combiner using label-free test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究cell-free massive MIMO基站上的呼吸感知，提出学习的复权波束成形器通过空间零陷抑制带内运动干扰，并用空间冗余测试时自适应（SR-TTA）在部署时无标签地弥合与逐记录oracle的差距。
AI.motivation: 6G网络希望复用通信基础设施将感知作为原生服务。现有手工设计的融合方法在良性条件下接近最优，但在强带内运动干扰（频率落入呼吸频带）下会失效，且基于频率和方差的判据无法区分带内干扰与呼吸。
AI.method: 在64天线cell-free massive MIMO信道上，用学习的复权波束成形器做空间零陷；提出空间冗余测试时自适应（SR-TTA），在带外频谱否决约束下最大化随机天线子集间的一致性；并将流程映射到O-RAN架构（O-DU距离门控、自适应xApp、标定rApp）。
AI.result: 仿真带内干扰下呼吸率误差从5.8 bpm降至0.8 bpm；真实测试床记录中，一次性跨受试者标定加SR-TTA将失败率从47%降至7%，与使用无标签测试时自适应的手工组合器持平，同时保持良性条件性能。
AI.conclusion: 无标签测试时自适应中，空间冗余是关键判据；SR-TTA能在带内干扰下恢复呼吸感知，并可映射到O-RAN实现，达到与手工方法相当的性能。

title: RAGenome: Scaling Retrieval-Based Genomic Language Models to Long Contexts
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures and 4 tables, Accepted at ML4Molecules workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: The genome holds the blueprint that governs the biological properties of the cell. Consequently, advancing our knowledge of genomic function is crucial both for a broader understanding of biology and for continued biomedical advances. The success of large language models on natural language and protein sequences has motivated similar efforts on genomic data. However, standard genomic language models (gLMs) often require extremely large computational resources and still fall behind traditional methods on some downstream tasks. Recently, MSA-based pretraining has been proposed as an efficient alternative, but existing models are limited to short input contexts, restricting their use to short-range tasks, such as variant effect prediction. In this work, we present RAGenome, the first retrieval-based gLM that scales pretraining to longer contexts (100$\times$ longer than existing MSA-based gLMs), allowing it to capture both across-species evolutionary relationships and within-species longer-range interactions. Trained on whole-genome alignments from 100 vertebrates, RAGenome substantially improves the long-range capabilities of MSA-based gLMs, raising gene finding performance from 0.45 to 0.60, while remaining competitive on purely evolutionary-based tasks like prioritizing pathogenic variants. RAGenome provides competitive gLM performance at a fraction of the training cost, unifying evolutionary modeling and long-range capabilities within a single, flexible, scalable framework. Code is available at https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome.

AI.tldr: 提出RAGenome，首个基于检索的基因组语言模型，将预训练上下文扩展100倍，融合跨物种进化关系与物种内长程互作，基因发现性能从0.45提升至0.60，同时保持变异致病性预测竞争力且训练成本低。
AI.motivation: 基因组决定细胞生物学特性，理解基因组功能对生物学与生物医学至关重要。现有标准基因组语言模型（gLM）计算开销巨大且部分下游任务不及传统方法；基于MSA的预训练虽高效，但受限于短输入上下文，仅适用于变异效应预测等短程任务，无法建模长程互作。
AI.method: 提出RAGenome，首个基于检索的gLM，将预训练上下文扩展至比现有MSA类gLM长100倍；基于100种脊椎动物的全基因组比对进行训练，通过检索机制同时捕获跨物种进化关系与物种内长程相互作用。
AI.result: RAGenome显著提升MSA类gLM的长程能力，基因发现性能由0.45提升至0.60，同时在致病性变异优先级等纯进化任务上保持竞争力，并以更低的训练成本达到有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: RAGenome在一个灵活、可扩展的统一框架内融合进化建模与长程能力，以较低成本实现有竞争力的gLM性能，代码已开源。

title: In-Ride Alcohol-Impairment Detection in E-Scooterists with False-Alarm Control
summary: Shared e-scooter services have become a widely adopted urban transport mode. While most users ride responsibly, alcohol intoxication stands out among the factors contributing to severe crashes. Nonetheless, countermeasures remain limited to single-point reaction tests and night bans that suspend the service altogether. This paper proposes a new approach in which onboard sensors evaluate the rider as the trip unfolds, raising an alarm as soon as enough evidence of impairment has accumulated. Specifically, we introduce a detector that operates on inertial and throttle measurements, with a provable bound on the rate of false alarms. Experiments on sensor data from 141 rides, in which 25 participants rode while sober and at two target blood alcohol concentration levels, confirm that the bound holds, whereas baselines and ablations either exceed it or lose detection performance, and in some cases delay the alarm. At a bound of 0.023, the detector identifies 91% of the rides performed at the higher concentration and 50% of those at the lower one, with median detection times of 25 and 27 seconds, respectively. We further show that an embedded implementation meets the real-time requirement, making mitigation actions feasible onboard, without requiring data to leave the vehicle. Overall, this work lays the ground for interventions that reach impaired riders as soon as possible, sparing the sober ones the burden of a pre-ride test or the suspension of the service at night, while letting operators budget false alarms against user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于车载传感器、在行程进行中实时评估骑行者是否醉酒的检测方法，对惯性及油门测量数据建模，并对误报率给出可证明的上界；在141次实际骑行数据上验证了该上界，高浓度组检出率91%、低浓度组50%，中位检测时间约25–27秒，且嵌入式实现满足实时性要求。
AI.motivation: 共享电动滑板车已成主流城市交通方式，醉酒是导致严重事故的重要因素，但现有对策仅限于单点式反应测试和夜间全面停服，前者覆盖有限、后者牺牲所有用户（含清醒用户）的可用性。因此需要一种能在行程中尽早识别受损骑行者、又不干扰清醒用户的干预手段。
AI.method: 利用车载惯性传感器与油门测量数据构建醉酒检测器，采用随行程逐步累积证据的序贯检测框架，一旦证据充分即触发报警，并对误报率提供可证明的理论上界；与基线方法及消融变体进行对比，并在嵌入式平台上实现以验证实时可行性，数据无需离车传输。
AI.result: 在包含141次骑行（25名参与者，分别处于清醒状态及两个目标血液酒精浓度水平）的传感器数据上，实验确认误报率上界成立，而基线与消融方法或超出该上界、或损失检测性能、甚至延迟报警。在误报率上界为0.023时，检测器对较高浓度骑行识别率为91%，较低浓度为50%，中位检测时间分别为25秒和27秒；嵌入式实现满足实时性要求。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为"尽早触达醉酒骑行者、同时免除清醒用户事前测试与夜间停服负担"的干预策略奠定基础，并允许运营商在误报率与用户体验之间进行量化权衡。

title: Compile the Table: Query-Calibrated Operator Compression for Tabular In-Context Learning
summary: Tabular in-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a training-free and accurate paradigm for tabular prediction, but current approaches to compressing its in-context examples face an accuracy-throughput tradeoff: fixed subsets can sacrifice accuracy, while query-specific retrieval limits cache reuse and batching across queries, reducing throughput. We propose QCOC (Query-Calibrated Operator Compression), which exploits the exchangeability and repeated use of in-context examples by compiling their full KV cache once into compact memory shared across subsequent queries. Instead of retaining raw examples, QCOC clusters their states into joint-KV prototypes, preserves per-cluster multiplicities and the original example count, and calibrates prototype values against attention query vectors produced by the in-context examples through an anchored closed-form solution. Prototype compression drives the speedup, while value fitting helps preserve accuracy. On 64 held-out OpenML-CC18 datasets, QCOC achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared compression and retrieval methods at both retained counts. Across 12 configurations on seven long tables, it ranks first among compressed methods in ten and averages 0.23 percentage points below full context. Compressing 8,192 in-context examples to 512 memory slots yields a 10.5x cache compression ratio; excluding one-time compilation, in a single-core CPU online-serving comparison over 1,000 queries, QCOC is up to 508x faster than dynamic retrieval baselines and 1.98x faster than full-context inference. These results show that QCOC enables compact-memory reuse and efficient inference across queries while retaining accuracy close to full context.

AI.tldr: 提出QCOC方法，通过将上下文示例的KV缓存一次性压缩为共享的紧凑记忆，在保持接近完整上下文精度的同时大幅提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 表格上下文学习（ICL）虽免训练且准确，但其上下文示例压缩存在精度—吞吐权衡：固定子集会牺牲精度，而查询特定的检索限制缓存复用与批处理，降低吞吐。
AI.method: 利用上下文示例的可交换性与重复使用特性，一次性将其完整KV缓存编译为跨查询共享的紧凑记忆。不保留原始示例，而是将其状态聚类为joint-KV原型，保留每簇多重性与原始示例数，并通过锚定闭式解，用上下文示例产生的注意力查询向量校准原型值。原型压缩带来加速，值拟合帮助保持精度。
AI.result: 在64个留出的OpenML-CC18数据集上，两种保留数量下均取得对比压缩与检索方法中最高的平均精度。七个长表12种配置中，十项在压缩方法中排名第一，平均仅低于完整上下文0.23个百分点。将8,192个上下文示例压缩至512个记忆槽，缓存压缩比达10.5倍；排除一次性编译，单核CPU在线服务1000次查询对比中，比动态检索基线快至508倍，比完整上下文推理快1.98倍。
AI.conclusion: QCOC实现了紧凑记忆复用与跨查询高效推理，同时保持接近完整上下文的精度。

title: PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives
summary: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRAXIS——一种将生成器、学习器与符号档案建模为相互作用动力系统的协同演化框架，并为非平稳目标下的自改进学习提供理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 自改进学习系统会自适应地调整数据选择、优化过程与辅助符号组件，导致目标函数非平稳，超出标准学习假设（如固定目标、平稳数据分布）的适用范围，因此需要新的理论框架来刻画并约束这种非平稳性。
AI.method: 提出PRAXIS协同演化框架，将生成器、学习器与符号档案视为相互作用的动力过程；采用KL约束的生成器更新与受控的档案权重移动，并对档案更新给出基于子高斯噪声的累积效用优势分析。
AI.result: 理论上证明三方面结论：KL约束的生成器更新与受控档案权重移动可约束单步目标漂移；档案更新能在子高斯噪声下相对任意固定比较器保持持久的累积效用优势并抑制该程序；SGD获得平均平稳性保证，其退化程度由累积目标漂移控制。实验在视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理与算法图推理任务上观察到生成器稳定化、学习器损失下降与档案集中现象，与理论机制一致。
AI.conclusion: PRAXIS为自改进学习中的非平稳目标提供了可证明的漂移控制与收敛保证，理论预测与多任务实验现象相互印证。

title: Recovery Guarantees for Posterior Sampling of One-Bit Compressed Sensing
summary: We study the sample complexity of noisy one-bit compressed sensing for signals drawn from a prior distribution. By characterizing the effective distributional complexity of the prior via its approximate covering number, we prove that posterior sampling achieves accurate recovery with high probability when the number of measurements scales with the logarithm of the approximate covering number, up to a one-bit separation gap factor. This upper bound is robust to learned prior mismatch. Specifically, we show that posterior sampling with an approximate prior remains reliable, provided that the learned prior distribution is sufficiently close to the true signal distribution in Wasserstein distance. In addition, we establish a sample complexity lower bound for any reliable method of noisy one-bit compressed sensing, showing that our upper bound is nearly matched in its main prior dependent term. To approximate the ideal posterior sampling process for real world scenarios, we instantiate posterior sampling through a plug-and-play algorithm with diffusion priors. Experiments on the FFHQ and ImageNet datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究先验分布下噪声一比特压缩感知的样本复杂度，通过近似覆盖数刻画先验的有效分布复杂度，证明后验采样在测量数近似正比于近似覆盖数对数时可高概率精确恢复，并给出下界与扩散先验的实验验证。
AI.motivation: 噪声一比特压缩感知的样本复杂度通常以信号维数衡量，未充分利用信号来自先验分布这一结构信息；本文旨在刻画由先验驱动的有效分布复杂度，并研究学习先验失配下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 以先验的近似覆盖数刻画有效分布复杂度；分析后验采样的恢复保证；利用Wasserstein距离衡量学习先验与真实分布的接近程度以处理先验失配；推导任意可靠方法的样本复杂度下界；用带扩散先验的即插即用（plug-and-play）算法近似理想后验采样。
AI.result: 证明后验采样在测量数随近似覆盖数的对数增长（至多差一个一比特分离间隔因子）时高概率精确恢复；当学习先验与真实分布在Wasserstein距离下足够接近时方法仍可靠；下界表明上界的主要先验相关项近乎紧；FFHQ与ImageNet实验显示所提方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 先验的近似覆盖数是刻画噪声一比特压缩感知样本复杂度的关键量，后验采样在对数覆盖数尺度上达到接近最优的样本复杂度且对先验失配鲁棒，扩散先验的即插即用实现验证了理论的有效性。

title: DADP: Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning, A Reverse Hebbian-Inspired Structural Pruning Method
summary: Modern neural networks are heavily over-parameterized. This redundancy incurs substantial compute and memory overhead during training and inference. Existing pruning methods rely on post-hoc magnitude thresholds or static initialization heuristics. Consequently, they often require manual per-layer sparsity targets or expensive retraining cycles. We propose Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning (DADP), a biologically inspired structural plasticity mechanism. During training, DADP measures connection importance via the accumulated product of pre-synaptic activations and post-synaptic error gradients. Using a single global threshold instead of fixed layer budgets, DADP dynamically allocates sparsity across network depth while naturally inducing neuron- and channel-level pruning. Across MLP, VGG-16, ResNet-18, BiLSTM-CRF, and MiniBERT architectures, DADP matches or outperforms Magnitude, SNIP and RigL, retaining 73.67% accuracy (dense baseline: 76.06%) at 99% sparsity on ResNet-18. Finally, matrix-based Shannon entropy and effective rank measurements confirm that DADP preserves latent feature diversity at extreme sparsities without representation collapse.

AI.tldr: DADP是一种生物启发的动态剪枝机制，以突触前激活与突触后误差梯度累积乘积衡量连接重要性，用单一全局阈值替代分层稀疏预算，在多架构多任务上匹配或超越Magnitude、SNIP和RigL，并在99%稀疏度下保持特征多样性。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络严重过参数化，带来训练与推理的计算和内存开销。现有剪枝方法依赖事后幅度阈值或静态初始化启发式，通常需要人工设定逐层稀疏目标或昂贵的重训练周期，缺乏动态、统一的稀疏分配机制。
AI.method: 提出Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning（DADP），一种生物启发的结构可塑性机制。训练过程中，通过突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的累积乘积度量连接重要性；使用单一全局阈值而非固定逐层预算，使稀疏度在深度上动态分配，并自然诱导神经元级和通道级剪枝。
AI.result: 在MLP、VGG-16、ResNet-18、BiLSTM-CRF和MiniBERT架构上，DADP匹配或超越Magnitude、SNIP和RigL；在ResNet-18上于99%稀疏度下保留73.67%准确率（稠密基线76.06%）。基于矩阵的Shannon熵与有效秩测量证实，DADP在极端稀疏度下仍保持潜在特征多样性，未出现表示坍塌。
AI.conclusion: DADP通过活动依赖的动态稀疏分配，无需逐层稀疏目标或昂贵重训练即可实现高效剪枝，并在高稀疏度下维持表示多样性，验证了生物启发结构可塑性在深度网络剪枝中的有效性。

title: Understanding Latent-Dimension Scaling in Dynamical-System Learning through Spectral Reliability
summary: In deep learning, approximation theory motivates increasing representation size. We ask whether this benefit extends to dynamics learning through autoregressive prediction. We analyze the learned time evolution through the eigenstructure of Koopman operators, using relative residuals to detect spurious eigenpairs arising even as one-step error falls. For bounded Koopman operators, we show that minimal residuals over learned dictionary spaces converge pointwise to their full-space counterparts as these spaces approximate the observable space in $L^2$. Our hypothesis is that Koopman spectral reliability helps explain how consistently rollout error decreases with increasing dimension. We compare two models of a shared Koopman autoencoder trained alternately for reconstruction and latent evolution, using latent-prediction loss (one-step prediction errors in latent coordinates) or spectral-residual loss (relative residuals of candidate eigenpairs). Across six chaotic systems, both models reduced median windowed rollout error from smallest to largest dimension. The spectral-residual model achieved lower medians than the latent-prediction model for all systems and dimensions, and its median fell by a larger factor in every system. Its median decreased monotonically with dimension in four systems, against one for latent prediction. Against four baseline families, its mean valid prediction times were nearly always longer. At the largest dimension under two-stage training, we compared eigenvalue positions with each learned dictionary's residual contours. Spectral-residual eigenvalues concentrated in low-residual regions, whereas latent-prediction eigenvalues also appeared in high-residual regions, consistent with the hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过Koopman算子本征结构与相对残差研究自回归动力学学习中表示规模增大是否提升动力学学习，发现以谱残差为损失训练的模型在六个混沌系统上滚动预测误差更低、随维度增长更稳定，且其特征值集中于低残差区域。
AI.motivation: 深度学习中近似理论支持增大表示规模以提升性能，但这一收益是否能延伸至通过自回归预测进行的动力学学习尚不清楚；作者试图用Koopman谱可靠性来解释维度增加时滚动误差为何持续下降。
AI.method: 基于Koopman算子本征结构分析学习到的时间演化，用相对残差检测即使一步误差下降时仍出现的伪本征对；对有界Koopman算子证明：当学习字典空间在L2中逼近可观测空间时，字典空间上最小残差逐点收敛于全空间对应残差。实验比较共享Koopman自编码器的两种交替训练模型：潜在预测损失（潜在坐标一步预测误差）与谱残差损失（候选本征对的相对残差），并在最大维度两阶段训练下将特征值位置与各字典的残差等值线对照。
AI.result: 在六个混沌系统上，两种模型从最小到最大维度均降低中位窗口滚动误差；谱残差模型在所有系统与维度上中位数均低于潜在预测模型，且在每个系统中下降倍数更大。其误差中位数在四个系统中随维度单调下降，而潜在预测仅在一个系统中如此。与四个基线家族相比，其平均有效预测时间几乎总是更长。在最大维度两阶段训练下，谱残差模型特征值集中于低残差区域，潜在预测模型特征值也出现在高残差区域。
AI.conclusion: Koopman谱可靠性可以解释表示维度增加时滚动误差的一致性改善；相较潜在预测损失，显式约束谱残差可获得更可靠的Koopman本征对、更低的滚动误差及更长的有效预测时间。

title: Automated Assembly Instruction Generation from CAD Models Using Grounded Large Language Models: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
summary: Assembly documentation is a downstream manufacturing artifact that is still usually authored by interpreting CAD models by hand. Structured product data and large language models are both available, yet studies of CAD interpretation, assembly sequence planning, instruction writing, and human oversight have largely proceeded separately. This paper formulates CAD-grounded assembly instruction generation: the production of natural-language assembly procedures constrained by structured engineering information extracted from CAD models. The proposed framework maps a STEP assembly to a typed ProductGraph intermediate representation, derives a precedence order by deterministic topological sorting, realizes each step as language conditioned only on selected graph context, attaches per-step visual documentation, and applies rule-based and model-assisted checks. PDF export remains disabled until a human reviewer resolves every quality flag. The case study establishes endto-end feasibility on a built-in six-part reference assembly: the pipeline preserves a reported assembly order and carries quantity, material, and torque into an exported manual page. Generalization and geometric validation remain open empirical questions. The contribution is an architecture that separates engineering state, deterministic reasoning, grounded language realization, verification, and human release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基于CAD的装配指令生成"任务，将STEP装配体映射为ProductGraph中间表示，经确定性拓扑排序推导装配优先顺序，再以图上下文为条件生成自然语言步骤并附视觉文档，配合规则与模型校验，需人工审核清除全部质量标记后方可导出PDF，并在六零件参考装配体上验证了端到端可行性。
AI.motivation: 装配文档作为下游制造产物，目前仍主要依靠人工解读CAD模型来编写。结构化产品数据与大语言模型均已可用，但CAD解读、装配序列规划、指令撰写与人工监督等研究长期彼此割裂，缺乏将工程约束与语言生成统一起来的框架。
AI.method: 提出一个分层架构：将STEP装配体映射为带类型的ProductGraph中间表示；通过确定性拓扑排序推导工序优先顺序；每个步骤的语言生成仅以选定的图上下文为条件；为每步附加视觉文档；并施加基于规则与模型辅助的双重检查；在人工审核者解决全部质量标记之前，PDF导出保持禁用。
AI.result: 在内置的六零件参考装配体上完成了案例研究，验证了端到端可行性：流水线保持了所报告的装配顺序，并将数量、材料与扭矩信息传递到导出的手册页面中。泛化能力与几何验证仍属未决的实证问题。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一种架构，明确分离了工程状态、确定性推理、有依据的语言实现、验证与人工放行五个环节，为CAD接地（CAD-grounded）的装配指令生成提供了可复用的框架，但泛化性与几何正确性尚待进一步验证。

title: Puffin: Probabilistic Learning of Spatial Detail From Coarse Observations
summary: High-resolution socioeconomic variables are important for applications such as urban planning, public health, disaster response, and resource allocation. In practice, however, these variables are often observed only at a coarse spatial resolution. We introduce Puffin, a probabilistic framework for statistical disaggregation that raises the resolution of coarse totals using high-resolution satellite embeddings as covariates. Instead of predicting a single value for each fine-resolution subregion, Puffin learns a probability distribution and is trained through an aggregation-aware likelihood. At inference, Puffin conditions these predictions on the observed regional total and splits it among the subregions. The resulting fine-scale estimates are consistent with the observed aggregate and come with calibrated uncertainty, without requiring fine-resolution labels for training. We evaluate Puffin on German and US census, employment, and election data across population, jobs, and other count variables, and study when statistical disaggregation succeeds or fails across regions, countries, and targets.

AI.tldr: Puffin是一个概率化统计分解框架，利用高分辨率卫星嵌入作为协变量，将粗分辨率总量提升到精细空间分辨率，输出与观测总量一致的细化估计并附带校准不确定性。
AI.motivation: 城市规化、公共健康、灾害响应和资源分配等应用需要高分辨率社会经济变量，但实际观测往往只有粗空间分辨率。
AI.method: Puffin不预测每个细分辨率子区域的单一取值，而是学习概率分布，并通过聚合感知似然进行训练；推理时以观测到的区域总量为条件，将总量在子区域间进行拆分。训练无需细分辨率标签。
AI.result: 在德国和美国的普查、就业与选举数据上，针对人口、岗位等计数变量进行评估，并分析统计分解在不同区域、国家和目标上成功或失败的条件。
AI.conclusion: Puffin能在无需细粒度标签的情况下生成与观测总量一致且具有校准不确定性的精细尺度估计，为粗分辨率社会经济数据的空间分解提供了概率化途径。

title: Interval-valued SHAP in Tree-Based Models
summary: Shapley values are among the most popular feature-attribution explanations. Efficient approaches for computing/estimating Shapley values for tree-based models, which are state-of-the-art for tabular data sets, have been developed. However, it is known that Shapley values can be (highly) unrobust due to small and realistic changes. In this paper, we propose an imprecise Dirichlet model (IDM) based method to analyze the robustness of Shapley values in decision trees and random forests. Technically, it is done by quantifying and analyzing the interval-valued Shapley values when a few unannotated instances are randomly introduced to the leaves of the trees. The interval-valued Shapley values can be defined following common principles in handling incomplete data: the pessimistic and averaging principles. We derive various theoretical results that lead to efficient computation of the interval-valued Shapley values. We also show that the proposed method can be straightforwardly generalized to the case of Banzhaf values. We then present various case studies and experiments to illustrate the behaviour of the proposed interval-valued Shapley values and their applications in debiasing uninformative features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于不精确Dirichlet模型（IDM）的方法，用于分析决策树与随机森林中Shapley值的鲁棒性，通过量化并分析当少量未标注实例随机引入叶子节点时的区间值Shapley值。
AI.motivation: Shapley值是最流行的特征归因解释方法之一，针对树模型已有高效计算/估计方法。然而，Shapley值可能因微小且现实的扰动而（高度）不鲁棒，这一问题亟待分析。
AI.method: 基于不精确Dirichlet模型（IDM），在少量未标注实例随机引入树叶时，依据处理不完整数据的悲观原则与平均原则定义区间值Shapley值；推导多项理论结果以实现其高效计算，并推广至Banzhaf值。
AI.result: 推导出多种理论结果，实现了区间值Shapley值的高效计算；方法可直接推广至Banzhaf值情形；通过案例研究与实验展示了区间值Shapley值的行为及其在去偏无信息特征中的应用。
AI.conclusion: 所提IDM方法可有效刻画并分析树模型Shapley值的鲁棒性，并为无信息特征去偏提供了应用途径。

title: Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction for Effective Subgroup Reliability
summary: Conformal prediction offers a distribution-free coverage guarantee, making it especially attractive for clinical applications. Standard conformal prediction, however, provides such guarantees only at the population level, and its prediction sets can exhibit coverage disparities across clinically important subgroups. A natural remedy is to calibrate within predefined groups. However, this can require access to sensitive subgroup attributes and is prone to a worst-group bottleneck: protecting the most difficult subgroup can inflate prediction sets for all, increasing cognitive burden on decision makers. To this end, we propose Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction (SGCP), a conformal framework for subgroup-reliable uncertainty quantification. It learns a stochastic grouping map that allows each sample to draw calibration information from others with similar calibration behavior, yielding a local score law that boosts reliability across subpopulations. We prove that SGCP retains the standard coverage guarantee. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that it consistently reduces subgroup coverage gaps while achieving smaller or comparable prediction set sizes relative to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出随机分组共形预测（SGCP）框架，通过学习随机分组映射，让每个样本从校准行为相似的样本中获取校准信息，在保持标准覆盖保证的同时缩小亚组覆盖差距并控制预测集大小。
AI.motivation: 标准共形预测仅在总体层面提供无分布覆盖保证，其预测集在临床重要亚组间存在覆盖差异。直接在预定义分组内校准虽可缓解，但需访问敏感亚组属性，且存在"最差组瓶颈"：保护最困难亚组会膨胀所有样本的预测集，加重决策者认知负担。
AI.method: 提出SGCP（Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction）：学习一个随机分组映射，使每个样本能够从校准行为相似的其他样本中抽取校准信息，从而获得局部得分分布（local score law），提升跨亚群的可靠性。理论证明SGCP保持标准覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实基准上的实验表明，与现有基线相比，SGCP一致地缩小亚组覆盖差距，同时取得更小或相当的预测集大小。
AI.conclusion: SGCP为亚组可靠的不确定性量化提供了一种无需敏感亚组属性、且避免最差组瓶颈的共形框架，兼顾亚组公平性与预测集效率。

title: Example-driven Parametrisations for Bayesian Shape Optimisation
summary: Bayesian optimisation is the natural tool for shape design when objectives are expensive and non-differentiable, but it needs a compact yet expressive parameterisation of the search space. Hand-crafting one is a complex endeavour requiring domain expertise, and often yields implicit infeasible regions, artificial bounds, and coupled, unordered coordinates. We instead learn the parameterisation from a collection of existing designs, applying principal component analysis to the deformations between shapes. The result is a linear, interpretable search space in which the number of components explicitly trades expressivity against dimensionality. Across aerofoils, wings, and radio-frequency cavities, spanning 2D geometry to 3D aerodynamics and electromagnetics, we show improved sample efficiency and the ability to explore beyond the confines of hand-crafted baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用PCA从已有设计中学习形状参数化，替代手工参数化，用于昂贵、不可微目标的贝叶斯优化，并在翼型、机翼和射频腔体上验证了更高的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化适合处理目标昂贵且不可微的形状设计问题，但需要紧凑且表达能力强的搜索空间参数化。手工参数化依赖领域专业知识，且常引入隐式不可行区域、人为边界以及耦合、无序的坐标。
AI.method: 从已有设计集合中学习参数化：对形状之间的形变（deformations）应用主成分分析（PCA），得到一个线性、可解释的搜索空间，其中主成分数量显式地在表达能力与维度之间进行权衡。
AI.result: 在翼型、机翼和射频腔体上，覆盖从2D几何到3D空气动力学与电磁学的问题，实验显示样本效率提升，并能探索超出手工基线限制的设计空间。
AI.conclusion: 基于PCA的形变学习参数化可作为贝叶斯优化中手工参数化的有效替代，兼顾紧凑性、可解释性与表达能力，并在多类物理设计任务中提升优化效率与探索范围。

title: The Polytopal Neural Network
summary: Understanding how deep neural networks process information remains a central challenge. Existing interpretability methods often compromise structural fidelity, rely on prespecified corpora, or explain models post-hoc. We propose Polytopal Neural Networks (PNNs), a framework that extracts distinct layer-wise aspects by enforcing a polytope-based structure that is used directly in subsequent information processing. We scale our approach using learned corpus representations and an amortized simplex inference procedure and highlight how the framework also gives a direct route to vector quantized (VQ) training. In PNNs, observations are explicitly described by their alignment with layer-specific aspects. Empirical results show that imposing polytopal constraints on neural network representations preserves meaningful structures in the latent space with minimal degradation in performance, favorable compressed representations when compared to VQ representations in unsupervised learning, while also providing a performant new approach to VQ deep learning training. Our findings suggest that deep networks can enforce interpretable polytope-based representations, offering a principled path toward more transparent AI systems with minimal performance compromise.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Polytopal Neural Networks（PNNs），通过在网络表示中施加多胞体（polytope）结构约束，直接从各层提取可解释的"方面（aspects）"，并借助学习式语料表示与摊销式单纯形推断实现规模化，同时为向量量化（VQ）训练提供新路径。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络的信息处理机制仍难以理解。现有可解释性方法存在若干局限：破坏结构保真性、依赖预先设定的语料库，或只能在事后对模型进行解释。作者希望在不显著牺牲性能的前提下，让模型本身在信息处理过程中内嵌可解释的结构。
AI.method: 提出PNNs框架：在网络表示中强制引入基于多胞体的结构，该结构直接参与后续信息处理，从而提取逐层的、彼此区分的"方面（aspects）"。为提升可扩展性，采用学习式的语料表示（learned corpus representations）与摊销式单纯形推断（amortized simplex inference）。该方法同时给出通往向量量化（VQ）训练的直接途径，观测样本被显式地描述为其与各层特定"方面"的对齐关系。
AI.result: 实验表明：对神经网络表示施加多胞体约束能够保留潜在空间中有意义的结构，且性能损失极小；在无监督学习下，相比VQ表示可获得更优的压缩表示；同时为VQ深度学习训练提供了一种性能良好的新方法。
AI.conclusion: 深度网络能够实现可解释的、基于多胞体的表示，为构建更透明的人工智能系统提供了一条有原则的路径，且几乎不带来性能上的妥协。

title: Test-Time Compute for Tabular Foundation Models: Mechanisms, Gains, and Limits
summary: Which forms of test-time compute improve the predictions of strong pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs)? We systematically study this along three axes: adaptation, aggregation, and context construction. Our evaluation spans modern TFMs across the TabArena benchmark, supplemented by experiments on wide and large-scale tables from OpenML. For adaptation, we introduce DiagScale, a diagonal query-key similarity update. It trains only 0.003-0.03% of model parameters and achieves gains comparable to full fine-tuning across three independently pretrained backbones. For aggregation, both pool composition and selection strategy matter. TabPFN-3 already averages predictions from different preprocessing variants of the same data, and adding more such predictions yields diminishing returns. With a broader pool of 96 configurations, greedy selection reduces error by 2.4% relative to the default predictor, but uniform averaging increases error. For context construction, attention-guided retrieval improves TabPFN-3's predictions on some large tables and supports source pools beyond the full context memory limit. The context expansion methods we test yield no consistent improvement. Taken together, our results suggest that adaptation and selective aggregation yield consistent benchmark-level gains. The benefits of context construction depend more on the task and data regime. Adaptation and aggregation over the same backbone yield further gains when combined, but require substantially more computation than default inference. These trade-offs motivate choosing strategies according to the available computation budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kanghui-learning/test-time-compute-for-tabular-foundation-models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了测试时计算（TTC）如何提升表格基础模型（TFM）的预测，沿适配、聚合、上下文构建三条轴线在TabArena与OpenML上展开评测。提出仅训练极少参数的DiagScale适配方法，发现选择性聚合稳定有效，而上下文构建收益依赖任务与数据规模；建议按算力预算选择策略。
AI.motivation: 强预训练表格基础模型（TFM）已成为表格任务的主流范式，但"测试时计算如何提升其预测"缺乏系统认识。已有工作零散地涉及微调、集成或检索，缺少在同一框架下对适配、聚合、上下文构建的统一评测，也不清楚各策略的收益与计算代价权衡，因此难以指导实践者按算力预算做选择。
AI.method: 在三条轴线上系统评测：1）适配：提出DiagScale，一种对角query-key相似度更新，仅训练0.003–0.03%参数；2）聚合：考察预测池的组成与选择策略，包括对同一数据不同预处理变体的预测进行均匀平均与贪心选择，并将池扩至96种配置；3）上下文构建：测试注意力引导的检索以及上下文扩展方法。评测覆盖TabArena上的现代TFM，并在OpenML的宽表与大表上补充实验，跨三个独立预训练骨干验证。
AI.result: 适配方面：DiagScale在三个独立预训练骨干上取得与全量微调相当的增益，参数开销极低。聚合方面：池组成与选择策略均重要；TabPFN-3已对同数据不同预处理变体做平均，继续增加此类预测收益递减；在96配置的更大池中，贪心选择相对默认预测器降低2.4%误差，而均匀平均反而增加误差。上下文构建方面：注意力引导检索在部分大表上改善TabPFN-3预测并支持超出完整上下文内存限制的来源池，但所测上下文扩展方法无一致提升。组合上，同一骨干上的适配与聚合结合可进一步增益，但计算量显著高于默认推理。
AI.conclusion: 适配与选择性聚合能在基准层面带来稳定增益，上下文构建的收益更依赖任务与数据规模；同一骨干上适配与聚合组合可继续提升但算力代价显著。这些权衡说明应按可用计算预算选择测试时计算策略，而非一律追求最大算力投入。

title: CausalDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models with Latent Disentanglement
summary: World models for control must capture which aspects of the environment respond to the agent's actions and which are relevant to reward. Generative world models such as Dreamer 4 consist of a video tokenizer, which encodes each frame into a latent, and a dynamics model, which is pretrained to predict future latents from past latents and actions. Yet the tokenizer is trained with a reconstruction objective, without action or reward supervision, so its latent provides no explicit mechanism to separate controllable, uncontrollable, reward-relevant, and reward-irrelevant information. We propose \textit{CausalDreamer}, which keeps the tokenizer frozen and re-encodes its latent into a factored representation of four groups along two axes: controllability, where only the two controllable groups receive the action, and reward relevance, learned by predicting the reward from the two reward-relevant groups. The pretrained dynamics model is then fine-tuned to predict the factored representation. We evaluate \textit{CausalDreamer} and the pretrained world model it starts from with model-predictive planning on 20 MMBench2 tasks: 10 clean tasks seen during training and 10 unseen tasks, of which 6 are manipulated variants of clean tasks with a changed background, object, or maze layout, and 4 are new environments. We normalize returns so that a policy taking uniformly random actions scores 0 and an expert scores 1. \textit{CausalDreamer} achieves a 14\% higher normalized score than the pretrained world model on the clean tasks (0.199 vs.\ 0.175) and a 25\% higher score on the manipulated variants (0.307 vs.\ 0.246), while neither model scores meaningfully above the random policy in the new environments. Additionally, our analysis shows that the factored representation separates reward-irrelevant changes, such as a changed background, from its reward-relevant groups.

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalDreamer，将冻结 tokenizer 的潜在表示重编码为可控性与奖励相关性两个轴上的四组因子化表示，并微调预训练动力学模型，在 MMBench2 规划任务上优于原始世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式世界模型（如 Dreamer 4）的 tokenizer 仅以重建目标训练，缺乏动作与奖励监督，其潜在表示无法显式区分可控/不可控、奖励相关/奖励无关的信息。
AI.method: 冻结 tokenizer，将其潜在表示重编码为沿两个轴划分的四组因子化表示：可控性轴上仅两个可控组接收动作输入；奖励相关性轴上通过从两个奖励相关组预测奖励来学习。随后微调预训练动力学模型以预测该因子化表示。
AI.result: 在 20 个 MMBench2 任务（10 个训练见到的干净任务、10 个未见任务：6 个改变背景/物体/迷宫布局的变体、4 个新环境）上以模型预测规划评估。归一化后随机策略为 0、专家为 1。CausalDreamer 在干净任务上归一化得分比预训练世界模型高 14%（0.199 vs. 0.175），在变体任务上高 25%（0.307 vs. 0.246）；两模型在新环境中均未显著优于随机策略。分析表明因子化表示能将无关奖励的变化（如背景改变）与奖励相关组分离。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可控性与奖励相关性的因子化潜在表示并对动力学模型微调，可在不重新训练 tokenizer 的前提下提升世界模型在规划中的表现与对干扰变化的鲁棒性，但泛化到全新环境仍是未解难题。

title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多视角图解释器（MPGE），将事实支持（PT，即原型）、反事实敏感性（CF）与样例容忍度（EXE）统一于同一约束框架下，为冻结的图神经网络分类器提供多视角解释。
AI.motivation: GNN虽能从化学图数据预测分子性质，但预测准确率无法解释图信息如何支持单次决策；紧凑且保持预测的依据（rationale）也不必然揭示哪些改动会反转决策或模型能容忍哪些修改，因此需要同时刻画事实支持、反事实敏感性与容忍度。
AI.method: 提出MPGE，统一三种解释视角：事实视角（PT）寻求保持相同标签与所需置信度的紧凑保留边集；反事实（CF）解释寻求有界、能改变预测的删边；样例（EXE）解释寻求非平凡的有界删边同时保持标签与置信度。三者共享约束形式化框架（衔接预测行为、紧凑性与编辑代价），但各有独立目标函数；并将CF-GNNExplainer扩展至图分类任务，学习对称边排序并验证离散候选，记录失败搜索；另设BBBP片段的RDKit净化后端。
AI.result: 在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD与BBBP上以语义覆盖率、条件质量、稳定性与运行时间评估主GCN实现：成功的事实掩码平均保留输入边的8.6%–15.5%；有界反事实覆盖率为4.8%–67.6%；样例保持覆盖率为98.9%–100.0%；探索性对照揭示硬投影与保留节点信息的影响。
AI.conclusion: 定量比较与分子可视化刻画了模型的支持、敏感性与容忍度，但不将其视为已验证的化学机制。

title: SCORE: Spectral Correlation Estimation for Multivariate Gaussians
summary: Neural network-based predictive modeling with high-dimensional structured Gaussian targets requires an efficient and numerically stable, yet expressive approximation of the covariance matrix. We propose SCORE: a scalable framework, combining scoring rule training with an expressive covariance approximation learned in spectral space. For $d$-dimensional data, the learning task is decomposed into learning the marginal distributions and learning a structured correlation matrix, which enables dense dependencies with linear storage and $\mathcal{O}(d\log d)$ cost. We utilize the closed form Gaussian kernel score for training, which remains defined even for degenerate covariances and admits bounded gradients during optimization. We characterize kernel scores under invertible transforms and prove exact invariance under unitary transforms. At population level, our two-level objective recovers the true marginals and projects the target correlation onto the representable class; finite-sample PAC bounds show that the errors of the two stages enter additively. We evaluate our model on a variety of tasks with a commonly assumed Gaussian domain: Time-series forecasting, monocular depth estimation, and spatial weather prediction, showing improved performance at lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出SCORE框架，用谱空间中的高斯核得分匹配训练可扩展协方差近似，实现线性存储、O(d log d)复杂度，并在时间序列预测、单目深度估计和空间天气预测上以更低算力取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 高维结构化高斯目标的神经网络预测建模，需要同时对协方差矩阵进行高效、数值稳定且具表达力的近似。传统方法难以兼顾存储与计算复杂度。
AI.method: SCORE将学习任务分解为两部分：学习边缘分布与学习结构化相关矩阵，在谱空间中表示，从而支持稠密依赖关系且仅需线性存储与O(d log d)计算。训练使用闭式高斯核得分，对退化协方差仍有定义且梯度有界；刻画了可逆变换下的核得分性质，并证明酉变换下的精确不变性。理论上，两级目标在总体层面恢复真实边缘并将目标相关投影到可表示类上。
AI.result: 给出有限样本PAC界，表明两阶段误差可加性；在时间序列预测、单目深度估计、空间天气预测任务上，性能提升且计算成本更低。
AI.conclusion: SCORE为高维结构化高斯预测提供了一种兼具表达力、数值稳定性与可扩展性的协方差建模方案，理论与实证均验证其有效性。

title: A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning
summary: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeZo-SAC，用几何方法（zonotope）自适应调整 critic 悲观程度，取得竞争性表现并降低过估计与动作能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有 off-policy actor-critic 方法（如 SAC）通过取双 critic 最小值来控制过估计偏差，但无论 critic 之间如何分歧都采用同一聚合规则，缺乏针对状态与动作的自适应性。作者希望根据 critic 分歧程度自适调节悲观程度。
AI.method: GeZo-SAC 为每个 critic 在标量值之外预测一组生成元（generators），定义成一个 zonotope（带体）。沿采样方向探测该 zonotope 得到几何宽度：该宽度从 critic 值中减去作为悲观偏移，同时给出两个 critic 间的分歧度量，并用 log-sum-exp 聚合。用该分歧控制 critic 的组合方式——分歧小时趋向宽度加权平均，分歧增大时趋向通常的取最小值。推理阶段使用未修改的 SAC actor，生成元仅在训练时用于 critic 侧。
AI.result: 在四个 MuJoCo-v5 运动基准与六个 off-policy 基线对比中，GeZo-SAC 在 Ant-v5 与 Hopper-v5 上取得最高平均回报，在其余任务上与其他方法相当。分析显示其单位距离平均执行器功与动作代价最低，且在四个环境中测得过估计频率接近零。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何表示让 critic 悲观程度随状态-动作与 critic 分歧自适应，可在保持 SAC 部署策略不变的前提下有效抑制过估计、提升部分任务回报并降低动作能耗，是一种可插拔的 critic 侧改进。

title: Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation
summary:
Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure.
  In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自动化特征提取方法，通过图转换与Weisfeiler-Lehman图核（1-WL）为约束编程实例生成结构化表示，并提出基于割的表示WLc；在2023–2025 MiniZinc挑战实例上验证，WLc特征在SVM上优于fzn2feat，在RF与MLP上两者接近。
AI.motivation: 算法选择对约束编程的效率至关重要，但传统特征提取依赖人工设计的实例级统计量，难以刻画问题的底层结构，因此需要自动化且能捕捉结构的特征表示方法。
AI.method: 整合图转换与Weisfeiler-Lehman图核（1-WL）生成实例的稳健结构表示；由于1-WL界定了标准消息传递GNN的图区分能力，WL类特征无需训练GNN即可提供替代方案。核心贡献是基于割的表示WLc，用于建模结构划分并提供更细粒度的预测信号。在2023–2025 MiniZinc挑战实例上，以最大化Borda计分与最大化预测准确率两个任务，使用SVM、随机森林与多层感知机进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，在SVM上基于割的特征优于fzn2feat；在随机森林与MLP上，两者表现较为接近。
AI.conclusion: 自动化、基于WL的结构化特征（尤其是WLc）为约束编程的算法选择提供了无需训练GNN的有效替代，并在部分模型上优于既有特征提取方法。

title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Quantum machine learning, and quantum neural networks (QNNs) in particular, are advancing fields with growing potential. Although systematic comparisons of QNN configurations have been explored primarily for classification tasks, comparatively little attention has been given to regression problems, particularly financial time series forecasting. This study presents a large-scale systematic comparative evaluation of QNN component configurations for financial time series forecasting, using the GBP/USD spot exchange rate as a case study. A grid search across encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions yields 1,368 distinct model configurations, each evaluated in terms of prediction accuracy, computational cost, and convergence behaviour. The results reveal unique insights into how the choice of methods influences performance, such as that gate selection and arrangement are more critical to model success than raw parameter count, and that entanglement is a system-level property of the full circuit rather than solely at the ansatz level. The best-performing QNN configuration achieves an $R^2$ score of 0.985, outperforming a classical BiLSTM baseline. Additionally, the impact of real quantum hardware noise is assessed through execution on the IQM Emerald device, revealing that gate errors and decoherence represent a significant barrier to practical deployment, with gate selection and circuit depth identified as key determinants of hardware noise resilience. Overall, the findings provide practical architectural guidance for QNN design and establish a baseline characterisation of QNN noise sensitivity on near-term quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文对量子神经网络（QNN）在金融时间序列预测中的组件配置进行了大规模系统性评估，以英镑/美元即期汇率为案例，通过网格搜索生成1,368种模型配置，从预测精度、计算成本和收敛行为三个维度展开比较。最优配置R²达0.985，超越经典BiLSTM基线；在IQM Emerald真机上的测试表明门错误与退相干是实用化部署的主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习与QNN发展迅速，但现有系统性配置比较主要集中于分类任务，对回归问题（尤其是金融时间序列预测）关注不足，缺乏针对QNN架构选择的实践性指导。
