AI.result: 在双积分器与 Safety Gym 上，FAITH 在无可信起点违规的方法中回报最高，并在不可行起点下匹配最低危害；在 29 自由度人形上，Walking-Avoid 中安全率达 99.95% 且保留 97% 未过滤回报，Push-Avoid 中测得最高安全率；同一策略亦在真实 Unitree G1 人形上验证。
AI.conclusion: FAITH 通过将安全过滤与任务策略更新解耦，并引入可行性感知的峰值危害回退机制，实现了无模型、长时程有效且适用于高自由度与真实机器人的安全强化学习。

title: VioLA: Learning Generalist Humanoid Control Policies from Human Data
summary: Teaching a humanoid to follow instructions with its whole body runs into two obstacles. Its action space is large and tightly coupled: legs, arms, and fingers must move together while the robot keeps its balance, which makes joint-level actions hard to learn. And humanoid demonstrations are scarce, so current humanoid generalist policies do not follow new instructions out of the box and are fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations of each task before deployment. Human demonstrations exist in far larger numbers, but a person's motion is not a robot command. We remove both obstacles by changing what the generalist policy predicts. We introduce VioLA, a generalist humanoid policy that predicts body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands. A pretrained body- and hand-controller execute these latents on the robot. Their corresponding motion encoders map human and robot motion into the same latent spaces. A human recording is therefore labeled in the policy's action space, and the training demonstration pool contains 140.6 million frames, 93.2% of them human. As a result, VioLA follows locomotion instructions on the real robot zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning, reaching 100% success where GR00T N1.7 and $Ψ_0$ reach 16.7% and 0%, respectively. It also reaches 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning. The same approach works across two VLA and one world-action model backbones. A generalist policy trained on human demonstrations alone performs locomotion tasks on the real robot zero-shot. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: VioLA将通用人形策略的预测目标从关节指令改为身体与手部运动潜变量，借助预训练控制器与运动编码器实现人机动作共享潜空间，从而利用海量人类视频作为动作标注数据，实现零样本全身指令跟随。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身指令跟随面临两大障碍：一是动作空间大且强耦合（腿、臂、手指需协同并保持平衡），导致关节级动作难以学习；二是人形演示数据稀缺，现有通用策略无法直接执行新指令，必须针对每个任务用遥操作演示微调。而人类演示数据规模远大于机器人数据，但人类运动并非机器人指令，无法直接使用。
AI.method: 改变通用策略的预测对象：VioLA不预测关节指令，而是预测身体与手部的运动潜变量（motion latents）。预训练的身体控制器和手部控制器负责在机器人上执行这些潜变量；配套的运动编码器将人类运动和机器人运动映射到同一潜空间，使人类录像可被自动标注为策略动作空间中的标签。训练演示池共1.406亿帧，其中93.2%为人类数据。该方法可兼容两种VLA骨干和一种世界-动作模型骨干。
AI.result: VioLA在真实机器人上零样本执行移动（locomotion）指令，无需任务特定微调，成功率达100%，而GR00T N1.7为16.7%、Ψ0为0%。在操作（manipulation）任务上，无需任务特定微调达到88.6%成功率。同一方法在两种VLA和一种世界-动作模型骨干上均有效；仅用人类演示训练的通用策略也能在真实机器人上零样本完成移动任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将策略输出从关节指令改为共享潜空间中的运动潜变量，可同时解决高维耦合动作学习困难与机器人演示稀缺两个问题，使人类视频成为有效的策略训练数据。这实现了人形机器人的零样本全身指令跟随，并具备跨骨干的通用性；代码与检查点将开源。

title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
summary: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出成功引导采样（SGS），一种自适应采样器，将强化学习训练集中在策略能力前沿附近的任务配置上，从而放大并行仿真的效益，实现百万级并行环境下的四足运动与接触密集型装配任务，并零样本迁移到真实硬件。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人需完成从敏捷运动到灵巧操作的大量任务。现有 sim-to-real 强化学习依赖逐任务、工程密集的结构先验（如塑形奖励、示范）。已有工作用多样化的仿真器重置加大规模并行仿真来减轻工程负担，但对更精确或更动态的问题，简单地扩展该范式仍很困难：均匀采样会浪费越来越大比例的学习经验，因为样本落在策略已掌握或尚无法尝试的配置上，导致并行规模扩展的期望收益难以兑现。
AI.method: SGS 是一种简单的自适应采样器，通过估计策略在任务配置上的表现，将采样分布动态地集中在“策略能力前沿”附近的配置上，使训练聚焦于最有信息量的区域。该方法可与大规模并行仿真结合（实验中最多使用 2^20 即超过一百万个并行环境），并在学习后将操作策略蒸馏为基于 RGB 的策略。
AI.result: 在最多 2^20 个并行环境的实验中，SGS 使强化学习能够解决此前方法无法解决的多地形四足运动与接触密集型装配任务；蒸馏得到的 RGB 策略在真实硬件上实现若干高难度装配任务的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 均匀采样会随训练推进而降低批次内的学习信号利用率，限制了并行仿真扩展的收益。将采样集中到策略能力前沿的 SGS 能更充分地利用每批经验，使大规模并行强化学习更有效，并在仿真与真实硬件上均取得成功，表明自适应采样是减轻工程先验、提升规模化 sim-to-real 强化学习的关键一环。

title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
summary: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. We demonstrate the complete system on a real-world Unitree G1, where it successfully prevents unsafe motions in a variety of scenarios, including interactions with humans and objects.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的情境安全过滤（CSF），将自然语言安全规则落地为生成器的安全/不安全参考轨迹，通过仿射安全值与CBF-QP约束实现情境相关的运动安全过滤。
AI.motivation: 文本条件运动生成器能生成可追踪的全身运动，但缺乏场景相关的安全概念：同一动作针对物体或人时含义不同。现有防护手段或检查提示词、或依赖标注运动数据、或施加几何约束，均无法直接刻画场景上下文如何改变运动语义。
AI.method: CSF 是一种免训练过滤器：对每条激活规则，利用生成器产生的安全与不安全参考轨迹定义仿射安全值，并由"安全参考跟踪 CBF-QP"强制执行该约束。方法在四种不同架构的预训练生成器上验证，并部署于真实 Unitree G1 机器人。
AI.result: 在所有显式及场景触发的不安全案例中，CSF 均能激活对应规则，将危险事件率最多降低 90%，同时保留 88–100% 的良性运动；在真实 Unitree G1 上成功阻止了多种场景（含与人、物体交互）中的不安全运动。
AI.conclusion: CSF 无需训练、不依赖标注数据，可直接将自然语言安全规则与生成器输出结合，实现情境感知的安全过滤，在多种架构生成器和真实机器人上均有效。

title: Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks: Diverse Quadruped Skills via Combined Reinforcement and Imitation Learning with Adversarial Task Selection
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled legged robots to perform a range of skills in single-task settings. However, applications such as farm robotics or space exploration require diverse skills such as locomotion, digging, or close-range surveying. Training an end-to-end policy to address this problem remains difficult due to challenges such as sample inefficiency and gradient conflict between tasks in multi-task learning. We propose a three-stage method that trains a single policy to perform distinct tasks such as walking, digging, and hopping, and compose them into novel behaviors such as crawling. First, multiple teacher policies are trained using RL on narrowly defined tasks. Then, two additional stages train a student policy with a multi-teacher distillation setup that uses a combined RL and Imitation Learning (IL) objective under an adversarial task selection process that focuses training on the worst-performing task. With this method, we train a student policy that performs 22 tasks using 8 teachers. Evaluations show our method preserves motion quality and tracks commands more accurately than PPO and distill-then-finetune baselines, and in some cases generalizes to new tasks without explicit training. Finally, we demonstrate real-world robustness by deploying the resulting policy on a Unitree B1 quadruped. Video: https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA

AI.tldr: 本文提出三阶段方法训练单一策略完成22种不同行为，通过多教师蒸馏、RL与IL联合目标及对抗式任务选择缓解多任务学习中的梯度冲突，并在Unitree B1四足机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 农业机器人、太空探索等应用需要行走、挖掘、近距离探测等多种技能，而端到端多任务策略训练面临样本效率低与任务间梯度冲突的难题。
AI.method: 三阶段：先用RL训练多个针对窄任务的教师策略；再以多教师蒸馏训练学生策略，采用RL与模仿学习结合的联合目标，并引入对抗式任务选择机制，将训练聚焦于表现最差的任务；最终用8个教师训练出执行22个任务的学生策略。
AI.result: 相比PPO和distill-then-finetune基线，所提方法更好地保持运动质量并更准确地跟踪指令，部分情况下可零样本泛化到新任务；并在Unitree B1四足机器人上完成真实部署验证鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多教师蒸馏结合RL/IL联合目标与对抗式任务选择，可有效训练单策略执行多任务并组合出新行为（如爬行），具备仿真到真实世界的迁移能力。

title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
summary: Hair stroking is common in daily grooming and personal care, and is also widely used in hair-product evaluation, motivating robots with similar physical interaction capabilities. Existing robotic hair-care and surface-following methods mainly rely on trajectory planning, compliance, force regulation, or tactile-conditioned policies, but deformable hair can remain in contact while gradually drifting across the end-effector, making local interaction difficult to regulate. We propose TacHair, a tactile contact-distribution guided online correction framework that represents high-resolution tactile observations as a spatial hair-contact distribution. A visuotactile imitation policy generates the nominal stroking motion, while a separately trained residual module corrects local contact deviations, separating task progression from contact recovery. We evaluate TacHair in 525 real-robot trials across five head geometries and three hair conditions. A successful stroke requires both sufficient task progression and contact maintenance; our method improves success from 42.9% to 62.3% and contact maintenance from 59.4% to 88.0% over the same visuotactile policy without correction. These results demonstrate spatial tactile contact distributions as an effective feedback representation for contact-preserving interaction with deformable and visually occluded surfaces. Demos, code, and datasets are available at https://tachair.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出TacHair：以高分辨率触觉接触分布为反馈的在线修正框架，将视觉触觉模仿策略（名义梳理运动）与残差修正模块解耦，在五种头型、三种发况共525次真实机器人试验中将成功率由42.9%提升至62.3%，接触维持率由59.4%提升至88.0%。
AI.motivation: 毛发抚摸常见于日常梳理与个人护理，也广泛用于发用品评测，因而需要具备类似物理交互能力的机器人。现有机器人护发与表面跟随方法主要依赖轨迹规划、柔顺控制、力调节或触觉条件策略，但可变形毛发可能在接触过程中逐渐在末端执行器上漂移，使局部接触状态难以调节，导致任务推进与接触维持相互冲突。
AI.method: TacHair是一个触觉接触分布引导的在线修正框架：将高分辨率触觉观测表征为空间毛发接触分布；由视觉触觉模仿策略生成名义梳理运动，另设独立训练的残差模块修正局部接触偏差，从而将任务推进与接触恢复解耦。
AI.result: 在525次真实机器人试验中，覆盖五种头部几何形状与三种毛发状态。成功梳理需同时满足充分任务推进与接触维持；相比无修正的同一视觉触觉策略，成功率由42.9%提升至62.3%，接触维持率由59.4%提升至88.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，空间触觉接触分布是一种有效反馈表征，可用于与可变形且视觉遮挡表面的保接触交互。演示、代码与数据集见 https://tachair.github.io。

title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
summary: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair. A masked generative transformer generates discrete trajectory candidates in parallel, and Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) uses scene geometry to target where to edit and which prior-supported alternatives to evaluate. This turns refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring beyond local trajectory deformation. MGMP achieves 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Controlled Route Invalidation on Kuka, exceeding the strongest external baselines by 23 and 25 percentage points, respectively. It further generalizes to unseen layouts, additional obstacles, unseen geometries, single- and dual-arm planning, and real-world Baxter tasks.

AI.tldr: MGMP将掩码生成式Transformer与几何引导的令牌搜索（GGTS）结合，把学习到的轨迹先验从并行生成扩展到结构级修复，实现路径层面的重构，在多项任务上大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式运动规划器仅在初始生成阶段依赖学习到的轨迹先验，测试时修复仍依赖局部连续精修，只能做局部轨迹形变，难以进行路径层面的结构调整。
AI.method: 提出Masked Generative Motion Planning（MGMP）：由掩码生成式Transformer并行生成离散轨迹候选；再用Geometry-Guided Token Search（GGTS）借助场景几何决定编辑位置以及评估哪些先验支持的替代方案，从而把修复过程转化为离散运动替代方案上的高效搜索。
AI.result: 在Ring Maze上达到96%成功率，在Kuka的Controlled Route Invalidation上达到82%修复成功率，分别超过最强外部基线23和25个百分点；并可泛化到未见布局、额外障碍物、未见几何、单臂与双臂规划以及真实Baxter任务。
AI.conclusion: 将修复视为离散运动替代方案上的搜索，可突破局部形变限制，实现结构级路径重构，且具备良好的泛化性与真实机器人适用性。

title: TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception
summary: Navigation in vision-denied environments is challenging for humanoid robots because proprioceptive odometry drifts and localization uncertainty accumulates rapidly. We present TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework that enables humanoid navigation toward a goal by actively probing surrounding structures without relying on vision. TAPNAV maintains a pose belief from odometry, IMU, and tactile contact observations, and couples uncertainty-aware global route planning with information-gain-driven local probing. The global planner searches for routes that keep predicted localization uncertainty bounded by exploiting opportunities for tactile correction, while the local planner selects probe actions that maximize expected information gain. A whole-body controller coordinates the humanoid's locomotion and end-effector contact to execute the planned navigation and probe motions. We evaluate TAPNAV in simulation and on a Unitree G1 across different floor plans and obstacle geometries. TAPNAV achieves lower state estimation error and a higher task completion rate than baselines. These results demonstrate that actively planning physical interactions with the environment can provide localization cues for reliable humanoid navigation without vision.

AI.tldr: 提出TAPNAV：一种面向人形机器人的触觉主动感知导航框架，在无视觉环境下通过主动探测周围结构实现目标导航。
AI.motivation: 视觉受限环境中，人形机器人的本体感受里程计漂移严重、定位不确定性快速累积，导致导航困难，需寻找不依赖视觉的定位线索。
AI.method: 维护由里程计、IMU与触觉接触观测构成位姿信念；将不确定性感知全局路径规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测相结合：全局规划器利用触觉修正机会使预测定位不确定性有界，局部规划器选择最大化期望信息增益的探测动作；全身控制器协调运动与末端执行器接触，执行导航与探测动作。
AI.result: 在仿真与Unitree G1真机上，针对不同户型与障碍物几何进行评测，TAPNAV相比基线取得更低的状态估计误差和更高的任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: 主动规划与环境的物理交互可为无视觉人形导航提供定位线索，实现可靠导航。

title: Same Action, Different Outcome: Variability in Dynamic Cloth Manipulation
summary: Although cloth is known to exhibit different outcomes under repeated fast dynamic motions, even when the same trajectory is applied, this variability has not yet been systematically characterized. Quantifying it is essential to assess the reliability of learned manipulation policies and the extent to which simulation can reproduce real-world behavior. To study this, we execute the same trajectory ten times across four dynamic tasks, two of which are novel, each tested with three cloths of very different properties and at up to three execution speeds, with a total of 269 recorded rollouts. For all of them, we record small marker positions on the cloth and synchronized stereo camera. We then formalize different metrics to quantify variability, and our results show how it is significant in every test condition, in most cases one to three orders of magnitude above the repeatability inherent to the robot and sensing noise. Our results also show variability is driven mainly by the cloth physical properties but also grows with speed. By replaying all the rollouts in four calibrated modern cloth simulators, we show that none of them can reproduce the variability magnitude we observed in real cloth, nor its ordering. Together with our analysis, we publish the dataset with synchronized OptiTrack, vision and robot logs and their corresponding simulator twins.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了布料在重复快速动态操作下的结果可变性，通过269次滚动画实验量化其幅度与驱动因素，并评估四种现代布料模拟器的再现能力。
AI.motivation: 布料在相同轨迹的重复快速动态操作下会呈现不同结果，但这种可变性此前未被系统刻画。量化该可变性对评估学习型操作策略的可靠性、以及判断仿真能否复现真实世界行为至关重要。
AI.method: 在4个动态任务（含2个新任务）上多次执行同一轨迹，使用3种性质差异显著的布料、最高3种执行速度，共记录269次滚动画；在布料上布置小型标记点并用同步立体相机记录；形式化定义多种可变性度量指标；再将全部滚动画在4个经过标定的现代布料模拟器中回放对比。
AI.result: 可变性在所有测试条件下均显著存在，多数情况比机器人自身重复性及传感噪声高一到三个数量级；可变性主要由布料物理属性驱动，并随速度增大而增长。四种模拟器均无法复现真实布料可变性的幅度，也无法复现其排序关系。
AI.conclusion: 重复快速动态布料操作的结果可变性普遍且显著，现有布料模拟器在可变性建模上存在明显不足；作者同时发布了同步OptiTrack、视觉与机器人日志及其对应模拟器孪生数据集，以支持后续研究。

title: Skill-SLM: Agent Skill-driven Small Language Models for Reliable Robot Operation
summary: Small language models (SLMs) have been increasingly adopted for onboard robot operation because they enable intelligent decision-making. However, existing approaches are mainly distillation-oriented and rely on enumerating representative task-solution pairs. This makes dataset construction difficult and limits generalization to diverse robot tasks whose possible forms grow rapidly. This paper proposes Skill-SLM, a framework that reformulates SLM-driven robot operation as a task-decomposition and skill-composition problem. Given a natural language task instruction, Skill-SLM decomposes the task into subtasks, selects appropriate skills from the skill library, and orchestrates the selected skills into executable robot operations. First, to support the skill-driven workflow, we propose a novel robot operational skill aware context-free grammar (CFG) to extract the skills required to accomplish tasks and build the skill library accordingly. Then, we configure LLM teachers to induce and synthesize training datasets for the SLMs, enabling SLMs to decompose tasks and orchestrate skills reliably. Additionally, we employ a progressive skill orchestration strategy to improve the reliability of skill implementation and overall robot operation. Experiments on UAV operation tasks indicate that Skill-SLM substantially outperforms distillation-oriented baselines, especially on unseen tasks that require generalization of capabilities. Additional experiments on ground vehicle tasks further demonstrate that Skill-SLM can be applied to different robot platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Skill-SLM框架，将SLM驱动的机器人操作重构为任务分解与技能组合问题，通过技能感知CFG构建技能库、LLM教师合成训练数据、渐进式技能编排策略，在无人机与地面车辆任务上显著优于蒸馏导向基线，尤其在新任务泛化上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有SLM驱动机器人操作的方法多为蒸馏导向，依赖枚举代表性"任务-解决方案"对来构建数据集，导致数据集构建困难，且难以泛化到形式快速增长的多样机器人任务。
AI.method: Skill-SLM将自然语言任务指令分解为子任务，从技能库中选择合适技能，并编排为可执行的机器人操作。具体包括：(1)提出机器人操作技能感知的上下文无关文法（CFG），用于提取任务所需技能并据此构建技能库；(2)配置LLM教师诱导并合成训练数据集，使SLM可靠地完成任务分解与技能编排；(3)采用渐进式技能编排策略提升技能执行与整体操作的可靠性。
AI.result: 在无人机（UAV）操作任务上，Skill-SLM显著优于蒸馏导向基线，尤其在需要能力泛化的未见任务上优势明显；在地面车辆任务上的额外实验进一步证明其可迁移至不同机器人平台。
AI.conclusion: Skill-SLM通过任务分解与技能组合的范式，摆脱了对枚举式任务-解决方案对的依赖，提升了SLM驱动机器人操作的可靠性与跨任务、跨平台的泛化能力。

title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
summary: The diversity of robot embodiments and action spaces makes it challenging to build robot world models that generalize across different embodiments. We introduce the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM), which operates within a learned unified latent action space shared across diverse embodiments. This unified action space improves the world model's performance when adapted to previously unseen robot embodiments. We compare LAC-WM with an Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model (EAC-WM), which conditions on explicit motion labels. Our results show that explicit action conditioning leads to disjoint action representations across embodiments, limiting downstream performance when adapting to new robots. We evaluate both models on dexterous manipulation tasks and a modified LIBERO benchmark. LAC-WM improves downstream performance over EAC-WM by up to 46.7% on dexterous manipulation and 11.7% on LIBERO. Crucially, the unified latent action space allows LAC-WM's downstream performance to scale positively with the number of embodiments used during pretraining. In contrast, the disjoint action space in EAC-WM leads to decreased performance as the number of pretraining embodiments increases. These results highlight the importance of a unified action space for efficient cross-embodiment learning, addressing a key challenge in robotics. Project website: https://lacwm.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出LAC-WM，在统一潜在动作空间中学习机器人世界模型，实现跨具身泛化，性能显著优于显式动作条件模型。
AI.motivation: 机器人具身形态与动作空间多样，导致世界模型难以跨具身泛化，如何构建可迁移的世界模型是机器人领域的核心挑战。
AI.method: LAC-WM在跨多样具身共享的学习型统一潜在动作空间内运作；对比基线EAC-WM则以显式运动标签作为条件。两者在灵巧操作任务和修改版LIBERO基准上评估，并考察预训练具身数量对下游性能的影响。
AI.result: LAC-WM下游性能比EAC-WM最高提升46.7%（灵巧操作）和11.7%（LIBERO）；随预训练具身数量增加，LAC-WM性能正向扩展，而EAC-WM因动作表征彼此不相交而性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 统一动作空间对高效的跨具身学习至关重要，可有效应对机器人领域的关键挑战。

title: OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video
comment: The project page is available at https://hydrofoooil.github.io/OmniHOI/
summary: Monocular videos of human manipulation provide abundant dexterous demonstrations, yet reconstructing hand-object interaction from a single view and transferring it to robot hands remain difficult, limiting their direct use for robot execution. Prior methods either require task-specific RL training, limiting scalability, or assume clean motion-capture trajectories and thus cannot operate directly on video. We present OmniHOI, a pipeline that turns an RGB video of hand-object interaction into an interaction-faithful trajectory on dexterous hands. The key idea is to enforce physical consistency using the evidence available at each stage: image evidence during reconstruction, contact geometry during retargeting, and dynamics during physics-in-the-loop refinement. Each stage optimizes the corresponding representation directly, correcting errors before they propagate downstream or must be absorbed by a learned policy. Across 150 motion-capture trajectories transferred to each of five dexterous hands with 6 to 22 DoF, we achieve 39-89% success, compared with at most 31% for prior transfer methods. On 60 monocular video clips, we achieve 53% success, compared with 28% for the best prior video-to-robot pipeline. Its trajectories also execute on a real bimanual robot across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: OmniHOI是一种将单目RGB人手-物体交互视频转化为灵巧手可执行轨迹的流水线，通过分阶段引入物理一致性证据（重建用图像、重定向用接触几何、精炼用动力学），在150条动捕轨迹和60段单目视频上分别达到39-89%和53%的成功率，显著优于现有方法，并在真实双臂机器人上完成多样任务。
AI.motivation: 人手操作的单目视频提供了丰富的灵巧演示，但从单视图重建手-物交互并迁移到机器人手仍很困难，限制了其直接用于机器人执行。现有方法要么需要任务专用的强化学习训练（可扩展性差），要么假设运动捕捉轨迹干净，无法直接处理视频。
AI.method: OmniHOI在每个阶段利用当时可得的证据来强制物理一致性：重建阶段使用图像证据，重定向阶段使用接触几何，物理在环精炼阶段使用动力学。每个阶段直接优化对应表示，在下游误差传播或被学习策略吸收之前先行纠正。
AI.result: 在迁移到五种灵巧手（6至22自由度）的150条动捕轨迹上，成功率为39-89%，而先前迁移方法最高仅31%。在60段单目视频片段上成功率为53%，而最佳先前视频到机器人流水线为28%。其轨迹也在真实双臂机器人上跨多样任务执行。
AI.conclusion: 通过分阶段以对应证据强化物理一致性，OmniHOI有效弥合了单目视频理解与机器人灵巧操作执行之间的差距，无需任务专用训练即可在真实硬件上实现可靠的交互保真轨迹迁移。

title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification
summary: Sampling-based system identification estimates physically meaningful parameters by tuning a simulator to reproduce the target system dynamics, providing an interpretable approach to improving sim-to-real transfer. Yet when the collected trajectories do not distinguish the effects of different parameters, multiple parameter combinations can reproduce those trajectories, leading to unreliable parameter estimates. To address this challenge, we introduce an Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design framework (IDTD), which formulates the objective for the exploration policy built on the Schur complement score derived from the Fisher information matrix. To faithfully reflect parameter separability in the exploration objective, IDTD normalizes the score against the per-parameter information, selects the most favorable trajectory segment for each parameter, and aggregates the resulting scores logarithmically. The optimized trajectory is therefore composed of complementary intervals, each exposing a distinct subset of parameters whose contribution to the motion over that interval can be attributed unambiguously. Across diverse simulation environments, ranging from a linear-dynamics system to the Go2 quadruped, G1 humanoid, and Crazyflie quadrotor, IDTD reduces the parameter identification error by 39.6% on average relative to the strongest prior active-exploration baseline and attains improved downstream policy transfer. Furthermore, we validate the proposed trajectory design on a real K1 humanoid, demonstrating that the resulting identified parameters accurately capture the real-system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出信息解耦轨迹设计框架IDTD，基于Fisher信息矩阵的Schur补分数构建探索目标，结合逐参数归一化、最优轨迹段选择与对数聚合，设计出由互补区间组成的轨迹，使各参数贡献可明确归因，从而缓解采样式系统辨识中的参数不可辨识问题。
AI.motivation: 采样式系统辨识通过调节仿真器复现目标系统动力学来估计具有物理意义的参数，是可解释地提升sim-to-real迁移的手段。但当采集轨迹无法区分不同参数的影响时，多个参数组合都能复现同一轨迹，导致参数估计不可靠，因此需要主动设计能分离参数效应的探索轨迹。
AI.method: 提出IDTD框架：以Fisher信息矩阵导出的Schur补分数作为探索策略的目标；为忠实反映参数可分性，对分数按逐参数信息进行归一化，为每个参数选择最有利的轨迹段，并对所得分数进行对数聚合。优化后的轨迹由互补区间构成，每个区间暴露一个可无歧义归因的参数子集。
AI.result: 在多种仿真环境中验证，涵盖线性动力学系统、Go2四足机器人、G1人形机器人和Crazyflie四旋翼；相对最强的先前主动探索基线，参数辨识误差平均降低39.6%，并取得更好的下游策略迁移效果。进一步在真实K1人形机器人上验证轨迹设计，辨识所得参数能准确刻画真实系统动力学。
AI.conclusion: IDTD通过信息解耦的轨迹设计有效提升参数可辨识性与估计精度，并在多仿真环境及真实人形平台上验证了其改善下游策略迁移和真实动力学刻画的能力。

title: iAm.md: Robot Skill Self-Assessment through Agentic Introspection for Unknown Open-Vocabulary Domains
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 13th Italian Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (AIRO 2026). Project page: https://yurimachine.github.io/iAm.md/
summary: Agentic AI based on Large Language Model generalization capabilities offers a wide range of potential applications, including planning for embodied tasks. For example, embodied agents based on Foundation models can generate plausible plans in autonomous robotics scenarios. Due to limited context windows or hallucinatory phenomena in the next-token prediction formulation, behaviors may be generated without establishing whether the deployed robot and the observed environment actually support the requested operation, in what we call a "grounding failure". Thanks to the recent improvements in reasoning capabilities of foundation models, autonomous robot behavior generation problem can be formulated as a code generation problem. We present iAm.md, a Markdown standard and generation framework, that allows anchoring this process in complementary forms of deployment evidence. Through open-vocabulary semantic mapping, we combine local vision-language detections and object segmentation and refer them to persistent object records in this intermediate standardized representation, allowing agentic introspection. We then study this new technique on a simulated TIAGo, on navigation-and-manipulation tasks, showing how this standardized representation jointly supports skill self-assessment and executable task generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 iAm.md——一种 Markdown 标准与生成框架，将自主机器人行为生成形式化为代码生成问题，并通过开放词汇语义建图把视觉-语言检测与物体分割锚定到持久化的标准化对象记录中，实现智能体自省，从而缓解"grounding failure"。在仿真的 TIAGo 上针对导航与操作任务的实验表明，该表示可同时支持技能自评估与可执行的任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型和基础模型的具身智能体虽能生成合理计划，但受限于有限的上下文窗口以及下一词预测带来的幻觉现象，生成的行为可能未验证实际机器人与环境是否支持所请求的操作，即产生"grounding failure"（接地失败）。因此需要一种能将行为生成锚定在部署证据上的机制。
AI.method: 借助基础模型推理能力的提升，将自主机器人行为生成问题形式化为代码生成问题。提出 iAm.md——一种 Markdown 标准与生成框架，通过开放词汇语义建图，融合本地视觉-语言检测与物体分割结果，并将其关联到该中间标准化表示中的持久化对象记录，从而支持智能体自省。
AI.result: 在仿真的 TIAGo 机器人上，针对导航与操作任务开展实验，结果显示该标准化表示能够同时支撑技能自评估（skill self-assessment）与可执行的任务泛化（executable task generalization）。
AI.conclusion: iAm.md 通过将行为生成锚定于互补形式的部署证据，有效缓解 grounding failure 问题，验证了标准化中间表示在具身智能体行为生成中的价值，为技能自评估与任务泛化提供统一支撑。

title: ActiveReg: Information-Driven Active Regional Probing for Partial-to-Full Bone Registration
summary: Accurate bone registration is essential for orthopedic surgical navigation and robotic assistance. In a common workflow, the surgeon needs to identify and probe a number of prescribed locations on the exposed bone surface to obtain data points for registration, which can be difficult and time-consuming under limited surgical exposure. Reducing the number of required points while providing clear probing guidance would ease the surgeon's acquisition task intra-operatively. We present ActiveReg, a closed-loop framework that recommends probing regions rather than individual points, allowing flexibility in the exact contact location. A D-optimal planner that takes into account the already acquired points and the uncertainty of current registration information helps achieve accurate registration with fewer points. An online assessment combines pre-update innovation consistency with uncertainty at predefined surgical task locations improves the reliability of completion decision, without requiring ground truth. Simulations across four anatomical scenarios demonstrated that ActiveReg can achieve competitive accuracy compared with baseline registration methods while using substantially fewer acquired points. Real phantom experiments with optical and electromagnetic tracking demonstrated comparable mean target registration error to the Gradient-SDF framework, using only 24-28 acquired points instead of 771-1263.

AI.tldr: 提出ActiveReg闭环框架，通过推荐探测区域而非单点、D-最优规划与在线评估，在显著减少配准点数的同时保持精度。
AI.motivation: 骨科手术导航与机器人辅助中，骨配准需要术者在暴露的骨面上识别并探测若干预定位置以获取数据点，在有限手术暴露下难以操作且耗时；因此希望在提供清晰探测引导的同时减少所需点数。
AI.method: ActiveReg为闭环框架：推荐探测区域而非具体单点，允许接触位置灵活；采用D-最优规划器，考虑已获取点与当前配准信息的不确定性；在线评估结合预更新新息一致性与预定义手术任务位置处的不确定性，无需真值即可改进完成判定。
AI.result: 在四个解剖场景仿真中，ActiveReg以显著更少的采集点达到与基线配准方法相当的精度；光学与电磁跟踪的真实体模实验中，其平均目标配准误差与Gradient-SDF框架相当，但仅用24–28个点，而非771–1263个点。
AI.conclusion: ActiveReg可在减少术中探测负担的同时实现高精度骨配准，区域级推荐与闭环在线评估提升了临床可用性与完成决策可靠性。

title: A Reconfigurable Fabric Based Pneumatic Actuator with Button Fastened Constraint Modules for Multi Mode Actuation
summary: Soft pneumatic actuators are widely used in soft robotics. However, their actuation modes are typically fixed by internal chamber designs or reinforcements, making post fabrication reconfiguration difficult. This paper presents a reconfigurable fabric-based pneumatic actuator that enables rapid, tool free, and reusable switching among multiple actuation modes by attaching constraint fabric modules to a buttoned textile sleeve. By rearranging low-stretch constraint parts on a single actuator body, the proposed system realizes four actuation modes isotropic expansion, contraction, bending, and twisting without redesigning or disassembling the actuator.We further introduce an attachable capacitive fabric-based tactile sensor module that can be mounted at arbitrary locations on the actuator surface for task dependent contact sensing. Experiments demonstrated an elongation ratio of 1.2, a maximum bending angle of approximately 60 degrees, and a twisting angle of approximately 90 degrees at 24 kPa, while achieving blocking forces exceeding 10 N across all modes. The tactile sensor exhibited a monotonic, force-dependent increase in capacitance with low hysteresis (approximately 12%) and stable cyclic responses under preload. Finally, we constructed soft robotic arms composed of multiple actuators and demonstrated in situ motion reconfiguration for grasping by changing the attached constraint patterns. These results indicate that the proposed modular constraint and sensing framework improves the functional adaptability of fabric-based soft robots while preserving a simple, robust actuator structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可重构织物气动执行器：通过将约束织物模块贴附于带扣织物套筒，可在不重新设计或拆装的情况下，在等向膨胀、收缩、弯曲和扭转四种驱动模式间快速、免工具、可重复切换，并集成可贴附电容式织物触觉传感器。
AI.motivation: 软气动执行器的驱动模式通常由内部腔体设计或增强结构固定，制造后难以重构，限制了功能适应性与任务复用性。作者希望在不改变执行器主体结构的前提下，实现驱动模式的可重构与任务相关的接触感知。
AI.method: 在带扣织物套筒上贴附低拉伸约束织物模块，通过重新排布约束件实现多种驱动模式切换；并引入可贴附式电容织物触觉传感器模块，可安装于执行器表面任意位置进行接触力感知。基于多执行器构建软体机械臂，验证原位运动重构抓取。
AI.result: 24 kPa下伸长率1.2、最大弯曲角约60°、扭转角约90°，各模式阻塞力均超过10 N；触觉传感器电容随力单调增加，迟滞低（约12%），预载下循环响应稳定。
AI.conclusion: 模块化约束与传感框架在保持执行器结构简单、鲁棒的同时，提升了织物软体机器人的功能适应性，可实现原位运动重构与抓取。

title: Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction
summary: Autonomous navigation in cluttered and constrained environments typically assumes a fixed environment and searches only for paths within existing free space. However, a route can be blocked by an articulated structure, a movable object, or a pedestrian, and reaching the goal may therefore require appropriate embodied interaction with the environment. This paper formulates Path-Creative Navigation (PCN), a navigation paradigm in which the robot recovers free space by coordinating locomotion and embodied interaction, and addresses one class of PCN tasks with a mapless framework. The vision-LiDAR-odometry framework integrates local observations, obstacle geometry, and robot-state estimates through a unified navigation system, providing stable semantic and geometric information for navigation and interaction. The traversability-aware decision method utilizes visual and LiDAR distance information to determine whether a blockage is actionable and whether it can be safely bypassed, enabling the robot to interact only when necessary while supporting articulated structure pushing, movable object pushing, obstacle avoidance, and pedestrian requests. We design simulation scenarios and evaluate different methods in both simulation and two real-world tasks that cannot be completed by conventional navigation alone without embodied interaction. These results demonstrate that our framework achieves higher task completion than the baseline methods by coordinating navigation and interaction in cluttered and constrained environments. Code is available at:{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/path-creative-navigation/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"路径创造型导航"(Path-Creative Navigation, PCN)新范式,让机器人通过协调运动与具身交互来开辟自由空间,并给出一个无地图的视觉-激光雷达-里程计框架来求解该类任务。
AI.motivation: 传统自主导航假设环境固定、只在既有自由空间中搜索路径。但路径可能被铰接结构、可移动物体或行人阻塞,此时到达目标必须与环境进行恰当的具身交互,而现有方法无法处理这类需要"创造"自由空间的场景。
AI.method: 提出无地图框架:视觉-激光雷达-里程计集成系统,融合局部观测、障碍物几何与机器人状态估计,为导航与交互提供稳定的语义与几何信息;并提出可通行性感知决策方法,利用视觉与激光雷达距离信息判断阻塞是否可被处置、能否安全绕行,使机器人仅在必要时交互,支持铰接结构推挤、可移动物体推挤、避障与行人请求。
AI.result: 设计了仿真场景,并在仿真及两个必须依赖具身交互才能完成的真实任务中评估多种方法;结果表明该框架通过协调导航与交互,在杂乱受限环境中的任务完成率高于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 协调运动与具身交互的PCN框架在杂乱受限环境中优于纯导航基线,验证了"创造自由空间"这一导航范式的可行性与有效性;代码已开源。

title: FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment
summary: Vision-based reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation is sample-inefficient because RGB-D observations are high-dimensional and noisy. Privileged state information available in simulation can accelerate training, but its absence at test time creates a train-test modality gap. We propose FOCUS, a single-stage PPO framework that trains the critic on privileged state while automatically regulating whether the actor collects rollouts from RGB-D or privileged-state latents. Regulation is driven by the KL divergence between the action distributions induced by the two modalities, while representation alignment encourages consistent action selection across them. Together, these mechanisms limit RGB-D rollouts when the actor's action distributions from RGB-D and privileged-state latents disagree. As they align, RGB-D exposure increases, shifting on-policy training toward the RGB-D inputs used at test time. Across five manipulation tasks, FOCUS raises average test success from 0.71 to 0.93 relative to the strongest RGB-D-at-test baseline on each task. When accounting for each method's complete training pipeline, budget-normalized training-success AUC increases from 0.47 to 0.65. On Pick-and-Place, test success rises from 0.47 to 0.86, while AUC increases from 0.12 to 0.61, a 5.0x improvement in learning efficiency over the fixed interaction budget.

AI.tldr: FOCUS：单阶段PPO框架，critic用特权状态训练，actor的rollout模态由两模态动作分布KL散度自动调节，配合表征对齐，缓解RGB-D与特权状态的训练-测试模态差距，五个操作任务平均测试成功率0.71→0.93。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的机器人操作强化学习因RGB-D观测高维且含噪而样本效率低；仿真中的特权状态信息可加速训练，但测试时不可用，造成训练-测试模态差距（train-test modality gap）。
AI.method: FOCUS为单阶段PPO框架：critic在特权状态上训练；actor是否用RGB-D或特权状态隐变量采集rollout，由两种模态诱导的动作分布之间的KL散度自动调节，同时用表征对齐鼓励跨模态动作选择一致。当两模态动作分布不一致时限制RGB-D rollout，随其对齐则增加RGB-D暴露，使on-policy训练逐步转向测试时使用的RGB-D输入。
AI.result: 五个操作任务上，平均测试成功率相对各任务最强"测试用RGB-D"基线从0.71提升至0.93；计入完整训练流程、预算归一化的训练-成功率AUC从0.47升至0.65。Pick-and-Place任务测试成功率0.47→0.86，AUC 0.12→0.61，固定交互预算下学习效率提升5.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过KL散度驱动的rollout模态自适应调度与跨模态表征对齐，FOCUS在不引入多阶段复杂流程的前提下有效弥合训练-测试模态差距，显著提升测试成功率与学习效率。

title: Distributed Relative Localization Based on Ultra-WideBand and LiDAR for Multi-robot with Limited Communication
comment: This paper has been published in IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
summary: Relative localization is crucial for a multi-robot system to collaboratively perform tasks, such as exploration and formation. However, this is highly challenging for homogeneous robots with similar appearance in GPS-denied and communication-limited environments. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative position estimation approach for a team of robots based on onboard UWB and LiDAR sensors, in which LiDAR is utilized to obtain the position of anonymous objects in Line-of-Sight (LOS), and UWB is used for ranging between robots. We construct two graphs, namely UWB connection graph and LiDAR connection graph, to represent the spatial relationship among objects (robots and obstacles) based on UWB and LiDAR measurements. Identification and relative position estimation are formulated as a common subgraph matching problem. A falsely-matched robot identification approach is designed to recognize the falsely-matched results caused by obstacle blockage in LiDAR field of view. These robots are then localized by leveraging the well-matched robots and the UWB ranging measurements in the UWB connection graph. We conducted experiments to evaluate the performance of our approach. The results show that the proposed approach is capable of achieving satisfactory positioning accuracy for a team of robots in a distributed manner with only exchanging limited information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于机载UWB与LiDAR的全分布式相对定位方法，将机器人识别与相对位置估计建模为公共子图匹配问题，并设计误匹配识别机制以应对LiDAR视场遮挡。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同任务（如探索与编队）依赖相对定位，但在GPS拒止、通信受限环境下，外观相似的同构机器人难以实现相对定位。
AI.method: 利用LiDAR获取视距内匿名物体的位置，UWB用于机器人间测距；构建UWB连接图与LiDAR连接图表示机器人及障碍物间的空间关系；将识别与相对位置估计形式化为公共子图匹配问题；设计误匹配机器人识别方法，检测由LiDAR视场遮挡导致的误匹配，并借助已正确匹配的机器人与UWB连接图中的测距信息对其进行定位。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在仅交换有限信息的情况下，能够以分布式方式为机器人团队取得令人满意的定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在GPS拒止、通信受限环境中实现同构多机器人的全分布式相对定位，并对LiDAR遮挡引起的误匹配具有鲁棒性。

title: PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning
summary: Robotic manipulation often contains repeated motions whose local observations look similar at different phases. When these phases require different actions, a policy that relies mainly on the current observation may repeat completed motions or switch phases at the wrong time. To address this phase ambiguity, we present the Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module (PMTRM), a lightweight plug-in module with only 7.61M parameters that encodes a bounded history of executed states and actions into a latent sequence for existing policies. To help distinguish phases, a temporal heterogeneity objective penalizes positive similarity between distant positions in this sequence, while anchor and reconstruction losses preserve information needed for action prediction. The reconstruction decoder is used only during training, leaving the temporal re-encoder to supply history to the policy at inference. We train the module progressively on synthetic sequences and robot data, then jointly with the policy, using temporal masking to accommodate partial histories. This integration retains the original action head and action space and adds auxiliary losses to the original policy loss. Experiments with multiple policy backbones in simulation and on a real robot show improved task success on tasks with phase ambiguity, with little additional computation.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量即插即用模块PMTRM（仅7.61M参数），将执行过的状态-动作历史编码为潜在序列供现有策略使用，缓解机器人操作中因局部观测相似导致的相位歧义问题。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作常包含重复运动，不同相位下的局部观测高度相似，但所需动作不同。仅依赖当前观测的策略容易重复已完成动作或在错误时机切换相位，即"相位歧义"问题。
AI.method: PMTRM将有限长度的执行状态与动作历史编码为潜在序列，并引入时间异质性目标（惩罚序列中远距离位置之间的正相似度）以区分相位，同时用锚点损失与重构损失保留动作预测所需信息；重构解码器仅在训练时使用。训练采用渐进策略：先在合成序列与机器人数据上训练，再与策略联合训练，并使用时间掩码以适应不完整历史。集成时保留原有动作头与动作空间，仅在原策略损失上增加辅助损失。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人上，配合多种策略骨干网络进行实验，在存在相位歧义的任务上提升了任务成功率，且额外计算开销很小。
AI.conclusion: PMTRM作为一种轻量、即插即用的时序重编码模块，可有效缓解相位歧义，提升现有策略在重复性操作任务中的表现，并具有良好的通用性与计算效率。

title: Higher-Order Action Supervision Makes A Strong Policy Class
summary: Modern data-driven decision-making methods, such as imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL), have achieved great success in solving many complex tasks. However, these methods often suffer from serious control instability and robustness issues when applied in real-world applications such as robotics and autonomous driving, posing notable challenges for their practical deployment. We argue that this instability issue stems largely from their limitations in solely supervising and optimizing zeroth-order actions (i.e., the action labels), failing to account for higher-order action dynamics and temporal consistency. In this paper, we show that simultaneously supervising both zeroth- and first-order actions can dramatically enhance policies' performance and control robustness. To achieve this, we introduce a novel and elegant loss scheme supported by formal theoretical guarantees that can equip any off-the-shelf policy model (e.g., deterministic, stochastic, or flow policies) with the capability for higher-order action supervision, without requiring any structural modifications. Moreover, our proposed method can serve as a lightweight plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates with a broad spectrum of existing offline RL frameworks. Extensive evaluations on OGBench and D4RL demonstrate that our approach yields substantial performance and robustness improvements across a wide range of continuous control environments. Notably, our method can also enhance policies' out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability in the challenging low-data regime, making it an ideal tool in tackling many real-world control problems.

AI.tldr: 本文指出IL与RL等数据驱动决策方法在真实场景中控制不稳定，根源在于仅监督零阶动作标签；提出同时监督零阶与一阶动作的损失方案，理论上有保证、结构上免修改、可插拔兼容离线RL框架，在OGBench与D4RL上显著提升性能、鲁棒性与OOD泛化。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习与强化学习在复杂任务上表现优异，但在机器人、自动驾驶等真实应用中存在严重的控制不稳定与鲁棒性问题，阻碍实际部署。作者认为该问题主要源于现有方法仅对零阶动作（动作标签）进行监督与优化，忽视了高阶动作动态与时间一致性。
AI.method: 提出一种新的损失方案，可同时对零阶和一阶动作进行监督。该方案具备形式化理论保证，能在不做任何结构修改的前提下，为任意现成策略模型（确定性、随机性或流策略）赋予高阶动作监督能力；同时作为轻量级即插即用模块，可与多种现有离线RL框架无缝集成。
AI.result: 在OGBench和D4RL上的大量实验表明，该方法在广泛连续控制环境中带来显著的性能与鲁棒性提升；在具有挑战性的低数据 regime 下还能增强策略的分布外（OOD）泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通同时监督零阶与一阶动作可显著提升策略性能与控制鲁棒性；所提方法通用、免结构改动、即插即用，是应对真实世界控制问题的理想工具。

title: Demonstrating Arena 5.0: A Photorealistic ROS2 Simulation Framework for Developing and Benchmarking Social Navigation
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures. Published at Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2025
summary: Building upon the foundations laid by our previous work, this paper introduces Arena 5.0, the fifth iteration of our framework for robotics social navigation development and benchmarking. Arena 5.0 provides three main contributions: 1) The complete integration of NVIDIA Isaac Gym, enabling photorealistic simulations and more efficient training. It seamlessly incorporates Isaac Gym into the Arena platform, allowing the use of existing modules such as randomized environment generation, evaluation tools, ROS2 support, and the integration of planners, robot models, and APIs within Isaac Gym. 2) A comprehensive benchmark of state-of-the-art social navigation strategies, evaluated on a diverse set of generated and customized worlds and scenarios of varying difficulty levels. These benchmarks provide a detailed assessment of navigation planners using a wide range of social navigation metrics. 3) Extensive scenario generation and task planning modules for improved and customizable generation of social navigation scenarios, such as emergency and rescue situations. The platform's performance was evaluated by generating the aforementioned benchmark and through a comprehensive user study, demonstrating significant improvements in usability and efficiency compared to previous versions. Arena 5.0 is open source and available at https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav.

AI.tldr: Arena 5.0 是机器人社会导航开发与基准测试框架的第五代版本，整合 NVIDIA Isaac Gym，提供高保真仿真、SOTA 策略基准测试与可定制场景生成，并通过基准实验和用户研究验证其可用性与效率提升。
AI.motivation: 在前几代工作的基础上，社会导航研究亟需更真实高效的仿真环境、标准化且覆盖多难度的策略对比基准，以及可灵活定制的场景与任务规划能力，以支撑开发与公平评测。
AI.method: 1) 将 NVIDIA Isaac Gym 完整集成进 Arena 平台，复用随机环境生成、评估工具、ROS2 支持以及规划器、机器人模型与 API；2) 构建覆盖多难度生成/定制世界与场景的 SOTA 社会导航策略综合基准，采用多维度社会导航指标评估；3) 开发大规模场景生成与任务规划模块，支持应急、救援等场景定制。
AI.result: 通过构建上述基准以及一项综合用户研究进行平台性能评估，结果显示相比此前版本在可用性与效率上有显著提升。平台已开源（https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav）。
AI.conclusion: Arena 5.0 通过 Isaac Gym 集成、系统化基准与可定制场景生成，形成了更高效、易用且可扩展的社会导航开发与评测平台，为后续研究与标准化评测提供基础。

title: SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Large-scale, diverse datasets have driven the success of LLMs and VLMs. But VLAs for robotics remain limited by the cost and complexity of real-world data collection. While simulation offers a scalable alternative, its potential for sim-to-real VLA learning in mobile manipulation remains largely underexplored. We introduce SimVLA, an end-to-end framework that trains VLAs entirely on synthetic simulation data without teleoperation for mobile manipulation. SimVLA is first pre-trained on two complementary simulation-derived datasets: SimAction, a large-scale robot action dataset spanning 35 diverse mobile manipulation tasks, generated by composing atomic skills, and SimVQA, which leverages privileged simulator state to provide spatial, geometric, and subtask-level visual-language supervision. We further post-train SimVLA on a mixture of SimAction and SimDeploy, a dataset collected from policy rollouts across diverse simulated environments. We evaluate SimVLA on tasks including restocking, pouring, and cleaning, and show zero-shot transfer to real-world mobile manipulation, including real home environments. SimVLA outperforms policies trained on 50 in-domain real-world demonstrations, suggesting that simulation can enable scalable sim-to-real mobile manipulation. We further demonstrate the value of multiple complementary forms of supervision for effectively leveraging simulation in VLA training.

AI.tldr: SimVLA是一个完全基于合成仿真数据训练、无需遥操作的端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，面向移动操作任务，实现了零样本仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移。
AI.motivation: 面向机器人的VLA受限于真实世界数据采集的成本与复杂度；仿真虽可提供可扩展的替代方案，但在移动操作的sim-to-real VLA学习中的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出SimVLA端到端框架，完全用合成仿真数据训练、无需遥操作。先在两个互补数据集上预训练：SimAction（通过组合原子技能生成、覆盖35种移动操作任务的大规模机器人动作数据集）与SimVQA（利用仿真器特权状态提供空间、几何及子任务级视觉-语言监督）；再利用SimAction与SimDeploy（来自多样化仿真环境中策略rollout采集的数据集）的混合数据进行后训练。
AI.result: 在补货、倒水、清洁等任务上评估，实现包括真实家庭环境在内的零样本sim-to-real迁移，性能优于用50条域内真实世界演示训练的策略；并验证了多种互补监督形式对有效利用仿真进行VLA训练的价值。
AI.conclusion: 仿真可支撑可扩展的sim-to-real移动操作，多种互补监督形式有助于在VLA训练中充分发挥仿真数据的作用。

title: Distributed Relative Localization for Homogeneous Multi-Robot Systems through UWB Ranging and Limited Communications
comment: This paper has been published in IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Accurate and reliable relative localization is crucial for multi-robot applications like exploration, search, and rescue missions. LiDAR-based solutions offer high accuracy in localizing surrounding objects; however, distinguishing homogeneous robots with similar appearances remains challenging due to the lack of distinctive identification features. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative pose estimation approach by integrating LiDAR, UWB, and odometry measurements, allowing each robot to accurately and continuously localize its teammates without external infrastructure. Specifically, potential anonymous teammate robot clusters from LiDAR scans are tracked by a dynamic tracker. We then identify teammate robots from these tracked anonymous clusters using a joint matching strategy, ensuring reliable data association between robots and clusters. Finally, by combining the corresponding LiDAR observations, UWB ranging, and odometry measurements, each robot precisely localizes others while minimizing data exchange. The system requires only odometry data exchange through onboard UWB, eliminating the need for additional communication infrastructure like WiFi routers or mesh networks. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed relative localization approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合LiDAR、UWB与里程计的全分布式相对位姿估计方法，使各机器人无需外部基础设施即可持续、精确地定位同伴，并通过仿真与实机实验验证了其有效性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人探索、搜索与救援等任务依赖精确可靠的相对定位。LiDAR方案对周围物体定位精度高，但对外观相似的同构机器人缺乏可区分特征，难以实现鲁棒的数据关联；同时现有方案常依赖外部基础设施或额外通信网络。
AI.method: 1) 由LiDAR扫描提取潜在的匿名同伴机器人簇，并用动态跟踪器进行跟踪；2) 采用联合匹配策略从跟踪到的匿名簇中辨识同伴机器人，保证机器人与簇之间可靠的数据关联；3) 融合对应的LiDAR观测、UWB测距与里程计信息，在最小化数据交换的前提下精确估计他人位姿；4) 系统仅通过机载UWB交换里程计数据，无需WiFi路由器或mesh网络等额外通信基础设施。
AI.result: 大量仿真与真实世界实验证明了所提出的相对定位方法的有效性与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该全分布式相对位姿估计方案能够在无外部基础设施条件下实现同构多机器人间准确且连续的对同伴定位，且通信开销极低、易于部署。

title: USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation
summary: Geometrically faithful and functional articulated 3D assets are essential for real-to-sim robot manipulation, where policies trained in simulation must transfer to physical objects. Recent mesh-based methods learn to infer articulation from annotated 3D assets, but deployment remains challenging when real-world objects fall outside the training distribution or their meshes are incomplete or corrupted. To address these limitations, we formulate articulated asset reconstruction as programmatic modeling grounded in partial geometric evidence and introduce USDCraft, a framework in which a pretrained LLM writes and revises executable programs for simulation-ready articulated assets without task-specific training. We propose source geometry analysis, which converts the source mesh into a metric textual description that distinguishes observed surface from unknown space, and iterative geometric rechecking, which re-encodes each candidate in the same representation so that discrepancies point to program edits while unobserved regions remain open to completion. Visual feedback and physical authoring guidance complete the modeling process, which produces articulated USD assets with explicit physical properties that load into Isaac Sim without manual adjustment. Experiments demonstrate leading articulation recovery on two benchmarks and validate USDCraft's effectiveness for real-to-sim-to-real robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 USDCraft 框架，用预训练 LLM 编写并迭代修改可执行程序，将带部分几何证据的铰接资产重建为可供 Isaac Sim 直接加载的 USD 资产，无需任务特定训练。
AI.motivation: 真实到仿真（real-to-sim）机器人操作需要几何忠实、功能正确的铰接 3D 资产，以便仿真中训练的策略能迁移到真实物体。现有基于网格的方法依赖标注资产学习铰接推断，当真实物体超出训练分布，或网格不完整、损坏时，部署效果差。
AI.method: 将铰接资产重建表述为以部分几何证据为基础的程序化建模，无需任务特定训练。两个核心组件：(1) 源几何分析，把源网格转换为度量化的文本描述，区分已观测表面与未知空间；(2) 迭代几何复核，用同一表示重新编码每个候选方案，使差异指向程序编辑，而未观测区域保持可补全。结合视觉反馈与物理创作指导，最终生成带显式物理属性的铰接 USD 资产。
AI.result: 在两个基准上取得领先的铰接恢复性能，并验证了 USDCraft 在 real-to-sim-to-real 机器人操作中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: USDCraft 以 LLM 驱动的程序化建模替代基于网格的学习式重建，在网格不完整或分布外场景下具有更好鲁棒性，产出的铰接 USD 资产可直接在 Isaac Sim 中无手动调整加载，支撑真实到仿真再到真实的机器人操作流程。

title: Rewiring Semantics, Dynamics, and Control: A Simple yet Effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent framework for complex robotic manipulation, building on the strong semantic understanding of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, such VLM backbones offer insufficient physical dynamics priors, which limits the generalization capabilities of robot policies. Recent efforts therefore integrate video-generation World Models (WMs) into robot policies through various strategies, using predictive dynamics to facilitate action generation. Despite these advances, harnessing semantic understanding and dynamics prediction as complementary guidance for action generation remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce $\mathrm{ACT}^3$, a simple yet effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer that fuses semantic and dynamics information into control actions while preserving the distinct roles of context streams. Specifically, $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ enables the dedicated action expert to access VLM and WM representations through layerwise attention, with each backbone attending only within its own stream. This straightforward interaction design maintains independent forward propagation in the context streams while allowing both backbones to be updated through control supervision. Experiments on both simulated and real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks show that the proposed $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ yields results superior to its counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出ACT³三流Transformer结构，在保持VLM与WM各自上下文流独立前向传播的同时，通过逐层注意力让专用动作专家融合语义与动力学表征，从而提升机器人操作策略的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: VLA模型依赖预训练VLM的语义理解能力，但缺乏物理动力学先验，限制了机器人策略的泛化。已有工作尝试引入视频生成的World Model提供预测性动力学，但如何将语义理解与动力学预测作为互补指导同时用于动作生成仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出ACT³（Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer）：由VLM流、WM流与动作专家流构成的三流结构。动作专家通过逐层注意力（layerwise attention）访问VLM与WM的表征，而两个骨干网络仅在各自流内进行注意力计算。该交互设计保持上下文流的独立前向传播，同时使两个骨干均能通过控制监督信号更新。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界机器人操作基准上，ACT³均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 以动作为中心、保留上下文流独立性的三流融合方式，可有效将语义理解与动力学预测作为互补信息注入动作生成，是一种简单而有效的VLA增强方案。

title: Experience-Guided Initiation Search for Learned Skills in Skill Composition
summary: Deploying frozen learned skills, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, in new environments requires identifying initiation configurations that support reliable execution. In skill composition, an initiation configuration affects not only the current skill but also the physical state passed to subsequent skills, so successful execution of an individual skill does not necessarily imply successful completion of the composed task. Estimating target-specific capability through extensive rollouts is costly in real-world deployment, while directly reusing historical experience can be unreliable under environment changes. We propose EVIS, an Experience-Guided and Behavior-Validated Initiation Search framework for discovering reliable initiation configurations under limited target interaction. EVIS uses historical execution experience to prioritize promising candidates and target-environment behavior to validate whether they remain effective. We evaluate EVIS on single-skill and two-stage manipulation tasks with frozen VLA policies. EVIS reduces mean target-environment queries and improves reliable candidate discovery under small interaction budgets. These results show that combining historical guidance with target-side behavioral validation can reduce the interaction cost of deploying frozen learned skills in new environments.

AI.tldr: EVIS：一种经验引导与行为验证的初始化配置搜索框架，用于在有限目标环境交互下发现可靠的初始化配置，降低冻结VLA策略部署的交互成本。
AI.motivation: 在新环境中部署冻结的VLA策略需要找到可靠的初始化配置。技能组合中初始化配置不仅影响当前技能，还影响传递给后续技能的物理状态，因此单技能成功不代表组合任务成功。真实部署中大量rollout代价高昂，而直接复用历史经验在环境变化下不可靠。
AI.method: EVIS利用历史执行经验对候选初始化配置进行优先级排序，并通过目标环境中的行为验证其是否仍然有效，从而在有限交互预算下搜索可靠配置。
AI.result: 在冻结VLA策略的单技能和两阶段操作任务上评估，EVIS减少了平均目标环境查询次数，并在小交互预算下提升了可靠候选的发现能力。
AI.conclusion: 结合历史引导与目标侧行为验证，可降低在新环境中部署冻结学习技能的交互成本。

title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
summary: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. Building on this, we propose Execution-Aware Learning (EAL), which combines Monte Carlo tree search with Q-learning to distill these outcomes into family-conditioned values. At deployment, the coordinator selects the policy family according to observable context, and the frozen coding agent generates the next local code block. Comprehensive single-episode evaluations on 100 tasks show that RoboAware reaches a 77.0% overall success rate, with SOTA averages of 90.0% on RoboSuite, 73.8% on diverse LIBERO-Pro task clusters, and 90.0% on challenging RoboTwin bimanual tasks, outperforming existing code-as-policy and VLA-harness baselines.

AI.tldr: RoboAware 通过从反事实结果中学习状态条件化的“责任协调器”，在编码智能体已有技能编排能力之上，实现模块化机器人技能与冻结端到端策略的有效组合，在100个任务的单回合评估中达到77.0%的整体成功率。
AI.motivation: 具身编码智能体虽可组合模块化机器人技能与冻结的端到端策略，但有效组合的前提是能预判当前物理状态下哪种策略族会成功。现有工作缺乏这种状态条件化的预测能力，也缺少反事实分支结果数据——仅凭被选中分支的执行经验无法观测到其他候选家族的结果。
AI.method: 提出 P^5 模式将技能统一组织为五个语义阶段，并据此构建分层 MDP，定义责任可比较的位置；引入 State-Locked Counterfactual Branching（SCB），将相同训练状态恢复后分别从各可行家族生成并执行代码块，暴露被选中分支经验未观察到的反事实结果；提出 Execution-Aware Learning（EAL），结合蒙特卡洛树搜索与 Q-learning 将这些结果蒸馏为家族条件价值。部署时协调器依据可观测上下文选择策略族，冻结的编码智能体生成下一个局部代码块。
AI.result: 在100个任务上的综合单回合评估显示，RoboAware 总体成功率达77.0%；RoboSuite 平均90.0%，多样 LIBERO-Pro 任务簇73.8%，高难度 RoboTwin 双臂任务90.0%，均优于现有 code-as-policy 与 VLA-harness 基线。
AI.conclusion: 仅学习状态条件化的责任协调器，即可在无需微调冻结策略的前提下提升技能组合的成功率，为编码智能体的技能编排提供了有效的反事实学习框架。

title: DAMP: Humanoid Locomotion via Denoised Belief Learning and Adversarial Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid robots possess the structural capability to traverse complex terrains. However, achieving stable t raversal without relying on perceived information remains challenging, particularly in complex environments. This paper introduces DAMP, a reinforcement learning framework aimed at achieving robust and naturalistic humanoid locomotion over challenging terrains, with the assumption that no perceived information is available. The framework leverages recurrent neural networks to capture temporal dependencies and implicitly infer privileged and other task-relevant latent information. By aligning the learned representations with the task objective, the method enables robust and goal-consistent policy learning. This end-to-end framework achieves transfer learning from simulation to real-world environments, demonstrating the proposed method's robustness and generalization capabilities. The video of the real-world demonstration can be found at the following link: https://youtu.be/AkI7TZB2DDM.

AI.tldr: 提出 DAMP 强化学习框架，在不依赖感知信息的前提下，利用循环神经网络隐式推断特权与任务相关潜在信息，实现人形机器人在复杂地形上稳健且自然的运动，并完成仿真到真实环境的迁移。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人具备穿越复杂地形的结构能力，但在无感知信息条件下实现稳定穿越仍很困难，尤其是在复杂环境中。因此作者希望在假设无感知信息可用的前提下，实现稳健且自然的运动。
AI.method: DAMP 采用强化学习框架，使用循环神经网络捕捉时间依赖关系，隐式推断特权信息及其他任务相关的潜在信息；通过使所学表征与任务目标对齐，实现稳健且目标一致的政策学习；整体为端到端框架。
AI.result: 该端到端框架实现了从仿真到真实环境的迁移学习，验证了所提方法的稳健性与泛化能力，并提供了真实世界演示视频链接。
AI.conclusion: 在无感知信息假设下，DAMP 能够支持人形机器人在复杂地形上实现稳健、自然且目标一致的运动，并具备从仿真迁移到真实环境的能力。

title: RAGNAROK: Radar-Aided Gravity-Normalized Alignment for Robust Open Keyframe-based Radar-Visual-Kinematic-Inertial SLAM
summary: Legged robots offer superior mobility in unstructured environments, but reliable operation in such conditions requires robust state estimation. To address the vulnerability of proprioceptive estimators in rough terrain, recent methods have incorporated radar to provide velocity measurements. However, their limited yaw observability still leads to drift, and failure-aware fusion for adverse environments remains underexplored. In this letter, we present RAGNAROK, the first radar-visual-kinematic-inertial SLAM designed for robust operation in challenging environments. It integrates slip- and rolling-contact-aware leg velocity estimation, a kinematics-aware radar factor, and degradation-aware image enhancement. We further incorporate a B-spline-based radar-aided proprioceptive backbone, adaptive weighting, and online extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets demonstrate that RAGNAROK achieves robust performance under challenging conditions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/hanjun815/RAGNAROK.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGNAROK，首个面向复杂环境的雷达-视觉-运动学-惯性SLAM系统，用于提升腿足机器人在非结构化地形下的鲁棒状态估计。
AI.motivation: 腿足机器人虽在非结构化环境中机动性强，但可靠运行依赖鲁棒的状态估计；现有本体感知估计器在崎岖地形易失效，引入雷达提供速度测量后偏航可观测性仍有限导致漂移，且面向恶劣环境的失效感知融合研究不足。
AI.method: 集成滑动与滚动接触感知的腿部速度估计、运动学感知雷达因子、退化感知图像增强；并引入基于B样条的雷达辅助本体感知骨干、自适应加权与在线外参标定。
AI.result: 在公开与自采数据集上的大量实验表明，RAGNAROK在复杂条件下具有鲁棒表现，并优于现有最先进基线。源码与数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 多模态雷达-视觉-运动学-惯性融合与退化感知机制可有效提升腿足机器人在复杂环境下的SLAM鲁棒性。

title: SDPAD: A Fully Spike-Driven Pipeline for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving demands trajectory planners that are both highly accurate and cheap enough for edge deployment. State-of-the-art artificial neural network (ANN) planners meet the accuracy requirement at the cost of heavy dense computation, while spiking neural networks (SNNs)---though promising orders-of-magnitude energy savings through sparse, event-driven arithmetic---still lag far behind in planning accuracy. We present \textbf{SDPAD}, a fully spike-driven end-to-end planning pipeline that closes this gap. SDPAD converts a pre-trained ANN perception stack into integer-spike form via quantized ANN2SNN conversion, lifts multi-view images into the bird's-eye-view (BEV) space with a spike-driven-max (SDM) depth distribution (Spike-3D-Lift), and plans through the Spike-QFormer, a spiking query transformer in which ego, agent, and map queries distilled from the BEV scene are fused by learnable waypoint queries via cross-attention, followed by deformable spike-cross-attention refinement. Every operation is gated by integer spikes and inference is a single feed-forward pass without temporal simulation loops. On the nuScenes open-loop benchmark, SDPAD achieves an average $L_2$ error of 0.40\,m and a collision rate of 0.12\%, on par with strong ANN planners while consuming 69.9\,mJ---less than 2\% of recent ANN baselines. In closed-loop evaluation on the NAVSIM navtest split, SDPAD reaches 86.3 PDMS, surpassing the previous SNN planner SAD by 4.3 points and matching mainstream ANN planners at a fraction of their energy. To our knowledge, SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven planner evaluated in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating that SNNs can rival dense ANNs in complex driving tasks.

AI.tldr: SDPAD是首个全脉冲驱动的端到端规划流水线，通过量化ANN2SNN转换、脉冲3D提升(BEV)和Spike-QFormer规划器，在nuScenes开环和NAVSIM闭环基准上以远低于ANN的能耗达到与主流ANN规划器相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶要求轨迹规划器兼顾高精度与边缘部署的低成本。现有ANN规划器精度高但稠密计算开销大；SNN虽可通过稀疏事件驱动计算实现数量级节能，但规划精度远落后于ANN。因此需要弥合这一精度-能耗鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出SDPAD全脉冲驱动端到端规划流水线：(1)通过量化ANN2SNN转换将预训练ANN感知栈转为整数脉冲形式；(2)Spike-3D-Lift用脉冲驱动的最大深度分布(SDM)将多视角图像提升到BEV空间；(3)Spike-QFormer脉冲查询Transformer，将BEV场景蒸馏出的ego、agent、map查询经可学习路点查询通过交叉注意力融合，并用可变形脉冲交叉注意力精炼。所有操作用整数脉冲门控，推理为单次前馈，无时间仿真循环。
AI.result: nuScenes开环基准：平均L2误差0.40m，碰撞率0.12%，与强ANN规划器相当，能耗仅69.9mJ（不足近期ANN基线2%）。NAVSIM navtest闭环评测：86.3 PDMS，超此前SNN规划器SAD 4.3分，并以极低能耗匹配主流ANN规划器。
AI.conclusion: SDPAD是首个在端到端自动驾驶中评估的全脉冲驱动规划器，证明SNN可在复杂驾驶任务中媲美稠密ANN。

title: Acting from Belief, Looking When Needed: A Bayesian Spatial World Model for Navigation under Intermittent Perception
summary: Robot navigation commonly uses wide-coverage, high-frequency sensing to reduce partial observability; this reliance becomes restrictive when another task temporarily redirects a shared sensor from navigation, interrupting navigation-relevant observations. We study navigation under intermittent perception: acting from an internal spatial belief and looking again only when execution needs a new observation, potentially freeing the shared sensor for other tasks between navigation observations. ALONE, a Bayesian spatial world model, propagates a structured spatial belief using executed actions and corrects it with selectively acquired observations; learned priors over common geometric structures infer unobserved structure from available observation history. It decodes the belief into a spatial estimate for the motion-planning module and predicts a reliability map expressing confidence in the estimate's accuracy. ALONE requests an observation only if insufficient reliability hinders navigation and new evidence should make relevant-region spatial information more reliable; otherwise, it continues acting from the propagated belief. We instantiate ALONE for drone navigation with intermittent single-camera depth images. Across two simulated scene families, it achieves 98% and 97% closed-loop success at a 10 Hz decision rate. Among successful trials, median fractions of decision steps requiring a new depth observation are only 0.9% and 1.3%, respectively, demonstrating high navigation success with substantially reduced observation demand. Real-world indoor flight experiments further validate navigation under intermittent depth observations, with all 10 trials successful.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"间歇感知"下的机器人导航问题，提出ALONE——一个贝叶斯空间世界模型，通过传播结构化空间信念并按需选择性获取观测，在显著降低观测需求的同时保持高导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航通常依赖宽覆盖、高频率的传感来降低部分可观测性，但当其他任务临时征用共享传感器时，这种依赖会中断导航相关观测。因此需要一种能在间歇感知条件下仍可自主运行的导航方法，从而释放共享传感器供其他任务使用。
AI.method: 提出ALONE（贝叶斯空间世界模型）：(1) 利用已执行动作传播结构化空间信念，并用选择性获取的观测进行校正；(2) 通过关于常见几何结构的可学习先验，从既有观测历史推断未观测结构；(3) 将信念解码为空间估计供运动规划模块使用，并预测表达估计准确度置信度的可靠性图；(4) 仅当可靠性不足且新证据应能提升相关区域空间信息可靠性时，才请求新观测，否则继续基于传播信念行动。在无人机导航上以间歇单目相机深度图像实例化。
AI.result: 在两个仿真场景族中，以10 Hz决策率分别取得98%和97%的闭环成功率。在成功试验中，需要新深度观测的决策步数中位比例仅为0.9%和1.3%。真实室内飞行实验中，全部10次试验均成功，验证了间歇深度观测下的导航能力。
AI.conclusion: ALONE能够在间歇感知条件下实现高导航成功率，并大幅降低观测需求，表明机器人可在共享传感器被其他任务占用时依据内部空间信念自主行动，从而有效释放共享传感器资源。

title: Learning Language-Conditioned Traversability Representations for Adaptive Visual Navigation
summary: Traversability is essential for visual navigation but varies with robot capabilities and user preferences. Conventional pipelines often rely on explicit costmaps or segmentation masks with predefined criteria, requiring hand-crafted rules and careful tuning. Moreover, viewpoint-dependent segmentation masks complicate asynchronous planning under perception latency. We present LaTraNav, a framework that learns language-conditioned traversability representations for adaptive visual navigation. Its asynchronous architecture combines a slow vision-language model that produces latent representations of traversability and navigation goals, with a fast flow-matching planner conditioned on these representations. To train the system, we develop a simulation-based data generation pipeline with controllable trajectories, producing observations paired with language instructions, traversability maps, goal locations, and diverse trajectories. Photorealistic image translation further enhances visual realism. Evaluations on datasets from multiple sources demonstrate effective language-guided traversability segmentation and goal localization by the slow VLM, alongside adaptive pixel-space path planning by the fast planner. Latent conditioning improves planning performance over explicit segmentation masks, while asynchronous scheduling increases the path-update rate by $6.05\times$ at the same semantic-update rate.

AI.tldr: 提出LaTraNav框架，学习语言条件下的可通行性表征，实现自适应视觉导航，异步架构结合慢速VLM与快速流匹配规划器，路径更新率提升6.05倍。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉导航依赖显式代价地图或预定义标准的分割掩码，需手工规则与精细调参；且分割掩码依赖视角，在感知延迟下难以支持异步规划，无法适应不同机器人能力与用户偏好。
AI.method: LaTraNav采用异步架构：慢速视觉语言模型（VLM）生成可通行性与导航目标的潜在表征，快速流匹配规划器以这些表征为条件进行像素空间路径规划。训练上构建基于仿真的可控轨迹数据生成流水线，产出与语言指令、可通行性图、目标位置及多样轨迹配对的观测，并通过真实感图像转换增强视觉真实性。
AI.result: 在多来源数据集上验证：慢速VLM能有效完成语言引导的可通行性分割与目标定位，快速规划器实现自适应像素空间路径规划；潜在条件表征优于显式分割掩码，异步调度在相同语义更新率下将路径更新率提升6.05倍。
AI.conclusion: LaTraNav通过学习语言条件下的可通行性潜在表征并结合异步快慢架构，克服了显式分割掩码的局限，实现了自适应、高效的语言引导视觉导航。

title: Scalable LEO Conjunction Screening using Adaptive Synthetic-Covariance Thresholds
summary: As orbital populations grow, conjunction screening must search more object pairs for potential collision risks. Existing pipelines use early-stage filters, such as an apsis filter, to eliminate pairs whose orbital altitude ranges cannot produce a close approach. However, these filters apply the same fixed threshold to every object, making the screening unnecessarily conservative for well-constrained objects while potentially insufficient for objects with greater orbit-prediction uncertainty. In this work, we present an uncertainty-aware conjunction screening method that replaces a single fixed apsis threshold with object-specific thresholds derived from propagated radial uncertainty. The resulting thresholds vary across both objects and prediction time, becoming narrower when propagated uncertainty is small and wider when uncertainty grows. We pair this adaptive screening rule with a binary-search altitude sweep that makes resulting heterogeneous intervals efficient to evaluate at catalog scale with log-linear search complexity. We evaluate the method on 33,791 objects from the Space-Track General Perturbations (GP) catalog using the preceding eight public ephemeris snapshots and a seven-day prediction horizon. The adaptive sieve retains 162.8 million candidate pairs, reducing the candidate set by 28.78% relative to a fixed 50 km apsis threshold and by 71.48% relative to brute-force all-pairs screening. It retains all close approaches identified in two independently propagated reference sets. At the largest tested catalog size, the binary-search sweep is 27 times faster than exhaustive interval evaluation while returning the same candidate set. These results demonstrate that uncertainty-aware screening can substantially reduce the candidate burden passed to downstream conjunction analysis, providing a scalable path toward managing increasingly large and heterogeneous orbital populations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的交会筛选方法，用基于传播径向不确定性的对象特定阈值替代固定近地点阈值，并结合二分搜索高度扫描实现对数线性复杂度的高效评估。
AI.motivation: 随着在轨目标数量增长，交会筛选需检索更多对象对。现有流程中的早期过滤器（如近地点/远地点过滤）对每个对象使用相同固定阈值：对轨道约束良好的对象过于保守，而对轨道预测不确定性较大的对象又可能不足。
AI.method: 用由传播径向不确定性导出的对象特定阈值取代单一固定近地点阈值；阈值随对象和预测时间变化，不确定性小时变窄、增大时变宽。并将该自适应筛选规则与二分搜索高度扫描配对，使生成的异质区间能以对数线性搜索复杂度在编目尺度上高效评估。
AI.result: 在Space-Track GP编目的33,791个对象上，使用前八个公开星历快照及七天预测时域评估。自适应筛保留1.628亿候选对，相比固定50 km近地点阈值减少28.78%，相比暴力全对筛选减少71.48%，并保留两个独立传播参考集识别出的所有近距离接近。在最大测试编目规模下，二分搜索扫描比穷举区间评估快27倍且返回相同候选集。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，不确定性感知筛选可显著降低传递给下游交会分析的候选负担，为管理日益庞大且异质的在轨目标群提供可扩展路径。

title: YOCO: You Only Calibrate Once! Fast Mocap Calibration for Dexterous Teleoperation
summary: Dexterous teleoperation requires reliable human-hand state estimations. However, common low-cost motion-capture gloves and markerless trackers often exhibit biases that vary across users, glove fit, and recording sessions, degrading retargeting and demonstration quality. We present YOCO, a fast few-shot, fine-tuning-free calibration framework that corrects biased hand-pose streams from a small set of paired raw and target poses. Instead of optimizing a separate model for every operator or session, YOCO conditions a calibration HyperNet on the paired examples and predicts LoRA-style updates for a frozen MANO hand-estimation module, turning per-user calibration into a lightweight feed-forward adaptation step while preserving the geometric prior of MANO and the efficiency of a compact estimator. We train YOCO with synthetic drift augmentations on InterHand2.6M and evaluate on augmented InterHand sequences, offline real glove data, and dexterous teleoperation tasks. Across these settings, YOCO improves calibration efficiency, hand-state estimation quality and teleoperation performance compared with uncalibrated input and standard calibration baselines.

AI.tldr: YOCO：一种快速少样本、免微调的手部姿态校准框架，通过HyperNet预测LoRA式更新，实现跨用户/会话的轻量前馈校准。
AI.motivation: 低成本动捕手套与无标记追踪器存在随用户、手套适配度和录制会话变化的偏差，损害重定向与示教质量，需要高效且可靠的按用户手部状态校准方案。
AI.method: 利用少量成对的原始姿态与目标姿态，用校准HyperNet条件化地预测冻结MANO手部估计模块的LoRA式参数更新，将逐用户校准转化为轻量前馈适应，同时保留MANO几何先验与紧凑估计器效率；在InterHand2.6M上用合成漂移增强进行训练。
AI.result: 在增强的InterHand序列、离线真实手套数据及灵巧遥操作任务上评估，YOCO相较未校准输入与标准校准基线，在校准效率、手部状态估计质量和遥操作性能上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: YOCO以少样本、免微调方式有效校正有偏手部姿态流，兼顾精度与效率，可提升遥操作与示教质量。

title: From Solo to Ensemble: A Hierarchical Framework for Composable Multi-Agent Human-Object Interaction
summary: Physics-based human-object interaction has achieved robust single-agent manipulation skills, yet extending them to multi-agent cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches typically adapt interaction policies through task-specific fine-tuning, which entangles low-level contact-rich execution with high-level coordination and limits reuse across object geometries, interaction types, and team sizes. We propose a hierarchical framework that converts a single-agent HOI policy into a reusable Object-oriented Motion Skill. Specifically, we reinterpret teacher rollouts as object-oriented action supervision by extracting short-horizon object-proxy motions from executed trajectories, and distill task-specific teachers into a low-level skill operating in an Object-oriented Action Space. For downstream tasks, the distilled skill is frozen as a reusable executor, while a high-level policy coordinates multiple agents by generating region-wise object-oriented actions conditioned on the shared object, task goal, agent states, and local manipulation regions. This formulation shifts multi-agent HOI learning from direct contact-rich full-body control to compact object-level proxy-motion coordination. Experiments on diverse HOI tasks show that the distilled Object-oriented Motion Skill supports robust proxy-motion execution and enables composable policy learning across different interaction types, object geometries, and team sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层框架，将单智能体人-物交互(HOI)策略转化为可复用的"物体导向运动技能"，通过物体导向动作空间实现多智能体协作，无需任务特定微调即可泛化到不同物体几何、交互类型与团队规模。
AI.motivation: 基于物理的HOI在多智能体协作任务中仍具挑战性。现有方法通常依赖任务特定的微调来适配交互策略，导致低层接触丰富的执行与高层协调相互纠缠，限制了在物体几何、交互类型和团队规模上的复用。
AI.method: 提出分层框架：将教师rollout重新解释为物体导向的动作监督，通过从执行轨迹中提取短时域的物体代理运动；将任务特定教师蒸馏为在"物体导向动作空间"中运行的低层技能。下游任务中冻结该技能作为可复用执行器，高层策略基于共享物体、任务目标、智能体状态和局部操作区域生成区域级物体导向动作，从而将多智能体HOI学习从直接接触丰富的全身控制转为紧凑的物体级代理运动协调。
AI.result: 在多种HOI任务上的实验表明，蒸馏得到的物体导向运动技能支持稳健的代理运动执行，并能在不同交互类型、物体几何和团队规模上实现可组合的策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 该分层解耦范式将低层接触执行与高层协调分离，使单智能体HOI策略可复用为多智能体协作的技能模块，提升了跨任务、跨物体与跨团队规模的泛化与复用能力。

title: 2DGS-Planner: Rasterization-based Path Planning in 2D Gaussian Splatting Map
summary: Gaussian splatting provides an explicit and efficiently rasterizable scene representation for robot navigation. However, individual Gaussian primitives may not reliably represent obstacles as they are jointly optimized through alpha-composited rendering from a finite set of reconstruction views. We propose 2DGS-Planner, a path planner for ground robots that reads planning-relevant geometry from a 2D Gaussian splatting (2DGS) map through rasterization, rather than treating individual Gaussian primitives as obstacles. During offline roadmap construction, multi-view attribution converts rendered normal dispersion into structural scores for non-ground disks supported by the reconstruction views. These scores guide adaptive node sampling on the ground. Path-aligned orthographic queries validate candidate edges, while cylindrical queries estimate local clearance fields that are cached on the edges. During online planning, graph search initializes a route, and path refinement reuses the cached fields while accounting for the robot's dimensions and ground constraints. Experiments demonstrate improved roadmap connectivity, more accurate clearance estimation, and higher planning success compared with the tested baselines. These results support rasterization as an effective geometric query interface for planning directly on Gaussian maps. Code and data are available at https://2dgs-planner.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 2DGS-Planner：通过光栅化从 2D 高斯溅射地图中读取规划相关几何，而非将单个高斯基元视为障碍，用于地面机器人路径规划。
AI.motivation: 高斯溅射提供显式、可高效光栅化的场景表示，适合机器人导航；但单个高斯基元是通过有限重建视角下的 alpha 合成渲染联合优化的，因此其个体位置/形状不能可靠表示障碍物，直接以基元作为障碍会导致规划误差。
AI.method: 离线阶段：多视角归因（multi-view attribution）将渲染法向离散度转化为非地面圆盘的结构分数，用于引导地面上的自适应节点采样；路径对齐的正交查询（orthographic queries）验证候选边，柱面查询（cylindrical queries）估计局部间隙场并缓存于边上。在线阶段：图搜索初始化路线，路径细化复用缓存间隙场，同时考虑机器人尺寸与地面约束。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较基线方法，路网连通性更好、间隙估计更准确、规划成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将光栅化作为直接在 Gaussian 地图上规划的有效几何查询接口。

title: UltraLight Luma: A Novel Edge-Deployable Perception Network for Crop-Row Segmentation in Agricultural Robotics
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IECON 2026. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Reliable crop-row perception is essential for autonomous agricultural robots, but low-cost deployment is constrained by computation, memory, power, and inference time. This paper addresses crop-row detection and navigation-line extraction using UltraLight Luma, a compact encoder-decoder segmentation network with a progressive learning strategy and only 13.1k trainable parameters. The predicted crop-row masks are processed using a post-processing algorithm to estimate row alignment for downstream visual servoing. UltraLight Luma improves parameter efficiency over U-Net, YOLOv8, and YOLOv26 while maintaining reliable crop-row detection performance. The model required only 25.23 mJ per inference, demonstrating its suitability for resource-constrained agricultural robots.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 UltraLight Luma，一种仅 13.1k 可训练参数的紧凑编码器-解码器分割网络，结合渐进学习策略，用于作物行检测与导航线提取，并通过后处理算法估计行对齐以支持视觉伺服。模型在保持可靠检测性能的同时，参数效率优于 U-Net、YOLOv8 和 YOLOv26，单次推理仅耗 25.23 mJ。
AI.motivation: 可靠的作物行感知对自主农业机器人至关重要，但低成本部署受到计算能力、内存、功耗与推理时间的限制。现有模型（如 U-Net、YOLO 系列）在资源受限场景下参数与能耗开销较大，难以满足实际农业机器人的轻量化需求。
AI.method: 提出 UltraLight Luma——一种紧凑的编码器-解码器分割网络，仅含 13.1k 可训练参数，并采用渐进学习策略进行训练。网络输出作物行分割掩码后，通过后处理算法提取导航线，估计行对齐信息以支持下游视觉伺服控制。
AI.result: 在参数效率上优于 U-Net、YOLOv8 与 YOLOv26，同时保持可靠的作物行检测性能；单次推理能耗仅 25.23 mJ，表明其适用于资源受限的农业机器人平台。
AI.conclusion: UltraLight Luma 以极低参数量和能耗实现了可靠的作物行检测与导航线提取，验证了轻量化分割网络在资源受限农业机器人上低成本部署的可行性。

title: PathTime-VLA: Path-Time Decoupling for Factorized Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies typically predict actions at fixed time intervals, coupling the route a robot follows with its execution pace. This coupling complicates adaptation from teleoperation: useful geometric guidance comes with timing shaped by interface delays and operator behavior. Our key insight is to bring the path-time parameterization of classical motion planning into the learned action representation of a VLA. We introduce PathTime-VLA, which represents motion as a progress-indexed interaction path $X(s)$ and a positive interval-time profile. The latter defines a monotone time law $t(s)$, yielding controller commands $X(s(t))$. For a given path, alternative executions are expressed through the time profile, allowing chunk-wise speed choices without changing the geometric prediction target. This representation supports a staged post-training procedure: demonstrations and DAgger interventions establish a target-domain prior, Speed-DQN learns execution multipliers from robot interaction, and Path-AWR uses rollout outcomes to refine the diffusion path generator. A path-conditioned action expert realizes the resulting motions while maintaining distinct learning interfaces for path generation and execution timing. Across three tasks, the complete method achieves $58/60$ successes versus $57/60$ for PathTime-VLA under BC + DAgger at fixed $1\times$, with approximately $39$-$52\%$ shorter mean completion times over successful trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathTime-VLA，将经典运动规划中的路径-时间参数化引入VLA动作表示，把运动解耦为进度索引的交互路径X(s)与单调时间律t(s)，从而在不改变几何预测目标的前提下实现分块速度调节，并通过分阶段后训练（演示+DAgger先验、Speed-DQN执行倍率、Path-AWR路径精修）提升执行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在固定时间间隔预测动作，将机器人行驶路径与执行节奏耦合。这使遥操作数据难以适配：几何引导信息有用，但其时间特性受接口延迟与操作者行为影响，导致路径与速度无法独立学习与调整。
AI.method: 将运动表示为进度索引的交互路径X(s)和正值的区间时间剖面；时间剖面定义单调时间律t(s)，由控制器执行X(s(t))。同一路径下，不同执行方式仅通过时间剖面表达，实现分块速度选择而不改变几何预测目标。采用分阶段后训练：演示与DAgger干预建立目标域先验；Speed-DQN从机器人交互中学习执行倍率；Path-AWR利用rollout结果精修扩散路径生成器。路径条件动作专家负责实现运动，同时保持路径生成与执行定时的独立学习接口。
AI.result: 在三个任务上，完整方法取得58/60成功率，对比PathTime-VLA在BC+DAgger固定1×下的57/60；在成功试验中平均完成时间缩短约39%–52%。
