AI.conclusion: 通过解耦路径几何与执行时间，PathTime-VLA使VLA策略能够复用遥操作中的几何引导并独立优化执行节奏，在保持或略微提升成功率的同时显著缩短任务完成时间。

title: WAND: Learning Robust Navigation under Complex Wind Disturbances and Dense Obstacles for Quadrotors
summary: Robust navigation in cluttered environments remains a fundamental challenge for quadrotors, particularly when strong wind disturbances arise, which perturb vehicle dynamics, limit control authority, and substantially increase collision risk. Existing learning-based navigation policies typically rely on obstacle perception and proprioceptive observations, requiring the policy to infer time-varying disturbance effects implicitly and thereby limiting robustness under partial observability. This paper proposes WAND (Wind-Aware Navigation with Disturbance Estimation), a reinforcement learning framework for navigation under time-varying wind disturbances in dense obstacle fields. Specifically, WAND estimates wind-induced disturbance acceleration from historical proprioceptive states using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). This estimation is integrated into the policy via a zero-initialized residual module, \emph{WindAdapter}, while simultaneously providing feedforward compensation for low-level control. The dual use of the estimate couples disturbance-conditioned navigation with feedforward disturbance rejection. Across 12 wind-disturbed simulation settings, WAND improved the observed success rate by 8.3 percentage points on average relative to feedforward compensation alone. Controlled opposite-crosswind experiments further showed wind-direction-dependent trajectory adaptation. In indoor fan-induced flight tests, WAND succeeded in 18 of 20 trials, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time onboard navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出WAND强化学习框架，用TCN从本体感知历史估计风扰加速度，经零初始化残差模块WindAdapter融入策略并前馈补偿底层控制，实现密集障碍与变风扰下的鲁棒导航。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在杂乱环境中的鲁棒导航是基本难题，强风扰会扰动动力学、限制控制权限并显著提高碰撞风险。现有学习型导航策略多依赖障碍感知与本体感知观测，需隐式推断时变扰动效应，在部分可观测下鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: WAND先从历史本体感知状态用时间卷积网络（TCN）估计风致扰动加速度；该估计通过零初始化残差模块WindAdapter注入策略，同时用于底层控制的前馈补偿。估计量的双重使用将扰动条件化导航与前馈扰动抑制耦合起来。
AI.result: 在12种风扰仿真设置下，WAND相较仅前馈补偿平均提升观测成功率8.3个百分点；受控逆风交叉实验显示轨迹随风向自适应调整；室内风扇诱导飞行测试20次成功18次。
AI.conclusion: 显式估计风扰并结合策略调节与前馈补偿，可有效提升部分可观测下四旋翼在密集障碍中的抗风导航鲁棒性，并具备实时机载部署可行性。

title: STAG: A Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph Representation from Grid-Based Costmaps for Robotic Navigation
summary: Autonomous rovers navigating large unstructured environments need efficient global planning that accounts for terrain traversability. However, searching dense grid-based costmaps becomes computationally expensive as the mapped area grows. We introduce STAG, a Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph that converts costmaps into compact graphs. STAG combines a medial-axis topological backbone, representative nodes for homogeneous traversability regions, and transition nodes near strong traversability gradients. Edges encode geometry and traversability to account for path length and terrain difficulty. We compare A* on STAG and dense grids using synthetic cave maps, mine maps and the DARPA CERBERUS dataset. Across five benchmark categories comprising 203 map instances and 101,200 queries, STAG reduces median planning time by 3.4x to 9.9x and peak query memory by 2.1x to 15.4x, with median relative path-length differences of -2.9% and +7.6%. STAG offers a compact representation for global planning, trading dense-grid traversability optimality for faster, less memory-intensive search.

AI.tldr: STAG将稠密代价地图转换为稀疏可通行性感知图，在保持路径质量的前提下大幅降低全局规划的计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 自主漫游车在大型非结构化环境中需要高效且考虑地形可通行性的全局规划，但基于稠密栅格代价地图的搜索随地图规模增长而计算代价高昂。
AI.method: STAG结合中轴拓扑骨架、代表同质可通行性区域的代表性节点，以及强可通行性梯度附近的过渡节点；边编码几何与可通行性信息，以同时体现路径长度与地形难度。
AI.result: 在合成洞穴图、矿井图及DARPA CERBERUS数据集上对比STAG上的A*与稠密栅格A*，涵盖5类基准、203个地图实例、101,200次查询；中位规划时间降低3.4x至9.9x，峰值查询内存降低2.1x至15.4x，路径长度中位相对差异为-2.9%与+7.6%。
AI.conclusion: STAG为全局规划提供了一种紧凑表示，以牺牲稠密栅格的可通行性最优性换取更快、更省内存的搜索。

title: Tell Robot What Not to Do: A Negation Understanding Perspective
summary: Instruction following enables robots to perform diverse tasks specified in natural language, making it a fundamental capability for human-robot interaction. Beyond communicating desired outcomes, users also need to specify constraints on what not to do. We investigate how to enable vision-language-action models (VLAs) to follow negated instructions, where robots must accomplish task goals while respecting explicit exclusions. To this end, we propose NegaAlign, a parameter-efficient, plug-and-play framework that extends pretrained VLAs to follow negated instructions through image-language supervision alone. Specifically, we introduce Negation Transformation Layers into selected layers of the vision-language backbone to reshape intermediate instruction representations. Meanwhile, a teacher-guided alignment mechanism is designed to align instruction-relevant visual tokens, transferring action-relevant grounding from instructions that satisfy the negated constraint. The training phase uses supervision constructed from existing demonstrations and updates only the inserted layers, keeping all pretrained parameters frozen, including the action generator. We further introduce NegaBench, a simulation benchmark spanning 10 scenarios across five domains for systematically evaluating manipulation under negated constraints. Experiments across GR00T, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements in negated instruction following. With 11.6M trainable parameters, NegaAlign increases the negated-instruction success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 2.60% to 88.45% on NegaBench and from 12.4% to 88.8% on real-world tasks, while retaining performance on affirmative instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出NegaAlign，一种参数高效、即插即用的框架，仅通过图像-语言监督即可让预训练VLA模型遵循否定指令；配合提出NegaBench基准，在GR00T、π0、π0.5上取得一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 指令跟随使机器人能执行自然语言指定的多样任务，是人机交互的基础能力。除表达期望结果外，用户还需指定"不要做什么"的约束。现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）难以遵循否定指令，即需要完成任务目标的同时遵守显式排除条件。
AI.method: 提出NegaAlign框架：在视觉-语言主干的部分层中引入Negation Transformation Layers以重塑中间指令表示；设计教师引导的对齐机制，对齐与指令相关的视觉token，从满足否定约束的指令中迁移动作相关grounding。训练阶段利用现有示范构建监督信号，仅更新插入层，冻结全部预训练参数（含动作生成器）。同时提出NegaBench仿真基准，覆盖5个领域10个场景。
AI.result: 在GR00T、π0、π0.5上均实现否定指令跟随的一致性提升。仅需11.6M可训练参数，NegaAlign将π0.5的否定指令成功率在NegaBench上从2.60%提升至88.45%，在真实任务中从12.4%提升至88.8%，同时保持对肯定指令的性能。
AI.conclusion: NegaAlign以参数高效、即插即用的方式有效赋予预训练VLA模型遵循否定指令的能力，并通过NegaBench为否定约束下的操作任务评估提供了系统化基准。

title: Predicting Cable Dynamics with Physical Attention Bias
summary: Learned simulators for deformable linear objects (DLOs) such as cables have to predict the motion of cables they were not trained on and stay stable over long rollouts. Most of their error occurs where the cable touches itself or the floor. Attention over all pairs of cable segments can represent contact between parts of the cable that are far apart along its length, but attention has no notion of geometry. A cable has two pairwise distances, which agree only while it is straight: the arc-length distance along the cable, which governs elastic forces, and the Euclidean distance in space, which governs contact. We add a physical attention bias, an additive term on the attention logits with a learned rate, and ask which distance it should use. We compare no bias, each distance alone, and both distances on disjoint sets of heads, keeping the rest of the model and the training protocol fixed. A physical bias improves prediction on unseen cables. The gain is largest when attention is the only mechanism that connects distant segments: there, the arc-length bias reduces prediction error by 15% and more than halves the drift in segment length. The Euclidean bias alone stays close to unbiased attention, while assigning both distances across heads is best or near-best on every metric we report. Code and per-run records: https://github.com/avihaig/dlogps.

AI.tldr: 本文在可变形线状物体（DLO）的学习型仿真器中引入物理注意力偏置，比较弧长距离、欧氏距离及两者分头并用的效果，发现物理偏置能提升对未见电缆的预测精度，尤其当注意力是连接远距离线段的唯一机制时，弧长偏置可降低15%预测误差并使段长漂移减半以上，而两种距离分头使用在各项指标上最好或接近最好。
AI.motivation: 学习型电缆仿真器需对未训练过的电缆保持长期稳定预测，但误差主要出现在电缆自接触或与地面接触处。注意力机制虽能建模沿长度相距较远的线段间接触，却缺乏几何概念；而电缆存在两种成对距离——控制弹性力的弧长距离与控制接触的欧氏距离，仅在笔直时一致。因此作者希望引入物理先验，明确注意力应使用哪种距离。
AI.method: 在注意力logits上加入带有可学习速率的加性物理偏置项，并在保持模型其余部分与训练协议不变的前提下，对比四种设置：无偏置、仅弧长距离、仅欧氏距离、以及在不相交的注意力头上分别使用两种距离。
AI.result: 物理偏置提升了在未见电缆上的预测表现。增益在注意力是连接远距离线段的唯一机制时最大：弧长偏置使预测误差降低15%，并使线段长度漂移减少一半以上。仅欧氏偏置的表现接近无偏置注意力，而将两种距离分配到不同注意力头上的方案在所报告的所有指标上均表现最佳或接近最佳。
AI.conclusion: 在注意力中加入物理几何偏置是一种有效且低成本的设计，可显著提升DLO仿真器对未见电缆的泛化与长期稳定性；弧长距离对弹性建模更关键，欧氏距离单独作用有限，而两种距离分头并用是综合最优的选择。

title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 as Spotlight. Project page: https://react-vla.github.io
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.

AI.tldr: REACT 是一种滚动去噪框架，通过维护带错位流时间步的持久动作缓冲区并引入双解耦架构，在保留长时域上下文的同时提升流式 VLA 的响应性，实现更平滑、更低延迟的机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过生成动作块实现时序连贯的机器人运动，但分块控制存在闭环权衡：长动作块执行平滑，却降低响应性；频繁重规划虽提升响应性，却带来动作不连续。因此需要一种既能提高响应性又能保持长时域上下文的方法。
AI.method: 提出 REACT 滚动去噪框架：不再从头重新生成整个动作块，而是维护一个带错位流时间步的持久动作缓冲区。每个控制步中，用最新观测对完整时域进行去噪，执行最干净的动作块，将部分精炼的未来块前移，并在尾部追加新噪声，使每个执行块在部署前经过多次近期观测的精炼。此外引入双解耦机制，将感知、VLM 编码、DiT 去噪与动作执行分离，支持高频观测更新与动作流式传输。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真基准以及涵盖双臂操作与动态控制的真实世界任务（多机器人平台）上，REACT 相比频繁重规划和异步基线，提升了任务成功率，降低了反应延迟，并生成更平滑的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: REACT 通过滚动去噪与双解耦有效缓解了分块控制的闭环权衡，在保持长时域上下文的同时显著增强响应性与平滑度，在仿真与真实任务中均优于现有基线。

title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

AI.tldr: 提出HWAM（人形世界动作模型），通过联合生成参考动作与执行后本体状态，显式建模机器人实际执行的运动，弥合"动作-执行差距"。在LimX OLI人形机器人三项真机任务中取得最高成功率（如Candy Picking 70.6% vs Fast-WAM 43.3%）。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人是通用操作的重要平台。VLA策略直接从多模态观测学习动作，WAM进一步引入未来视觉预测来改进动作生成。但在分层人形系统中，VLA与WAM输出的是参考动作，需经全身控制、机器人动力学、平衡与接触才能实现，由此产生"动作-执行差距"：策略产生的参考动作可能与机器人实际实现的运动不同。若不显式建模实际身体状态，未来视觉预测必须同时解释场景演化与参考动作-执行运动之间的偏差，导致难以将动作与其物理结果关联。
AI.method: 提出HWAM，一种具有联合状态-动作生成能力的人形世界动作模型，将机器人执行后的本体感知状态作为显式预测目标，通过联合生成参考动作及其实现的身体状态，把对已执行运动的监督直接纳入动作学习。HWAM通过三条互补的条件路径训练：(1) Policy路径，仅以当前观测为条件联合去噪状态-动作轨迹，以匹配部署条件；(2) 前向动力学建模（FDM），以动作和执行后状态为条件预测未来视觉观测；(3) 逆动力学建模（IDM），从视觉转换重建联合轨迹。三条路径将策略参考、实际身体运动与视觉结果相连。
AI.result: 在LimX OLI人形机器人的三项真机任务上，HWAM在所有评估基线中取得最高成功率。在Candy Picking任务上，HWAM成功率达70.6%，而Fast-WAM为43.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将执行后本体状态作为显式预测目标并联合生成状态-动作轨迹，HWAM有效弥合了分层人形系统中的动作-执行差距，验证了显式建模实际身体运动对提升真机操作成功率的有效性。

title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
summary: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.

AI.tldr: 提出TWS（Traceable World State），一种与中间件无关的语义表示与参考运行时，用于可溯源机器人世界状态，通过不可变快照、确定性重放和SHA-256哈希链实现可审计性。
AI.motivation: 机器人在长期任务中需维护由不同时刻到达、置信度不一且可能被修订的观测所组成的全局世界状态。传统表示侧重最新估计，导致难以追溯事实来源、复现决策或审计执行过程。
AI.method: TWS快照记录实体、关系、观测、置信度与修订元数据；经校验的更新操作以不可变方式变换快照；有序更新支持确定性重放；规范SHA-256哈希链提供防篡改日志。通过模式一致性、完整状态生命周期、确定性重放与故障注入进行评估。
AI.result: 在Python 3.10–3.14下通过38项测试，可检测记录损坏、哈希链接断裂、序列不连续及世界状态不一致。在10个公开BEHAVIOR-1K任务定义中导入153个实体与146个关系并通过校验；在103条含78,369帧的NVIDIA Unitree G1仿真轨迹上实现全部episode的终端状态精确重放，检测出412/412注入损坏，相较Plain JSONL仅有1.72%存储开销。
AI.conclusion: TWS以极小存储代价为机器人世界状态提供可溯源、可重放、防篡改的表示方案，适用于长时任务的审计与决策复现。

title: SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
comment: IROS 2026 Workshop on Haptics and Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires both large-scale task progression and precise contact-rich interaction, making it challenging to collect demonstrations that effectively support both regimes. We present SkillWeave, a heterogeneous demonstration framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that combines teleoperation for coarse reaching and transport with kinesthetic teaching for precise, contact-rich skills. To address the visual mismatch introduced by the demonstrator's presence during kinesthetic data collection, we propose an object-mask-conditioned diffusion policy that uses offline object segmentation for training supervision and a lightweight learned mask predictor at deployment, avoiding online segmentation and image inpainting. To mitigate distribution shift between independently trained sub-task policies, we introduce successor-aware terminal steering, which selects among actions sampled from the predecessor policy to guide the system toward states supported by the successor's demonstrated initial-state distribution. Across three real-world long-horizon tasks, SkillWeave achieves 27% average end-to-end success. Mask-conditioned kinesthetic policies improve dexterous sub-task success to an average of 65%, while successor-aware handoffs achieve an average composition efficiency of 87%. These results show that matching demonstration modality to interaction regime, explicitly addressing kinesthetic visual mismatch, and steering policy handoffs toward successor-supported states substantially improves long-horizon dexterous manipulation. Videos and code are available at skillweave-authors.github.io .

AI.tldr: SkillWeave 提出一种异构示教框架，用于长时程灵巧操作：粗粒度移动/搬运用遥操作，精细接触技能用动觉示教，并配合物体掩码条件扩散策略与后继感知终端引导来缓解视觉不匹配和子策略分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作既需要大范围任务推进，又需要精确的接触丰富交互，单一示教方式难以同时有效支撑这两种模式，因此示教数据收集困难。
AI.method: 采用异构示教：遥操作负责粗粒度接近与搬运，动觉示教负责精确接触丰富技能；针对动觉数据中示教者存在导致的视觉不匹配，提出物体掩码条件扩散策略，训练时用离线物体分割监督，部署时用轻量学习掩码预测器，避免在线分割与图像修复；为缓解独立训练子任务策略之间的分布偏移，引入后继感知终端引导，从前驱策略采样动作中挑选能引导系统进入后继策略示教初始状态分布支持状态的动作。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界长时程任务上，SkillWeave 平均端到端成功率达 27%；掩码条件动觉策略将灵巧子任务成功率提升至平均 65%；后继感知交接平均组合效率达 87%。
AI.conclusion: 将示教模态与交互模式匹配、显式处理动觉示教视觉不匹配、并将策略交接引导至后继支持状态，可显著提升长时程灵巧操作性能。视频与代码见 skillweave-authors.github.io。

title: ManiUnit: A Manipulation Skill Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate multi-room environments and execute a sequence of manipulation skills under a single natural language instruction. Learning and evaluating these skills present three challenges: similar observations under a fixed task instruction may make skill selection ambiguous; even when a preceding skill succeeds, the robot state inherited by the next skill may deviate from its demonstrated starting states and affect execution; and task-level metrics hinder skill-specific diagnosis, while early failures leave later skills untested. We therefore introduce ManiUnit, a manipulation skill dataset and benchmark built from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities. Its dataset contains 137,899 segments across 21 skill types and 417 subtasks, and its benchmark contains 1,260 test instances. Correspondingly, ManiUnit pairs each segment with an explicit subtask instruction; measures sensitivity to perturbations of the robot's starting base position or joint configuration; and restores intermediate simulator states and defines local success conditions so that each skill can be evaluated without executing preceding stages. Evaluations of representative vision-language-action (VLA) policies show that similar aggregate scores can hide substantial per-skill differences. The tested starting-state perturbations also degrade execution: on the full benchmark, joint perturbations reduce success rates by approximately 56% relative to those from demonstrated starting states. On two long-horizon activities, a skill policy trained on ManiUnit segments achieves 78.7% local manipulation success, compared with 49.3% for a task policy trained on complete demonstrations. The trained skills further support complete-task execution on these activities, as coordinating the task and skill policies through a planner raises full-task success from 4.0% to 18.0%.

AI.tldr: ManiUnit：面向长时程移动操作的操作技能数据集与基准，含137,899个片段、21类技能、417个子任务与1,260个测试实例，通过显式子任务指令、起始状态扰动敏感度测量与中间状态恢复实现技能级独立评测。
AI.motivation: 长时程移动操作需在单条自然语言指令下完成多房间导航与技能序列执行，而现有学习与评测存在三方面难题：固定任务指令下观测相似导致技能选择歧义；前序技能成功但继承的机器人状态偏离示范起始状态，影响后续技能执行；任务级指标难以定位具体技能问题，且早期失败使后续技能无法被测试。
AI.method: 构建基于50个BEHAVIOR-1K活动的操作技能数据集与基准。数据集含137,899个片段，覆盖21种技能类型、417个子任务；基准含1,260个测试实例。设计三点对齐机制：为每个片段配显式子任务指令；测量对机器人起始基座位置或关节构型扰动的敏感度；恢复中间仿真状态并定义局部成功条件，使各技能无需执行前序阶段即可独立评测。
AI.result: 对代表性视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的评测显示，相近的总体分数会掩盖显著的技能间差异；起始状态扰动导致执行退化，全基准上关节扰动使成功率相较示范起始状态下降约56%。在两个长时程活动上，基于ManiUnit片段训练的技能策略取得78.7%的局部操作成功率，而基于完整示范训练的任务策略为49.3%；通过规划器协调任务与技能策略后，完整任务成功率由4.0%提升至18.0%。
AI.conclusion: ManiUnit通过显式子任务指令、起始状态扰动敏感度与中间状态恢复的局部评测，实现了可诊断的技能级基准；结果表明技能级训练与任务-技能规划协调能显著提升长时程移动操作的局部与整体成功率。

title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 27 pages, 11 figures and 13 tables. Under review
summary: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UNITAS，首个3D原生的世界动作模型，在统一度量三维坐标系中表示观测、动作与场景动态，实现动作执行与动作条件场景预测。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型多基于预训练视频生成器，用图像或视觉潜变量表示世界演化。但机器人交互发生在度量三维空间，而图像是视角相关的投影，其像素距离不能直接编码物理距离，存在表示层面的不匹配。
AI.method: UNITAS在同一交互内将观测、动作和场景动态统一到共享的度量3D坐标系，并采用跨机器人本体与人手的通用表示。用动作流将人手与机器人夹爪表示为3D点轨迹，场景流描述以这些轨迹为条件的场景点位移；世界对齐的3D位置嵌入为有/无深度输入的视觉token提供定位；物理时间轨迹分词器将每条点轨迹编码为锚定于当前3D位置的单个token。该接口同时支持直接动作执行与动作条件场景预测。模型规模1.7B参数。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin上取得对比方法中最佳的动作条件场景预测，位移误差较PointWorld最多降低49%；操作成功率方面，LIBERO达99.8%，真实世界任务平均85%。
AI.conclusion: 以3D原生、度量对齐的统一表示构建世界动作模型，可同时提升场景动态预测与真实操作性能，验证了三维空间表示相对图像表示的优势，代码已开源。

title: PIER: An Evidence-Gated Execution Interface for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Ancillary files include reproducibility code and retained experimental records
summary: Generating a plausible robot action does not establish that current observations justify its execution. Motivated by exploratory observations of high-confidence visual outputs under severe occlusion, we present PIER, an execution-authorization interface that separates evidence checks, decision provenance, and stage-scoped re-observation from hardware control. The deterministic gate evaluates declared visual and tactile inputs, while its caller maintains a budget of at most one re-observation per stage. We evaluate the implementation using 1,600 threshold-grid cases and 1,200 paired synthetic traces spanning score noise, missing tactile inputs, stale observations, and falsely reassuring scores. The finite grid yields zero declared invariant violations, and a matched Boolean baseline reproduces all non-recovery decisions. Under synthetic score noise, re-observation reduces valid-state denials from 57/120 to 18/120 while increasing invalid-state proceeds from 5/120 to 7/120. Stale and falsely reassuring inputs expose limitations that threshold checks alone cannot resolve. Exploratory visual, tactile, and robot setup records provide context but do not establish physical task performance. These results characterize an inspectable authorization interface and its input-contract limitations, without claiming superiority over equivalent rule logic, calibrated tactile accuracy, or certified physical safety.

AI.tldr: 提出 PIER——一种将证据检查、决策溯源与阶段性再观测同硬件控制分离的“执行授权”接口；在合成与阈值网格测试中验证其可检视性与输入契约边界，但不主张物理安全或优越性。
AI.motivation: 生成看似合理的机器人动作并不等于当前观测足以支持其执行；作者由"严重遮挡下仍输出高置信度视觉结果"的探索性观察出发，试图把"是否被授权执行"从硬件控制中独立出来。
AI.method: PIER 接口将确定性授权门、决策溯源与阶段作用域再观测和硬件控制解耦：门依据声明的视觉与触觉输入做判定，调用方每阶段预算至多一次再观测。评测使用 1600 个阈值网格用例与 1200 组配对合成轨迹，覆盖分数噪声、触觉缺失、陈旧观测与"虚假安心"分数。
AI.result: 有限阈值网格下未出现被声明的契约违反；匹配的布尔基线可复现全部非恢复决策。合成分数噪声下，再观测将有效状态的拒绝由 57/120 降至 18/120，同时把无效状态的放行由 5/120 升至 7/120。陈旧与虚假安心输入暴露出仅靠阈值检查无法解决的局限。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了一个可检视的授权接口及其输入契约局限；探索性视觉、触觉与机器人搭建记录仅提供背景，不能证明物理任务性能，作者也不声称优于等价规则逻辑、标定后的触觉精度或经认证的物理安全。

title: Leveraging Human-In-The-Loop Demonstrations in Reinforcement Learning for Digital Twin-Driven Robot Flexibility
summary: Growing automation makes collaborative robots work in more variable environments, increasing the need for adaptation. We propose a human-in-the-loop online training framework combining a digital twin (DT), reinforcement learning (RL), and human demonstrations. Unlike DTs used mainly to generate synthetic data before task execution, our DT is synchronized with the physical system in real time through camera feeds, allowing the virtual robot to update its observations and policy from real-world feedback. A dual actor framework integrates imitation learning (IL) without adding a direct imitation loss to the RL actor, so demonstrations can guide adaptation instead of manual reprogramming. The proposed framework is demonstrated on the Ufactory Xarm5 collaborative robot, where the robot's end-effector aims to reach the target position while avoiding obstacles. The experiments show that the framework can resume training after a change in the physical workspace and that, with a fixed set of non-optimal demonstrations, the dual actor framework achieves a much higher final success rate than two methods that add an imitation loss to the actor. The same pattern holds with real human demonstrations collected in virtual reality (VR): with demonstrations that never reach the goal, the dual actor framework reached 83-100% mean deterministic evaluation success, against 0-17% for the two imitation-loss methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种数字孪生、强化学习与人类演示结合的人在环在线训练框架，使协作机器人能在环境变化后继续适应，并避免直接模仿损失。
AI.motivation: 自动化程度提高使协作机器人面临更多变的工作环境，对在线适应能力的需求上升；传统数字孪生多仅用于任务执行前生成合成数据，无法实时反映物理变化，且人工重编程成本高。
AI.method: 构建人在环在线训练框架：数字孪生通过摄像头实时与物理系统同步，使虚拟机器人用真实反馈更新观测与策略；采用双演员（dual actor）结构，在不向RL演员加入直接模仿损失的情况下集成模仿学习，让演示引导适应而非人工重编程。在Ufactory Xarm5协作机械臂上验证，任务为末端执行器在避障条件下到达目标位置。
AI.result: 实验表明框架可在物理工作空间改变后恢复训练；在固定的非最优演示下，双演员框架最终成功率显著高于两种向演员加入模仿损失的方法。使用VR收集的真实人类演示时同样成立：在从未到达目标的演示条件下，双演员框架平均确定性评估成功率达83–100%，而两种模仿损失方法仅0–17%。
AI.conclusion: 实时同步数字孪生与双演员设计可在不依赖最优演示、无需人工重编程的前提下支持协作机器人在线适应，显著优于直接加入模仿损失的基线方法。

title: Instance-anchored interaction evidence: Grounding robot plans in human pointing and handling
summary: A robot that assists people must often act on what a person has shown rather than said: which of several identical cartons was pointed at, or which box was handled. The plan is executed from the final scene, whereas the evidence occurs earlier, possibly on objects that have since moved. We propose instance-anchored interaction evidence (IAE), which registers every object of the final scene to its public identifier, keeps each identity through the video by backward mask propagation, and describes every frame by the geometry between hands, forearms and these instances. An evidence network trained only from task outcomes scores the instances. For pointing tasks, a grammar-constrained dynamic program trained with a structured loss decodes object-destination programs; symbolic programs handle reference disambiguation and, without learning, episodic tasks. On 1,255 WatchAct benchmark requests, scored by symbolic execution, IAE reaches 64.2% plan success on implicit-intent tasks against 27.5% for a 32B vision-language model (strict success 49.7% against 15.4%), and 46.4% against 27.0% on restoration, reversal and imitation without task-specific training. Controls with the same perception overlays, the same 32 frames, forward tracking, or a relation model trained on the same labels do not explain the gain. Given IAE's evidence as text with its meaning explained, the same language model reaches 57.4%: most of the gain comes from the instance-anchored evidence, and the explicit programs add 6.8 points at a fraction of the cost. Pointing remains the hardest case, with 16.9% strict success. The code is available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact.

AI.tldr: 提出"实例锚定交互证据"(IAE)：将末帧物体与公开标识符绑定并通过反向掩码传播保持身份，以手/前臂与实例间几何描述每帧，证据网络仅用任务结果训练打分，配合语法约束动态规划与结构化损失解码目标程序，在WatchAct上显著超越32B视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 机器人常需依据人的"示"而非"说"行动（如指向哪个相同纸箱、操作过哪个盒子）；而执行发生在最终场景，证据却出现在更早时刻、可能涉及此后已移动的物体，存在证据—执行时序错位与实例身份漂移问题。
AI.method: 1) 将最终场景每个物体注册到公开标识符；2) 通过反向掩码传播在整段视频中保持每个身份；3) 用双手、前臂与这些实例之间的几何关系描述每一帧；4) 仅由任务结果训练的证据网络对实例打分；5) 对指向任务，用语法约束的动态规划配合结构化损失解码"物体—目的地"程序；6) 符号程序处理指代消歧，并在无学习条件下完成情节式任务。
AI.result: 在1,255条WatchAct请求上以符号执行评分：隐式意图任务计划成功率达64.2%（32B视觉语言模型为27.5%），严格成功率49.7%对15.4%；在复原、反转与模仿任务上无任务特定训练即达46.4%（对照27.0%）。相同感知叠加、相同32帧、前向跟踪或用相同标签训练的关系模型均不能解释该增益。将IAE证据以文本形式附带含义解释交给同一语言模型可得57.4%，说明增益主要来自实例锚定证据，显式程序在此基础上再贡献6.8个百分点且成本极低。指向仍最难，严格成功率16.9%。
AI.conclusion: IAE通过把交互证据锚定到跨帧稳定的物体实例身份，有效解决了证据早于执行、物体移动导致的指代歧义问题，在隐式意图理解上大幅优于大型视觉语言模型，且显式符号程序以极小代价带来额外提升；代码已开源。

title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
summary: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.

AI.tldr: 提出空间语言建模（Spatial Language Modeling），用离散坐标与语义token共享词表表示场景轮廓、目标、动作目标与未来状态，借任务语法组织为空间序列，由单个自回归Transformer通过统一next-token目标同时学习动作生成与动作条件下的状态预测。
AI.motivation: 目标导向操作中，动作如何改变场景几何这一信息可为目标导向操作提供互补监督；需要一个统一框架把动作生成与动作条件下的状态预测结合起来。
AI.method: 以共享的离散坐标与语义token词表表示场景轮廓、目标、动作目标及未来状态；用任务特定文法将这些元素组织成空间序列；单个自回归Transformer以统一的下一token预测目标同时学习动作生成与动作条件状态预测。训练流程为：先进行随机游走转移预训练，再在专家演示上联合训练动作与状态；预训练时记录的动作坐标用于条件化后续状态预测且被排除在预测损失之外；控制时仅解码可执行动作目标，并用新观测状态更新历史。
AI.result: 在仿真Push-T与真实机器人上评估：仿真性能具竞争力；真实机器人上任务成功率与目标覆盖率优于所比较的策略基线。消融实验显示联合动作与状态序列可改善控制，随机游走预训练带来进一步提升；给定动作轨迹时，同一模型还能预测连续场景状态，刻画推挤的几何效应。
AI.conclusion: 统一的动作-状态空间语言建模能够以单一自回归模型联合学习动作生成与动作条件状态预测，并借助随机游走预训练与联合序列训练提升真实机器人操作表现，同时具备状态预测能力。

title: RESETTLE: Robotic Recovery through Disagreement-Triggered Retrieval and Efficient Corrective Control
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires timely intervention to correct emerging deviations and restore progress after execution errors. However, recovery methods based on repeated vision-language reasoning or iterative online optimization can incur substantial latency, delaying intervention. To address these challenges, we introduce RESETTLE(Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrievaL and Efficient Corrective Control), a model-agnostic framework that provides computationally efficient recovery at the action-execution interface of frozen robot policies. RESETTLE triggers recovery when two action proposals independently sampled under identical conditioning persistently disagree. It retrieves a same-task demonstration reference using an adapted V-JEPA encoder and combines a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual to execute one corrective action without online trajectory optimization or additional vision-language reasoning, then returns control to the base policy. Across six base policies in simulation, RESETTLE achieves up to 8.70%, 6.28%, and 6.83% absolute success-rate gains on LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World, and RoboCasa Tabletop, respectively, with further improvements on four real-world tasks using two policies. In QwenPI-based comparisons, its monitoring-and-recovery computation latency is 74.04%--93.57% lower than VoLoAgent's monitoring-and-planning latency for grasp and place tool calls. It also raises Harness VLA's LIBERO-Pro Swap success from 42% to 50%, demonstrating compatibility with high-level agentic planning. Code available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

AI.tldr: RESETTLE是一个模型无关框架，通过在动作执行接口处检测动作分歧触发恢复，利用检索到的演示参考与状态伺服先验执行一次纠正动作，无需在线优化或额外视觉语言推理，在多仿真与真实任务上提升成功率并大幅降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 可靠的机器人操作需要在偏差出现时及时干预、在执行错误后恢复进程。但基于重复视觉语言推理或迭代在线优化的恢复方法延迟高，导致干预滞后，亟需高效、低延迟的恢复机制。
AI.method: 提出RESETTLE框架，作用于冻结机器人策略的动作-执行接口。当在相同条件下独立采样的两个动作提案持续出现分歧时触发恢复；通过适配的V-JEPA编码器检索同一任务的演示参考，并结合状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差执行一个纠正动作，不进行在线轨迹优化，也不额外调用视觉语言推理，随后将控制权交还基础策略。
AI.result: 在仿真中跨六个基础策略，LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World、RoboCasa Tabletop分别取得最高8.70%、6.28%、6.83%的绝对成功率提升；在两个策略的四个真实任务上进一步提升。基于QwenPI的对比中，其监控-恢复计算延迟比VoLoAgent的监控-规划延迟低74.04%–93.57%。还将Harness VLA在LIBERO-Pro Swap上的成功率从42%提升至50%，表现出与高层智能体规划的兼容性。
AI.conclusion: RESETTLE以模型无关方式在动作执行接口实现高效恢复，兼顾成功率提升与低计算延迟，并可兼容高层智能体规划，为机器人操作的及时纠偏与错误恢复提供了通用有效方案。

title: MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling
summary: World modeling has emerged as an effective co-training objective for robot policies, giving rise to World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly predict actions and future states. However, most WAMs predict future states in the native representation space of pretrained visual backbones, resulting in high-dimensional targets with substantial training cost. We introduce MiniWAM, which instead predicts compact future representations learned from privileged current-future transitions. To construct these targets, we propose Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling (PRISM), which combines inverse-dynamics supervision with feature reconstruction to emphasize control-relevant transition information while preserving useful future-state information. With the learned PRISM encoder frozen, MiniWAM is trained to jointly predict the resulting targets and robot actions from current observations. With 65$\times$ fewer native future feature tokens, MiniWAM consistently outperforms native future-feature prediction with both DINOv3 and WAN2.1 VAE features, while achieving up to an 8$\times$ speedup in world-action training. At 0.25B parameters, MiniWAM is already competitive with substantially larger WAMs on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmarks. Representation analyses further show that PRISM contributes behavioral structure beyond feature reconstruction alone. These results demonstrate that effective world-action modeling does not require predicting native visual futures, and that compact predictive representations provide a strong and substantially more efficient target for policy learning. The project page is available at: https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM.

AI.tldr: MiniWAM通过预测紧凑的未来表征（由PRISM学习）替代原生视觉特征预测，在token减少65倍的情况下性能更优、训练提速至8倍。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）多在预训练视觉骨干的原生表征空间中预测未来状态，导致目标维度高、训练成本大。
AI.method: 提出PRISM，通过逆动力学监督与特征重建联合学习紧凑的预测性表征，强调控制相关转移信息；冻结PRISM编码器后，MiniWAM从当前观测联合预测该目标与机器人动作。
AI.result: 在DINOv3与WAN2.1 VAE特征上均优于原生未来特征预测，训练提速最高8倍；0.25B参数的MiniWAM在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus与RoboTwin 2.0上可与更大WAMs竞争；表征分析表明PRISM带来超越纯特征重建的行为结构。
AI.conclusion: 有效的世界动作建模无需预测原生视觉未来，紧凑预测性表征为策略学习提供了强且高效的监督目标。

title: MAP2: Model- and Acceleration-Based Pursuit with MPC and Gaussian Process Residual Learning for Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racing requires accurate trajectory tracking near the handling limits of a vehicle while maintaining low computational latency. Geometric controllers are computationally efficient, but the Ackermann steering geometry becomes invalid under limit-handling conditions. Model- and Acceleration-based Pursuit (MAP) preserves the simplicity of geometric approaches while leveraging tire dynamics. Yet MAP remains fundamentally a geometric controller that relies on Ackermann steering geometry, and its tire model may not fully capture the vehicle's actual dynamic response. This paper presents MAP2, a model-based pursuit controller that combines a curvature-based kinematic MPC and a Sparse Gaussian Process (SGP) residual correction. The proposed algorithm uses MPC to optimize kinematic control inputs over a prediction horizon and maps them to steering commands through a tire dynamics model augmented with SGP residual correction. Real-world vehicle experiments demonstrate substantial reductions in lateral tracking error and lap time. Compared with MAP and Pure Pursuit (PP), MAP2 reduces the average lateral tracking error by 37.99% and 44.65%, respectively, while reducing average lap time by at least 1.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出MAP2控制器，将曲率型运动学MPC与稀疏高斯过程（SGP）残差修正结合，用于极限工况下的自动驾驶赛车轨迹跟踪。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶赛车需在车辆操控极限附近实现高精度轨迹跟踪且保持低计算延迟，但几何控制器在极限工况下Ackermann转向几何失效；MAP虽引入轮胎动力学，本质上仍是依赖Ackermann几何的几何控制器，其轮胎模型难以完全刻画车辆真实动态响应。
AI.method: MAP2采用曲率型运动学MPC在预测时域内优化运动学控制输入，并通过经SGP残差修正增强的轮胎动力学模型将其映射为转向指令，从而融合MPC优化与高斯过程残差学习。
AI.result: 实车实验表明横向跟踪误差与圈速显著下降：相较MAP与Pure Pursuit，平均横向跟踪误差分别降低37.99%与44.65%，平均圈速至少缩短1.5%。
AI.conclusion: MAP2在保持几何方法简洁性的同时克服了Ackermann几何在极限工况下的局限，通过SGP残差修正提升轮胎模型精度，实现了更优的跟踪精度与圈速表现。

title: Sim-to-Real RL for ASVs using SysID
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to ICRA 2027. Code available at: https://github.com/UMich-CURLY/ASTRA_RL/tree/df98e7fd01420163082255403f3b032e0d8d0d03
summary: Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) operating in dynamic marine environments require robust control policies for tasks such as path following and station keeping, making reinforcement learning (RL) a promising alternative to classical controllers. However, existing ASV simulators rarely support parallel environments for RL training. Such existing simulators require accurate hydrodynamic modeling from computational fluid dynamics solvers or towing tank tests for setting hydrodynamic parameters to address the sim-to-real gap. To address these challenges, we present an ASV simulator and accompanying pipeline that enables training policies starting from unknown vehicle dynamics. Our framework uses only a CAD model and brief set of open-water field trajectories for approximating and refining both hydrodynamic and thruster parameters. Real-world deployments on a BlueBoat ASV demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in path following and station-keeping tasks without prior hydrodynamic and propeller information.

AI.tldr: 提出一套ASV仿真器及配套流程，仅用CAD模型与少量实船轨迹即可近似并精化水动力与推进器参数，支持并行RL训练，并在BlueBoat上实现路径跟踪与定点保持的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 自主水面艇在动态海洋环境中执行路径跟踪、定点保持等任务需要鲁棒控制策略，强化学习是经典控制器的有前景替代方案。但现有ASV仿真器很少支持面向RL训练的并行环境；且通常依赖CFD或拖曳水池试验获取精确水动力参数以弥合sim-to-real差距，成本高、门槛高。作者希望从"未知动力学"出发训练策略，降低对精确建模的依赖。
AI.method: 构建ASV仿真器与配套训练流程：输入仅为CAD模型和少量开阔水域实船轨迹，用其近似并逐步精化水动力参数与推进器参数；仿真器支持并行环境以加速RL训练；在BlueBoat ASV平台上进行真实部署验证。
AI.result: 在无任何先验水动力与螺旋桨信息的条件下，路径跟踪与定点保持任务均实现成功的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: 无需CFD或水池试验的精确水动力建模，仅凭CAD与少量实船轨迹即可支撑RL策略训练并完成零样本实船部署，表明该仿真器与流程可有效缓解ASV领域RL训练的仿真环境与sim-to-real瓶颈。

title: Residual Modeling Closes the Regression and Generative Policy Gap in Robot Learning
summary: Learning from demonstration has enabled impressive robot behaviors. A common choice for policy learning is to use diffusion or flow matching (Flow-Policies), which often outperforms direct action regression trained with mean squared error (MSE-Policies). This gap is commonly attributed to multimodal demonstrations. We revisit this gap from the perspective of statistical modeling: how action-prediction residuals shape policy optimization. Our analysis of real-world robot demonstration data reveals substantial state-dependent variation in residual scales and heavier-than-Gaussian tails. While both MSE-Policies and Flow-Policies exhibit heavy-tailed action residuals, their training gradients behave differently: MSE allocates more gradient magnitude to observations with large action residuals, which hurts optimization. Motivated by these findings, we introduce heteroscedastic Student-t action regression (HT-Policies), which learns input-dependent residual scales and reduces the influence of heavy tails. HT-Policies predict action chunks with a single feed-forward pass and can reuse pretrained flow-matching-based policy networks as the backbone. Across four simulation benchmarks and real-robot evaluations, HT-Policies achieves success rates competitive with generative policy baselines, both when trained from scratch and from pretrained vision-language-action and world-action models, despite being faster in training and inference. Together, these findings shed light on the practical advantages of generative objectives in robot learning from demonstrations and offer an efficient direct-regression alternative for a range of architectures and tasks. Project page: https://the-labone.github.io/regression-policy-project/

AI.tldr: 论文从统计建模角度重新审视生成式策略(Flow-Policies)优于MSE策略的原因，发现动作残差存在状态相关的异方差性和重尾性，进而提出异方差Student-t动作回归(HT-Policies)，兼顾效率与性能。
AI.motivation: Flow/Diffusion策略普遍优于MSE直接回归策略，通常被归因于多模态演示数据。但作者认为这一解释不充分，希望从统计建模角度，即动作预测残差如何影响策略优化，来重新理解这一性能差距。
AI.method: 分析真实机器人演示数据中的残差分布，发现残差尺度随状态显著变化且呈重尾分布；比较MSE与Flow策略的梯度行为，发现MSE会将更大梯度幅值分配给大残差样本从而损害优化。据此提出异方差Student-t动作回归(HT-Policies)，学习输入相关的残差尺度以抑制重尾影响，单次前向预测动作块，并可复用预训练flow-matching策略网络作为骨干。
AI.result: 在四个仿真基准和真实机器人评测中，无论从零训练还是基于预训练VLA和world-action模型训练，HT-Policies的成功率均可与生成式策略基线相竞争，同时训练和推理更快。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了生成式目标在机器人模仿学习中的实际优势来源，并提供了一种适用于多种架构与任务的高效直接回归替代方案。

title: From Language to Motion: Task-Conditioned Focal-Stack Trajectory Integration for Microscopic Robots
summary: Microscopic robots require accurate task geometry despite changes in language, parts, and focus. We present a semantic-to-physical framework that maps instructions to constrained geometric operators, reuses frozen open-vocabulary perception, and integrates locally reliable focal-plane trajectories by confidence weighting and dynamic programming. Calibrated multi-view geometry connects 2-D paths to physical execution. Prompt, unseen-part, and geometry reconfiguration tests yield 6.30-6.59-pixel RMSE. Relative to part-specific U-Net training with 20-100 labels, the proposed zero-new-label configuration takes 15 rather than 72-165 min. Across nine part-illumination conditions, trajectory-space integration reduces RMSE from 14.41 to 6.28 pixels (56.4%) and P95 error from 20.07 to 8.13 pixels (59.5%) compared with image-first multi-focus fusion. An ablation isolates the roles of confidence and path-wise selection. In representative robot experiments, target-region coverage improves from 83.5% to 92.9%. Dispensing provides a measurable physical trace, not a task-specific limitation of the method.

AI.tldr: 提出语义到物理框架，将指令映射为几何算子，复用冻结开放词汇感知，并以置信度加权和动态规划融合局部可靠焦平面轨迹，实现显微机器人精确任务几何。
AI.motivation: 显微机器人任务几何需在语言、零件与焦点变化下保持准确；现有零件专用训练标注成本高、耗时长，且多焦融合易产生误差。
AI.method: 语义到物理框架：指令映射为受约束几何算子；复用冻结开放词汇感知；置信度加权与动态规划进行轨迹空间集成；标定多视图几何将2-D路径连接至物理执行；并以消融实验分离置信度与路径选择作用。
AI.result: 提示、未见零件与几何重构测试RMSE为6.30-6.59像素；相比20-100标签的零件专用U-Net训练，零新标签配置仅需15分钟而非72-165分钟；九种零件-光照条件下，轨迹空间集成将RMSE由14.41降至6.28像素（56.4%），P95误差由20.07降至8.13像素（59.5%）；机器人实验中目标区域覆盖率由83.5%提升至92.9%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹空间集成显著优于图像优先多焦融合，零新标签配置兼顾精度与效率；分液提供可测量物理轨迹，表明方法不限于特定任务。

title: Fixed-Reference Pose Residuals for Measuring Cross-Dataset Cue Transfer in Human-Robot Interaction Anticipation
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Supplementary material available as an ancillary file
summary: Social and service robots in public spaces need to anticipate which nearby person is about to approach and touch them, so that a response can be prepared before contact. It is largely unknown which cues support this anticipation when a model trained with one robot is used on another robot at a different site. We study this question with a fixed-reference pose residual (FRPR) model: a geometry predictor built from the person's bounding box and mask is trained and frozen, and a temporal network then learns from body pose an additive correction to its logit, so that every prediction splits exactly into a geometry term and a pose term. Between two public egocentric datasets recorded by different robots, HUI360 and SSUP-A, with every choice made on source data, the pose correction raised average precision (AP) from 0.277 to 0.321 from SSUP-A to HUI360 and gave no measurable gain in the opposite direction; the same asymmetry held over a stronger, source-selected geometry reference. Freezing gave no AP advantage over joint training, and simple geometric baselines and tree ensembles remained competitive or better, so the construction serves measurement rather than prediction accuracy. A head-orientation residual added small gains in both directions. Post hoc, whether a person faces the camera kept its discriminative direction across datasets, whereas head pitch reversed. With thresholds chosen on source data, the neural models that use geometry detected at most 17% of target interactions. Code and processed data are available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/FRPR-interaction-anticipation.

AI.tldr: 该研究用"固定参考位姿残差"(FRPR)模型研究跨机器人、跨场景的"即将接触"预判可迁移性，发现位姿修正项增益高度不对称、冻结几何模块无优势，该构造更适合测量而非提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 公共空间中的社交与服务机器人需要在接触发生前预判哪位邻近者将要靠近并触摸自己，以便提前准备响应。但当一个模型从一台机器人迁移到另一场地、另一台机器人上时，哪些线索能支撑这种预判仍基本未知。
AI.method: 提出固定参考位姿残差(FRPR)模型：先用人体的边界框与掩码训练一个几何预测器并冻结，再让时序网络从身体位姿学习对其logit的加性修正，从而使每次预测严格分解为几何项与位姿项。在HUI360与SSUP-A两个不同机器人采集的公开自我中心数据集间双向迁移，所有选择均在源域数据上完成；并对比更强的源域选择几何参考、冻结与联合训练、简单几何基线及树集成，另测试头朝向残差。
AI.result: SSUP-A→HUI360方向的位姿修正将平均精度(AP)从0.277提升到0.321，反方向无可见增益；换用更强的源域几何参考后，该不对称性依然存在。冻结未比联合训练带来AP优势，简单几何基线与树集成仍具竞争力甚至更优。头朝向残差在两个方向都有小幅增益。事后分析显示，"人是否面向相机"的判别方向跨数据集保持稳定，而头部俯仰方向发生反转。以源域选定阈值，使用几何的神经模型在目标域最多只检出17%的真实交互。
AI.conclusion: 该FRPR构造主要价值在于测量与归因(将预测分解为几何项与位姿项)，而非提升预测精度；跨机器人迁移的增益高度不对称，几何线索可迁移性优于位姿线索，现有模型在目标域的交互检出率仍然很低。代码与处理后的数据已公开。

title: Real-Time Motion Planning with Dynamic Hazards: Classical vs. Learning-Based Methods
comment: This paper is scheduled to be presented at the 2027 International Symposium on Artificial Life and Robotics (AROB 2027)
summary: We study real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields through a controlled comparison between classical planning and learning-based methods. Rather than introducing a new planner, we construct a unified benchmark in which representative classical and learning-based methods face the same environments, motion constraints, information assumptions, and evaluation metrics. The test environment consists of planar domains populated with rotating sprinkler-like hazards that generate time-varying forbidden regions via sweeping angular sectors. Our results show a clear regime shift. In deterministic environments, classical planners achieve near-perfect success and higher-quality paths, though sometimes at the cost of substantial planning or replanning time. Under stochastic obstacle dynamics, however, online search becomes strongly budget-sensitive: low budgets lead to frequent failure, while high budgets improve success at the cost of latency and longer trajectories. PPO-based policies, trained under the same scenario distribution, consistently outperform in latency, success rate, and path quality in these stochastic regimes. Overall, the results indicate that uncertainty in obstacle evolution, more than partial observability, is the dominant factor determining which planning paradigm is practically effective for the problem at hand.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过统一基准实验对比经典规划与基于学习的规划方法在动态危险场中的实时运动规划表现，发现环境不确定性（而非部分可观测性）是决定哪类范式更有效的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 研究实时运动规划在动态危险场中的方法选择问题，明确经典规划与学习型方法各自适用的条件，而非提出新的规划器。
AI.method: 构建统一基准，让代表性经典规划方法与学习型方法（如PPO策略）在相同环境、运动约束、信息假设与评价指标下进行受控对比；测试环境为平面域，含旋转喷淋式危险源，通过扫掠角扇区生成时变禁行区域。
AI.result: 确定性环境下经典规划器成功率近乎完美、路径质量更高但规划/重规划耗时可能较大；随机障碍动态下在线搜索对预算高度敏感，低预算易失败、高预算提升成功率但增加延迟与轨迹长度；相同场景分布下训练的PPO策略在延迟、成功率与路径质量上均稳定更优。
AI.conclusion: 障碍演化的不确定性比部分可观测性更是决定哪种规划范式在实际问题中有效的决定性因素。

title: Walking on Roofs: Exploring the Potential of Walking Robots for Construction Work on Roofs
comment: Preprint of paper which appeared in the Proceedings of CLAWAR 2026, 29th International Conference on Climbing and Walking Robots and the Support Technologies for Mobile Machines, Cranfield University, Cranfield, Beford, United Kingdome, 2026
summary: This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying quadruped walking robots for the automation of work in roof environments. While quadrupeds have demonstrated versatility across various domains, their large-scale deployment remains limited, partly due to lack of application-specific designs. Roof environments represent a novel and unexplored use case, combining high safety risks for human workers with repetitive, strenuous tasks that could benefit from robotic assistance. A dedicated test rig of a roof's surface was designed to evaluate the baseline performance of a commercial quadruped, the \emph{Unitree Go2}, in this new environment. Experiments revealed that standard ball feet are inherently inadequate for locomotion on sloped roofs: slippage increased quadratically with incline angle, get-up and lie-down sequences were only possible on small inclines, and critical failures already occurred regularly on moderate inclines of 25°. This work provides the first systematic assessment of quadruped locomotion in roof environments, highlighting both the potential and the current limitations of this application and establishes a baseline for future research. Effective solutions will require a combination of task-oriented foot designs, advanced contact mechanics and environment-specific control strategies, such as reinforcement learning for roof-adapted gaits.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估商用四足机器人（Unitree Go2）在屋顶环境中的作业可行性，构建屋面测试平台并开展实验，发现标准球形足端在坡面运动能力不足。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人虽在多个领域展现通用性，但大规模部署受限于缺乏面向具体应用的设计。屋顶作业兼具高危性与重复性、高强度特征，是尚未探索的新场景，亟需评估其可行性与基线性能。
AI.method: 搭建屋面表面专用测试台，以商用四足机器人 Unitree Go2 为对象，在坡面环境下测试其基线运动性能，考察足端打滑、起身/趴下序列及不同倾角下的失效情况。
AI.result: 标准球形足端不适用于坡面运动：打滑程度随倾角呈平方增长；起身与趴下动作仅能在小倾角下完成；在约 25° 的中等倾角下已频繁出现关键失效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统评估四足机器人在屋顶环境的运动能力，既揭示应用潜力也指出当前局限，并建立未来研究基线；有效方案需结合任务导向足端设计、先进接触力学与环境特定控制策略（如面向屋面步态的强化学习）。

title: Toward Lunar Legged Robots: Field Deployment Lessons at LUNA
comment: Proceeding to the IEEE iSparo Conference 2026
summary: Legged robots are promising candidates for future lunar surface missions because they can traverse steep, loose, and obstacle-rich terrain that challenges conventional wheeled rovers. However, readiness for lunar deployment is limited by uncertainties in foot-regolith interaction, dust generation, illumination-driven perception degradation, and operational constraints. This paper reports lessons from the 2025 LUNA analogue campaign, where ANYmal-D and Magnecko traversed loose regolith simulant and crater-like terrain and collected long-horizon navigation and visual-inertial data under challenging lighting. We show that quadrupedal robots can traverse regolith simulant, but performance is affected by sinkage and slip, dust-generating contacts, and perception failures caused by overexposure, shadows, and low-texture regions. These results motivate tighter integration of regolith-aware locomotion policies, illumination-robust perception, repeatable analogue testing, and mission-level operational validation for future lunar legged robots.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2025年LUNA模拟月面实验，使用ANYmal-D与Magnecko四足机器人在松散模拟月壤及类陨石坑地形中进行测试，发现在此环境下机器人虽可通行，但受下陷、打滑、扬尘以及强光/阴影/低纹理导致的感知失效影响，提出需强化月壤感知运动策略、光照鲁棒感知、可重复模拟测试及任务级验证。
AI.motivation: 腿足机器人具备穿越陡峭、松散及障碍密集地形的能力，被视为未来月面任务的潜在平台，优于传统轮式巡视器。然而其月面部署的成熟度受限于足-月壤相互作用不确定性、扬尘、光照导致的感知退化及操作约束等未解决问题，亟需实地模拟数据加以评估。
AI.method: 报告2025年LUNA模拟实验的经验：让ANYmal-D与Magnecko两型腿足机器人在松散模拟月壤和类陨石坑地形上行走，并在具有挑战性的光照条件下采集长时程导航数据与视觉-惯性数据。
AI.result: 四足机器人能够在模拟月壤上通行，但性能受到下陷与打滑、产生扬尘的足地接触，以及由过曝、阴影和低纹理区域引起的感知失效的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果说明，未来月面腿足机器人需要更紧密地整合具备月壤感知能力的运动策略、光照鲁棒的感知方法、可重复的模拟测试流程，以及任务级的运行验证。

title: PLaW-VLA: Predictive Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Learning to predict how the world evolves can provide vision-language-action (VLA) policies with predictive context for long-horizon control, but its effectiveness depends on what future representation is modeled and how it conditions action generation. We introduce PLaW-VLA, which models task-relevant future states in a pretrained prediction-oriented representation space, reducing the need to predict control-irrelevant visual details. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, PLaW-VLA conditions action generation on observation history, current task semantics, and predicted future states through structured causal attention. Experiments show a +11.8 percentage-point (pp) gain over reactive policies on RoboTwin Hard Horizon III and a +1.77 pp gain over reconstruction-oriented latent prediction on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, supporting improved long-horizon control and generalization under distribution shift, respectively. By avoiding low-level visual reconstruction, PLaW-VLA lowers the burden of future prediction, enabling a lightweight latent world model with parallel future prediction and about 1/19 the inference latency of generative world-action modeling at comparable policy performance.

AI.tldr: PLaW-VLA通过预训练预测导向表征空间建模任务相关未来状态，并以Mixture-of-Transformers结合结构化因果注意力生成动作，提升长时程控制与泛化，同时显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 预测世界演化可为VLA策略提供长时程控制的预测性上下文，但其有效性取决于建模何种未来表征以及如何以此条件化动作生成。既有方法或关注控制无关的视觉细节、或需低层视觉重建，带来不必要的预测负担与推理开销。
AI.method: 在预训练预测导向表征空间中建模任务相关未来状态，避免预测控制无关的视觉细节；基于Mixture-of-Transformers架构，通过结构化因果注意力，将动作生成条件化于观测历史、当前任务语义与预测未来状态。采用轻量潜在世界模型并行预测未来。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin Hard Horizon III上较反应式策略提升11.8个百分点；在零样本LIBERO-Plus上较重建导向的潜在预测提升1.77个百分点；在策略性能相当的情况下，推理延迟约为生成式世界-动作建模的1/19。
AI.conclusion: 避免低层视觉重建可降低未来预测负担，使轻量潜在世界模型具备并行预测能力；该方法在长时程控制、分布偏移下的泛化以及推理效率方面均具优势。

title: LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Onboard Visual Navigation in the Wild
summary: Direct visual navigation policies generate trajectories efficiently but do not explicitly evaluate their future consequences. Generative navigation world models provide this foresight through visual rollouts, which are costly when evaluating multiple candidates. We present LiteNWM, a latent navigation world model that shares visual encoding across candidates and jointly predicts their action-conditioned future representations at multiple horizons, while a learned scorer uses these predictions to select trajectories. In offline evaluations on RECON, SCAND, and SACSoN, LiteNWM reduces macro-averaged trajectory error by 17.56% relative to NoMaD+NWM-XL and achieves a 128.00-fold end-to-end speedup on an RTX 5090. The same evaluator transfers from NoMaD to MBRA without proposer-specific retraining, reducing MBRA's macro-averaged trajectory error by 16.2%. In real-robot experiments in unseen indoor and outdoor environments, LiteNWM improves navigation success from 43.3% to 83.3% relative to NoMaD. These results demonstrate that LiteNWM can be deployed for future-aware planning and closed-loop navigation on a physical robot.

AI.tldr: LiteNWM 是一种潜在导航世界模型，通过共享视觉编码与多视界联合预测，实现高效未来感知轨迹选择。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉导航策略虽高效但缺乏对未来后果的显式评估；生成式导航世界模型可通过视觉 rollout 提供前瞻，但在多候选评估时计算代价过高。
AI.method: LiteNWM 在各候选间共享视觉编码，联合预测其动作条件下的多视界未来表示，并由学习到的评分器基于这些预测选择轨迹。
AI.result: 在 RECON、SCAND、SACSoN 离线评测中，相较 NoMaD+NWM-XL 宏平均轨迹误差降低 17.56%，在 RTX 5090 上端到端加速 128.00 倍；同一评估器从 NoMaD 迁移到 MBRA 无需针对提议器重训练，使 MBRA 宏平均轨迹误差降低 16.2%；在未见室内外真实机器人实验中，相较 NoMaD 将导航成功率从 43.3% 提升至 83.3%。
AI.conclusion: LiteNWM 可部署于物理机器人，实现未来感知规划与闭环导航。

title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
summary: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

AI.tldr: ARC 提出一种通过"推理配方"提升现有机器人基础模型零样本任务性能的高效互补方法。
AI.motivation: 主流提升机器人基础模型（RFM）的方式依赖更大模型、更多机器人示范数据和昂贵的规模化训练，成本高。作者希望找到一种高效且互补的替代方案，在不增加数据与训练规模的前提下改善零样本性能。
AI.method: ARC 配方包含三要素：(1) 推理迹（reasoning trace），需以机器人下一步动作为基础，解释其因果结构即为何该动作合适及其应产生的效果；(2) 可扩展的自动标注流水线，从现有示范（如 DROID）自动生成推理迹，构建 ARC-Trace-DROID，无需采集新数据；(3) 将预训练 RFM 适配为利用这些迹进行控制的策略，针对不同模型架构与能力定制微调与推理，适用于 π0.5 等 VLA 和 Cosmos3-Nano-Policy 等 WAM。
AI.result: 在无额外机器人示范和基础规模训练的情况下取得前所未有的零样本性能增益。适配模型在 RoboLab-120 与 MolmoSpaces 上刷新 SOTA，在 RoboLab-Reasoning-50 上提升最高达 50 个百分点；真实机器人上使 π0.5 任务成功率提升 82.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，恰当的推理配方可作为提升机器人基础模型性能的有效、高效途径，与规模化训练互补，显著增强零样本泛化与真实任务成功率。

title: A Physics-Informed Collision Learning Framework for Collaborative Robot Motion Generation
summary: Close-proximity multi-arm manipulation requires collision models that are both geometrically accurate and differentiable enough for real-time optimization. Classical geometry checkers provide reliable distances but are difficult to use inside gradient-based model predictive control, while conservative proxy models can restrict tightly coupled motion. We present PI-UDF, a physics-informed unified differentiable framework for body-to-body collision distance prediction between articulated robots. PI-UDF combines analytical forward kinematics with learnable link-geometry embeddings and a shared residual network to predict pairwise inter-arm distances directly from robot configurations. To improve safety-critical fidelity, we combine quota-driven boundary mining with an asymmetric boundary-crossing penalty that emphasizes false-safe sign errors near the collision boundary. The learned distance field is integrated into nonlinear MPC as a differentiable inter-arm clearance term. We validate the framework on a real dual-Franka platform through high-speed close-proximity 14-DoF dual-arm swapping, sustained single-arm dynamic evasion, and dynamic-evasion planning configurations with frozen, predicted, and target-switching treatments of the moving arm. Hardware experiments and offline Drake/FCL replay show that PI-UDF provides a differentiable inter-arm clearance estimate suitable for closed-loop collision-aware collaborative robot motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 PI-UDF，一种物理信息驱动的统一可微分框架，用于关节机器人躯干间碰撞距离预测，并将学习到的距离场嵌入非线性 MPC，实现双臂紧邻协作运动。
AI.motivation: 紧密贴近的多臂操作需要既几何精确又可微分的碰撞模型以支持实时优化。传统几何检测器距离可靠但难以用于基于梯度的 MPC；保守代理模型又会限制紧耦合作运动，因此需要兼顾精度与可微性的统一距离预测框架。
AI.method: PI-UDF 将解析正运动学与可学习的连杆几何嵌入、共享残差网络结合，直接从机器人构型预测成对臂间距离；采用配额驱动的边界挖掘与非对称越界惩罚，重点惩罚碰撞边界附近的"假安全"符号错误；将学习到的距离场作为可微分臂间间隙项集成进非线性 MPC。
AI.result: 在真实双 Franka 平台上验证：高速紧邻 14 自由度双臂交换、持续单臂动态规避，以及移动臂在冻结、预测与目标切换处理下的动态规避规划。硬件实验与离线 Drake/FCL 回放表明，PI-UDF 提供了适用于闭环碰撞感知协作机器人运动生成的可微分臂间间隙估计。
AI.conclusion: PI-UDF 统一了几何精确性与可微性，可作为非线性 MPC 中可微分的臂间间隙项，在真实双臂紧邻操作任务中实现闭环碰撞感知的运动生成。

title: GLIO2: A GPU-Parallelized Tightly-Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS System for Robust and Real-Time Global Localization and Mapping
summary: Globally consistent, real-time state estimation in large-scale, perceptually degraded environments is essential for autonomous vehicles and aerial robots, and requires fusing LiDAR, inertial, and GNSS measurements. Existing fusion methods, however, share a scan-to-map front-end with two failure modes. First, each scan is aligned to an incrementally built map that drifts under degeneracy, and once the estimate diverges the error is irrecoverable. Second, even without divergence, a registration biased by dynamic objects or wrong correspondences is propagated as a single pose constraint with an over-confident covariance, leaving its correspondences unavailable for GNSS to re-weight or relinearize. We propose GLIO2, a tightly-coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS system whose GPU-parallel front-end jointly optimizes scan-to-multiscan LiDAR, IMU pre-integration, and raw GNSS measurements in a single sliding-window factor graph, sustaining real-time operation on edge hardware. A complementary offline back-end reuses the same cached factors to refine the entire trajectory in batch, completing the 30-min, 4.51-km UrbanNav Whampoa sequence in about 24 s. Across three public benchmarks (UrbanNav, MARS-LVIG, M3DGR) and self-collected UAV and vehicle data, GLIO2 attains the best overall accuracy among evaluated systems. On a 5.66-km bridge traversed at up to 96 km/h, where every competing baseline diverges under LiDAR degeneracy, it maintains 1.6 m horizontal accuracy. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, the full pipeline runs at about 25 Hz (39.60 ms per scan). The source code and datasets will be released.

AI.tldr: GLIO2：一种GPU并行前端紧耦合LiDAR-惯性-GNSS系统，将scan-to-multiscan LiDAR、IMU预积分与原始GNSS观测在单一滑窗因子图中联合优化，实时运行于边缘硬件，并配以复用相同缓存因子的离线批处理后端。
AI.motivation: 大规模、感知退化环境下的全局一致实时状态估计对自动驾驶与空中机器人至关重要，需融合LiDAR、惯性与GNSS。现有融合方法共用scan-to-map前端，存在两大失效模式：(1) 每帧扫描对齐到增量构建的地图，退化下地图漂移，估计发散后误差不可恢复；(2) 即使不发散，受动态物体或错误对应影响的配准被作为单一位姿约束传播，协方差过度自信，导致其对应关系无法被GNSS重新加权或重线性化。
AI.method: 提出GLIO2，紧耦合LiDAR-惯性-GNSS系统。其GPU并行前端在单一滑窗因子图中联合优化scan-to-multiscan LiDAR、IMU预积分与原始GNSS测量，可在边缘硬件上实时运行；互补的离线后端复用相同缓存因子，对整条轨迹进行批处理精化。
AI.result: 离线后端约24秒完成30分钟、4.51公里的UrbanNav Whampoa序列。在UrbanNav、MARS-LVIG、M3DGR三个公开基准及自采集无人机与车辆数据上，GLIO2在所评估系统中取得最佳整体精度。在5.66公里、最高96 km/h的桥梁场景中，所有对比基线在LiDAR退化下发散，而GLIO2保持1.6米水平精度。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，完整流程约25 Hz运行（每帧39.60 ms）。
AI.conclusion: GLIO2通过联合优化多源因子并在前端保留对应关系，克服了scan-to-map前端的漂移不可恢复与协方差过度自信问题，在退化环境中实现全局一致、实时的状态估计，兼顾精度与边缘端实时性；源码与数据集将开源。

title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
summary: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboRSI——一种基于“自顶向下技能细化”（TSR）的机器人自我改进系统，通过将任务分解为有明确职责与输入输出契约的技能树，把执行反馈归因到对应分支并进行受控修正，实现技能验证后的复用；在移动操作平台上完成104轮多物体家庭清理任务，并在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 仿真基准上取得最高成功率，超过最强基线2.7–11.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人不仅需完成多样任务，还应能从执行经验中持续提升，把执行中学到的内容转化为后续任务可复用的能力。现有通过代码行动的机器人代理已能依据执行反馈修复程序，但核心难题在于：如何围绕赋予经验意义的任务结构来组织这些经验，使每次修复都能归因到应负责的能力、有执行证据支撑，并在复用前得到验证。
AI.method: 提出 RoboRSI 自我改进系统，其核心为自顶向下技能细化（TSR）：将任务分解为复合技能、原子技能与基础技能，赋予各级技能限定职责和显式输入—输出契约；把每次执行结果归因到负责该结果的分支，并将修订限制在该分支内。在此结构之上，由管理者（Manager）、规划者（Planner）、工程师（Engineer）与审查者（Reviewer）协同完成规划、执行、诊断与新技能的验证发布，人类通过目标与纠正进行引导；稳定的技能序列进一步被整合为可复用的复合技能。
AI.result: 在移动操作平台上，RoboRSI 经104轮迭代发展出多物体家庭清理能力；在仿真中，该系统于 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus 与 RoboTwin 上均取得最高成功率，较最强基线高出2.7至11.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以技能层次结构与显式契约为组织框架，可将执行反馈转化为有归因、有证据、经验证的可复用技能，从而支撑机器人的持续自我改进，并在多类仿真基准上验证了其有效性与泛化优势。

title: Control-Ready Uncertainty for Trajectory Diffusion
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026 as a Spotlight presentation. 39 pages, 12 figures
summary: Diffusion models can represent complex, multimodal trajectory distributions, but extracting uncertainty from them typically requires costly Monte Carlo sampling. This limits their use in real-time control, where robots must rapidly assess risk and maintain safety margins. We introduce Score-Curvature for Online Precision Estimation (SCOPE), a lightweight module that augments diffusion trajectory models with control-ready uncertainty. SCOPE learns a structured precision matrix around each nominal trajectory by distilling score-curvature information and producing calibrated Gaussian tubes with low overhead and without repeated Monte Carlo sampling. These tubes provide per-timestep covariance estimates that can be used both as predicted occupancy for moving agents and as adaptive exploration guides for robot control. We evaluate SCOPE with mode-conditioned multimodal diffusion backbones in pedestrian forecasting, crowd navigation, Maze2D control, and real-world Franka Panda manipulation. Across these settings, SCOPE provides fast uncertainty estimation, which leads to better closed-loop performance. Project page: https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出 SCOPE，一种轻量模块，通过蒸馏 score 曲率信息为扩散轨迹模型附加结构化精度矩阵，实现无需蒙特卡洛采样的实时校准不确定度（高斯管）估计。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能表示复杂多模态轨迹分布，但从中提取不确定度通常需要昂贵的蒙特卡洛采样，难以满足机器人实时控制中对风险快速评估与安全裕度维持的需求。
AI.method: SCOPE 围绕每条标称轨迹学习结构化精度矩阵，通过蒸馏 score-curvature 信息构建校准的高斯管，逐时间步输出协方差估计；该协方差既可作为移动智能体的预测占据，也可作为机器人控制的自适应探索引导；开销低且无需重复蒙特卡洛采样。
AI.result: 在行人预测、人群导航、Maze2D 控制以及真实 Franka Panda 机械臂操作上，配合模式条件化的多模态扩散骨干进行评测，SCOPE 均能实现快速不确定度估计并带来更好的闭环性能。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE 以低开销将扩散轨迹模型转化为控制可用的不确定度来源，兼顾实时性与闭环表现，适用于机器人预测与控制任务。

title: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning dexterous manipulation, but the embodiment gap prevents human motion from being executed directly on robots. Inverse kinematics (IK) retargets human motion to robots efficiently but ignores dynamics, often producing infeasible motions. Reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) are commonly employed to yield dynamically feasible motions, but both are sample-inefficient and sensitive to hyperparameters. RL suffers from costly and unstable training and tedious reward engineering; MPC avoids policy optimization, yet retargets each trajectory in isolation, and solving one does not make the next easier. Sampling cost grows rapidly with dataset size and task difficulty. We hypothesize that dynamically feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, so that retargeting can be reduced to sampling from that manifold, conditioned on human motion, rather than solving a fresh optimization problem for every demonstration. We propose \textbf{Generative Neural Retargeting} (GNR), which uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories. GNR outperforms MPC with only $8.5\%$ of the samples required by MPC, achieving a success rate of $56.20\%$ compared to $27.20\%$ for MPC. GNR can be used for scalable and efficient retargeting of large-scale, long-horizon, and millimeter precision human demonstrations: by applying GNR within a real-to-sim data engine, we produce a dexterous manipulation dataset with dense contact-force labels, spanning $223$k demonstrations and $3.3$k object geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式神经重定向（GNR），用流匹配模型从跨演示共享的低维流形中采样可行轨迹，仅需MPC 8.5%的采样量即可将成功率从27.2%提升至56.2%，并构建了22.3万条演示的灵巧操作数据集。
AI.motivation: 人类演示是学习灵巧操作的可扩展数据源，但存在具身差距，无法直接在机器人上执行。逆运动学重定向高效却忽略动力学，常产生不可行运动；RL与采样MPC虽能生成动力学可行运动，但样本效率低、对超参敏感（RL训练昂贵不稳定、需繁琐奖励工程），且MPC逐条轨迹独立求解，采样成本随数据规模与任务难度急剧增长。
AI.method: 作者假设动力学可行轨迹集中于一个跨演示共享的低维流形附近，因而重定向可转化为在人类运动条件下从该流形采样，而非对每条演示重新求解优化问题。据此提出GNR，采用流匹配（flow matching）生成模型来采样可行轨迹。
AI.result: GNR仅需MPC所需8.5%的采样量即超越MPC，成功率达56.20%（MPC为27.20%）。将GNR应用于real-to-sim数据引擎，可支持大规模、长时程、毫米级精度人类演示的可扩展高效重定向，产出含密集接触力标签的灵巧操作数据集，涵盖22.3万条演示与3300种物体几何。
AI.conclusion: GNR通过把重定向建模为在共享低维流形上的条件生成采样，显著提升了样本效率与成功率，验证了轨迹流形假设的有效性，并展示了在构建大规模灵巧操作数据集方面的可扩展性。

title: SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation
summary: Frontier multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) have recently shown strong potential for direct robotic control, yet their performance on fine manipulation remains limited. We argue that an important source of failure is not necessarily insufficient policy capability, but insufficient spatial observability, where task-critical spatial relationships may be poorly revealed by the existing physical camera setup. We introduce SpatialHarness, a test-time embodied harness that provides test-time spatial scaffolding for fine robotic manipulation without policy fine-tuning or changes to the physical sensing setup. SpatialHarness maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real-world execution, identifies task-critical spatial relationships, and renders complementary virtual views that expose them to a frozen multimodal policy. To keep the simulated scene aligned during interaction, we develop interaction-aware scene synchronization that distinguishes static, held, and transition modes. We evaluate SpatialHarness on four real-robot manipulation tasks spanning precise geometric alignment, object-relative placement, and articulated-object interaction. Using the same frozen GPT-6 Astra policy, SpatialHarness substantially improves task success, including from 26.7% to 66.7% on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on Tower of Hanoi. These results indicate that improving spatial observability at test time can unlock fine-manipulation capabilities already present in strong multimodal foundation models. Project website: https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/.

AI.tldr: SpatialHarness 是一个测试时具身增强框架，通过在线仿真场景与互补虚拟视角为冻结的多模态策略提供空间可观测性，无需微调或改动物理传感设置，即可显著提升精细操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态基础模型（如 GPT-6 Astra）虽具备直接机器人控制潜力，但在精细操作上表现受限。作者认为失败主因并非策略能力不足，而是空间可观测性不足——任务关键的空间关系未被现有物理相机配置充分呈现。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialHarness 测试时具身增强框架：在线维护与真实执行同步的仿真场景，识别任务关键空间关系，并渲染互补虚拟视角输入冻结的多模态策略；同时提出交互感知场景同步机制，区分静态、持握与过渡三种模式以保持虚实对齐。无需策略微调，也不改动物理传感配置。
AI.result: 在四类真实机器人操作任务（精确几何对齐、物体相对放置、铰接物体交互）上评估，使用同一冻结的 GPT-6 Astra 策略，任务成功率显著提升：插头插入从 26.7% 提升至 66.7%，汉诺塔从 0% 提升至 100%。
AI.conclusion: 在测试时提升空间可观测性，可释放强多模态基础模型中已具备但未被激发的精细操作能力。

title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 Keyframe Mnemonics 自监督方法，通过从随机采样的历史观测中学习目标函数来发现信息关键的观测（mnemonics），并将其作为关键帧选择的奖励，进而训练以关键帧为条件的 BC 策略，实现无限视野下的上下文保留与记忆密集型任务的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 非马尔可夫环境中的行为克隆需要策略在长视野上对上下文信息进行推理。现有策略架构依赖循环或注意力机制：循环模型在时间反向传播下存在隐状态坍缩与梯度不稳定问题，而注意力模型受限于上下文长度。因此需要一种既能保证长视野上下文保留、又能维持小规模工作记忆的新方法。
AI.method: Keyframe Mnemonics 是一种新颖的自监督方法。它通过从随机采样的过去观测中学习一个目标函数，用以发现一组信息关键的观测（即 mnemonics），并将该目标用作关键帧选择的奖励。随后训练一个以所发现关键帧为条件的 BC 策略来建模动作分布。在特定任务结构假设下，该形式化方法可提供无限视野下的上下文保留保证，同时将决策相关关键帧维持在策略工作记忆的小集合中。
AI.result: 在合成记忆域上，以 mnemonics 为条件的 BC 策略达到 100% 成功率，并能泛化到比训练长数个数量级的视野而无性能退化。在记忆密集型机器人操作基准上，跨 23 个任务相比最强基线平均绝对成功率提升 13.9%，并在真实机器人上于 20 倍更长视野下保持 80% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: Keyframe Mnemonics 通过自监督发现信息关键帧并以之为条件，有效缓解了循环模型的梯度不稳定与注意力模型的上下文长度限制，在理论上提供无限视野上下文保留保证，并在合成与真实机器人任务中验证了其长视野泛化能力与显著性能提升。

title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
summary: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at https://github.com/SAP/synthesis-through-simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通过模拟合成"（STS）范式，用LLM智能体在模拟企业环境中调用策略执行API生成数据，实现无需数据库模式的表格数据合成。
AI.motivation: 企业AI的智能体训练与评测受限于商业与法律约束，难以访问真实企业系统、数据与数据库模式。现有表格数据合成方法受结构有效性与模式可用性制约，而基于流程的方法又缺乏分布保真度且需逐域人工编写。
AI.method: 提出STS（Synthesis Through Simulation）模式无关的数据合成范式：LLM智能体在模拟企业环境中执行对策略执行API的操作来生成数据。由于数据由定义有效性的同一环境生成，STS在构造上即保证结构有效性，并将有效性约束与分布建模解耦。其通用填充器（Generalist Populator, GP）为领域无关智能体。
AI.result: GP在全部十个环境中无需访问数据库模式即达到平均边际保真度0.88与100%约束满足率；统计合成器因必需种子数据要求无法适用于其中七个环境；具备模式权限的智能体在航空环境紧耦合工作流中82%轨迹失败，源于任务组合脆弱。
AI.conclusion: STS通过模拟环境生成数据，在保证结构有效性的同时解耦分布建模，验证了模式无关合成的可行性。作者开源了完整框架、十个环境及生成数据集。

title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/boldprojekte/agent-forgetting-research
summary: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of USD 1.28-1.44 versus approximately USD 4.38. Both arms passed the two-case primary behavioral oracle; neither fully satisfied the follow-up evaluation. The method made more requests and took 17% longer. A contrasting application-development pair produced no context or cost saving, and an earlier continuation exhibited lower manually assessed quality despite reduced context. These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"智能体控制的遗忘"机制：模型选择先前观察到的工具结果，用简短笔记原位替换，并将原始内容存入可恢复存档，从而在噪声较大的工具使用轨迹中显著节省token与成本，但效果存在工作负载依赖。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型智能体在轨迹中反复携带观察结果，其有效内容往往远小于原始负载，造成上下文膨胀与资源浪费，因此需要研究可逆的上下文管理方式。
AI.method: 由执行模型主动选择此前的工具结果，在每个结果的原始位置替换为短笔记，同时将精确原文保留在可恢复存档中；通过Python测试框架提供批量归档与显式恢复，无需任务特定的模型训练，并保护用户指令与助手消息不被操作。
AI.result: 在OpenTelemetry调试加无关实现任务的探索性案例中，方法结束时为231,951个提供商报告的prompt token，而保留完整历史为912,492个；累计输入token减少50%，估算API成本约1.28–1.44美元（对照组约4.38美元）。两组均通过两案例主行为判定，但都未完全满足后续评估；该方法请求次数更多、耗时增加17%。另一组应用开发案例无上下文或成本节省，且更早的续写虽减少上下文但人工评估质量下降。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在噪声较大的工具使用轨迹中可实现可观的资源节省，但工作负载依赖性是可逆上下文管理的核心考量因素。

title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures. Includes proofs and reproducibility artifacts
summary: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness.
