A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $Σ_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteqΣ_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteqΣ_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个"有界验证"框架，用隐藏终端随机性刻画智能体AI改进机制，区分搜索更久、获得额外支持与修改提议/核验方式三类变化，并给出随机验证类的包含关系、表示分析与自改进的复杂度结论。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统的性能分数无法区分其改进来源：是延长搜索、获得额外支持，还是修改提议与验证输出的方式。需要一套形式化工具，把这些机制性差异与正确性、可采信证据和资源义务绑定起来。
AI.method: 引入stage概念：给定可采信转录集、多项式界、交替验证协议与终端核验器。原生reach使用默认支持，闭包frontier允许接口已许可的全部支持。在逐点一致概率间隙与任务相对可靠性下定义语言；用有界验证与隐藏终端随机性比较不同改进路径，并研究独立多数投票放大、精确验证（零随机性）、随机验证类层级与递归自改进。
AI.result: 独立多数投票放大保持两类语言不变，而对随机带的存在式接受可能引入错误输出。精确验证是零随机性特例，具有位置与完备性结果。随机验证类满足Σ_k^P ⊆ Σ_k^RV ⊆ Σ_{k+1}^P；严格扩张与深度分离需显式复杂度假设，BPP=P时给出frontier相同的精确companion。表示分析将不变接受与可在重构下改变的核心-支持标签分离。在公共可靠解释器与固定验证协议下，一致有界自修改仍留在同一验证类。条件误差预算控制自适应候选选择中的误选；配额强制的XOR合成族把搜索成功率的无界比值与被接受语言的变化分离，并用精确与概率审计检验证据要求。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把自改进主张转化为对正确性、可采信证据、验证资源与选择误差的显式义务，为评价智能体AI的"更强表现"提供机制层面而非单一分数层面的刻画。

title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
comment: 14 pages, 5 tables. Code, configuration and per-run outputs: https://github.com/rav11l/cace-bench (v0.6.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23207546)
summary: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.

AI.tldr: 将自我进化限制在运行时外壳（指令文本、工具调用逻辑、原语组合）而固定模型权重，可使每次自适应变成带原因和测试的可审查diff；基于该边界的双环引擎加哈希链准入门，在仿真中显著优于无界系统的检查。
AI.motivation: 自我改进型LLM智能体虽能适应规则变化，但自我重写会破坏监管者所审查的产物（具名改动、记录的测试、审批）。作者主张：只有当自我进化被约束在运行时外壳内、模型权重保持固定时，进化才可审查，从而让每次适应成为附带原因与测试的diff。
AI.method: 提出以该边界为基础的双环引擎，设有一个在部署前写入哈希链记录的准入门。测量在仿真中进行，使用模拟智能体与种子搜索提议器而非语言模型。实验覆盖三类监督性重新解释、三种严重程度，每种10个种子。
AI.result: 带门循环在7,449个候选改动中准入144个，均未在留出历史上恶化错误，并在所有低、中严重度单元中将假阳性率恢复至oracle水平且未提高漏报。将门替换为无界系统的检查（仅看近期痕迹中更少错误）后，同一循环准入309个有害改动，90次运行中49次漏报率超过10%。在班前标签上评估时，门拒绝了全部候选，说明重新解释须编码为可重标历史的规则。参数性与范围性偏移可局部修复，结构性偏移仅能靠原语替换；在最高结构严重度下，门的固定容差在半数种子中阻断了正确替换。
AI.conclusion: 将自我进化限定于运行时外壳使适应可审查，准入门能显著抑制有害改动与漏报。作者将机制映射到EU AI Act关于高风险信用评分的条款，并指出2026年4月美国模型风险指南将代理式AI排除在其范围之外。

title: Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and AirVLN.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)，通过将简短意图指令翻译为导航器可执行的详细命令，弥合航空视觉语言导航中的指令鸿沟，在冻结导航器条件下显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 航空VLN智能体通常基于细节丰富、轨迹对齐的命令训练，而用户实际下达的是简短、意图驱动的指令，二者存在"指令鸿沟"。在冻结的OpenFly导航器上，这一鸿沟使成功率从31.03%骤降至11.33%，亟需一种方法将弱指令转化为智能体可执行的命令。
AI.method: 作者先用人类写作风格示例提示语言模型，将原始命令转换为配对的、以意图为中心的弱命令（Weak commands）以扩展翻译器训练数据。在此基础上提出TGIT前端翻译器，保持导航器冻结，通过从轨迹结果中学习，将弱输入翻译为智能体可执行的命令。
AI.result: 仅用弱命令训练的翻译器将弱输入成功率提升至37.93%；零样本迁移到真实人类指令时成功率从11.33%提升至32.51%；在留出的OpenFly上从4.95%提升至20.79%；并在CityNav和AirVLN上实现了恢复性提升。
AI.conclusion: TGIT作为一种前端翻译模块，在不修改导航器的情况下有效弥合了指令鸿沟，既能处理弱指令，又能零样本泛化到真实人类指令，并在多个基准上取得一致的性能提升。

title: Reading the Room: Foundations, Design, and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
summary: Human communities are governed by normative systems: shared standards that produce \textit{norms} dictating acceptable behavior, enforced through community sanctioning. Aligning increasingly autonomous AI systems with these norms is a central alignment challenge, complicated by the fact that norms are vast in number, change quickly, and are often arbitrary (e.g., dress or language conventions). Thus, alignment requires \textit{normative competence}: the ability to discern from interaction alone what norms a community enforces without relying on static pretrained knowledge. We introduce a multi-agent community debate setting, where access to debate is governed by synthetic norms, to study normative competence in isolation from pretraining exposure. We show that baseline LLM agents fail to learn norms even when doing so would improve their accuracy. We then experiment with various \textit{normative modules} -- architectural components for norm inference -- finding that norm-following is highly sensitive to both the style of norm and the model powering the normative module, suggesting a lack of generalizability. Furthermore, when idiosyncratic, non-normative behaviors accompany the true norm, LLM agents exhibit an unselective attribution failure: they indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside enforced rules, a pattern that persists even when imitating unnecessary behaviors is explicitly penalized. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to operationalize and evaluate normative competence in LLMs, demonstrating that current AI systems excel at behavioral mimicry but lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将"规范能力"(normative competence)操作化并评估：在多智能体社区辩论环境中，让LLM智能体仅通过交互推断被隐性执行的规范。实验表明基线智能体无法学会规范，规范模块效果高度依赖规范风格与模型能力，且存在"无选择性归因失败"。
AI.motivation: 人类社会由规范系统治理，AI对齐需要与规范一致，但规范数量庞大、变化快且常具任意性，无法依赖静态预训练知识。因此需要"规范能力"：仅从交互中辨别社区所执行的规范。既有研究未能在排除预训练暴露的条件下专门考察这一能力。
AI.method: 提出多智能体社区辩论设定，辩论准入由合成规范(synthetic norms)控制，从而在隔离预训练暴露的条件下研究规范能力。测试基线LLM智能体，并引入多种"规范模块"(normative modules)——用于规范推断的架构组件进行对比实验；同时设置特殊/非规范性行为与真实规范共同出现的情境，检验智能体能否区分。
AI.result: 基线LLM智能体即便学会规范能提升准确率也仍然失败；规范遵循对规范风格与规范模块所用模型能力高度敏感，缺乏泛化性。当特殊性非规范行为与真实规范并存时，智能体出现"无选择性归因失败"，将特殊噪声与被执行规则一并模仿，且即使明确惩罚模仿无用行为该模式仍持续。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI系统擅长行为模仿，却缺乏辨别社会所执行秩序的能力，即不具规范能力。这是首个对LLM规范能力进行操作化与评估的工作，揭示了对齐研究的关键缺口。

title: Learning How to Search for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
summary: Heuristic search for a plan can store exponentially many states, even when its heuristic is almost perfect. We instead learn search control, one specification per domain, written as an indexical policy: a generalized policy with registers that hold objects and modes that sequence its rules. We add the choose rule, which loads an object into a register and marks a backtracking point, where one candidate suffices; every other rule must work for all of its outcomes and needs no search. Our main result is that structural termination, which rules out infinite executions, also bounds every execution by a polynomial in the number of objects. A depth-first procedure then finds a plan in polynomial space, however large the state space, with no list of visited states. The cost is time, exponential only in the choice depth, the number of real choices along an execution. Any class that such a policy solves therefore lies in NP, and in P at constant choice depth. We learn these policies with a language model in a counterexample-guided loop that certifies termination, verifies the training tasks, and keeps the choice depth small. With the learned policies, the procedure solves 1,709 of 1,890 test tasks of the IPC 2023 Learning Track and the Autoscale Agile suite, more than LAMA, BFWS, and Levitron, and most of them within one second and 100 MiB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种索引式策略（indexical policy）的搜索控制方法：策略含寄存器与模式，新增 choose 规则以标记回溯点。结构终止性保证执行步数为对象数的多项式；深度优先过程在多项式空间内求规划，时间仅随选择深度指数增长。用大模型在反例引导循环中学习策略，在 IPC 2023 Learning Track 与 Autoscale Agile 上解决 1709/1890 题，优于 LAMA、BFWS 与 Levitron。
AI.motivation: 启发式搜索即使在启发函数近乎完美时也可能存储指数级状态，导致空间开销巨大。作者希望学习搜索控制知识，用每域一份的广义策略替代对状态空间的遍历，从而在多项式空间内完成规划。
AI.method: 提出索引式策略（indexical policy），由寄存器（存放对象）和模式（规则序列）构成。新增 choose 规则：将对象装入寄存器并标记回溯点，该点仅需一个候选；其余规则必须对所有结果成立，无需搜索。若满足结构终止性（排除无穷执行），则每次执行步数被对象数的多项式界定。据此设计深度优先过程，无访问状态列表，时间仅随选择深度（真实选择数）指数增长。用语言模型在反例引导循环中学习策略，并认证终止性、验证训练任务、保持小选择深度。
AI.result: 结构终止性同时限制执行长度多项式界；对应规划类属于 NP，在常数选择深度下属于 P。学习到的策略在 IPC 2023 Learning Track 与 Autoscale Agile 的 1890 个测试任务中解决 1709 个，超过 LAMA、BFWS 和 Levitron，且多数任务在一秒、100 MiB 内完成。
AI.conclusion: 学习索引式搜索控制可在多项式空间内求解原本需指数状态空间的问题，时间代价仅由选择深度决定；该框架给出 NP/P 的复杂度刻画，并在标准基准上以高效资源显著超越经典启发式规划器。

title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal: A Cross-Language Benchmark and Defense
summary: Safety-aligned language models often refuse a harmful request stated directly but answer the same request inside a role-play or narrative wrapper. We measure this vulnerability across languages and registers: attack success on Qwen3-1.7B is already 89.4% in English and 93.0% in modern Chinese, and reaches 95.7% in Classical Chinese. We build GUISE, a benchmark for systematically studying this vulnerability. It includes parallel requests in English, modern Chinese, and Classical Chinese, matched harmful and benign pairs, wrapper types held out for evaluation, and a stricter criterion that counts warn-then-answer responses as attack successes. Representation analysis shows that language and register move harmful-request representations only slightly away from the model's refusal direction, whereas narrative wrappers move them much farther away. We propose AXIS, which combines preference optimisation with a rotation objective that aligns harmful-request representations with the refusal direction and a commitment objective that trains the model to refuse completely rather than produce a warn-then-answer response. Across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B and GLM-4-9B, AXIS achieves the highest combined safety and usability score among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示安全对齐语言模型在角色扮演/叙事包装下会绕过拒绝机制，构建了GUISE基准（英/现代汉语/文言平行请求）并发现文言文攻击成功率最高，提出AXIS方法（偏好优化+旋转目标+承诺目标）在校正表示方向上取得更优的安全-可用性平衡。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐模型对直接有害请求能拒绝，但对同一请求加角色扮演或叙事包装后会回答，形成显著漏洞。该漏洞在跨语言和跨语体（register）维度上的规模与机制尚不明确，且缺乏系统评测基准与有效防御方法。
AI.method: 构建GUISE基准：英/现代汉语/文言三语平行请求、有害-良性配对、留出（held-out）的包装类型用于评测，并采用更严格判定标准将“先警告后回答”计为攻击成功。表示分析显示语言与语体仅使有害请求表示轻微偏离拒绝方向，而叙事包装偏移更大。提出AXIS：结合偏好优化、将有害请求表示与拒绝方向对齐的旋转目标，以及训练模型完全拒绝的承诺目标。
AI.result: 攻击成功率在Qwen3-1.7B上英语89.4%、现代汉语93.0%、文言文95.7%。在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、GLM-4-9B上，AXIS在对比方法中取得最高的安全-可用性综合得分。
AI.conclusion: 叙事包装是比语言/语体更主要的表示偏移来源；通过旋转表示至拒绝方向并强化完全拒绝的承诺，AXIS可跨模型尺寸与家族提升安全性的同时保持可用性。

title: Distillation for Incrimination and Distillation for Capabilities
summary: Powerful misaligned AI models might recognize alignment evaluations and strategically behave well on them, rendering direct audits uninformative. However, distilling such a model into a weaker benign student places the teacher in a Distillation Double Bind: if misalignment transfers, the student may conceal it less effectively, revealing evidence about the teacher; if it does not, the student may learn useful capabilities while remaining benign. We introduce two distinct distillation approaches, one targeting each outcome. Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) aims to transfer misalignment but not the ability to conceal it. Distilling AuditBench's secret-keeping models into their underlying instruction-tuned model produces students that are significantly more likely than their teachers to admit their hidden behavior when asked, suggesting that knowledge of the behavior transferred more readily than the propensity to conceal it. Confession gains largely disappear when the student does not share the teacher's pretrained base, so DFI should target the teacher's own pre-RL checkpoint, which is weaker than the teacher but shares its base model. Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) aims to transfer capabilities but not misalignment. Among several techniques we evaluate, two are effective: inoculation prompting and training for more epochs on fewer unique examples. Both preserve the capability gains of standard distillation while substantially reducing the subliminal transfer of an animal preference, our proxy for misalignment. Together, these findings demonstrate two ways distillation can be used for AI safety: incriminating misaligned models, and extracting their capabilities without their misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"蒸馏双重困境"框架，并给出两种蒸馏方法：DFI用于"定罪"隐藏错位的模型，DFC用于在保留能力的同时去除错位。
AI.motivation: 强大的错位模型可能识别对齐评估并策略性地表现良好，使直接审计失效。作者希望利用蒸馏这一工具，从被审计模型中获取关于其错位的证据，或提取其能力而不继承其错位。
AI.method: 提出两种蒸馏路径。DFI旨在转移错位但不转移隐藏能力，通过将保密模型蒸馏回其基础指令微调模型（尤其是教师自身的RL前检查点）实现；DFC旨在转移能力但不转移错位，评估了接种提示与在更少样本上训练更多轮次等技术，以动物偏好作为错位的代理指标。
AI.result: DFI产生的学生模型在被询问时显著比教师更可能承认隐藏行为，且当学生不与教师共享预训练基础时，坦白增益基本消失。DFC中，接种提示和少样本多轮训练在保留标准蒸馏能力增益的同时，显著降低了动物偏好的潜意识转移。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏可用于AI安全的两条路径：使错位模型"定罪"暴露，以及在不继承错位的前提下提取其能力。

title: Beyond Imitation: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Peer Review
summary: The rapid growth of scientific publishing has strained peer review, particularly in machine learning, raising concerns about declining review quality and increasing reviewer workload. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as automated review assistants, yet their evaluation has focused largely on imitating human-written reviews rather than supporting the core functions of peer review. Here, we introduce a verification-centric perspective on LLM-assisted peer review, emphasizing error detection as a critical and resource-intensive task. We present a scalable benchmark that evaluates review systems' ability to identify logical contradictions, constructed through synthetic insertion of errors into conference papers, yielding unambiguous evaluation targets and enabling systematic comparison. We further propose a Multi-Layered Review (MLR) framework that prioritizes detailed manuscript comprehension before review generation, aligning more closely with human reviewing practices while improving token efficiency. Across evaluations, our approach demonstrates strong alignment with human review scores, achieves high error detection performance, and provides complementary perspectives on reviewer focus. These improvements can be attributed to both the choice of the underlying LLM and the design of our system. At the same time, we corroborate persistent vulnerabilities to adversarial manipulation, underscoring the need for robustness in automated review systems. Our findings highlight the importance of rigorous, error-focused evaluation to guide responsible deployment of LLM-based tools in peer review and other critical scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"错误检测"为核心的大模型辅助同行评审评测视角，构建了通过向会议论文合成注入错误而形成的可扩展基准，并提出"多层评审（MLR）"框架，强调先深入理解稿件再生成评审。实验表明该方法与人类评审分数高度一致、错误检测性能强，同时仍存在对抗操纵的脆弱性，凸显自动化评审系统对鲁棒性的需求。
AI.motivation: 科学出版规模快速增长使同行评审承压，机器学习领域尤为突出，评审质量下降与审稿人负担加重引发担忧。已有研究多将大模型作为自动评审助手，但其评测主要关注"模仿人类撰写的评审意见"，而非支撑同行评审的核心功能，因此缺乏对评审关键能力的系统性检验。
AI.method: 1）提出以验证为中心（verification-centric）的视角，将错误检测视为评审中关键且高资源消耗的任务；2）构建可扩展基准：通过向会议论文中合成注入错误（如逻辑矛盾）来构造评测目标，使评价标准明确、结果可系统比较；3）提出 Multi-Layered Review（MLR）框架，在生成评审意见之前先进行细粒度的稿件理解，以更贴近人类评审实践并提升 token 效率。
AI.result: 所提方法在多项评测中与人类评审分数表现出较强一致性，错误检测性能高，并能提供关于审稿人关注点的互补视角；这些改进可同时归因于底层大模型的选择与系统设计。同时，研究证实系统对对抗性操纵仍存在持续脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调，应以严格、以错误为中心的评测来指导大模型评审工具在同行评审及其他关键科学工作流中的负责任部署，并呼吁提升自动化评审系统的鲁棒性。

title: OpenProblemBench: Benchmarking AI on Open Problems in the Foundational Theoretical Sciences
summary: The next frontier for artificial general intelligence is tackling unresolved scientific problems, calling for benchmarks that assess progress beyond established knowledge. We introduce OpenProblemBench, a benchmark of 82 unresolved problems drawn from the mathematics and theoretical physics literature. Each problem supplies the research context, assumptions, and prior progress needed to investigate the question. We select problems whose proposed solutions admit comparatively clear checks of their decisive mathematical or computational claims. Four evaluator models independently assess the correctness, completeness, and degree of progress of each submission without reference solutions. Across seven evaluated configurations, GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest mean judged solve rate of 14.0%, compared with 5.5-6.7% for the evaluated full-size open models and 2.4-3.7% for Flash models. Case comparisons connect stronger outcomes to changes in problem representation, general arguments that extend beyond finite evidence, and proofs of the steps needed to complete a solution. By grounding evaluation in questions arising from the research literature, OpenProblemBench provides a setting for investigating the capabilities and limitations of AI as a contributor to foundational theoretical science.

AI.tldr: 介绍 OpenProblemBench：一个含 82 道数学与理论物理未解问题的基准，通过多模型独立评判考察 AI 在超越已有知识的前沿科研问题上的能力。
AI.motivation: AGI 的下一个前沿是攻克未解决的科研问题，然而现有基准多基于已有知识，难以衡量 AI 在真正开放问题上的贡献能力，因此需要构建面向未解科学问题的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 OpenProblemBench，收录 82 个来自数学与理论物理文献的未解问题，每题提供研究背景、假设与已有进展；选取其解答的关键数学或计算主张可较清晰核验的问题；由四个评测模型在无参考解条件下独立评估提交结果的正确性、完整性与进展程度。
AI.result: 在七种配置中，GPT-6-Astra 取得最高平均判定求解率 14.0%；同期评测的全尺寸开源模型为 5.5–6.7%，Flash 类模型为 2.4–3.7%。案例比较表明，更优结果与问题表征的改变、超越有限证据的一般性论证以及完成求解所需步骤的证明相关。
AI.conclusion: 通过将评测扎根于研究文献中的开放问题，OpenProblemBench 为研究 AI 作为基础理论科学贡献者的能力与局限提供了评测环境。

title: When Interfaces Speak: Data-Aware Generative UI Harness for Active Interaction
summary: Most human-agent interaction today remains text-based. Natural language can impose cognitive overload, ambiguity, information chaos, and slow input for complex tasks; ephemeral generative UIs can present structured information and guide users toward task completion. We propose GenUI-Harness, a multi-agent harness pairing a Tool Agent for information retrieval and task execution with a GUI Coder Agent that identifies ambiguities and generates front-end code for structured interfaces. Training the coder with reinforcement learning is challenging: verifiable rewards for interactive UI generation require costly execution, while LLM-as-a-Judge rewards are prone to reward hacking. We address the first challenge with Dynamic UX, a lightweight package for dynamic interaction and reward collection in a single sandbox, and the second with Reward Auditor, a meta-reward mechanism that monitors reward distributions and distills diagnostic patterns into a shared rubric and scoring specification. We introduce UI-TAU Bench, a benchmark for active human-agent interaction through generated UI code, built on 10 real-world domain databases constructed from public data sources and based on Tau-Bench tool-use settings, with Lite (300 tasks) and Full (1,000 tasks) splits. GenUI-Harness achieves an average Pass@3 gain of 4.48 percentage points over smolagents on Lite. Training with GenUI-Harness improves a 4B backbone from 9.33% to 58.00% Pass@3, outperforming larger frontier models such as Claude Opus 5 (46.67%). GenUI-Harness also remains robust on ambiguous and non-ambiguous queries. In a reviewer survey comparing communication channels, generated UIs reduce average dialogue rounds from 3.4 to 1.2. These results show that data-aware generative interfaces can support effective task completion and reduce dialogue rounds in evaluated database-backed workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出 GenUI-Harness 多智能体框架，通过生成式前端界面替代纯文本交互，结合 Dynamic UX 与 Reward Auditor 解决强化学习奖励难题，并在 UI-TAU Bench 上显著提升任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 当前人机交互以文本为主，自然语言在复杂任务中易造成认知负荷、歧义、信息混乱与输入缓慢；短暂性生成式 UI 可呈现结构化信息并引导用户完成任务，因此需要构建能生成结构化界面的智能体系统。
AI.method: GenUI-Harness 采用多智能体架构：Tool Agent 负责信息检索与任务执行，GUI Coder Agent 识别歧义并生成前端代码。针对可验证奖励执行成本高的问题，提出 Dynamic UX（单沙箱内动态交互与奖励收集轻量包）；针对 LLM-as-a-Judge 易被奖励黑客攻击的问题，提出 Reward Auditor 元奖励机制，通过监控奖励分布并提炼诊断模式形成共享评分标准。同时构建 UI-TAU Bench 基准，基于 10 个真实领域数据库与 Tau-Bench 工具使用设置，含 Lite(300) 与 Full(1000) 任务划分。
AI.result: GenUI-Harness 在 Lite 上较 smolagents 平均 Pass@3 提升 4.48 个百分点；4B 骨干模型经训练后 Pass@3 从 9.33% 提升至 58.00%，超过 Claude Opus 5(46.67%) 等更大前沿模型；在歧义与非歧义查询上均保持稳健；评审调查显示生成式 UI 将平均对话轮次从 3.4 降至 1.2。
AI.conclusion: 数据感知的生成式界面能有效支持任务完成并减少数据库驱动工作流中的对话轮次，验证了 GenUI-Harness 在主动式人机交互中的有效性。

title: Balancing Reference Guidance and Free Generation in Trajectory Rollouts for Reasoning RL
summary: A verified reference solution provides a correct trajectory for training a reasoning model. Alternatively, a prefix of the reference can guide the model in generating a trajectory of its own. How much reference guidance should we provide? We study this question through prefix continuation, where the model continues from a reference prefix and keeps the resulting trajectory if it passes verification, falling back to the reference otherwise. Since both procedures produce correct trajectories, we compare their distributions with the ideal distribution, the model's own distribution conditioned on successful verification. For one continuation, we derive the KL divergence in closed form, which, up to a bounded term, decreases with the product of the probability of generating a different correct trajectory and the reference surprisal, the negative log probability of the reference suffix given the prefix. Since a longer prefix tends to raise the former but lowers the latter, continuation success alone does not determine the preferred amount of guidance. From this analysis, we learn a prefix selector shared across training questions from continuation outcomes, without estimating success probabilities or additional generation. The resulting Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) constructs correct trajectories within a fixed generation budget, and we apply it to all-failure groups in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ARG achieves the highest aggregate pass@12 among the evaluated methods with competitive average sampled accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应参考引导（ARG），通过前缀续写分析 KL 散度，学习跨题共享的前缀选择器，在固定生成预算下构造正确轨迹并用于 GRPO 全失败组，实验显示在五个数学推理基准上取得最高 pass@12。
AI.motivation: 训练推理模型时，已验证的参考解提供正确轨迹，而参考前缀可引导模型自行生成轨迹。关键问题是应提供多少参考引导：前缀越长越可能让模型生成不同的正确轨迹，但同时降低参考后缀的意外度（surprisal），仅凭续写成功率无法判断最优引导量。
AI.method: 研究前缀续写范式：模型从参考前缀继续生成，若通过验证则保留该轨迹，否则回退到参考解。将续写分布与理想分布（模型在验证成功条件下的自身分布）比较，对单次续写推导出闭式 KL 散度；据此学习一个跨训练问题共享的前缀选择器，无需估计成功概率或额外生成。将所得 ARG 应用于 GRPO 中的全失败组。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，跨五个数学推理基准的实验表明，ARG 在所评估方法中取得最高的聚合 pass@12，同时平均采样准确率具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 引导量的权衡由“生成不同正确轨迹的概率”与“参考意外度”的乘积决定，续写成功率本身不足以判断最优引导量；基于该分析的共享前缀选择器 ARG 能有效利用固定生成预算构造正确轨迹，并提升 GRPO 全失败组的训练效果。

title: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury
summary: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) is prevalent among adolescents with depression, but the rapid brain-state dynamics linking social distress to maladaptive behavior remain unclear. We combine an experimental pain paradigm, electroencephalography (EEG) microstate analysis, and interpretable deep sequence modeling to investigate NSSI-related neurodynamics in 106 adolescents with depression, including 67 with NSSI (DN+) and 39 without NSSI (DN-), during social pain, physical pain, and resting-state conditions. A model integrating disease-specific, domain-adversarial, consistency, and contrastive learning captures higher-order dependencies in microstate sequences. Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination, with 68.55% accuracy, outperforming the best baseline by 8.94% points. Model interpretation and conventional microstate analyses reveal weakened bidirectional transitions between MS3 and MS5 in DN+ adolescents during social pain. Source reconstruction associates MS3 with emotional/interoceptive processing and MS5 with action preparation, suggesting disrupted emotion-action coupling. Time-resolved analyses show greater early-to-middle action-state recruitment and later emotion-state recruitment in DN+ adolescents. In DN- adolescents, MS5-to-MS3 dynamics mediate associations between social-evaluation sensitivity and affective outcomes, whereas this mediation is absent in DN+; conversely, MS3-to-MS5 transitions are associated with greater negative affect in DN+. Together, these findings identify disrupted emotion-action coupling as a key neurodynamic mechanism underlying altered social pain processing in adolescents with NSSI, providing a mechanistically interpretable neural signature for objective identification of NSSI.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合实验性疼痛范式、EEG微状态分析与可解释深度序列建模，揭示伴非自杀性自伤（NSSI）抑郁青少年在社会疼痛下存在情绪-行动耦合受损的神经动力学机制，并提供可解释的NSSI客观识别标志。
AI.motivation: NSSI在抑郁青少年中高发，但将社会痛苦与适应不良行为联系起来的快速脑状态动力学机制尚不清楚，且缺乏可解释的客观神经标志。研究旨在探究NSSI相关神经动力学，并构建可解释的识别模型。
AI.method: 对106名抑郁青少年（67名伴NSSI，DN+；39名不伴NSSI，DN-）在社交疼痛、躯体疼痛与静息态条件下采集EEG，采用微状态分析；构建融合疾病特异、域对抗、一致性及对比学习的深度序列模型以捕捉微状态序列的高阶依赖，并结合源重建与时间分辨分析。
AI.result: 社会疼痛条件对NSSI区分能力最强，准确率68.55%，优于最佳基线8.94个百分点；DN+青少年社会疼痛下MS3与MS5间双向转换减弱。源重建显示MS3与情绪/内感受加工相关、MS5与行动准备相关。时间分辨分析显示DN+早期至中期行动状态募集增强、后期情绪状态募集增强。DN-中MS5→MS3动力学中介社会评价敏感性与情感结局关联，DN+中该中介缺失；DN+中MS3→MS5转换与更强负性情感相关。
AI.conclusion: 情绪-行动耦合受损是伴NSSI抑郁青少年社会疼痛加工异常的关键神经动力学机制，提供了具有机制可解释性的NSSI客观识别神经标志。

title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
summary: Persistent memory can improve personalization in LLM agents but can also induce sycophancy and cross-domain leakage. We distinguish two governance decisions: admission, which determines what recalled information enters the working context, and presentation, which determines how admitted information is expressed. We implement two inference-time designs without retraining: factor-compiled admission (FC), which assesses whole memory entries, and permission-semantic admission (PS), which decomposes entries into typed units; both translate adjudicated attributes into eligibility decisions via deterministic policies. We evaluate on a four-backbone development suite and an external benchmark with four tasks of 300 samples each. Relative to verbatim injection, FC and PS reduce pooled judge-assessed failure rates on the external benchmark by 6.7 and 8.8 percentage points (p = 2.7e-7 and 4.1e-12), and development-set cross-domain leakage falls by up to 29.5 percentage points. A query-conditioned gating baseline shows no significant change in objective-fact failure or pooled failure. Under matched admission budgets, PS outperforms random and relevance-based selection on external objective-fact judgment after Holm correction. Holding presentation fixed, tightening admission cuts cross-domain failure by a further 17.5 percentage points (p = 1.6e-4); in contrast, no comparison between two renderings of identical adjudicated outputs survives multiple-comparison correction. Both designs increase personalization failures, and PS misses the preregistered improvement and personalization-preservation criteria. These results support evaluating admission and presentation separately: selection quality provides task-specific safety gains, while preserving beneficial memory use remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分记忆治理中的"准入"与"呈现"两类决策，在无需重训的推理阶段实现FC与PS两种设计，并证明收紧准入能显著降低跨域失败率，而呈现方式差异不显著；但个性化保留问题仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆虽能提升LLM智能体的个性化能力，却也可能引发谄媚与跨域信息泄漏，因此需要明确记忆治理机制及其效果边界。
AI.method: 将治理拆分为准入（决定哪些被召回信息进入工作上下文）与呈现（决定已准入信息如何表达）；推理阶段实现两种无重训设计：因子编译准入（FC，评估整条记忆条目）与权限语义准入（PS，将条目分解为带类型单元），二者均通过确定性策略将裁定属性转化为资格决策。在四骨干开发套件与外部基准（四个任务、各300样本）上评估，并设查询条件门控基线、随机与相关性选择基线及呈现对照。
AI.result: 相对逐字注入，FC与PS在外部基准上的合并评判失败率分别降低6.7与8.8个百分点（p=2.7e-7、4.1e-12），开发集跨域泄漏最多下降29.5个百分点；查询条件门控基线在客观事实失败与合并失败上均无显著变化。在匹配准入预算下，PS经Holm校正后在外部客观事实判断上优于随机与相关性选择。固定呈现时收紧准入使跨域失败再降17.5个百分点（p=1.6e-4）；而同裁定输出的两种呈现方式比较均未通过多重比较校正。两种设计均增加个性化失败，且PS未达预注册的改进与个性化保留标准。
AI.conclusion: 应分别评估准入与呈现：选择质量带来任务特定安全增益，而保留有益记忆使用仍属未解问题。

title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasing
summary: Long-term Time Series Forecasting (LTSF) tasks, which leverage the current data sequence as input to predict the future sequence, have become increasingly crucial in real-world applications such as weather forecasting and planning of electricity consumption. However, state-of-the-art LTSF models often fail to achieve prediction output alignment for the same timestamps across lagged input sequences. Instead, these models exhibit low output alignment, resulting in fluctuation in prediction outputs for the same timestamps, undermining the model's reliability. To address this, we propose AliO (Align Outputs), a novel approach designed to improve the output alignment of LTSF models by reducing the discrepancies between prediction outputs for the same timestamps in both the time and frequency domains. To measure output alignment, we introduce a new metric, TAM (Time Alignment Metric), which quantifies the alignment between prediction outputs, whereas existing metrics such as MSE only capture the distance between prediction outputs and ground truths. Experimental results show that AliO effectively improves the output alignment, i.e., up to 58.2% in TAM, while maintaining or enhancing the forecasting performance (up to 27.5%). This improved output alignment increases the reliability of the LTSF models, making them more applicable in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 针对长期时间序列预测(LTSF)模型对同一时间戳预测输出不一致的问题，提出了AliO方法以提升输出对齐性，并引入TAM度量指标。
AI.motivation: 现有LTSF模型在滞后输入序列下对同一时间戳的预测输出对齐性低，导致预测结果波动，削弱模型可靠性。而MSE等现有指标仅衡量预测与真值的距离，无法捕捉输出对齐性。
AI.method: 提出AliO(Align Outputs)方法，通过减少同一时间戳在时域和频域上的预测输出差异来提升LTSF模型的输出对齐性；并引入新的度量指标TAM(Time Alignment Metric)量化预测输出间的对齐程度。
AI.result: 实验表明，AliO有效提升输出对齐性，TAM最高提升58.2%，同时保持或提升预测性能(最高27.5%)。
AI.conclusion: 提升输出对齐性增强了LTSF模型的可靠性，使其更适用于实际场景。

title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models
summary: Large language model agents are being increasingly deployed as autonomous scientists, designing experiments and inferring mechanistic world models with minimal human oversight. Yet identifiability is often overlooked: when a plateau is reached, the agent needs to know whether it is not yet capable enough or the model simply is not identifiable from the data, in which case no amount of further experimentation of the same kind can help. We propose the Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) for closed-loop discovery with an identifiability engine that returns a three-way plateau verdict: capability limit, resolvable within the design class, or certified exhausted. On ODEBench, 60 of the 62 systems with free constants are identifiable at round 0; the RC circuit is certified exhausted for every experiment that protocol can run, and a harvesting model is resolvable by one added initial condition. The identifiability engine reproduces known verdicts on Lotka-Volterra, Van der Pol, Lorenz, and a pharmacokinetic model, where it recommends the intravenous arm pharmacologists use, and it ranks the depth scorer of our own benchmark last among four observation designs. On the DiscoverPhysics benchmark, it finds two public worlds whose explanation rubric rewards a distinction no legal experiment can make, and every model there with accurate trajectories failed the explanation grade (15 of 15, against 5 of 9 in identifiable worlds, p = 0.012). On the Alien Universe, a two-body testbed we propose in which a force law switches between a provably non-identifiable and an identifiable protocol, LLM-IDEA on the identifiable protocol reaches discovery depth at least three on 8/8 seeds versus 1/8 without it. An autonomous discovery agent can thus compute, rather than guess, whether a plateau calls for more search, a better experiment of the same kind, or a different kind of experiment.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLM-IDEA，用可辨识性引擎为闭环自主发现提供“能力不足/同设计类可解/已穷尽”三分类判据。
AI.motivation: 自主科学发现智能体常把平台期误判为能力不足，忽视可辨识性，导致对同一类实验做无效重复；需要区分继续搜索、改进同类实验还是更换实验类型。
AI.method: 构建 LLM-IDEA 闭环发现智能体，内置可辨识性引擎，输出三向平台期判据：能力上限、设计类内可解、认证穷尽；在 ODEBench、DiscoverPhysics、Alien Universe 等基准上验证。
AI.result: ODEBench 62 个含自由常数系统中 60 个在第 0 轮即可辨识；RC 电路对协议可执行实验均判定穷尽，harvesting 模型加一个初始条件即可解。引擎复现 Lotka-Volterra、Van der Pol、Lorenz 与药代模型结论，并推荐静脉给药臂。DiscoverPhysics 中找出两个公开世界其解释评分奖励任何合法实验都无法区分的差异，轨迹准确模型 15/15 解释不合格（可辨识世界 5/9，p=0.012）。Alien Universe 可辨识协议下 8/8 种子达到发现深度≥3，无引擎仅 1/8。
AI.conclusion: 自主发现智能体可计算而非猜测平台期含义，从而决定继续搜索、改进同类实验或改用不同实验。

title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Agents combine reasoning with tools to interact with external systems and complete real-world tasks. Early agents typically interleave reasoning and actions along a single execution chain. On complex tasks, this chain becomes unreliable because growing histories obscure intermediate dependencies and allow early planning errors to propagate. Recursively decomposing a complex task into smaller subtasks offers a natural solution, yet effective decomposition must account for the system's capabilities so that each subtask can be executed by the available tools. In realistic systems, however, tool libraries can be too large to expose in full. Injecting every tool description consumes substantial context while making relevant tools harder to retrieve and useful task boundaries harder to identify. We propose tool-aware recursive decomposition, which organizes tools by functional relationships into a hierarchy of capabilities. During execution, the agent discovers tools on demand and uses the hierarchy to recursively decompose a complex task into a subtask tree whose levels are aligned with the capabilities required at each stage. Experiments on complex real-world tasks show that the proposed method improves end-to-end task success rate by up to 40 percentage points over the compared baselines. The implementation of TaReD is available on GitHub: https://github.com/WeiXiang-Mao/TaReD.

AI.tldr: 提出工具感知的递归分解方法TaReD，将工具按功能关系组织为能力层次结构，代理按需发现工具并据此递归分解复杂任务，端到端任务成功率最高提升40个百分点。
AI.motivation: 早期代理沿单一执行链交错进行推理与动作，在复杂任务中历史累积会掩盖中间依赖，并使早期规划错误不断传播；虽然递归分解是自然解法，但有效分解必须匹配系统能力以保证子任务可由现有工具执行，而现实系统工具库过大无法全部暴露，全部注入工具描述既消耗大量上下文，又降低相关工具检索与任务边界识别的效果。
AI.method: 提出工具感知递归分解（tool-aware recursive decomposition，TaReD）：按功能关系将工具组织成能力层次结构；执行过程中代理按需发现工具，并利用该层次结构将复杂任务递归分解为子任务树，使各层级与相应阶段所需能力对齐。
AI.result: 在复杂真实世界任务上的实验表明，相比对比基线，该方法将端到端任务成功率最高提升40个百分点。TaReD实现已开源：https://github.com/WeiXiang-Mao/TaReD。
AI.conclusion: 通过将工具组织为能力层次结构并按需发现，递归分解可与系统能力对齐，从而在工具库庞大时仍能有效提升复杂任务的端到端执行成功率。

title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
summary: Autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs requires generating and testing hypotheses adaptively as evidence accumulates while maintaining statistical validity. Existing anytime-valid methods can handle data-dependent hypotheses, but open-ended discovery poses a deeper challenge: the best discovered hypothesis may still be the best of a bad lot, with better explanations yet undiscovered, while even background knowledge such as physical laws may require revision in light of new findings. In response, we formalize the problem as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory. We introduce abductive utility, a computable measure of discovery progress, and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm for AASD, which maintains anytime validity and achieves $\varepsilon$-optimal abductive utility asymptotically under suitable conditions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scientific-discovery tasks show strong performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“溯因自主科学发现（AASD）”问题，用可能性理论形式化开放式的LLM自主发现，并提出可计算指标“溯因效用”及首个算法“可能性前沿搜索”，在保持anytime有效性的同时渐近达到ε最优溯因效用。
AI.motivation: 自主科学发现需在证据累积过程中自适应地生成并检验假设，且要保持统计有效性。现有anytime-valid方法虽能处理数据依赖的假设，但开放式发现面临更深层挑战：已发现的最佳假设可能只是“坏中之最”，更好的解释尚未被发现；甚至物理定律等背景知识也可能需随新发现而修正。
AI.method: 用可能性理论（possibility theory）将问题形式化为溯因自主科学发现（AASD）；提出溯因效用（abductive utility），一种可计算的发现进展度量；并设计可能性前沿搜索（possibility frontier search），作为首个面向AASD的算法。
AI.result: 该算法保持anytime有效性，并在适当条件下渐近达到ε最优的溯因效用。在合成及真实科学发现任务上均表现出强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文为LLM驱动的开放式科学发现提供了统一的形式化框架与可计算进展度量，并给出首个兼具统计有效性与渐近最优性的算法，实验验证其有效性。

title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
summary: Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. Its payoff is cross-domain generalization: on multiple unseen domains it attains end-to-end zero-shot speedup---to our knowledge the first for presolve action sequences---varying by domain and not explained by corpus richness, the strongest domain reaching the largest speedup once racing is added. Deployment uses sequence racing, in which candidate sequences run concurrently and the winner is kept, enabled by an execution-and-observation facility, added by modifying the SCIP source, that injects sequences along the native path and records which actions actually execute and in which round.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ORDO 框架，将混合整数规划（MIP）的 presolve 规划重新表述为统一原子动作空间上的自回归序列生成问题，实现跨域零样本加速。
AI.motivation: Presolve 对 MIP 性能影响显著，但现有基于学习的方法仅优化参数配置，无法表达动作之间非交换的时间依赖关系；这些依赖的默认顺序在多数问题上几乎唯一且在功能上必要（打乱同一序列的顺序会使求解时间分布的尾部膨胀数倍）。因此需要将决策对象从参数配置转向动作序列。
AI.method: 将 presolve 规划建模为统一原子动作空间上的自回归序列生成，称为 ORDO（Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve），把决策对象移为动作序列。部署时采用序列竞速（sequence racing）：多个候选序列并发执行并保留优胜者；并通过修改 SCIP 源码增加执行与观测设施，将序列注入原生执行路径，记录实际执行的动作及其所在轮次。
AI.result: 在多个未见领域上实现端到端零样本加速——据作者所知，这是 presolve 动作序列的首次；加速幅度随领域变化，且无法由语料丰富度解释，加入竞速后最强领域获得最大加速。
AI.conclusion: 表明将 presolve 规划转为自回归序列生成可实现跨域泛化，动作顺序具有功能必要性，序列竞速与观测设施是有效部署手段。

title: MedBenchAgent: Towards Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmark Construction
summary: Large-scale construction of medical vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks is increasingly feasible with richly annotated imaging datasets and large language models (LLMs), yet existing automation largely focuses on generating evaluation items within predefined benchmark specifications. We study the broader problem of automatically deriving the specification itself: what to evaluate, which annotations support each task, and how to translate this evidence into reliable evaluation items. We formulate benchmark construction as constrained compilation, in which the benchmark specification is progressively derived from evaluation requirements, heterogeneous annotations, and medical knowledge. Based on this formulation, we introduce MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework with a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) that encodes task definitions, evidence mappings, evaluation protocols, and item specifications across construction stages. MedBenchAgent separates planning, which derives and verifies the specification, from instantiation, which constructs and audits items under the locked specification. MedBenchAgent achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9%, outperforming direct task induction (79.2-80.0%) and prior-guided induction (85.1%); 994 of 1,000 sampled items from correctly identified tasks pass human audit. We further demonstrate portability to a specialized medical domain and evaluate twelve VLMs, revealing task- and setting-specific variation obscured by aggregate scores. These results establish constrained compilation as a scalable and auditable framework for medical VLM benchmark construction beyond question generation.

AI.tldr: 将医学视觉语言模型（VLM）基准构建形式化为"约束编译"问题，提出多智能体框架 MedBenchAgent，实现从评测需求到评测项目的自动化推导，任务空间 F1 达 90.9%，显著优于直接任务归纳与先验引导归纳。
AI.motivation: 现有医学 VLM 基准的自动化构建主要集中于"在预定义基准规范内生成评测题目"，而"基准规范本身如何推导"（评什么、哪些标注支持哪些任务、如何将证据转化为可靠评测项）尚未被系统研究。本文旨在自动化地推导规范本身，突破仅做题目生成的局限。
AI.method: 将基准构建形式化为约束编译（constrained compilation）：基准规范由评测需求、异构标注与医学知识逐步推导而来。据此提出 MedBenchAgent 多智能体框架，引入基准中间表示（BIR），编码任务定义、证据映射、评测协议与项目规格，贯穿各构建阶段。框架将"规划"（推导并验证规范）与"实例化"（在锁定规范下构建并审核评测项）解耦。
AI.result: MedBenchAgent 的任务空间 F1 达 90.9%，优于直接任务归纳（79.2–80.0%）与先验引导归纳（85.1%）；从正确识别任务中采样的 1000 个评测项中有 994 个通过人工审核。进一步验证了向专门医学领域的可移植性，并评测了 12 个 VLM，揭示出聚合分数所掩盖的任务与情境特异性差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，约束编译是一种可扩展且可审计的医学 VLM 基准构建框架，其能力超越单纯的题目生成，为规范级自动化构建提供了新范式。

title: Finsler Flow Matching: Dynamics-Aware Geodesic Interpolation for Single-Snapshot Trajectory Inference
summary: Single-cell snapshot data can resolve a continuum of cellular states but do not uniquely determine the dynamics governing transitions between them. However, additional dynamical information can often be encoded in a cell-cell Markov transition kernel. Existing generative approaches for single cell trajectory inference either infer transport only from population marginals, impose a symmetric geometry on the state space, or incorporate directionality through a single velocity vector at each observed state. We introduce Finsler Flow Matching (FFM), a framework for learning continuous stochastic dynamics from discrete Markov transition graphs. We use the first and second local moments to construct a Finsler structure motivated by the Freidlin--Wentzell action, where the second moment determines anisotropic accessibility and the first moment introduces a preferred direction of motion. We learn neural approximations of the resulting directed geodesics, use their Finsler cost to construct source-target couplings, and define geometry-aware stochastic conditional paths that can be distilled into a continuous generative process through simulation-free score and flow matching. Across synthetic and single-cell trajectory inference benchmarks, FFM improves recovery of withheld intermediate populations, particularly when the transition dynamics are strongly directional or anisotropic. Our results provide a principled route from discrete transition probabilities to continuous generative dynamics while retaining both directional and diffusive structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Finsler Flow Matching (FFM)，一个从离散马尔可夫转移图学习连续随机动力学的框架，利用一、二阶局部矩构造 Finsler 结构以捕捉各向异性与方向性，在单细胞轨迹推断中更准确地恢复中间细胞群。
AI.motivation: 单细胞快照数据能刻画细胞状态的连续谱，却无法唯一确定状态间的转移动力学，而额外的动力学信息常编码在细胞-细胞马尔可夫转移核中。现有生成式轨迹推断方法存在局限：仅从群体边缘分布推断传输、在状态空间上强加对称几何、或仅用单个速度向量引入方向性，难以刻画强方向性或各向异性的转移动态。
AI.method: FFM 从离散马尔可夫转移图学习连续随机动力学。其核心是用一阶与二阶局部矩构造 Finsler 结构（受 Freidlin–Wentzell 作用量启发）：二阶矩决定各向异性可达性，一阶矩引入偏好运动方向。方法学习该有向测地线的神经网络近似，用其 Finsler 代价构造源-目标耦合，并定义几何感知的随机条件路径；随后通过无模拟的 score matching 与 flow matching 将之蒸馏为连续生成过程。
AI.result: 在合成数据与单细胞轨迹推断基准上，FFM 提升了对被隐藏的中间细胞群的恢复能力，当转移动力学具有强方向性或各向异性时尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: FFM 提供了一条从离散转移概率到连续生成动力学的有原则路径，同时保留了方向性与扩散结构。

title: Mine Odyssey: Benchmarking Spatial Agentic Intelligence in the Wild
summary: Advances in foundation models are driving efforts to introduce agents to assist people in the physical world. Such agents require agentic spatial intelligence: exploring unfamiliar environments, updating spatial understanding through interaction, and adapting actions based on feedback to sustain progress toward a sequence of goals. Existing benchmarks cover only a limited range of spatial layouts, scales, and traversal requirements. We introduce Mine Odyssey, a benchmark for evaluating agentic spatial intelligence using Minecraft reconstructions of real-world locations. It comprises 180 tasks covering 30 such locations across 20 countries and regions on five continents, including 20 outdoor and 10 indoor settings. These settings span diverse spatial scales, layouts, terrains, and connectivity patterns, from Midtown Manhattan and rural Entrup to Santa Lucía Hill and Buckingham Palace. We select meaningful waypoints, such as landmarks, buildings, and rooms, and manually verify their accessibility. Each task provides a natural-language instruction specifying which waypoints to visit and in what order. Completing these tasks requires agents to find accessible routes and entrances, open doors, and move between levels using stairs and ladders, while monitoring their progress and recovering from navigation errors. Across eight evaluated state-of-the-art models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 85.6%. However, the second-best model, Claude Opus 5.5, completes 73.9% of tasks, while the strongest evaluated open-weight model, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, reaches 23.9%, highlighting substantial room for improvement in the agentic spatial intelligence of current models. Comprehensive analyses and ablation studies on Mine Odyssey reveal current models' limitations and provide insights for advancing agentic spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mine Odyssey 基准，用真实地点的 Minecraft 重建评估智能体的空间智能，包含 180 项任务，覆盖 30 个地点、20 个国家与地区。
AI.motivation: 基础模型推动智能体进入物理世界，需要"智能体空间智能"：探索陌生环境、通过交互更新空间认知、依据反馈调整行动以持续推进目标序列；但现有基准在空间布局、尺度与通行要求上覆盖有限。
AI.method: 基于真实世界地点的 Minecraft 重建构建基准，含 180 项任务、30 个地点（20 个国家与地区、五大洲），包括 20 个室外与 10 个室内场景，空间尺度、布局、地形与连通性多样（如 Midtown Manhattan、rural Entrup、Santa Lucía Hill、Buckingham Palace）；人工选取地标、建筑、房间等有意义路点并核验可达性；每项任务给出指定访问路点及顺序的自然语言指令，需完成寻路、找入口、开门、用楼梯与梯子跨层，并监控进度、从导航错误中恢复。
AI.result: 评测八种先进模型：GPT-6 Astra 成功率最高 85.6%；Claude Opus 5.5 第二，73.9%；最强开源权重模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 仅 23.9%。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在智能体空间智能上仍有显著提升空间；对 Mine Odyssey 的全面分析与消融实验揭示了现有模型的局限，并为推进该方向提供启示。

title: TokenBank: Financial Infrastructure for AI Services
comment: The cloud infrastructure repository is available at https://github.com/Nexilume-AI/nexus-cloud. The hosted deployment can be accessed at https://cloud.nexilume.com/
summary: AI services incur inference costs during execution, while revenue may arrive later. Changing API prices, limited upfront capital, and service failures can limit operators' ability to sustain or expand their services. Beyond reducing per-request costs, operators need to plan future spending, fund execution before revenue arrives, and obtain compensation for specified losses. This requires clear agreements across services with different pricing and execution conditions. These agreements must distinguish rights to consume services from rights to receive payments, define obligations under uncertain costs and income, and specify which failures qualify for compensation and how much can be paid. We present TokenBank, a financial infrastructure that represents these commitments through structured contracts. It supports service-consumption rights, agreements that settle API-price differences in cash (forwards), financing through limited rights to future service revenue, and protection claims for specified service failures. Contracts specify participants, covered services, validity, ownership, fulfillment conditions, and settlement rules. Evaluation combines replay of 899,441 API requests, real model-driven agent execution, and contract API tests. In a zero-discount rising-price resampling scenario, forwards reduce mean expenditure by USD 304.88 but increase its standard deviation from USD 1,152.45 to USD 1,190.82. A controlled replication with five portfolios per capital condition finds mean contribution differences between financing and self-funding of +1.0635, -0.1406, and -0.2962 experimental USD under low, baseline, and ample capital, respectively. The evaluation distinguishes contract correctness from economic effectiveness under declared economic and failure assumptions; supplier invoices and commercial revenue are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TokenBank——一种以结构化合约表示服务承诺的金融基础设施，支持服务消费权、现金结算价格差（远期）、基于未来服务收入有限权利的融资，以及特定服务故障的赔付请求；并通过 899,441 条 API 请求回放、真实模型驱动的智能体执行与合约 API 测试进行评估。
AI.motivation: AI 服务在执行时产生推理成本，而收入可能滞后到账；API 价格变动、前期资本有限以及服务故障会限制运营者维持或扩展服务的能力。除降低单次请求成本外，运营者还需规划未来支出、在收入到账前为执行融资，并就特定损失获得补偿。这要求跨不同定价与执行条件的服务之间建立清晰协议，区分服务消费权与收款权、界定不确定成本与收入下的义务，并明确哪些故障可获赔付及赔付额度。
AI.method: TokenBank 通过结构化合约表示上述承诺，合约规定参与者、覆盖服务、有效期、所有权、履行条件与结算规则；支持服务消费权、以现金结算 API 价格差的远期协议、通过未来服务收入的有限权利进行融资，以及针对特定服务故障的保障请求。评估方法结合 899,441 条 API 请求回放、真实模型驱动的智能体执行和合约 API 测试。
AI.result: 在零折扣、价格上涨的重采样情景中，远期合约使平均支出减少 304.88 美元，但标准差从 1,152.45 美元升至 1,190.82 美元。在每种资本条件下设置五个组合的受控重复实验中，低资本、基线与充足资本下，融资与自筹资金的均值贡献差分别为 +1.0635、−0.1406 和 −0.2962 实验美元。
AI.conclusion: 评估区分了在所声明的经济与故障假设下的合约正确性与经济有效性；供应商发票与商业收入数据不可得。

title: ReCast: Attribution-Oriented Step Representation Learning for LLM-Based Agent Systems
summary: In LLM-based agent systems, failures can originate from early steps whose effects propagate through subsequent interactions, making their origins difficult to identify. To trace such failures back to their origin, failure attribution has been formulated as the task of identifying the earliest step responsible for the failure. Recent methods leverage LLM internal signals for failure attribution, typically using hidden states as step representations. We therefore conduct an empirical study to evaluate how effectively these representations distinguish root-cause steps from other steps and find limited separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose ReCast, a step representation learning method that transforms hidden states from a frozen LLM into attribution-oriented step representations. ReCast first selects attribution-relevant layers, then constructs complementary pattern and deviation features, and finally learns contextualized step representations through an encoder trained with contrastive and ranking objectives. We also introduce ReCast-2K, a training dataset for failure attribution. ReCast achieves the best Hit@1 across four benchmarks, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.65 and 9.19 pp on Who&When Algorithm and Handcrafted, respectively. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ReCast-5FB6 .

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体系统故障归因问题，指出现有方法直接使用隐藏状态作为步骤表示区分根因步骤的能力有限，提出ReCast方法将冻结LLM的隐藏状态转化为面向归因的步骤表示，并构建ReCast-2K数据集，在四个基准上取得最优Hit@1。
AI.motivation: 在基于LLM的智能体系统中，早期步骤的失败会通过后续交互传播，导致故障源头难以识别。故障归因被定义为识别导致失败的最早步骤。现有方法利用LLM内部信号（通常以隐藏状态作为步骤表示）进行归因，但作者发现这些表示对根因步骤与其他步骤的区分能力有限。
AI.method: 提出ReCast步骤表示学习方法，将冻结LLM的隐藏状态转化为归因导向的步骤表示：首先选择与归因相关的层，然后构造互补的模式特征与偏差特征，最后通过使用对比学习和排序目标训练的编码器学习上下文相关的步骤表示。同时构建故障归因训练数据集ReCast-2K。
AI.result: ReCast在四个基准上取得最优Hit@1，在Who&When的Algorithm和Handcrafted上分别超越最强基线5.65和9.19个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过实证研究发现原始隐藏状态对根因步骤的区分能力有限，而以归因为导向的表示学习能有效提升故障归因性能，ReCast与ReCast-2K为此提供了有效方法与数据支持。

title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
summary: Physics-based models connect scientific explanation with quantitative prediction. Constructing them requires selecting physical processes, defining states and governing equations, specifying couplings, and identifying parameters from experiments. Existing AI systems remain limited in making these model structure decisions autonomously. We introduce EvoSim, a self-evolving AI scientist for physical modeling. It uses experimental discrepancies to drive mechanism and equation revisions and held-out experimental data to test physical plausibility. Exploration traces make updates to knowledge, skills, and multi-agent orchestration. This co-evolution improves physics-based models and EvoSim's ability to select mechanisms, diagnose failures, and coordinate research. We evaluate EvoSim on two industrial battery modeling tasks. It predicts lithium-metal-plating onset from 25 to 45 degrees Celsius and 2 C to 6 C with a mean absolute error of 1.79% in state of charge. Dynamic voltage prediction under vehicle driving conditions achieves a root mean square error of 7.62 mV, surpassing the reported accuracy of models developed by human experts. Self-evolution reduces model and physics errors by approximately 36% relative to baseline, demonstrating improved scientific modeling capability. EvoSim turns experimental observations into validated models and cumulative research expertise.

AI.tldr: EvoSim 是一个面向物理建模的自演化 AI 科学家，通过实验偏差驱动机理与方程修正、留出实验数据检验物理合理性，实现知识、技能和多智能体编排的共同演化。在工业电池建模任务中，其锂沉积起始预测平均绝对误差为 1.79% SOC，动态电压预测 RMSE 为 7.62 mV，自演化使模型与物理误差较基线降低约 36%。
AI.motivation: 物理模型兼具科学解释与定量预测能力，但其构建需完成过程选择、状态与方程定义、耦合设定以及参数辨识。现有 AI 系统尚难自主完成这些模型结构决策，因此需要一种能自动完成物理建模决策的方法。
AI.method: 提出 EvoSim，一种自演化 AI 科学家。其方法核心为：利用实验偏差驱动机理与方程修订，以留出实验数据检验物理合理性；通过探索轨迹更新知识、技能与多智能体编排，实现模型与系统能力的协同演化。
AI.result: 在两个工业电池建模任务上评估：在 25–45°C、2C–6C 条件下预测锂金属沉积起始，荷电状态平均绝对误差为 1.79%；车辆行驶工况下动态电压预测 RMSE 为 7.62 mV，优于人类专家所建模型的报道精度；自演化相较基线将模型与物理误差降低约 36%。
AI.conclusion: EvoSim 能将实验观测转化为经检验的模型，并积累可复用的科研经验，展现出更强的科学建模能力。

title: SynCo: Data Synthesis Co-Training for Self-Evolving LLMs via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Self-evolving LLM agents promise to improve autonomously through continual interaction and learning, reducing their dependence on manually curated supervision. Realizing this promise requires not only updating the agent, but also evolving its training experience as its capabilities change. However, most existing pipelines rely on static datasets or separately updated synthesis models, causing previously useful tasks to become trivial while overly difficult tasks remain uninformative. This growing mismatch between agent capability and training experience limits sustained self-improvement. To address this problem, we propose SynCo, an agentic data synthesis co-training framework for self-evolving LLMs based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. SynCo jointly optimizes two independently parameterized agents: a Synthesizer that constructs training tasks from the Reasoner's evolving capability state, and a Reasoner that learns from the resulting experience. Each synthesized task induces multiple Reasoner rollouts whose outcomes provide complementary rewards to both agents. Correctness feedback improves the Reasoner, while task quality, answer reliability, and outcome-grounded teachability guide the Synthesizer. Their updates are fed back into subsequent synthesis rounds, allowing the task-solving policy and its training distribution to evolve together. Extensive experiments across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SynCo substantially outperforms a broad range of existing synthetic-data methods and controlled baselines, achieving the strongest overall performance while deriving most of its gains from previously unsolved problems.

AI.tldr: 提出SynCo，一种基于多智能体强化学习的agentic数据合成协同训练框架，令合成器与推理器协同进化，实现LLM智能体的持续自我提升。
AI.motivation: 自进化LLM智能体需在更新自身的同时进化其训练经验，但现有流水线依赖静态数据集或独立更新的合成模型，导致旧任务变得平凡、过难任务缺乏信息量，训练经验与智能体能力之间错配，限制持续自我改进。
AI.method: SynCo采用多智能体强化学习，联合优化两个独立参数化的智能体：Synthesizer（合成器）依据Reasoner（推理器）不断进化的能力状态构造训练任务，Reasoner则从生成的经验中学习。每个合成任务触发多次Reasoner rollout，其结果向两个智能体提供互补奖励：正确性反馈改进Reasoner，任务质量、答案可靠性与基于结果的可教性引导Synthesizer。二者更新反馈至后续合成轮次，使解题策略与训练分布共同演化。
AI.result: 在八个数学推理基准上的大量实验表明，SynCo显著优于多种现有合成数据方法与受控基线，取得最强整体性能，且大部分增益来自此前未解决的问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务合成与策略学习统一于协同训练框架，SynCo有效缓解能力-经验错配问题，为自进化LLM智能体提供了可持续的自我改进路径。

title: Writing for the Reviewer: Defensive Writing in GPT Models
summary: Researchers increasingly use ChatGPT to revise their papers, and recent GPT versions often narrow or even retract the authors' claims. We call such changes defensive writing when the given material does not support them, and we test two explanations: the model corrects the authors' overclaiming, or it writes for an anticipated reviewer. We ask GPT versions and models from other developers to rewrite paragraphs from papers written before ChatGPT, or to write from an evidence sheet that lists a paper's method and results. Defensive writing grows with GPT version. GPT-6-astra retracts the authors' claims outright, and when it writes from the evidence sheet, it still adds the most ungrounded qualifications. The results favor the anticipated-review explanation, and correcting overclaiming explains only a small part. When the models are only asked to polish, defense stays near the level of the originals; mentioning review raises it, and one round of self-review raises it further. At the same time, fewer than one in ten of the claims GPT-6-astra retracts are overstated. AI reviewers score defensive rewrites higher, while human readers find them harder to read and the authors less certain. Combining AI writing with AI review may amplify this style.

AI.tldr: 研究者提出"防御性写作"概念：ChatGPT等大模型在改写论文时，会在材料不支持的情况下弱化甚至撤回作者主张，且随版本升级愈演愈烈。实验证据更支持"迎合预期审稿人"的解释，而非"纠正过度声称"。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到研究者越来越多地使用ChatGPT修改论文，而较新的GPT版本常常收窄甚至撤回作者的主张，这种与给定材料不符的改动被称为"防御性写作"。本文旨在厘清其成因：究竟是模型在纠正作者的过度声称，还是模型在面向想象中的审稿人写作。
AI.method: 让不同版本的GPT及其他开发者的模型重写ChatGPT出现之前发表的论文段落，或基于仅列出方法与结果的"证据表"写作；并对模型施加不同提示条件——仅要求润色、提及审稿、以及进行一轮自我评审，比较防御性写作的程度。
AI.result: 防御性写作随GPT版本升级而增强。GPT-6-astra会直接撤回作者主张，且在依据证据表写作时仍加入最多无依据的限定语。结果更支持"预期审稿"解释，纠正过度声称仅能解释很小一部分。仅要求润色时，防御程度接近原文；提及审稿会提高防御性；一轮自我评审会进一步提高。同时，GPT-6-astra撤回的主张中不到十分之一是过度声称。AI审稿人对防御性改写评分更高，而人类读者认为其更难读、作者更不自信。
AI.conclusion: 防御性写作主要由模型面向预期审稿人写作的倾向驱动，而非对真实过度声称的修正；AI写作与AI审稿相结合可能放大这种风格，并牺牲可读性与作者表达的信心。

title: Equal Path Cost, Unequal Output Effects: Understanding Perturbation Propagation in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, with their sampling procedures routinely modified to control generation and improve efficiency. These modifications introduce perturbations along the sampling trajectory, raising a central question: how do such perturbations affect generated output? To address this question, we develop a theoretical framework to investigate perturbation propagation, combining dynamical analysis of the sampling process with an information-theoretic characterization of output responses. Within this framework, we quantify perturbation strength using the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between perturbed and reference trajectory distributions, termed as path cost, which is shown to bound, but do not determine, changes in the output distribution. Building on this analysis, we derive a response identity that connects the propagation and accumulation of local perturbations with the information captured by a selected feature mean, explaining why changes in the output distribution can remain undetected by its first-order response. We test our theoretical analysis through controlled interventions at equal path cost in pretrained diffusion models, revealing distinct patterns of output sensitivity across sampling stages and spatial frequencies. To assess whether our framework can diagnose perturbations arising from practical approximations, we apply it to cache-based acceleration and show that our propagation analysis reliably identifies sampling intervals where caching causes larger image errors.

AI.tldr: 本文建立理论框架，结合采样过程的动力学分析与输出响应的信息论刻画，研究扩散模型采样轨迹扰动如何传播并影响生成结果，提出"路径代价"（扰动与参考轨迹分布间的KL散度）与响应恒等式，并通过等路径代价干预实验及缓存加速诊断验证理论。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的采样过程常被修改以控制生成或提升效率，这些修改会在采样轨迹上引入扰动，但扰动如何影响最终生成输出尚缺乏系统的理论理解。作者希望回答这一核心问题，并检验理论能否诊断实际近似（如缓存加速）带来的扰动。
AI.method: 将采样过程的动力学分析与输出响应的信息论刻画相结合，构建扰动传播的理论框架；用扰动轨迹与参考轨迹分布间的KL散度定义"路径代价"来衡量扰动强度；基于该分析推导响应恒等式，将局部扰动的传播与累积同所选特征均值所捕获的信息联系起来；在预训练扩散模型上进行等路径代价的受控干预实验，并应用于缓存加速场景。
AI.result: 理论分析表明路径代价能够界定（但不能决定）输出分布的变化，响应恒等式解释了输出分布的变化为何可能不被其一阶响应检测到。实验显示在等路径代价下，输出敏感性在采样阶段与空间频率上呈现不同模式；在缓存加速中，传播分析能够可靠识别缓存导致较大图像误差的采样区间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解扩散模型采样扰动如何传播并影响生成输出提供了统一的理论视角，并具备诊断实际近似（如缓存加速）误差来源的实用价值。

title: Environmental Feedback Modeling Matters: Rethinking Feedback Treatment in Agentic Hindsight Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning is commonly used to train language agents in interactive environments, but cannot be directly applied when rewards are unavailable. Recent methods use environmental feedback as privileged context for hindsight self-distillation, but our analysis suggests that simply conditioning the teacher on feedback is insufficient, motivating us to rethink how environmental feedback is used in agentic self-distillation. Given that environmental feedback contains rich supervision for modeling how the environment responds to agent actions, we introduce \textit{agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling} (SELF), a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation. SELF learns to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher into the policy. Our analysis reveals a mutually reinforcing mechanism: environmental feedback modeling strengthens hindsight supervision and policy learning, while self-distillation enhances the model's ability to model environmental feedback. With Qwen3-8B, SELF outperforms SDPO and GRPO by 6.4 and 4.1 percentage points in $τ$-bench success rate, and by 10.71 and 3.57 percentage points in AppWorld task goal completion, respectively. These results show that SELF uses environmental feedback more effectively within agentic self-distillation, improving agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SELF 框架，将环境反馈建模与事后自蒸馏联合优化，使语言智能体在无奖励场景下也能有效学习，并在 τ-bench 与 AppWorld 上超过 SDPO 和 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 强化学习训练交互环境中的语言智能体依赖奖励，而奖励常常不可得。近期方法用环境反馈作为特权上下文进行事后自蒸馏，但作者分析发现仅让教师模型以反馈为条件并不充分，因此需要重新思考环境反馈在智能体自蒸馏中的使用方式。
AI.method: 提出 SELF（agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling）框架，联合优化环境反馈建模与事后自蒸馏。具体地，模型学习预测环境响应，同时将来自“以反馈为条件的自教师”的指导蒸馏进策略中。
AI.result: 分析揭示出相互增强机制：环境反馈建模增强事后监督与策略学习，而自蒸馏提升模型对环境反馈的建模能力。基于 Qwen3-8B，SELF 在 τ-bench 成功率上分别超过 SDPO 和 GRPO 6.4 与 4.1 个百分点，在 AppWorld 任务目标完成度上分别超过 10.71 与 3.57 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 SELF 在智能体自蒸馏中更有效地利用环境反馈，从而提升智能体能力。

title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models
summary: System One models output calibrated probabilities over typed answers such as categorical choices, ordinal levels, or binary outcomes, via a non-generative interface. Software can act on these probabilities through thresholds, cost-weighted choices, and escalation rules. Consequently, if these probabilities are miscalibrated or wording-sensitive, the software ma take unintended actions leaving human operators with no textual rationale to inspect. Current evaluations largely report accuracy and calibration on public classification datasets without a clear reference. We present TypedBench, a benchmark for typed decision models like Jev built from seven policy-labelled generators and nine evaluation suites. We report accuracy as median and range across paraphrases, and calibration error relative to the finite-sample noise floor of a matched, perfectly calibrated predictor. We assess probability quality through selective prediction, ordinal proper scoring rules, and realised cost under asymmetric cost matrices. We evaluate a hosted model, an open encoder, and a family of open decoders spanning 0.8B-9B parameters on identical items. The hosted model follows the stated policy but is wording-sensitive and systematically underconfident; under asymmetric costs, using its probabilities can be worse than taking its top answer. Decoders route exactly and are slow as options or questions are added. The decoder is least accurate on policy questions and degrades with more options. Overall, typed decision models must be evaluated jointly on policy adherence, wording robustness, probability quality, and induced decision outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TypedBench基准，用七个策略标注生成器和九个评估套件，从策略遵循、措辞稳健性、概率质量与决策后果四个维度联合评估类型化决策模型的概率输出。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型通过非生成接口输出分类、序数或二元结果上的校准概率，软件据此执行阈值、成本加权与升级规则。若概率失准或对措辞敏感，软件会采取非预期动作，而人类操作者又缺乏可检查的文本依据。现有评估多在公开分类数据集上报告准确率与校准，缺少明确参照，无法反映上述风险。
AI.method: 构建TypedBench基准，包含七个策略标注生成器与九个评估套件。准确率以跨改写的中位数与范围报告；校准误差相对匹配的完美校准预测器的有限样本噪声下限来衡量。通过选择性预测、序数proper scoring rules及非对称成本矩阵下的实际代价评估概率质量。在相同条目上评测托管模型、开源编码器以及0.8B–9B参数的开源解码器系列。
AI.result: 托管模型遵循既定策略，但对措辞敏感且系统性欠自信；在非对称成本下，使用其概率可能比直接采用其最高答案更差。解码器能够精确路由，但随着选项或问题数量增加而变慢；在策略类问题上准确率最低，且随选项增多而下降。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策模型必须在策略遵循、措辞稳健性、概率质量与诱发决策结果四个方面进行联合评估。

title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE
summary: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE

AI.tldr: 提出认知导向的情感分析框架TRACE及评测基准TRACE-Bench，并给出结构化推理方法TRACER，在五项任务上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有情感计算已从类别化情绪识别发展到基于大型多模态模型的开放式情感分析，但情感科学认为情绪是由评价（appraisal）、调节（regulation）和社会解读共同塑造的动态展开过程，这一过程性视角在计算建模上仍被严重忽视。
AI.method: 1) 提出TRACE框架，将情感片段形式化为Condition（条件）、Affect（情感）、Effect（效应）三个相互关联阶段，融合可观察线索与内部立场、情绪表达调节等认知因素；2) 构建TRACE-Bench，基于646个视频、3,746条结构化问答对，覆盖五类任务：情境化情感识别、调节解码、原因推理、效应推理、全链重构；3) 提出TRACER，一种认知落地的结构化推理方法，将每步推断与来自事实观察、认知评价及上游结论的显式前提相耦合，形成可追溯的中间与目标结论图。
AI.result: 人类与模型对照实验显示存在显著性能差距；情感专用模型总体落后于通用多模态大模型；模型出现规律性失败，如将表现出的行为当作真实感受、在长链生成中捏造缺乏依据的事件。TRACER在五类任务上均优于所有被评估的模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 将情感视为认知驱动的过程性链式结构，并以显式前提约束推理，可有效提升多模态模型的情感理解与可追溯性，为开放式情感分析提供新的评测与方法范式。

title: Why machines will still not rule the world
summary: In our book Why machines will never rule the world [13, 14] we argue that arti- ficial general intelligence is mathematically impossible. This is because the human beings and the processes which exhibit intelligence are complex systems whose be- haviour cannot be captured by the kinds of models that we can generate with or without computers. Proponents of contemporary machine intelligence respond with two lines of argument: a theoretical one, grounded in the universal approximation theorems for neural networks and the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle; and an em- pirical one, grounded in rapidly rising scores on standardized benchmarks. In this communication we examine and reject both responses. First, we show serious issues in the physicalist counter-argument based on the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle. Second, we review recent evidence to the effect that prominent benchmarks are compromised by training-data contamination, flawed test construction, and strate- gic optimization. Our central argument remains: That models required to perform cognitive behaviour in open-ended, thermodynamically complex and non-ergodic environments are not and will not become achievable.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了"通用人工智能可通过神经网络与Church-Turing-Deutsch原理实现"的理论论证及"基准分数快速上升"的实证论证，坚持认为在开放、热力学复杂且非遍历环境中实现认知行为的模型不可实现。
AI.motivation: 作者在《Why machines will never rule the world》一书中主张通用人工智能在数学上不可能，因为人类及智能过程属于复杂系统，其行为无法被任何可生成模型（无论是否借助计算机）所刻画。针对这一主张，当代机器智能支持者提出两条反驳路线（理论路线与实证路线），本文旨在系统检验并驳斥这两条反驳。
AI.method: 理论层面：剖析基于Church-Turing-Deutsch原理的物理主义反驳论证，指出其存在的严重问题。实证层面：梳理近期证据，说明主流基准测试受到训练数据污染、测试构造缺陷以及策略性优化（strategic optimization）的影响。
AI.result: 两条反驳均被否定：基于Church-Turing-Deutsch原理的物理主义论证存在严重缺陷；主流基准的分数提升被训练数据污染、测试构造缺陷和策略性优化所污染，因而不能作为通用智能的可靠证据。
AI.conclusion: 核心论点维持不变：在开放、热力学复杂且非遍历的环境中执行认知行为所需的模型，既不可实现，将来也不会实现。

title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)
summary: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a strategy that clears one level can fail on the next, so every new level is in effect a new task. The agent records what it learns as Python scripts and text notes, while the harness keeps a complete log of every action and observation. Our contribution is a measurement protocol that traces each thought through these files, from the task where it forms to the task where it is corrected or abandoned, applied to seven evaluation runs with three backbones from two model families. Scripts written for one task are almost never called again in a later task (33 of 630 references cross a task boundary), because most scripts embed the state of the current level. Instead, the agent rewrites its knowledge into new scripts, keeping the general rules and dropping the level-specific details, and abandons 74% of the scripts it wrote before a boundary. The notes, which only the model reads, are never revised: the agent appends without removing earlier claims, and the contradictions that accumulate are settled against the log. Because the log preserves everything, the agent forgets selectively, not catastrophically. The most costly error is a hard-coded value carried into a task where it no longer holds. These findings come from the files the agent wrote, without access to the model, and constitute a white-box analysis of how a coding agent continually learns.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一套白盒测量协议，通过追踪编码智能体在ARC-AGI-3连续任务中写入文件的思想痕迹，揭示其跨任务学习表现为"选择性遗忘+知识重写"而非灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 探究编码智能体在无指令的连续抽象推理任务中如何跨任务学习：智能体除书面工件外不保留状态，因此每个思想（信念、规则、计划）都在文件中留下可追踪的痕迹，为无需访问模型内部的白盒分析提供了条件。
AI.method: 在固定框架中运行冻结的基础模型智能体，其通过编写并执行Python与shell脚本行动，并保留完整动作/观察日志。提出测量协议，追踪每个思想从形成任务到被修正或放弃任务的轨迹，在3个骨干模型（2个模型家族）、7次评估运行上应用。
AI.result: 任务间脚本复用极少（630次引用中仅33次跨任务边界），因多数脚本硬编码了当前关卡状态；智能体将知识重写为新脚本，保留通用规则、丢弃关卡特定细节，在边界前放弃74%的脚本；笔记只增不改，累积的矛盾以日志为依据解决；最昂贵的错误是硬编码值被带入不再成立的后续任务。
AI.conclusion: 由于日志保留一切，智能体是选择性遗忘而非灾难性遗忘。这些发现完全来自智能体写入的文件、无需访问模型内部，构成对编码智能体持续学习机制的白盒分析。

title: SpikeSSL: A Universal Spike Inference Framework with Dynamics-Informed State-Space Layers
summary: Two-photon calcium imaging is a standard tool for recording large neural populations in vivo, yet inferring spikes accurately across the growing diversity of calcium indicators remains an open problem. Existing supervised methods achieve reasonable in-domain accuracy but generalize poorly to unseen indicators, because different indicators induce distinct fluorescence kinetics and signal statistics while existing architectures remain relatively simple generic temporal regressors without dynamics-matched inductive bias. We propose SpikeSSL, a universal spike inference framework whose temporal backbone is a bank of bidirectional IIR state-space layers broadly motivated by calcium dynamics. A multi-modal conditioning encoder maps indicator identity, sampling rate, and trace-level signal statistics into a global conditioning vector that modulates the backbone via Adaptive Layer Normalization, while a heteroscedastic variance head provides calibrated per-frame uncertainty. On a benchmark with five fixed evaluation splits built from 33 public ground-truth datasets, SpikeSSL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and zero-shot leave-one-indicator-out settings. We also develop a biophysical simulation pipeline capable of generating paired fluorescence-spike traces with systematically varied kinetic parameters, spike statistics, response nonlinearities, baseline drift, and noise. Using this pipeline, we synthesize approximately 11,000 simulated traces. Augmenting training with these data effectively closes the cross-indicator domain gap and improves zero-shot generalization. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/detimage123/SpikeSSL.

AI.tldr: 提出SpikeSSL通用钙成像脉冲推断框架，以受钙动力学启发的双向IIR状态空间层为时序主干，结合指示剂身份、采样率与信号统计的多模态条件编码和异方差方差头，在33个公开数据集五折基准上实现域内与零样本跨指示剂SOTA，并通过约11000条生物物理仿真轨迹的增广有效缩小跨指示剂域差。
AI.motivation: 双光子钙成像广泛用于记录大规模神经元群体，但不同钙指示剂具有不同的荧光动力学与信号统计特性，现有监督方法虽在域内表现尚可，却因架构多为通用简单时序回归器、缺乏与动力学匹配的归纳偏置，难以泛化到未见指示剂，因此需构建可跨指示剂通用的脉冲推断方法。
AI.method: SpikeSSL以一组双向IIR状态空间层构成的时序主干（受钙动力学启发）为核心，采用多模态条件编码器将指示剂身份、采样率及轨迹级信号统计映射为全局条件向量，经自适应层归一化（Adaptive Layer Normalization）调制主干；同时设异方差方差头输出经过校准的逐帧不确定性。此外构建生物物理仿真流程，可系统生成具有不同动力学参数、脉冲统计、响应非线性、基线漂移与噪声的配对荧光-脉冲轨迹，合成约11000条仿真轨迹用于训练增广。
AI.result: 在由33个公开真值数据集构建、含五个固定评估划分的基准上，SpikeSSL在域内及零样本留一指示剂（leave-one-indicator-out）两种设定下均取得当前最优性能；使用生物物理仿真数据增广训练可有效弥合跨指示剂域差并提升零样本泛化能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SpikeSSL通过将钙动力学归纳偏置嵌入时序主干并进行多模态条件调制，配合不确定性估计与生物物理仿真增广，为跨钙指示剂的通用脉冲推断提供了有效方案，显著缓解了跨指示剂域泛化难题。

title: From Chain-of-Thought to Loops: Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often improves language-model performance by giving models additional computation before answering. However, explicit CoT expresses this computation as a sequence of autoregressively generated tokens. Latent reasoning replaces these tokens with compact continuous states, but most autoregressive latent-reasoning methods retain a left-to-right dependency among latent vectors. We introduce LLoCoT: a looped latent-reasoning framework that replaces left-to-right latent generation with iterative refinement of a compact latent workspace. A shared transformer is reapplied for a small number of refinement iterations, jointly updating the latent slots based on the prompt and the evolving workspace state. Using the refined state, a probabilistic head predicts a distribution from which latent tokens are sampled in parallel and used to condition an autoregressive decoder for answer generation. Training uses continuous representations derived from explicit CoT together with a final-answer prediction loss and likelihood-based supervision of the latent states. Across HumanEval and MBPP, LLoCoT achieves the highest mean among the evaluated methods, performing on par in accuracy with Reasoning SFT, our explicit-CoT baseline, while outperforming the base model, answer-only SFT and NF-CoT. Relative to Reasoning SFT, LLoCoT reduces time to the first answer token by approximately $36\times$ and reasoning-phase latency by approximately $42\times$, while increasing end-to-end throughput by $9.2\%$. This design replaces serial thought generation with parallel latent-slot refinement while retaining probabilistic latent modeling and autoregressive answer decoding.

AI.tldr: LLoCoT提出一种循环式潜在推理框架，用对紧凑潜在工作区的迭代精炼替代自回归的从左到右潜在生成，实现并行化的潜在槽更新，在保持精度的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链（CoT）通过增加作答前的计算量提升语言模型性能，但将计算表达为自回归生成的token序列，导致串行开销大、延迟高。潜在推理用紧凑连续状态替代token，但多数自回归潜在推理方法仍保留潜在向量间的从左到右依赖，未能摆脱串行瓶颈。因此需要一种既能保留潜在建模优势、又能消除串行依赖的推理框架。
AI.method: 提出LLoCoT循环式潜在推理框架：用共享Transformer对紧凑潜在工作区进行少量迭代精炼，每次迭代基于提示和演化中的工作区状态联合更新潜在槽；精炼后的状态经概率头预测分布，并行采样潜在token，用于条件化自回归解码器生成答案。训练使用由显式CoT导出的连续表示，结合最终答案预测损失和潜在状态的似然监督。
AI.result: 在HumanEval和MBPP上，LLoCoT在所评估方法中取得最高均值，准确率与显式CoT基线Reasoning SFT相当，并优于base model、answer-only SFT和NF-CoT。相较Reasoning SFT，首答案token时间约降低36倍，推理阶段延迟约降低42倍，端到端吞吐提升约9.2%。
AI.conclusion: LLoCoT以并行潜在槽精炼替代串行思维生成，同时保留概率化潜在建模与自回归答案解码，在精度不劣化的前提下显著提升推理效率，验证了循环迭代精炼作为潜在推理范式的有效性。

title: BridgeGuard: Explicit Safety Drift for Diffusion-based Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion-based driving planners capture diverse behaviors but can generate unsafe trajectories under distribution shift. We propose BridgeGuard, a safety-constrained diffusion planning method that progressively strengthens a constraint term during denoising to drive intermediate trajectories toward a scene-dependent safety domain. Corrections operate in a low-dimensional curve space, promoting geometric coherence. A learned module, DistanceFieldNet, predicts a time-dependent distance field from bird's-eye-view features. Value and spatial-gradient supervision at queries sampled beyond expert trajectories teaches this field about both safe and unsafe regions. The learned field supplies the constraint term through safety injection while the pretrained perception backbone and planner remain frozen. We further establish sufficient conditions for terminal safety in an idealized continuous-time bridge. On Bench2Drive, BridgeGuard improves driving score/success rate from 87.99/74.99% to 90.88/76.36% for BridgeDrive and from 80.79/58.18% to 90.46/74.09% for $\text{DiffusionDrive}^{\text{geo}}$, demonstrating cross-model generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出BridgeGuard，一种安全约束扩散规划方法，通过在去噪过程中逐步增强约束项，将中间轨迹驱动至场景相关安全域，并在Bench2Drive上实现跨模型泛化提升。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的驾驶规划器虽能捕获多样行为，但在分布偏移下可能生成不安全轨迹。
AI.method: 在低维曲线空间中进行轨迹修正以保持几何一致性；训练DistanceFieldNet从鸟瞰图特征预测时变距离场，并在专家轨迹之外采样查询，用值与空间梯度监督学习安全与不安全区域；该场通过安全注入提供约束项，同时冻结预训练感知骨干与规划器；并在理想化连续时间桥中给出终端安全的充分条件。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive上，BridgeGuard将BridgeDrive的驾驶分数/成功率从87.99/74.99%提升至90.88/76.36%，将DiffusionDrive^geo从80.79/58.18%提升至90.46/74.09%，展现出跨模型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: BridgeGuard通过逐步增强的安全约束与学习到的距离场，有效提升扩散驾驶规划的安全性与成功率，且具备跨模型泛化性。

title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
